def main():

    print()
    print("=" * 72)
    print(
        "P2-C3 - ESPECIFICACIONES DEL BANCO SEED"
    )
    print("=" * 72)
    print()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T01 - ARCHIVOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    required_files = [
        SYLLABUS_FILE,
        GAP_PLAN_FILE,
    ]

    missing = [
        path
        for path in required_files
        if not path.exists()
    ]

    if missing:

        print(
            "[ERROR] Faltan archivos requeridos:"
        )

        for path in missing:

            print(
                f"  - {path}"
            )

        sys.exit(1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T02 - JSON
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:

        syllabus = load_json(
            SYLLABUS_FILE
        )

        plan = load_json(
            GAP_PLAN_FILE
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        print(
            f"[ERROR] No se pudo leer JSON: {exc}"
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T03 - VALIDAR P2-C2
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        plan.get(
            "stage"
        )
        != "P2-C2"
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] El plan de entrada "
            "no corresponde a P2-C2."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    if (
        plan.get(
            "policy_version"
        )
        != "p2c2_seed_v2"
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] Se esperaba "
            "policy_version=p2c2_seed_v2."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    summary = plan.get(
        "summary",
        {},
    )

    if (
        summary.get(
            "coverage_seed_questions_total"
        )
        != EXPECTED_SEED_TOTAL
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] P2-C2 no contiene "
            "las 76 preguntas seed esperadas."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    if (
        summary.get(
            "clusters_with_gaps"
        )
        != EXPECTED_CLUSTERS_WITH_GAPS
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] P2-C2 no contiene "
            "los 37 clusters con huecos esperados."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    coverage_counts = summary.get(
        "coverage_status_counts",
        {},
    )

    if (
        coverage_counts.get(
            "none",
            0,
        )
        != EXPECTED_ZERO_TOPICS
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] P2-C2 no conserva "
            "los 142 subtemas sin evidencia."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    print(
        "[OK] Checkpoint P2-C2 reconocido."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T04 - VALIDAR TEMARIO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    syllabus_topics = flatten_syllabus(
        syllabus
    )

    if (
        len(
            syllabus_topics
        )
        != EXPECTED_TOPICS
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] El registro canónico "
            f"contiene {len(syllabus_topics)} "
            "subtemas; se esperaban 202."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    syllabus_ids = [
        topic[
            "topic_id"
        ]
        for topic in syllabus_topics
    ]

    if (
        len(
            syllabus_ids
        )
        != len(
            set(
                syllabus_ids
            )
        )
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] Existen topic_id "
            "duplicados en el temario."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    syllabus_by_id = {
        topic[
            "topic_id"
        ]:
            topic
        for topic in syllabus_topics
    }

    print(
        "[OK] Registro canónico: 202 subtemas."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T05 - ÍNDICE DE CLUSTERS P2-C2
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    clusters = plan.get(
        "clusters",
        [],
    )

    cluster_lookup = {}

    for cluster in clusters:

        key = (
            cluster.get(
                "area"
            ),
            cluster.get(
                "unit"
            ),
            cluster.get(
                "cluster"
            ),
        )

        if key in cluster_lookup:

            print(
                "[ERROR] Cluster duplicado en P2-C2:"
            )

            print(
                key
            )

            sys.exit(1)

        cluster_lookup[
            key
        ] = cluster

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T06 - COLA DE GENERACIÓN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    queue = plan.get(
        "generation_queue",
        [],
    )

    if (
        len(
            queue
        )
        != EXPECTED_CLUSTERS_WITH_GAPS
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] La cola P2-C2 contiene "
            f"{len(queue)} clusters; "
            "se esperaban 37."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T07 - GENERAR SPECS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    specs = []

    global_spec_index = 1

    cluster_spec_counts = Counter()

    for queue_item in queue:

        area = queue_item.get(
            "area"
        )

        unit = queue_item.get(
            "unit"
        )

        cluster_name = queue_item.get(
            "cluster"
        )

        queue_position = queue_item.get(
            "queue_position"
        )

        priority = queue_item.get(
            "priority"
        )

        seed_count = queue_item.get(
            "coverage_seed_questions"
        )

        focus_ids = queue_item.get(
            "seed_focus_topic_ids",
            [],
        )

        key = (
            area,
            unit,
            cluster_name,
        )

        cluster = cluster_lookup.get(
            key
        )

        if cluster is None:

            print(
                "[ERROR] Cluster de la cola "
                "no existe en P2-C2:"
            )

            print(
                key
            )

            sys.exit(1)

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Coherencia cola ↔ cluster
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        if (
            seed_count
            != cluster.get(
                "coverage_seed_questions"
            )
        ):

            print(
                "[ERROR] Seed count inconsistente:"
            )

            print(
                key
            )

            sys.exit(1)

        cluster_focus_ids = cluster.get(
            "seed_focus_topic_ids",
            [],
        )

        if (
            set(
                focus_ids
            )
            != set(
                cluster_focus_ids
            )
        ):

            print(
                "[ERROR] Foco seed inconsistente:"
            )

            print(
                key
            )

            sys.exit(1)

        if not focus_ids:

            print(
                "[ERROR] Cluster seed sin "
                "subtemas objetivo:"
            )

            print(
                key
            )

            sys.exit(1)

        if (
            not isinstance(
                seed_count,
                int,
            )
            or seed_count < 1
            or seed_count > 3
        ):

            print(
                "[ERROR] Seed count inválido:"
            )

            print(
                key,
                seed_count,
            )

            sys.exit(1)

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Validar que los focos realmente pertenezcan
        # al cluster y estén sin evidencia.
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        cluster_topic_lookup = {
            topic.get(
                "topic_id"
            ):
                topic
            for topic in cluster.get(
                "topics",
                [],
            )
        }

        for topic_id in focus_ids:

            topic = cluster_topic_lookup.get(
                topic_id
            )

            if topic is None:

                print(
                    "[ERROR] Foco no pertenece "
                    "al cluster:"
                )

                print(
                    topic_id,
                    key,
                )

                sys.exit(1)

            if (
                topic.get(
                    "coverage_status"
                )
                != "none"
            ):

                print(
                    "[ERROR] Foco seed ya tiene "
                    "evidencia:"
                )

                print(
                    topic_id,
                    topic.get(
                        "coverage_status"
                    ),
                )

                sys.exit(1)

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Repartir objetivos entre specs.
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        groups = balanced_groups(
            focus_ids,
            seed_count,
        )

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Evitar preguntas excesivamente cargadas.
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        max_group_size = max(
            len(
                group
            )
            for group in groups
        )

        if (
            max_group_size
            > MAX_TARGET_TOPICS_PER_SPEC
        ):

            print(
                "[ERROR] El cluster requiere una "
                "pregunta con demasiados subtemas."
            )

            print(
                "Cluster:",
                key,
            )

            print(
                "Máximo detectado:",
                max_group_size,
            )

            print(
                "Máximo permitido:",
                MAX_TARGET_TOPICS_PER_SPEC,
            )

            print(
                "Revisar P2-C2 antes de continuar."
            )

            sys.exit(1)

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Crear cada spec.
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        for slot, target_ids in enumerate(
            groups,
            start=1,
        ):

            profile = slot_profile(
                slot,
                seed_count,
            )

            target_topics = []

            for topic_id in target_ids:

                official = syllabus_by_id.get(
                    topic_id
                )

                if official is None:

                    print(
                        "[ERROR] topic_id inexistente:"
                    )

                    print(
                        topic_id
                    )

                    sys.exit(1)

                if (
                    official[
                        "area"
                    ]
                    != area
                    or official[
                        "unit"
                    ]
                    != unit
                    or official[
                        "cluster"
                    ]
                    != cluster_name
                ):

                    print(
                        "[ERROR] El topic_id no "
                        "pertenece al cluster esperado:"
                    )

                    print(
                        topic_id
                    )

                    sys.exit(1)

                target_topics.append(
                    {
                        "topic_id":
                            topic_id,

                        "label":
                            official[
                                "label"
                            ],
                    }
                )

            primary = target_topics[
                0
            ]

            secondaries = target_topics[
                1:
            ]

            spec_id = (
                f"SEED-"
                f"{global_spec_index:03d}"
            )

            spec = {
                "spec_id":
                    spec_id,

                "spec_version":
                    "p2c3_seed_specs_v1",

                "stage":
                    "P2-C3",

                "origin":
                    "generated_reinforcement_spec",

                "intended_bank":
                    "reinforcement_bank",

                "official_utn_question":
                    False,

                "area":
                    area,

                "unit":
                    unit,

                "cluster":
                    cluster_name,

                "cluster_priority":
                    priority,

                "queue_position":
                    queue_position,

                "slot_in_cluster":
                    slot,

                "cluster_seed_count":
                    seed_count,

                "primary_topic_id":
                    primary[
                        "topic_id"
                    ],

                "primary_topic_label":
                    primary[
                        "label"
                    ],

                "secondary_topic_ids": [
                    topic[
                        "topic_id"
                    ]
                    for topic
                    in secondaries
                ],

                "secondary_topic_labels": [
                    topic[
                        "label"
                    ]
                    for topic
                    in secondaries
                ],

                "target_topic_ids": [
                    topic[
                        "topic_id"
                    ]
                    for topic
                    in target_topics
                ],

                "target_topic_labels": [
                    topic[
                        "label"
                    ]
                    for topic
                    in target_topics
                ],

                "target_topic_count":
                    len(
                        target_topics
                    ),

                **profile,

                "requirements":
                    common_item_requirements(),

                "coverage_rule":
                    (
                        "La pregunta generada debe evaluar "
                        "de manera real y verificable todos "
                        "los target_topic_ids indicados. "
                        "No marcar cobertura por mera "
                        "mención superficial."
                    ),

                "generation_notes": [
                    (
                        "Mantener dificultad coherente con "
                        "una evaluación preuniversitaria."
                    ),
                    (
                        "No depender de conocimientos "
                        "fuera del temario objetivo."
                    ),
                    (
                        "No usar ponderación específica "
                        "por carrera."
                    ),
                    (
                        "No presentar el ítem como "
                        "pregunta auténtica de admisión UTN."
                    ),
                ],
            }

            specs.append(
                spec
            )

            cluster_spec_counts[
                key
            ] += 1

            global_spec_index += 1

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T08 - VALIDAR TOTAL DE SPECS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        len(
            specs
        )
        != EXPECTED_SEED_TOTAL
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] Se generaron "
            f"{len(specs)} specs; "
            "se esperaban 76."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T09 - IDS ÚNICOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    spec_ids = [
        spec[
            "spec_id"
        ]
        for spec in specs
    ]

    if (
        len(
            spec_ids
        )
        != len(
            set(
                spec_ids
            )
        )
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] Existen spec_id duplicados."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    expected_spec_ids = [
        f"SEED-{index:03d}"
        for index in range(
            1,
            EXPECTED_SEED_TOTAL + 1,
        )
    ]

    if (
        spec_ids
        != expected_spec_ids
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] Los spec_id no son "
            "secuenciales SEED-001..SEED-076."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T10 - VALIDAR SPECS POR CLUSTER
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    for queue_item in queue:

        key = (
            queue_item.get(
                "area"
            ),
            queue_item.get(
                "unit"
            ),
            queue_item.get(
                "cluster"
            ),
        )

        expected = queue_item.get(
            "coverage_seed_questions"
        )

        actual = cluster_spec_counts.get(
            key,
            0,
        )

        if actual != expected:

            print(
                "[ERROR] Número de specs "
                "incorrecto para cluster:"
            )

            print(
                key
            )

            print(
                "Esperado:",
                expected,
            )

            print(
                "Actual:",
                actual,
            )

            sys.exit(1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T11 - TODOS LOS 142 VACÍOS DEBEN ESTAR
    #       REPRESENTADOS AL MENOS UNA VEZ
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    expected_focus_ids = set()

    for queue_item in queue:

        expected_focus_ids.update(
            queue_item.get(
                "seed_focus_topic_ids",
                [],
            )
        )

    actual_target_ids = set()

    topic_occurrences = Counter()

    for spec in specs:

        for topic_id in spec[
            "target_topic_ids"
        ]:

            actual_target_ids.add(
                topic_id
            )

            topic_occurrences[
                topic_id
            ] += 1

    if (
        len(
            expected_focus_ids
        )
        != EXPECTED_ZERO_TOPICS
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] P2-C2 no contiene "
            "142 focos seed únicos."
        )

        print(
            "Detectados:",
            len(
                expected_focus_ids
            ),
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    if (
        actual_target_ids
        != expected_focus_ids
    ):

        missing_targets = sorted(
            expected_focus_ids
            - actual_target_ids
        )

        extra_targets = sorted(
            actual_target_ids
            - expected_focus_ids
        )

        print(
            "[ERROR] Las specs no cubren exactamente "
            "los 142 objetivos seed."
        )

        print(
            "Faltan:",
            missing_targets,
        )

        print(
            "Sobran:",
            extra_targets,
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T12 - NINGÚN TARGET AJENO AL TEMARIO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    official_id_set = set(
        syllabus_ids
    )

    invalid_ids = sorted(
        actual_target_ids
        - official_id_set
    )

    if invalid_ids:

        print(
            "[ERROR] Specs con topic_id "
            "no oficiales:"
        )

        print(
            invalid_ids
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T13 - ÁREAS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    specs_by_area = Counter(
        spec[
            "area"
        ]
        for spec in specs
    )

    normalized_area_specs = {
        area:
            specs_by_area.get(
                area,
                0,
            )
        for area in sorted(
            OFFICIAL_AREAS
        )
    }

    if (
        normalized_area_specs
        != EXPECTED_AREA_SEED
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] Distribución seed "
            "por área incorrecta."
        )

        print(
            normalized_area_specs
        )

        print(
            "Esperado:"
        )

        print(
            EXPECTED_AREA_SEED
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T14 - ESTADÍSTICA NO DEBE TENER SPECS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    statistics_specs = [
        spec
        for spec in specs
        if spec[
            "area"
        ]
        == "Estadística"
    ]

    if statistics_specs:

        print(
            "[ERROR] Estadística recibió "
            "specs seed."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T15 - BIOLOGÍA NO DEBE APARECER
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    biology_specs = [
        spec
        for spec in specs
        if str(
            spec.get(
                "area",
                ""
            )
        ).casefold()
        == "biología".casefold()
    ]

    if biology_specs:

        print(
            "[ERROR] Biología apareció "
            "en las specs FICA."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T16 - NO MÁS DE 4 SUBTEMAS POR SPEC
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    overloaded_specs = [
        spec
        for spec in specs
        if spec[
            "target_topic_count"
        ]
        > MAX_TARGET_TOPICS_PER_SPEC
    ]

    if overloaded_specs:

        print(
            "[ERROR] Existen specs con más "
            "de 4 subtemas objetivo."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T17 - CADA SPEC DEBE TENER AL MENOS
    #       UN OBJETIVO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    empty_specs = [
        spec
        for spec in specs
        if not spec[
            "target_topic_ids"
        ]
    ]

    if empty_specs:

        print(
            "[ERROR] Existen specs sin "
            "subtema objetivo."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T18 - NINGUNA SPEC PUEDE SER OFICIAL UTN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    falsely_official = [
        spec
        for spec in specs
        if spec.get(
            "official_utn_question"
        )
        is not False
    ]

    if falsely_official:

        print(
            "[ERROR] Alguna spec fue marcada "
            "como pregunta oficial UTN."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T19 - TODAS LAS SPECS DEBEN SER NATIVAS
    #       Y NO DEPENDER DE PDF ORIGINAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    rendering_errors = []

    for spec in specs:

        requirements = spec.get(
            "requirements",
            {},
        )

        if (
            requirements.get(
                "rendering"
            )
            != "native_text"
        ):

            rendering_errors.append(
                spec[
                    "spec_id"
                ]
            )

            continue

        if (
            requirements.get(
                "requires_original_pdf"
            )
            is not False
        ):

            rendering_errors.append(
                spec[
                    "spec_id"
                ]
            )

    if rendering_errors:

        print(
            "[ERROR] Specs incompatibles "
            "con banco generado nativo:"
        )

        print(
            rendering_errors
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # RESUMEN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    specs_by_priority = Counter(
        spec[
            "cluster_priority"
        ]
        for spec in specs
    )

    specs_by_difficulty = Counter(
        spec[
            "difficulty"
        ]
        for spec in specs
    )

    specs_by_cognitive_target = Counter(
        spec[
            "cognitive_target"
        ]
        for spec in specs
    )

    target_count_distribution = Counter(
        spec[
            "target_topic_count"
        ]
        for spec in specs
    )

    max_targets = max(
        spec[
            "target_topic_count"
        ]
        for spec in specs
    )

    total_target_assignments = sum(
        spec[
            "target_topic_count"
        ]
        for spec in specs
    )

    repeated_target_assignments = (
        total_target_assignments
        - len(
            actual_target_ids
        )
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # INFORME JSON
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    report = {
        "stage":
            "P2-C3",

        "spec_version":
            "p2c3_seed_specs_v1",

        "title":
            (
                "Especificaciones de generación "
                "del banco seed FICA"
            ),

        "scope": {
            "period":
                "2P2026",

            "group":
                "FICA",

            "common_syllabus":
                True,

            "career_specific_weighting":
                False,

            "official_topic_count":
                EXPECTED_TOPICS,

            "source_gap_plan":
                "p2c2_seed_v2",
        },

        "generation_contract": {
            "purpose":
                (
                    "Crear material inicial de refuerzo "
                    "para cubrir subtemas sin evidencia."
                ),

            "question_count":
                EXPECTED_SEED_TOTAL,

            "target_topic_count":
                EXPECTED_ZERO_TOPICS,

            "generated_items_are_official_utn_questions":
                False,

            "generated_items_modify_original_bank":
                False,

            "intended_output_bank":
                "data/reinforcement_bank.json",

            "adaptive_followup_included":
                False,

            "note":
                (
                    "Estas son especificaciones de diseño. "
                    "Las preguntas todavía no han sido "
                    "generadas."
                ),
        },

        "summary": {
            "spec_count":
                len(
                    specs
                ),

            "clusters_represented":
                len(
                    cluster_spec_counts
                ),

            "unique_target_topics":
                len(
                    actual_target_ids
                ),

            "total_target_assignments":
                total_target_assignments,

            "repeated_target_assignments":
                repeated_target_assignments,

            "max_target_topics_per_spec":
                max_targets,

            "specs_by_area":
                dict(
                    sorted(
                        specs_by_area.items()
                    )
                ),

            "specs_by_priority":
                dict(
                    sorted(
                        specs_by_priority.items()
                    )
                ),

            "specs_by_difficulty":
                dict(
                    sorted(
                        specs_by_difficulty.items()
                    )
                ),

            "specs_by_cognitive_target":
                dict(
                    sorted(
                        specs_by_cognitive_target.items()
                    )
                ),

            "target_count_distribution":
                {
                    str(
                        key
                    ):
                        value
                    for key, value
                    in sorted(
                        target_count_distribution.items()
                    )
                },
        },

        "target_topic_occurrences":
            dict(
                sorted(
                    topic_occurrences.items()
                )
            ),

        "specs":
            specs,
    }

    RESULTS_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    JSON_REPORT.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            report,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # INFORME TXT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    lines = []

    lines.append(
        "=" * 72
    )

    lines.append(
        "P2-C3 - ESPECIFICACIONES DEL BANCO SEED"
    )

    lines.append(
        "=" * 72
    )

    lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        "Alcance: temario común FICA 2P2026"
    )

    lines.append(
        "Ponderación específica por carrera: NO"
    )

    lines.append(
        "Preguntas oficiales UTN generadas: NO"
    )

    lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        "RESUMEN"
    )

    lines.append(
        "-" * 72
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Specs seed                  : "
        f"{len(specs)}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Clusters representados      : "
        f"{len(cluster_spec_counts)}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Subtemas objetivo únicos    : "
        f"{len(actual_target_ids)}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Asignaciones de subtema     : "
        f"{total_target_assignments}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Asignaciones repetidas      : "
        f"{repeated_target_assignments}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Máximo subtemas por spec    : "
        f"{max_targets}"
    )

    lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        "POR ÁREA"
    )

    lines.append(
        "-" * 72
    )

    for area in sorted(
        OFFICIAL_AREAS
    ):

        lines.append(
            f"{area:<16}: "
            f"{specs_by_area.get(area, 0)} specs"
        )

    lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        "POR DIFICULTAD"
    )

    lines.append(
        "-" * 72
    )

    for difficulty in [
        "foundation",
        "standard",
        "transfer",
    ]:

        lines.append(
            f"{difficulty:<16}: "
            f"{specs_by_difficulty.get(difficulty, 0)}"
        )

    lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        "ESPECIFICACIONES"
    )

    lines.append(
        "-" * 72
    )

    for spec in specs:

        lines.append(
            f"{spec['spec_id']} | "
            f"{spec['area']} | "
            f"{spec['unit']} | "
            f"{spec['cluster']}"
        )

        lines.append(
            f"  prioridad : "
            f"{spec['cluster_priority']}"
        )

        lines.append(
            f"  slot      : "
            f"{spec['slot_in_cluster']}/"
            f"{spec['cluster_seed_count']}"
        )

        lines.append(
            f"  dificultad: "
            f"{spec['difficulty']}"
        )

        lines.append(
            f"  cognitivo : "
            f"{spec['cognitive_target']}"
        )

        lines.append(
            "  objetivos : "
            + ", ".join(
                spec[
                    "target_topic_ids"
                ]
            )
        )

        lines.append(
            "  temas     : "
            + " | ".join(
                spec[
                    "target_topic_labels"
                ]
            )
        )

        lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        "REGLAS"
    )

    lines.append(
        "-" * 72
    )

    lines.append(
        "- Cada spec debe producir exactamente "
        "una pregunta de opción múltiple."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- Cada pregunta debe tener una sola "
        "respuesta correcta."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- Todos los target_topic_ids deben ser "
        "evaluados de forma real, no solo mencionados."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- El material será nativo y no dependerá "
        "de los PDF originales."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- No copiar preguntas existentes."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- No presentar material generado como "
        "preguntas oficiales UTN."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- No aplicar ponderación específica "
        "por carrera."
    )

    TXT_REPORT.write_text(
        "\n".join(
            lines
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # CONSOLA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    print(
        "[OK] P2-C2 validado."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Temario canónico validado."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] 76 especificaciones creadas."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] 37 clusters representados."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] 142 subtemas vacíos incluidos."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Ningún subtema fuera del temario."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Estadística recibe 0 specs."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Biología recibe 0 specs."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Ninguna spec se marca como "
        "pregunta oficial UTN."
    )

    print()

    print(
        "DISTRIBUCIÓN POR ÁREA"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 72
    )

    for area in sorted(
        OFFICIAL_AREAS
    ):

        print(
            f"{area:<16}: "
            f"{specs_by_area.get(area, 0)}"
        )

    print()

    print(
        "DISTRIBUCIÓN PEDAGÓGICA"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 72
    )

    for difficulty in [
        "foundation",
        "standard",
        "transfer",
    ]:

        print(
            f"{difficulty:<16}: "
            f"{specs_by_difficulty.get(difficulty, 0)}"
        )

    print()

    print(
        "COBERTURA DE SPECS"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 72
    )

    print(
        "Specs totales               :",
        len(
            specs
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Subtemas objetivo únicos     :",
        len(
            actual_target_ids
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Asignaciones totales         :",
        total_target_assignments,
    )

    print(
        "Asignaciones repetidas       :",
        repeated_target_assignments,
    )

    print(
        "Máximo subtemas por pregunta :",
        max_targets,
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"Informe JSON: {JSON_REPORT}"
    )

    print(
        f"Informe TXT : {TXT_REPORT}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "IMPORTANTE:"
    )

    print(
        "- NO se modificó question_bank.json."
    )

    print(
        "- NO se creó reinforcement_bank.json."
    )

    print(
        "- NO se generaron preguntas todavía."
    )

    print(
        "- Este parche solo crea contratos "
        "de generación."
    )

    print()

    print(
        "RESULTADO: P2-C3 SPECS SEED GENERADAS"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path


# ============================================================
# RUTAS
# ============================================================

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

SYLLABUS_FILE = (
    ROOT
    / "data"
    / "utn_fica_2p2026_syllabus.json"
)

CROSSWALK_FILE = (
    ROOT
    / "results"
    / "p2c_crosswalk_audit.json"
)

RESULTS_DIR = ROOT / "results"

JSON_REPORT = (
    RESULTS_DIR
    / "p2c_gap_plan.json"
)

TXT_REPORT = (
    RESULTS_DIR
    / "p2c_gap_plan.txt"
)


# ============================================================
# CONSTANTES
# ============================================================

EXPECTED_SYLLABUS_TOPICS = 202
EXPECTED_BANK_QUESTIONS = 180
EXPECTED_ELIGIBLE_QUESTIONS = 163

OFFICIAL_AREAS = {
    "Matemática",
    "Física",
    "Química",
    "Lenguaje",
    "Estadística",
}

EXPECTED_AREA_COUNTS = {
    "Matemática": 63,
    "Física": 38,
    "Química": 56,
    "Lenguaje": 39,
    "Estadística": 6,
}


# ============================================================
# POLÍTICA DE COBERTURA
#
# Esto mide cobertura del banco.
# NO representa ponderación oficial UTN.
# ============================================================

def coverage_status(
    question_count: int,
) -> str:

    if question_count <= 0:
        return "none"

    if question_count == 1:
        return "critical"

    if question_count == 2:
        return "weak"

    if question_count <= 4:
        return "basic"

    return "sufficient"


def reinforcement_level(
    status: str,
) -> str:

    return {
        "none":
            "required",

        "critical":
            "recommended",

        "weak":
            "recommended",

        "basic":
            "optional",

        "sufficient":
            "none",
    }[
        status
    ]


# ============================================================
# UTILIDADES
# ============================================================

def load_json(
    path: Path,
):

    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def safe_ratio(
    numerator,
    denominator,
):

    if denominator == 0:
        return 0.0

    return (
        numerator
        / denominator
    )


def flatten_syllabus(
    syllabus,
):

    entries = []

    for area in syllabus.get(
        "areas",
        [],
    ):

        area_name = area.get(
            "name"
        )

        for unit in area.get(
            "units",
            [],
        ):

            unit_name = unit.get(
                "name"
            )

            for cluster in unit.get(
                "clusters",
                [],
            ):

                cluster_name = cluster.get(
                    "name"
                )

                for topic in cluster.get(
                    "topics",
                    [],
                ):

                    entries.append(
                        {
                            "topic_id":
                                topic.get("id"),

                            "area":
                                area_name,

                            "unit":
                                unit_name,

                            "cluster":
                                cluster_name,

                            "label":
                                topic.get("label"),
                        }
                    )

    return entries


# ============================================================
# P2-C2 v2
# POLÍTICA DE GENERACIÓN INICIAL
#
# OBJETIVO:
# cerrar amplitud del temario sin inflar el banco.
#
# NO intentamos conseguir 5 preguntas por subtema.
#
# Las preguntas generadas deben diseñarse para poder trabajar
# varios subtemas relacionados cuando pedagógicamente tenga
# sentido.
#
# Máximo inicial:
# 3 preguntas nuevas por cluster.
#
# Si un cluster ya tiene evidencia en TODOS sus subtemas:
# 0 preguntas nuevas en esta fase.
#
# La profundidad se añadirá posteriormente de forma adaptativa
# según desempeño real del estudiante.
# ============================================================

def calculate_seed_target(
    topic_count,
    zero_count,
):

    if topic_count <= 0:
        return 0

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Sin huecos oficiales:
    # reutilizamos el banco existente.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if zero_count == 0:
        return 0

    zero_ratio = safe_ratio(
        zero_count,
        topic_count,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # NIVEL 1
    #
    # Hay al menos un hueco.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    target = 1

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # NIVEL 2
    #
    # Hay varios huecos o al menos la mitad del cluster
    # está descubierta.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        zero_count >= 3
        or zero_ratio >= 0.50
    ):

        target = 2

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # NIVEL 3
    #
    # Cluster grande y muy descubierto.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        zero_count >= 6
        or (
            topic_count >= 8
            and zero_ratio >= 0.70
        )
    ):

        target = 3

    return target


# ============================================================
# PRIORIDAD DEL CLUSTER
#
# Prioridad = carencia del banco.
# No ponderación del examen.
# ============================================================

def classify_cluster_priority(
    topic_count,
    zero_count,
):

    if topic_count <= 0:
        return "none"

    if zero_count == 0:
        return "covered"

    zero_ratio = safe_ratio(
        zero_count,
        topic_count,
    )

    if (
        zero_count >= 6
        or zero_ratio >= 0.75
    ):

        return "very_high"

    if (
        zero_count >= 3
        or zero_ratio >= 0.50
    ):

        return "high"

    return "medium"


# ============================================================
# TIPO DE HUECO
# ============================================================

def classify_gap_type(
    status,
    cluster_zero_ratio,
):

    if status == "none":

        if cluster_zero_ratio >= 0.75:
            return "cluster_gap"

        return "topic_gap"

    if status in {
        "critical",
        "weak",
    }:
        return "thin_evidence"

    if status == "basic":
        return "reinforcement_opportunity"

    return "covered"


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main():

    print()
    print("=" * 72)
    print(
        "P2-C2 - DIAGNÓSTICO DE VACÍOS "
        "Y PLAN INICIAL DE REFUERZO"
    )
    print("=" * 72)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. ARCHIVOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    missing_files = []

    if not SYLLABUS_FILE.exists():

        missing_files.append(
            str(
                SYLLABUS_FILE
            )
        )

    if not CROSSWALK_FILE.exists():

        missing_files.append(
            str(
                CROSSWALK_FILE
            )
        )

    if missing_files:

        print(
            "[ERROR] Faltan archivos requeridos:"
        )

        for path in missing_files:

            print(
                f"  - {path}"
            )

        sys.exit(1)

    RESULTS_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    try:

        syllabus = load_json(
            SYLLABUS_FILE
        )

        audit = load_json(
            CROSSWALK_FILE
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        print(
            f"[ERROR] No se pudo leer JSON: {exc}"
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. VALIDAR P2-C1
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        audit.get(
            "stage"
        )
        != "P2-C1"
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] El crosswalk no corresponde a P2-C1."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    if (
        audit.get(
            "total_bank_questions"
        )
        != EXPECTED_BANK_QUESTIONS
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] P2-C1 no contiene "
            "las 180 preguntas esperadas."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    if (
        audit.get(
            "eligible_p2b_questions"
        )
        != EXPECTED_ELIGIBLE_QUESTIONS
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] P2-C1 no contiene "
            "las 163 preguntas elegibles esperadas."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    pending = audit.get(
        "pending_crosswalk_count",
        None,
    )

    if pending is None:

        status_counts = audit.get(
            "crosswalk_status_counts",
            {},
        )

        pending = sum(
            status_counts.get(
                status,
                0,
            )
            for status in [
                "review",
                "unmatched",
                "no_candidates",
            ]
        )

    if pending != 0:

        print(
            "[ERROR] P2-C1 todavía contiene "
            f"{pending} correspondencias pendientes."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    unit_errors = audit.get(
        "unit_errors",
        [],
    )

    if unit_errors:

        print(
            "[ERROR] P2-C1 todavía contiene "
            f"{len(unit_errors)} problemas de unidad."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    print(
        "[OK] P2-C1 completamente resuelto."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. VALIDAR REGISTRO CANÓNICO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    syllabus_entries = flatten_syllabus(
        syllabus
    )

    if (
        len(syllabus_entries)
        != EXPECTED_SYLLABUS_TOPICS
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] Registro oficial: "
            f"{len(syllabus_entries)} subtemas; "
            f"se esperaban {EXPECTED_SYLLABUS_TOPICS}."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    topic_ids = [
        entry[
            "topic_id"
        ]
        for entry in syllabus_entries
    ]

    if (
        len(topic_ids)
        != len(
            set(
                topic_ids
            )
        )
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] Existen topic_id duplicados."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    area_counts = Counter(
        entry[
            "area"
        ]
        for entry in syllabus_entries
    )

    if (
        dict(
            area_counts
        )
        != EXPECTED_AREA_COUNTS
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] Distribución de áreas "
            "distinta de P2-C0."
        )

        print(
            dict(
                area_counts
            )
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    print(
        "[OK] Registro canónico: 202 subtemas."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. RECUPERAR EVIDENCIA P2-C1
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    evidence_by_topic = defaultdict(
        set
    )

    accepted_statuses = {
        "exact",
        "strong",
        "manual",
    }

    for item in audit.get(
        "crosswalk",
        [],
    ):

        if (
            item.get(
                "match_status"
            )
            not in accepted_statuses
        ):

            continue

        question_ids = item.get(
            "question_ids",
            [],
        )

        primary = item.get(
            "best_candidate"
        )

        if primary:

            topic_id = primary.get(
                "topic_id"
            )

            if topic_id:

                evidence_by_topic[
                    topic_id
                ].update(
                    question_ids
                )

        for secondary in item.get(
            "secondary_candidates",
            [],
        ):

            topic_id = secondary.get(
                "topic_id"
            )

            if topic_id:

                evidence_by_topic[
                    topic_id
                ].update(
                    question_ids
                )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. VALIDAR IDS DE EVIDENCIA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    official_ids = set(
        topic_ids
    )

    unknown_ids = sorted(
        set(
            evidence_by_topic.keys()
        )
        - official_ids
    )

    if unknown_ids:

        print(
            "[ERROR] Evidencia apuntando a "
            "topic_id inexistentes:"
        )

        for topic_id in unknown_ids:

            print(
                f"  - {topic_id}"
            )

        sys.exit(1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. COBERTURA INDIVIDUAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    topic_rows = []

    for entry in syllabus_entries:

        question_ids = sorted(
            evidence_by_topic.get(
                entry[
                    "topic_id"
                ],
                set(),
            )
        )

        count = len(
            question_ids
        )

        status = coverage_status(
            count
        )

        topic_rows.append(
            {
                **entry,

                "existing_question_count":
                    count,

                "question_ids":
                    question_ids,

                "coverage_status":
                    status,

                "reinforcement":
                    reinforcement_level(
                        status
                    ),
            }
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 7. AGRUPAR POR CLUSTER
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    topics_by_cluster = defaultdict(
        list
    )

    for topic in topic_rows:

        key = (
            topic[
                "area"
            ],
            topic[
                "unit"
            ],
            topic[
                "cluster"
            ],
        )

        topics_by_cluster[
            key
        ].append(
            topic
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 8. DIAGNÓSTICO DE CLUSTERS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    cluster_rows = []

    for (
        area,
        unit,
        cluster,
    ), topics in sorted(
        topics_by_cluster.items(),
        key=lambda item: (
            item[0][0],
            item[0][1],
            item[0][2],
        ),
    ):

        status_counts = Counter(
            topic[
                "coverage_status"
            ]
            for topic in topics
        )

        topic_count = len(
            topics
        )

        zero_count = status_counts.get(
            "none",
            0,
        )

        critical_count = status_counts.get(
            "critical",
            0,
        )

        weak_count = status_counts.get(
            "weak",
            0,
        )

        basic_count = status_counts.get(
            "basic",
            0,
        )

        sufficient_count = status_counts.get(
            "sufficient",
            0,
        )

        existing_question_ids = set()

        for topic in topics:

            existing_question_ids.update(
                topic[
                    "question_ids"
                ]
            )

        existing_evidence = len(
            existing_question_ids
        )

        zero_ratio = safe_ratio(
            zero_count,
            topic_count,
        )

        covered_count = (
            topic_count
            - zero_count
        )

        priority = classify_cluster_priority(
            topic_count=
                topic_count,

            zero_count=
                zero_count,
        )

        seed_target = calculate_seed_target(
            topic_count=
                topic_count,

            zero_count=
                zero_count,
        )

        enriched_topics = []

        for topic in topics:

            status = topic[
                "coverage_status"
            ]

            enriched_topics.append(
                {
                    **topic,

                    "gap_type":
                        classify_gap_type(
                            status,
                            zero_ratio,
                        ),

                    "include_in_seed_focus":
                        status
                        == "none",

                    "include_in_adaptive_followup":
                        status
                        in {
                            "critical",
                            "weak",
                            "basic",
                        },
                }
            )

        seed_focus_ids = [
            topic[
                "topic_id"
            ]
            for topic in enriched_topics
            if topic[
                "include_in_seed_focus"
            ]
        ]

        followup_ids = [
            topic[
                "topic_id"
            ]
            for topic in enriched_topics
            if topic[
                "include_in_adaptive_followup"
            ]
        ]

        cluster_rows.append(
            {
                "area":
                    area,

                "unit":
                    unit,

                "cluster":
                    cluster,

                "official_topic_count":
                    topic_count,

                "covered_topic_count":
                    covered_count,

                "uncovered_topic_count":
                    zero_count,

                "coverage_ratio":
                    round(
                        safe_ratio(
                            covered_count,
                            topic_count,
                        ),
                        4,
                    ),

                "existing_unique_question_evidence":
                    existing_evidence,

                "coverage_status_counts": {
                    "none":
                        zero_count,

                    "critical":
                        critical_count,

                    "weak":
                        weak_count,

                    "basic":
                        basic_count,

                    "sufficient":
                        sufficient_count,
                },

                "priority":
                    priority,

                "coverage_seed_questions":
                    seed_target,

                "adaptive_followup_questions":
                    "dynamic",

                "generation_strategy":
                    (
                        "shared_cluster_questions"
                        if seed_target > 0
                        else "reuse_existing_bank"
                    ),

                "seed_focus_topic_ids":
                    seed_focus_ids,

                "adaptive_followup_topic_ids":
                    followup_ids,

                "topics":
                    enriched_topics,
            }
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 9. RESUMEN GLOBAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    global_status_counts = Counter(
        topic[
            "coverage_status"
        ]
        for topic in topic_rows
    )

    global_reinforcement_counts = Counter(
        topic[
            "reinforcement"
        ]
        for topic in topic_rows
    )

    global_cluster_priorities = Counter(
        cluster[
            "priority"
        ]
        for cluster in cluster_rows
    )

    total_seed_questions = sum(
        cluster[
            "coverage_seed_questions"
        ]
        for cluster in cluster_rows
    )

    clusters_with_gaps = sum(
        1
        for cluster in cluster_rows
        if cluster[
            "uncovered_topic_count"
        ] > 0
    )

    clusters_without_gaps = (
        len(
            cluster_rows
        )
        - clusters_with_gaps
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 10. RESUMEN POR ÁREA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    area_summary = {}

    for area in sorted(
        OFFICIAL_AREAS
    ):

        area_topics = [
            topic
            for topic in topic_rows
            if topic[
                "area"
            ]
            == area
        ]

        area_clusters = [
            cluster
            for cluster in cluster_rows
            if cluster[
                "area"
            ]
            == area
        ]

        covered = sum(
            1
            for topic in area_topics
            if topic[
                "existing_question_count"
            ] > 0
        )

        seed_questions = sum(
            cluster[
                "coverage_seed_questions"
            ]
            for cluster in area_clusters
        )

        area_summary[
            area
        ] = {
            "official_topics":
                len(
                    area_topics
                ),

            "topics_with_evidence":
                covered,

            "topics_without_evidence":
                len(
                    area_topics
                )
                - covered,

            "coverage_ratio":
                round(
                    safe_ratio(
                        covered,
                        len(
                            area_topics
                        ),
                    ),
                    4,
                ),

            "cluster_count":
                len(
                    area_clusters
                ),

            "clusters_with_gaps":
                sum(
                    1
                    for cluster in area_clusters
                    if cluster[
                        "uncovered_topic_count"
                    ] > 0
                ),

            "coverage_seed_questions":
                seed_questions,
        }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 11. COLA PARA PRIMERA EXPANSIÓN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    priority_rank = {
        "very_high": 0,
        "high": 1,
        "medium": 2,
        "covered": 3,
        "none": 4,
    }

    generation_queue = sorted(
        [
            {

                        "unit"
                    ],

    # --------------------------------------------------------

# ============================================================
# UTILIDADES
# ============================================================

def sha256(path: Path) -> str:

    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open("rb") as f:

        for chunk in iter(
            lambda: f.read(65536),
            b"",
        ):
            digest.update(chunk)

    return digest.hexdigest()


def slug(text: str) -> str:

    normalized = unicodedata.normalize(
        "NFKD",
        text,
    )

    ascii_text = "".join(
        char
        for char in normalized
        if not unicodedata.combining(char)
    )

    ascii_text = ascii_text.lower()

    ascii_text = re.sub(
        r"[^a-z0-9]+",
        "_",
        ascii_text,
    )

    return ascii_text.strip("_")


def clean_lines(text: str) -> list[str]:

    raw = []

    for line in text.splitlines():

        line = line.replace(
            "ﬂ",
            "fl",
        )

        line = re.sub(
            r"\s+",
            " ",
            line,
        ).strip()

        if not line:
            continue

        if line in {
            "Unidades",
            "Temas",
        }:
            continue

        raw.append(line)

    # Algunas celdas largas del PDF se parten en
    # dos líneas. Una continuación que comienza
    # en minúscula se une a la línea anterior.
    cleaned = []

    for line in raw:

        if (
            cleaned
            and line
            and line[0].islower()
        ):

            cleaned[-1] = (
                cleaned[-1]
                + " "
                + line
            )

        else:

            cleaned.append(line)

    return cleaned


def download_official_pdf():

    SOURCES_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    if PDF_FILE.exists():

        print(
            "[OK] PDF oficial ya existe:"
        )

        print(
            f"     {PDF_FILE}"
        )

        return

    print(
        "[INFO] Descargando temario oficial UTN..."
    )

    try:

        urllib.request.urlretrieve(
            SOURCE_URL,
            PDF_FILE,
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        print(
            "[ERROR] No se pudo descargar "
            f"el PDF oficial: {exc}"
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    print(
        "[OK] PDF oficial descargado."
    )


def find_topic_groups(
    doc,
    page_number: int,
    needle: str,
) -> list[list[str]]:

    page = doc[
        page_number
    ]

    try:

        tables = (
            page
            .find_tables()
            .tables
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        print(
            "[ERROR] PyMuPDF no pudo detectar "
            f"tablas en página {page_number + 1}: "
            f"{exc}"
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    for table in tables:

        data = table.extract()

        flattened = "\n".join(
            ""
            if cell is None
            else str(cell)
            for row in data
            for cell in row
        )

        if (
            needle.casefold()
            not in flattened.casefold()
        ):
            continue

        groups = []

        for row in data:

            if len(row) < 2:
                continue

            topic_cell = row[1]

            if not topic_cell:
                continue

            lines = clean_lines(
                str(topic_cell)
            )

            if (
                lines
                and lines[0]
                == "Temas"
            ):
                lines = lines[1:]

            if lines:
                groups.append(lines)

        if groups:
            return groups

    print(
        "[ERROR] No se encontró la tabla "
        f"esperada en página {page_number + 1}: "
        f"{needle}"
    )

    sys.exit(1)


# ============================================================
# CONSTRUCCIÓN DE LA ESTRUCTURA
# ============================================================

def direct_unit(
    unit_id,
    name,
    topics,
):

    return {
        "id": unit_id,
        "name": name,
        "clusters": [
            {
                "id": (
                    unit_id
                    + "_contenido"
                ),
                "name": name,
                "topics": topics,
            }
        ],
    }


def grouped_unit(
    unit_id,
    name,
    groups,
):

    clusters = []

    for number, group in enumerate(
        groups,
        start=1,
    ):

        if len(group) < 2:

            print(
                "[ERROR] Grupo matemático "
                f"demasiado corto: {group}"
            )

            sys.exit(1)

        cluster_name = (
            group[0]
            .rstrip(":")
            .strip()
        )

        clusters.append(
            {
                "id": (
                    f"{unit_id}_"
                    f"{number:02d}_"
                    f"{slug(cluster_name)}"
                ),
                "name": cluster_name,
                "topics": group[1:],
            }
        )

    return {
        "id": unit_id,
        "name": name,
        "clusters": clusters,
    }

        (
            "qui_hidrocarburos_abiertos",
            "HIDROCARBUROS DE CADENA ABIERTA",
        ),
        (
            "qui_hidrocarburos_cerrados",
            "HIDROCARBUROS DE CADENA CERRADA",
        ),
        (
            "qui_oxigenados",
            "COMPUESTOS OXIGENADOS",
        ),
        (
            "qui_nitrogenados",
            "COMPUESTOS NITROGENADOS",
        ),
    ]

    if (
        len(chemistry_groups)
        != len(chemistry_units)
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] Número inesperado de "
            "unidades de Química."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    chemistry = {
        "id": "quimica",
        "name": "Química",
        "units": [
            direct_unit(
                unit_id,
                unit_name,
                topics,
            )
            for (
                unit_id,
                unit_name,
            ), topics
            in zip(
                chemistry_units,
                chemistry_groups,
            )
        ],
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # LENGUAJE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    language_groups = find_topic_groups(
        doc,
        13,
        "Comprensión a través de niveles",
    )

    language_units = [
        (
            "len_lectura_critica",
            "LECTURA CRÍTICA",
        ),
        (
            "len_produccion_textos",
            "PRODUCCIÓN DE TEXTOS",
        ),
        (
            "len_gramatica_ortografia",
            "GRAMÁTICA Y ORTOGRAFÍA",
        ),
        (
            "len_oratoria",
            "ORATORIA",
        ),
    ]

    if (
        len(language_groups)
        != len(language_units)
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] Número inesperado de "
            "unidades de Lenguaje."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    language = {
        "id": "lenguaje",
        "name": "Lenguaje",
        "units": [
            direct_unit(
                unit_id,
                unit_name,
                topics,
            )
            for (
                unit_id,
                unit_name,
            ), topics
            in zip(
                language_units,
                language_groups,
            )
        ],
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # ESTADÍSTICA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    statistics_groups = find_topic_groups(
        doc,
        14,
        "Variables estadísticas",
    )

    if len(statistics_groups) != 1:

        print(
            "[ERROR] Número inesperado de "
            "unidades de Estadística."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    statistics = {
        "id": "estadistica",
        "name": "Estadística",
        "units": [
            direct_unit(
                "est_estadistica_probabilidad",
                "ESTADÍSTICA Y PROBABILIDAD",
                statistics_groups[0],
            )
        ],
    }

    return [
        mathematics,
        physics,
        chemistry,
        language,
        statistics,
    ]


# ============================================================
# IDS PARA LOS SUBTEMAS
# ============================================================

def assign_topic_ids(
    areas,
):

    prefixes = {
        "Matemática": "MAT",
        "Física": "FIS",
        "Química": "QUI",
        "Lenguaje": "LEN",
        "Estadística": "EST",
    }

    for area in areas:

        prefix = prefixes[
            area["name"]
        ]

        counter = 1

        for unit in area["units"]:

            for cluster in unit[
                "clusters"
            ]:

                converted = []

                for label in cluster[
                    "topics"
                ]:

                    converted.append(
                        {
                            "id": (
                                f"{prefix}-"
                                f"{counter:03d}"
                            ),
                            "label": label,
                        }
                    )

                    counter += 1

                cluster[
                    "topics"
                ] = converted


def count_topics(
    area,
):

    return sum(
        len(
            cluster["topics"]
        )
        for unit in area["units"]
        for cluster in unit[
            "clusters"
        ]
    )


# ============================================================
# VALIDACIONES
# ============================================================

def validate_document(
    doc,
):

    if len(doc) < 15:

        print(
            "[ERROR] El PDF tiene menos páginas "
            "de las esperadas."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    fica_text = "\n".join(
        doc[p].get_text(
            "text"
        )
        for p in range(
            8,
            15,
        )
    )

    required = [
        "CIENCIAS APLICADAS-FICA",
        "TEMARIO DE MATEMÁTICA",
        "TEMARIO DE FÍSICA",
        "TEMARIO DE QUÍMICA",
        "TEMARIO DE LENGUAJE",
        "TEMARIO DE ESTADÍSTICA",
    ]

    missing = [
        value
        for value in required
        if value not in fica_text
    ]

    if missing:

        print(
            "[ERROR] El PDF no coincide "
            "con la estructura FICA esperada:"
        )

        for value in missing:
            print(
                f"  - {value}"
            )

        sys.exit(1)


def validate_areas(
    areas,
):

    names = [
        area["name"]
        for area in areas
    ]

    expected_names = list(
        EXPECTED_TOPIC_COUNTS
    )

    if names != expected_names:

        print(
            "[ERROR] Las áreas extraídas "
            "no coinciden con FICA."
        )

        print(
            "Actual:",
            names,
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    topic_ids = set()

    total = 0

    for area in areas:

        name = area[
            "name"
        ]

        count = count_topics(
            area
        )

        expected = (
            EXPECTED_TOPIC_COUNTS[
                name
            ]
        )

        if count != expected:

            print(
                f"[ERROR] {name}: "
                f"{count} subtemas; "
                f"se esperaban {expected}."
            )

            print(
                "El PDF oficial pudo cambiar "
                "o la extracción necesita revisión."
            )

            sys.exit(1)

        total += count

        for unit in area[
            "units"
        ]:

            for cluster in unit[
                "clusters"
            ]:

                for topic in cluster[
                    "topics"
                ]:

                    topic_id = topic[
                        "id"
                    ]

                    if topic_id in topic_ids:

                        print(
                            "[ERROR] ID duplicado: "
                            f"{topic_id}"
                        )

                        sys.exit(1)

                    topic_ids.add(
                        topic_id
                    )

                    if (
                        not topic[
                            "label"
                        ].strip()
                    ):

                        print(
                            "[ERROR] Subtema vacío."
                        )

                        sys.exit(1)

    if total != 202:

        print(
            "[ERROR] Total de subtemas "
            f"inesperado: {total}"
        )

        sys.exit(1)
