# ============================================================
# UTILIDADES
# ============================================================

def load_json(
    path: Path,
):

    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def write_json(
    path: Path,
    data,
):

    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            data,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def sha256_file(
    path: Path,
):

    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open(
        "rb"
    ) as handle:

        while True:

            chunk = handle.read(
                1024 * 1024
            )

            if not chunk:

                break

            digest.update(
                chunk
            )

    return digest.hexdigest().upper()


def fail(
    message,
):

    print(
        f"[ERROR] {message}"
    )

    sys.exit(1)


def spec_number(
    spec_id,
):

    try:

        return int(
            str(
                spec_id
            ).split(
                "-"
            )[-1]
        )

    except Exception:

        return 999999


def planned_item_id(
    spec_id,
):

    number = spec_number(
        spec_id
    )

    return f"R-{number:03d}"


def cluster_key(
    spec,
):

    return (
        spec.get(
            "area"
        ),
        spec.get(
            "unit"
        ),
        spec.get(
            "cluster"
        ),
    )


def spec_cost(
    spec,
):

    priority = PRIORITY_RANK.get(
        spec.get(
            "cluster_priority"
        ),
        99,
    )

    queue_position = spec.get(
        "queue_position",
        999,
    )

    slot = spec.get(
        "slot_in_cluster",
        99,
    )

    number = spec_number(
        spec.get(
            "spec_id"
        )
    )

    return (
        priority * 1_000_000
        + queue_position * 1_000
        + slot * 10
        + number
    )


def selected_ids(
    specs,
):

    return tuple(
        sorted(
            spec.get(
                "spec_id"
            )
            for spec in specs
        )
    )


def target_set(
    spec,
):

    return set(
        spec.get(
            "target_topic_ids",
            []
        )
    )


# ============================================================
# VALIDACIÓN DE CHECKPOINTS
# ============================================================

def validate_checkpoints():

    required = [
        QUESTION_BANK,
        QUESTION_BANK_P2B_BACKUP,

        REINFORCEMENT_SCHEMA,
        REINFORCEMENT_SCHEMA_BACKUP,

        REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK_BACKUP,

        P2D0_CONTRACT,
        P2D0_CONTRACT_BACKUP,

        P2C3_SPECS,
        P2C3_BACKUP,
    ]

    missing = [
        path
        for path in required
        if not path.exists()
    ]

    if missing:

        for path in missing:

            print(
                "[ERROR] Falta:",
                path,
            )

        sys.exit(1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # P2-C3
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2C3_BACKUP
        )
        != P2C3_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "El backup P2-C3 no coincide "
            "con el SHA-256 aprobado."
        )

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2C3_SPECS
        )
        != P2C3_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "p2c3_seed_specs.json ya no coincide "
            "con el checkpoint aprobado."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Checkpoint P2-C3 verificado."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # SCHEMA P2-D0
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_SCHEMA_BACKUP
        )
        != P2D0_SCHEMA_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "El backup del schema P2-D0 "
            "no coincide con el SHA-256 aprobado."
        )

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_SCHEMA
        )
        != P2D0_SCHEMA_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "reinforcement_bank_schema.json "
            "cambió desde P2-D0."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Schema P2-D0 preservado."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # BANCO VACÍO P2-D0
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK_BACKUP
        )
        != P2D0_BANK_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "El backup del reinforcement bank P2-D0 "
            "no coincide con el SHA-256 aprobado."
        )

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )
        != P2D0_BANK_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "reinforcement_bank.json cambió "
            "antes de iniciar P2-D1."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] reinforcement_bank P2-D0 preservado."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # CONTRACT P2-D0
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2D0_CONTRACT_BACKUP
        )
        != P2D0_CONTRACT_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "El backup contractual P2-D0 "
            "no coincide con el SHA-256 aprobado."
        )

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2D0_CONTRACT
        )
        != P2D0_CONTRACT_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "El contrato activo P2-D0 cambió."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Contrato P2-D0 preservado."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # BANCO ORIGINAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )
        != sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK_P2B_BACKUP
        )
    ):

        fail(
            "question_bank.json difiere "
            "del checkpoint P2-B."
        )

    question_bank = load_json(
        QUESTION_BANK
    )

    if (
        not isinstance(
            question_bank,
            list,
        )
        or len(
            question_bank
        )
        != 180
    ):

        fail(
            "question_bank.json ya no contiene "
            "exactamente 180 preguntas."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Banco original preservado: 180 preguntas."
    )


# ============================================================
# VALIDAR FUENTES P2-D0 / P2-C3
# ============================================================

def validate_sources():

    schema = load_json(
        REINFORCEMENT_SCHEMA
    )

    bank = load_json(
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK
    )

    contract = load_json(
        P2D0_CONTRACT
    )

    specs_report = load_json(
        P2C3_SPECS
    )

    if (
        schema.get(
            "schema_version"
        )
        != EXPECTED_SCHEMA_VERSION
    ):

        fail(
            "schema_version inesperada."
        )

    if (
        bank.get(
            "schema_version"
        )
        != EXPECTED_SCHEMA_VERSION
    ):

        fail(
            "reinforcement_bank usa "
            "schema_version inesperada."
        )

    if (
        bank.get(
            "items"
        )
        != []
    ):

        fail(
            "P2-D1 debe comenzar con "
            "reinforcement_bank vacío."
        )

    if (
        bank.get(
            "official_utn_question_bank"
        )
        is not False
    ):

        fail(
            "El banco de refuerzo está "
            "marcado incorrectamente como oficial."
        )

    if (
        contract.get(
            "stage"
        )
        != "P2-D0"
        or
        contract.get(
            "next_stage",
            {},
        ).get(
            "pilot_required_first"
        )
        is not True
    ):

        fail(
            "P2-D0 no reconoce el piloto "
            "como siguiente etapa obligatoria."
        )

    if (
        specs_report.get(
            "stage"
        )
        != "P2-C3"
        or
        specs_report.get(
            "spec_version"
        )
        != EXPECTED_SPEC_VERSION
    ):

        fail(
            "Archivo de specs P2-C3 incompatible."
        )

    specs = specs_report.get(
        "specs",
        []
    )

    if len(
        specs
    ) != 76:

        fail(
            "Se esperaban 76 specs P2-C3."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Fuentes P2-C3/P2-D0 coherentes."
    )

    return specs


# ============================================================
# PARES VÁLIDOS POR ÁREA
# ============================================================

def build_area_pairs(
    specs,
    area,
):

    candidates = [
        spec
        for spec in specs
        if spec.get(
            "area"
        )
        == area
    ]

    if len(
        candidates
    ) < 2:

        fail(
            f"{area}: no existen al menos 2 specs."
        )

    candidates = sorted(
        candidates,
        key=lambda spec: (
            spec_cost(
                spec
            ),
            spec.get(
                "spec_id",
                "",
            ),
        ),
    )

    pairs = []

    for first, second in itertools.combinations(
        candidates,
        2,
    ):

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Queremos dos clusters diferentes dentro del área.
        # Así el piloto prueba más amplitud conceptual.
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        if (
            cluster_key(
                first
            )
            == cluster_key(
                second
            )
        ):

            continue

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # No queremos repetir un target_topic_id
        # dentro del piloto del mismo área.
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        if (
            target_set(
                first
            )
            &
            target_set(
                second
            )
        ):

            continue

        pair = [
            first,
            second,
        ]

        pair_cost = sum(
            spec_cost(
                spec
            )
            for spec in pair
        )

        pairs.append(
            (
                pair_cost,
                pair,
            )
        )

    if not pairs:

        fail(
            f"{area}: no se pudo formar un par "
            "de specs de clusters distintos "
            "sin repetir objetivos."
        )

    pairs.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            item[0],
            selected_ids(
                item[1]
            ),
        )
    )

    return pairs


# ============================================================
# FEATURES DEL PILOTO
# ============================================================

def feature_state(
    specs,
):

    difficulty = Counter(
        spec.get(
            "difficulty"
        )
        for spec in specs
    )

    foundation = min(
        difficulty.get(
            "foundation",
            0,
        ),
        MIN_DIFFICULTY_COUNTS[
            "foundation"
        ],
    )

    standard = min(
        difficulty.get(
            "standard",
            0,
        ),
        MIN_DIFFICULTY_COUNTS[
            "standard"
        ],
    )

    transfer = min(
        difficulty.get(
            "transfer",
            0,
        ),
        MIN_DIFFICULTY_COUNTS[
            "transfer"
        ],
    )

    has_single_topic = any(
        spec.get(
            "target_topic_count"
        )
        == 1
        for spec in specs
    )

    has_max_load = any(
        spec.get(
            "target_topic_count"
        )
        == 4
        for spec in specs
    )

    return (
        foundation,
        standard,
        transfer,
        has_single_topic,
        has_max_load,
    )


def merge_state(
    old_state,
    new_specs,
):

    (
        old_foundation,
        old_standard,
        old_transfer,
        old_single,
        old_max,
    ) = old_state

    difficulty = Counter(
        spec.get(
            "difficulty"
        )
        for spec in new_specs
    )

    foundation = min(
        old_foundation
        + difficulty.get(
            "foundation",
            0,
        ),
        MIN_DIFFICULTY_COUNTS[
            "foundation"
        ],
    )

    standard = min(
        old_standard
        + difficulty.get(
            "standard",
            0,
        ),
        MIN_DIFFICULTY_COUNTS[
            "standard"
        ],
    )

    transfer = min(
        old_transfer
        + difficulty.get(
            "transfer",
            0,
        ),
        MIN_DIFFICULTY_COUNTS[
            "transfer"
        ],
    )

    has_single = (
        old_single
        or any(
            spec.get(
                "target_topic_count"
            )
            == 1
            for spec in new_specs
        )
    )

    has_max = (
        old_max
        or any(
            spec.get(
                "target_topic_count"
            )
            == 4
            for spec in new_specs
        )
    )

    return (
        foundation,
        standard,
        transfer,
        has_single,
        has_max,
    )


def pilot_constraints_satisfied(
    state,
):

    (
        foundation,
        standard,
        transfer,
        has_single,
        has_max,
    ) = state

    return (
        foundation
        >= MIN_DIFFICULTY_COUNTS[
            "foundation"
        ]
        and
        standard
        >= MIN_DIFFICULTY_COUNTS[
            "standard"
        ]
        and
        transfer
        >= MIN_DIFFICULTY_COUNTS[
            "transfer"
        ]
        and
        has_single
        and
        has_max
    )


# ============================================================
# SELECCIÓN DETERMINISTA CON PROGRAMACIÓN DINÁMICA
# ============================================================

def choose_pilot(
    specs,
):

    area_pairs = {
        area:
            build_area_pairs(
                specs,
                area,
            )
        for area in AREA_ORDER
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Estado:
    #
    # (
    #   foundation_cap,
    #   standard_cap,
    #   transfer_cap,
    #   has_single_topic,
    #   has_four_topic_spec
    # )
    #
    # Para cada estado guardamos solo la solución
    # de menor costo.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    initial_state = (
        0,
        0,
        0,
        False,
        False,
    )

    dp = {
        initial_state: (
            0,
            [],
        )
    }

    for area in AREA_ORDER:

        next_dp = {}

        for (
            current_state,
            (
                current_cost,
                current_specs,
            ),
        ) in dp.items():

            for (
                pair_cost,
                pair,
            ) in area_pairs[
                area
            ]:

                new_state = merge_state(
                    current_state,
                    pair,
                )

                new_cost = (
                    current_cost
                    + pair_cost
                )

                new_specs = (
                    current_specs
                    + pair
                )

                existing = next_dp.get(
                    new_state
                )

                candidate_key = (
                    new_cost,
                    selected_ids(
                        new_specs
                    ),
                )

                if existing is None:

                    next_dp[
                        new_state
                    ] = (
                        new_cost,
                        new_specs,
                    )

                    continue

                existing_cost, existing_specs = (
                    existing
                )

                existing_key = (
                    existing_cost,
                    selected_ids(
                        existing_specs
                    ),
                )

                if (
                    candidate_key
                    < existing_key
                ):

                    next_dp[
                        new_state
                    ] = (
                        new_cost,
                        new_specs,
                    )

        dp = next_dp

    valid_solutions = []

    for (
        state,
        (
            cost,
            selected,
        ),
    ) in dp.items():

        if pilot_constraints_satisfied(
            state
        ):

            valid_solutions.append(
                (
                    cost,
                    selected_ids(
                        selected
                    ),
                    selected,
                )
            )

    if not valid_solutions:

        print()
        print(
            "[ERROR] No existe una selección "
            "de 8 specs que satisfaga simultáneamente:"
        )

        print(
            "- 2 Física"
        )

        print(
            "- 2 Lenguaje"
        )

        print(
            "- 2 Matemática"
        )

        print(
            "- 2 Química"
        )

        print(
            "- >=2 foundation"
        )

        print(
            "- >=2 standard"
        )

        print(
            "- >=1 transfer"
        )

        print(
            "- >=1 spec con 1 target"
        )

        print(
            "- >=1 spec con 4 targets"
        )

        print()
        print(
            "No reduzcas los requisitos todavía."
        )

        print(
            "Primero habría que inspeccionar "
            "las 76 specs."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    valid_solutions.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            item[0],
            item[1],
        )
    )

    _, _, selected = valid_solutions[
        0
    ]

    # Orden de salida:
    # prioridad -> cola -> spec id.
    selected = sorted(
        selected,
        key=lambda spec: (
            PRIORITY_RANK.get(
                spec.get(
                    "cluster_priority"
                ),
                99,
            ),
            spec.get(
                "queue_position",
                999,
            ),
            spec.get(
                "spec_id",
                "",
            ),
        ),
    )

    return selected


# ============================================================
# VALIDAR SELECCIÓN
# ============================================================

def validate_selection(
    selected,
):

    if len(
        selected
    ) != PILOT_SIZE:

        fail(
            "El piloto no contiene "
            "exactamente 8 specs."
        )

    ids = [
        spec.get(
            "spec_id"
        )
        for spec in selected
    ]

    if len(
        ids
    ) != len(
        set(
            ids
        )
    ):

        fail(
            "El piloto contiene spec_id duplicados."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 2 por área
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    area_counts = Counter(
        spec.get(
            "area"
        )
        for spec in selected
    )

    actual_area_counts = {
        area:
            area_counts.get(
                area,
                0,
            )
        for area in AREA_ORDER
    }

    if (
        actual_area_counts
        != PILOT_AREA_QUOTA
    ):

        fail(
            "Distribución por área incorrecta: "
            f"{actual_area_counts}"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Estadística fuera del piloto.
    # No tiene huecos seed.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if any(
        spec.get(
            "area"
        )
        == "Estadística"
        for spec in selected
    ):

        fail(
            "Estadística no debe recibir "
            "preguntas seed en el piloto."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Clusters distintos
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    cluster_keys = [
        cluster_key(
            spec
        )
        for spec in selected
    ]

    if (
        len(
            cluster_keys
        )
        != len(
            set(
                cluster_keys
            )
        )
    ):

        fail(
            "El piloto debe usar "
            "8 clusters distintos."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Targets sin repetición
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    all_targets = [
        topic_id
        for spec in selected
        for topic_id in spec.get(
            "target_topic_ids",
            []
        )
    ]

    if (
        len(
            all_targets
        )
        != len(
            set(
                all_targets
            )
        )
    ):

        fail(
            "El piloto repite un target_topic_id."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Perfiles
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    difficulty = Counter(
        spec.get(
            "difficulty"
        )
        for spec in selected
    )

    for (
        level,
        minimum,
    ) in MIN_DIFFICULTY_COUNTS.items():

        if (
            difficulty.get(
                level,
                0,
            )
            < minimum
        ):

            fail(
                f"El piloto necesita al menos "
                f"{minimum} specs {level}."
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Extremos del contrato
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if not any(
        spec.get(
            "target_topic_count"
        )
        == 1
        for spec in selected
    ):

        fail(
            "El piloto debe incluir al menos "
            "una spec de 1 target."
        )

    if not any(
        spec.get(
            "target_topic_count"
        )
        == 4
        for spec in selected
    ):

        fail(
            "El piloto debe incluir al menos "
            "una spec de 4 targets."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Solo material de refuerzo no oficial
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    for spec in selected:

        if (
            spec.get(
                "official_utn_question"
            )
            is not False
        ):

            fail(
                f"{spec.get('spec_id')} está "
                "marcada incorrectamente como oficial."
            )

        if (
            spec.get(
                "intended_bank"
            )
            != "reinforcement_bank"
        ):

            fail(
                f"{spec.get('spec_id')} no apunta "
                "a reinforcement_bank."
            )

        if (
            spec.get(
                "learning_role"
            )
            != "coverage_seed"
        ):

            fail(
                f"{spec.get('spec_id')} no es "
                "coverage_seed."
            )

        count = spec.get(
            "target_topic_count"
        )

        if (
            not isinstance(
                count,
                int,
            )
            or count < 1
            or count > 4
        ):

            fail(
                f"{spec.get('spec_id')} tiene "
                "target_topic_count inválido."
            )

    print(
        "[OK] Selección piloto supera "
        "las restricciones internas."
    )

def build_txt(
    manifest,
):

    summary = manifest[
        "summary"
    ]

    lines = []

    lines.append(
        "=" * 72
    )

    lines.append(
        "P2-D1 - MANIFIESTO DEL LOTE PILOTO"
    )

    lines.append(
        "=" * 72
    )

    lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        "Estado                     : selected_for_authoring"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Specs piloto               : {summary['selected_spec_count']}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Clusters distintos          : {summary['distinct_clusters']}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Targets únicos              : {summary['unique_target_topics']}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Asignaciones de targets     : {summary['target_assignments']}"
    )

    lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        "DISTRIBUCIÓN POR ÁREA"
    )

    lines.append(
        "-" * 72
    )

    for area in AREA_ORDER:

        lines.append(
            f"{area:<16}: "
            f"{summary['by_area'].get(area, 0)}"
        )

    lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        "DISTRIBUCIÓN PEDAGÓGICA"
    )

    lines.append(
        "-" * 72
    )

    for level in [
        "foundation",
        "standard",
        "transfer",
    ]:

        lines.append(
            f"{level:<16}: "
            f"{summary['by_difficulty'].get(level, 0)}"
        )

    lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        "CARGA DE SUBTEMAS"
    )

    lines.append(
        "-" * 72
    )

    for count in [
        "1",
        "2",
        "3",
        "4",
    ]:

        lines.append(
            f"{count} target(s)     : "
            f"{summary['target_count_distribution'].get(count, 0)}"
        )

    lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        "SPECS SELECCIONADAS"
    )

    lines.append(

    for item in manifest[
        "selected_specs"
    ]:

        lines.append("")

        lines.append(

        for (

        ):

    lines.append("")

                "draft",

            "initial_mastery_eligible":
                False,

            "human_review_required":
                True,

            "answer_verification_required":
                True,

            "coverage_verification_required":
                True,

            "ambiguity_check_required":
                True,

            "distractor_check_required":
                True,

            "explanation_check_required":
                True,

            "must_be_self_contained":
                True,

            "requires_original_pdf":
                False,

            "copy_original_bank_question_allowed":
                False,

            "present_as_official_utn_question":
                False,

            "next_action":
                (
                    "Author exactly the selected "
                    "8 pilot items, then validate "
                    "before writing them into "
                    "reinforcement_bank.json."
                ),
        },

        "selected_specs":
            selected_entries,
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. Comprobar idempotencia / no sobrescribir diferencias
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if PILOT_JSON.exists():

        try:

            existing = load_json(
                PILOT_JSON
            )

        except Exception as exc:

            fail(
                "Ya existe p2d1_pilot_manifest.json "
                f"pero no puede leerse: {exc}"
            )

        if existing != manifest:

            fail(
                "Ya existe un manifiesto P2-D1 "
                "diferente. No se sobrescribirá."
            )

        print(
            "[OK] Manifiesto JSON existente "
            "ya coincide con la selección."
        )

    else:

        write_json(
            PILOT_JSON,
            manifest,
        )

        print(
            "[OK] Manifiesto JSON creado."
        )

    txt = build_txt(
        manifest
    )

    if PILOT_TXT.exists():

        existing_txt = PILOT_TXT.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )

        if existing_txt != txt:

            fail(
                "Ya existe un informe TXT P2-D1 "
                "diferente. No se sobrescribirá."
            )

        print(
            "[OK] Informe TXT existente "
            "ya coincide."
        )

    else:

        PILOT_TXT.write_text(
            txt,
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        print(
            "[OK] Informe TXT creado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 7. Seguridad final
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    bank_after = load_json(
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK
    )

    if (
        bank_after.get(
            "items"
        )
        != []
    ):

        fail(
            "El selector P2-D1 modificó "
            "reinforcement_bank.json."
        )

    if (
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )
        != sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK_P2B_BACKUP
        )
    ):

        fail(
            "El selector P2-D1 modificó "
            "question_bank.json."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] reinforcement_bank sigue con 0 preguntas."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] question_bank sigue intacto."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 8. Salida
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    summary = manifest[
        "summary"
    ]

    print()
    print(
        "DISTRIBUCIÓN POR ÁREA"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 72
    )

    for area in AREA_ORDER:

        print(
            f"{area:<16}: "
            f"{summary['by_area'][area]}"
        )

    print()
    print(
        "DISTRIBUCIÓN PEDAGÓGICA"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 72
    )

    for level in [
        "foundation",
        "standard",
        "transfer",
    ]:

        print(
            f"{level:<16}: "
            f"{summary['by_difficulty'][level]}"
        )

    print()
    print(
        "COBERTURA DEL PILOTO"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 72
    )

    print(
        "Specs                   :",
        summary[
            "selected_spec_count"
        ],
    )

    print(
        "Clusters distintos      :",
        summary[
            "distinct_clusters"
        ],
    )

    print(
        "Targets únicos          :",
        summary[
            "unique_target_topics"
        ],
    )

    print(
        "Asignaciones de targets :",
        summary[
            "target_assignments"
        ],
    )

    print(
        "Incluye caso 1 target   :",
        summary[
            "contains_single_target_case"
        ],
    )

    print(
        "Incluye caso 4 targets  :",
        summary[
            "contains_four_target_case"
        ],
    )

    print()
    print(
        "SPECS SELECCIONADAS"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 72
    )

    for item in manifest[
        "selected_specs"
    ]:

        print(
            (
                f"{item['planned_item_id']} "
                f"<- {item['source_spec_id']} "
                f"| {item['area']} "
                f"| {item['difficulty']} "
                f"| {item['target_topic_count']} target(s)"
            )
        )

        for (
            topic_id,
            label,
        ) in zip(
            item[
                "target_topic_ids"
            ],
            item[
                "target_topic_labels"
            ],
        ):

            print(
                f"    {topic_id}: {label}"
            )

    print()
    print(
        "ARCHIVOS"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 72
    )

    print(
        PILOT_JSON
    )

    print(
        PILOT_TXT
    )

    print()
    print(
        "IMPORTANTE:"
    )

    print(
        "- NO se generaron preguntas todavía."
    )

    print(
        "- reinforcement_bank.json sigue vacío."
    )

    print(
        "- question_bank.json sigue con "
        "sus 180 preguntas originales."
    )

    print(
        "- Las 8 specs quedaron seleccionadas "
        "para autoría controlada."
    )

    print(
        "- Ningún ítem piloto será considerado "
        "oficial UTN."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "RESULTADO: P2-D1 PILOTO SELECCIONADO"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# ============================================================
# UTILIDADES
# ============================================================

def load_json(path: Path):

    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def write_json(
    path: Path,
    data,
):

    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            data,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def sha256_file(path: Path):

    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open("rb") as handle:

        while True:

            chunk = handle.read(
                1024 * 1024
            )

            if not chunk:
                break

            digest.update(chunk)

    return digest.hexdigest().upper()


def fail(message):

    print(
        f"[ERROR] {message}"
    )

    sys.exit(1)


# ============================================================
# CHECKPOINTS
# ============================================================

def verify_checkpoints():

    required_files = [
        QUESTION_BANK,
        QUESTION_BANK_P2B_BACKUP,
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK_P2D0_BACKUP,
        REINFORCEMENT_SCHEMA,
        REINFORCEMENT_SCHEMA_P2D0_BACKUP,
        P2D0_CONTRACT,
        P2D0_CONTRACT_BACKUP,
        P2C3_SPECS,
        P2C3_BACKUP,
        P2D1_MANIFEST,
        P2D1_BACKUP,
    ]

    missing = [
        path
        for path in required_files
        if not path.exists()
    ]

    if missing:

        for path in missing:

            print(
                "[ERROR] Falta:",
                path,
            )

        sys.exit(1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # P2-C3
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(P2C3_BACKUP)
        != P2C3_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "El backup P2-C3 fue alterado."
        )

    if (
        sha256_file(P2C3_SPECS)
        != P2C3_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "P2-C3 activo difiere del checkpoint aprobado."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Checkpoint P2-C3 verificado."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # P2-D0 schema
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_SCHEMA_P2D0_BACKUP
        )
        != P2D0_SCHEMA_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "Backup del schema P2-D0 alterado."
        )

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_SCHEMA
        )
        != P2D0_SCHEMA_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "Schema P2-D0 activo alterado."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Schema P2-D0 preservado."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # P2-D0 bank
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK_P2D0_BACKUP
        )
        != P2D0_BANK_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "Backup del reinforcement bank P2-D0 alterado."
        )

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )
        != P2D0_BANK_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "reinforcement_bank.json cambió antes de P2-D2."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] reinforcement_bank P2-D0 preservado."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # P2-D0 contract
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2D0_CONTRACT_BACKUP
        )
        != P2D0_CONTRACT_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "Backup contractual P2-D0 alterado."
        )

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2D0_CONTRACT
        )
        != P2D0_CONTRACT_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "Contrato P2-D0 activo alterado."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Contrato P2-D0 preservado."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # P2-D1
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2D1_BACKUP
        )
        != P2D1_MANIFEST_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "Backup P2-D1 no coincide con "
            "el SHA-256 aprobado."
        )

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2D1_MANIFEST
        )
        != P2D1_MANIFEST_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "Manifiesto P2-D1 activo difiere "
            "del checkpoint aprobado."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Checkpoint P2-D1 verificado."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Banco original
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )
        != sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK_P2B_BACKUP
        )
    ):

        fail(
            "question_bank.json difiere "
            "del checkpoint P2-B."
        )

    questions = load_json(
        QUESTION_BANK
    )

    if (
        not isinstance(
            questions,
            list,
        )
        or len(questions) != 180
    ):

        fail(
            "question_bank.json no contiene "
            "exactamente 180 preguntas."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Banco original preservado: 180 preguntas."
    )


# ============================================================
# CONSTRUIR ÍTEM
# ============================================================

def build_item(
    manifest_entry,
):

    source_spec_id = manifest_entry.get(
        "source_spec_id"
    )

    if source_spec_id not in DRAFT_CONTENT:

        fail(
            f"No existe contenido para {source_spec_id}."
        )

    authored = DRAFT_CONTENT[
        source_spec_id
    ]

    defaults = manifest_entry.get(
        "draft_defaults",
        {},
    )

    item = {

        "id":
            manifest_entry.get(
                "planned_item_id"
            ),

        "schema_version":
            defaults.get(
                "schema_version"
            ),

        "origin":
            defaults.get(
                "origin"
            ),

        "source_spec_id":
            source_spec_id,

        "official_utn_question":
            defaults.get(
                "official_utn_question"
            ),

        "area":
            manifest_entry.get(
                "area"
            ),

        "unit":
            manifest_entry.get(
                "unit"
            ),

        "cluster":
            manifest_entry.get(
                "cluster"
            ),

        "primary_topic_id":
            manifest_entry.get(
                "primary_topic_id"
            ),

        "secondary_topic_ids":
            copy.deepcopy(
                manifest_entry.get(
                    "secondary_topic_ids",
                    [],
                )
            ),

        "target_topic_ids":
            copy.deepcopy(
                manifest_entry.get(
                    "target_topic_ids",
                    [],
                )
            ),

        "difficulty":
            manifest_entry.get(
                "difficulty"
            ),

        "cognitive_target":
            manifest_entry.get(
                "cognitive_target"
            ),

        "learning_role":
            manifest_entry.get(
                "learning_role"
            ),

        "stem":
            authored[
                "stem"
            ],

        "choices":
            copy.deepcopy(
                authored[
                    "choices"
                ]
            ),

        "answer":
            authored[
                "answer"
            ],

        "explanation":
            authored[
                "explanation"
            ],

        "explanation_layers":
            copy.deepcopy(
                authored[
                    "explanation_layers"
                ]
            ),

        "distractor_analysis":
            copy.deepcopy(
                authored[
                    "distractor_analysis"
                ]
            ),

        "quality":
            copy.deepcopy(
                defaults[
                    "quality"
                ]
            ),

        "generation":
            copy.deepcopy(
                defaults[
                    "generation"
                ]
            ),
    }

    return item


# ============================================================
# AUTOVALIDACIÓN DE BORRADORES
# ============================================================

def validate_drafts(
    items,
    manifest_lookup,
):

    if len(items) != 8:

        fail(
            "P2-D2 debe producir exactamente "
            "8 borradores."
        )

    ids = [
        item.get("id")
        for item in items
    ]

    if len(ids) != len(set(ids)):

        fail(
            "Existen IDs de borrador duplicados."
        )

    source_ids = [
        item.get(
            "source_spec_id"
        )
        for item in items
    ]

    if (
        set(source_ids)
        != EXPECTED_SOURCE_SPEC_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "Los source_spec_id de P2-D2 "
            "no coinciden con P2-D1."
        )

    if (
        set(DRAFT_CONTENT.keys())
        != EXPECTED_SOURCE_SPEC_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "DRAFT_CONTENT no contiene exactamente "
            "las 8 specs aprobadas."
        )

    total_targets = []

    for item in items:

        item_id = item.get("id")

        source_spec_id = item.get(
            "source_spec_id"
        )

        manifest_entry = manifest_lookup.get(
            source_spec_id
        )

        if manifest_entry is None:

            fail(
                f"{source_spec_id} no existe "
                "en el manifiesto P2-D1."
            )

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Identidad
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        if (
            item_id
            != manifest_entry.get(
                "planned_item_id"
            )
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_spec_id}: ID incorrecto."
            )

        if (
            item.get(
                "schema_version"
            )
            != EXPECTED_SCHEMA_VERSION
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: schema_version incorrecta."
            )

        if (
            item.get(
                "origin"
            )
            != "generated_reinforcement"
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: origin incorrecto."
            )

        if (
            item.get(
                "official_utn_question"
            )
            is not False
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: no puede marcarse "
                "como pregunta oficial UTN."
            )

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Metadata exacta desde P2-D1
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        metadata_fields = [
            "area",
            "unit",
            "cluster",
            "primary_topic_id",
            "secondary_topic_ids",
            "target_topic_ids",
            "difficulty",
            "cognitive_target",
            "learning_role",
        ]

        for field in metadata_fields:

            if (
                item.get(field)
                != manifest_entry.get(field)
            ):

                fail(
                    f"{item_id}: metadata "
                    f"{field} difiere de P2-D1."
                )

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Targets
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        targets = item.get(
            "target_topic_ids",
            []
        )

        if (
            not isinstance(targets, list)
            or len(targets) < 1
            or len(targets) > 4
            or len(targets) != len(set(targets))
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: target_topic_ids inválidos."
            )

        if (
            item.get(
                "primary_topic_id"
            )
            != targets[0]
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: primary_topic_id "
                "no coincide con el primer target."
            )

        if (
            item.get(
                "secondary_topic_ids"
            )
            != targets[1:]
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: secondary_topic_ids "
                "no coincide con targets[1:]."
            )

        total_targets.extend(
            targets
        )

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Stem
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        stem = item.get(
            "stem"
        )

        if (
            not isinstance(stem, str)
            or not stem.strip()
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: stem vacío."
            )

        forbidden_pdf_fragments = [
            "página del pdf",
            "observe la figura del pdf",
            "simulacro 1",
            "simulacro 3",
        ]

        lower_stem = stem.lower()

        if any(
            fragment in lower_stem
            for fragment in forbidden_pdf_fragments
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: el enunciado "
                "depende del PDF original."
            )

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Choices
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        choices = item.get(
            "choices"
        )

        if not isinstance(
            choices,
            dict,
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: choices no es objeto."
            )

        allowed_keys = [
            "A",
            "B",
            "C",
            "D",
            "E",
        ]

        if (
            len(choices) < 4
            or len(choices) > 5
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: debe tener "
                "4 o 5 alternativas."
            )

        if (
            list(choices.keys())
            != allowed_keys[
                :len(choices)
            ]
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: las alternativas "
                "deben ser consecutivas desde A."
            )

        if any(
            not isinstance(value, str)
            or not value.strip()
            for value in choices.values()
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: existe "
                "una alternativa vacía."
            )

        if (
            len(set(choices.values()))
            != len(choices)
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: existen "
                "alternativas duplicadas."
            )

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Answer
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        answer = item.get(
            "answer"
        )

        if answer not in choices:

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: answer no existe "
                "dentro de choices."
            )

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Explanation
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        explanation = item.get(
            "explanation"
        )

        if (
            not isinstance(
                explanation,
                str,
            )
            or not explanation.strip()
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: explanation vacía."
            )

        layers = item.get(
            "explanation_layers",
            {},
        )

        required_layers = [
            "intuition",
            "step_by_step",
            "common_error",
            "why_correct",
        ]

        if (
            list(layers.keys())
            != required_layers
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: explanation_layers "
                "incompletas o desordenadas."
            )

        if any(
            not isinstance(
                layers[key],
                str,
            )
            or not layers[key].strip()
            for key in required_layers
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: alguna capa "
                "de explicación está vacía."
            )

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Distractores
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        distractors = item.get(
            "distractor_analysis"
        )

        if not isinstance(
            distractors,
            dict,
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: distractor_analysis "
                "no es objeto."
            )

        expected_distractors = {
            key
            for key in choices
            if key != answer
        }

        if (
            set(distractors.keys())
            != expected_distractors
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: distractor_analysis "
                "no documenta exactamente las "
                "alternativas incorrectas."
            )

        if answer in distractors:

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: la respuesta correcta "
                "no debe figurar como distractor."
            )

        if any(
            not isinstance(value, str)
            or not value.strip()
            for value in distractors.values()
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: análisis de "
                "distractor vacío."
            )

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Quality: debe seguir en draft
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        quality = item.get(
            "quality",
            {},
        )

        expected_quality = {
            "status":
                "draft",

            "mastery_eligible":
                False,

            "coverage_verified":
                False,

            "answer_verified":
                False,

            "ambiguity_checked":
                False,

            "distractors_checked":
                False,

            "explanation_checked":
                False,

            "flags":
                [
                    "pilot_pending_validation"
                ],
        }

        if quality != expected_quality:

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: quality debe "
                "seguir exactamente en estado draft."
            )

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Generation
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        generation = item.get(
            "generation",
            {},
        )

        expected_generation = {
            "generation_stage":
                "P2-D",

            "generator_type":
                "synthetic_reinforcement",

            "human_review_required":
                True,

            "source_material": [
                (
                    "UTN FICA 2P2026 "
                    "official syllabus"
                ),
                (
                    "P2-C3 seed specification"
                ),
            ],
        }

        if generation != expected_generation:

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: generation "
                "no coincide con el contrato."
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # El piloto P2-D1 tenía 20 targets únicos
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if len(total_targets) != 20:

        fail(
            "Las 8 preguntas no conservan "
            "las 20 asignaciones de targets."
        )

    if len(set(total_targets)) != 20:

        fail(
            "Las preguntas piloto repiten "
            "algún target_topic_id."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Las 8 preguntas superan "
        "la autovalidación estructural."
    )


# ============================================================
# INFORME TXT
# ============================================================

def build_txt(
    package,
):

    lines = []

    summary = package[
        "summary"
    ]

    lines.append(
        "=" * 72
    )

    lines.append(
        "P2-D2 - BORRADORES DEL LOTE PILOTO"
    )

    lines.append(
        "=" * 72
    )

    lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        "Estado                  : drafts_authored_pending_validation"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Preguntas borrador      : {summary['draft_count']}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Targets conservados     : {summary['unique_target_topics']}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Banco reinforcement     : {summary['reinforcement_bank_items']}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Banco original          : {summary['original_bank_items']}"
    )

    lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        "DISTRIBUCIÓN"
    )

    lines.append(
        "-" * 72
    )

    for area in [
        "Física",
        "Lenguaje",
        "Matemática",
        "Química",
    ]:

        lines.append(
            f"{area:<16}: "
            f"{summary['by_area'].get(area, 0)}"
        )

    lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        "BORRADORES"
    )

    lines.append(
        "-" * 72
    )

    for item in package[
        "items"
    ]:

        lines.append("")
        lines.append(
            "=" * 72
        )

        lines.append(
            (
                f"{item['id']} <- "
                f"{item['source_spec_id']} "
                f"| {item['area']} "
                f"| {item['difficulty']}"
            )
        )

        lines.append(
            "=" * 72
        )

        lines.append("")

        lines.append(
            "Targets:"
        )

        for topic_id in item[
            "target_topic_ids"
        ]:

            lines.append(
                f"  - {topic_id}"
            )

        lines.append("")

        lines.append(
            "Pregunta:"
        )

        lines.append(
            item[
                "stem"
            ]
        )

        lines.append("")

        for key, value in item[
            "choices"
        ].items():

            lines.append(
                f"{key}) {value}"
            )

        lines.append("")

        lines.append(
            f"Respuesta: {item['answer']}"
        )

        lines.append("")

        lines.append(
            "Explicación:"
        )

        lines.append(
            item[
                "explanation"
            ]
        )

        lines.append("")

        lines.append(
            "Distractores:"
        )

        for key, value in item[
            "distractor_analysis"
        ].items():

            lines.append(
                f"  {key}: {value}"
            )

    lines.append("")
    lines.append(
        "=" * 72
    )

    lines.append(
        "SEGURIDAD"
    )

    lines.append(
        "=" * 72
    )

    lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        "- Las 8 preguntas siguen en estado draft."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- mastery_eligible permanece false."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- coverage_verified permanece false."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- answer_verified permanece false."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- ambiguity_checked permanece false."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- distractors_checked permanece false."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- explanation_checked permanece false."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- reinforcement_bank.json permanece vacío."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- question_bank.json conserva sus 180 preguntas."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- Ninguna pregunta es una pregunta oficial UTN."
    )

    lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        "SIGUIENTE PASO"
    )

    lines.append(
        "-" * 72
    )

    lines.append(
        "Validación independiente del contenido, "
        "respuesta, cobertura, ambigüedad, "
        "distractores y explicaciones."
    )

    return "\n".join(
        lines
    )

# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main():

    print()
    print("=" * 72)
    print(
        "P2-D2 - AUTORÍA DE 8 BORRADORES PILOTO"
    )
    print("=" * 72)
    print()

    RESULTS_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Checkpoints
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    verify_checkpoints()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Manifiesto P2-D1
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    manifest = load_json(
        P2D1_MANIFEST
    )

    if (
        manifest.get(
            "stage"
        )
        != "P2-D1"
        or
        manifest.get(
            "pilot_version"
        )
        != EXPECTED_PILOT_VERSION
        or
        manifest.get(
            "status"
        )
        != "selected_for_authoring"
    ):

        fail(
            "El manifiesto activo no corresponde "
            "al P2-D1 aprobado."
        )

    selected = manifest.get(
        "selected_specs",
        []
    )

    if len(selected) != 8:

        fail(
            "El manifiesto P2-D1 no contiene "
            "exactamente 8 specs."
        )

    selected_source_ids = {
        item.get(
            "source_spec_id"
        )
        for item in selected
    }

    if (
        selected_source_ids
        != EXPECTED_SOURCE_SPEC_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "Las specs del manifiesto "
            "no coinciden con el lote aprobado."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Manifiesto P2-D1 reconocido: "
        "8 specs."
    )

    manifest_lookup = {
        item.get(
            "source_spec_id"
        ):
            item
        for item in selected
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Autoría
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    items = [
        build_item(
            manifest_entry
        )
        for manifest_entry in selected
    ]

    print(
        "[OK] 8 borradores construidos "
        "desde las specs seleccionadas."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Autovalidación estructural
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    validate_drafts(
        items,
        manifest_lookup,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. Métricas
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    by_area = Counter(
        item.get(
            "area"
        )
        for item in items
    )

    by_difficulty = Counter(
        item.get(
            "difficulty"
        )
        for item in items
    )

    all_targets = [
        topic_id
        for item in items
        for topic_id in item.get(
            "target_topic_ids",
            []
        )
    ]

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. Verificar bancos ANTES de escribir reports
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    reinforcement = load_json(
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK
    )

    questions = load_json(
        QUESTION_BANK
    )

    if (
        reinforcement.get(
            "items"
        )
        != []
    ):

        fail(
            "reinforcement_bank.json dejó de estar vacío."
        )

    if len(questions) != 180:

        fail(
            "question_bank.json dejó de contener 180 preguntas."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 7. Paquete P2-D2
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    package = {

        "stage":
            "P2-D2",

        "draft_version":
            DRAFT_VERSION,

        "status":
            "drafts_authored_pending_validation",

        "purpose":
            (
                "Autoría controlada de las ocho preguntas "
                "piloto seleccionadas en P2-D1."
            ),

        "source_manifest":
            "results/p2d1_pilot_manifest.json",

        "target_bank_after_validation":
            "data/reinforcement_bank.json",

        "writes_to_reinforcement_bank":
            False,

        "writes_to_original_bank":
            False,

        "official_utn_questions":
            False,

        "checkpoint_verification": {

            "p2c3_specs_sha256":
                P2C3_SHA256,

            "p2d0_schema_sha256":
                P2D0_SCHEMA_SHA256,

            "p2d0_empty_bank_sha256":
                P2D0_BANK_SHA256,

            "p2d0_contract_sha256":
                P2D0_CONTRACT_SHA256,

            "p2d1_manifest_sha256":
                P2D1_MANIFEST_SHA256,
        },

        "validation_state": {

            "structural_self_check":
                True,

            "independent_validation_pending":
                True,

            "content_validation_pending":
                True,

            "answer_validation_pending":
                True,

            "coverage_validation_pending":
                True,

            "ambiguity_validation_pending":
                True,

            "distractor_validation_pending":
                True,

            "explanation_validation_pending":
                True,

            "bank_insertion_allowed":
                False,
        },

        "summary": {

            "draft_count":
                len(items),

            "target_assignments":
                len(all_targets),

            "unique_target_topics":
                len(set(all_targets)),

            "by_area": {
                area:
                    by_area.get(
                        area,
                        0,
                    )
                for area in [
                    "Física",
                    "Lenguaje",
                    "Matemática",
                    "Química",
                ]
            },

            "by_difficulty": {
                level:
                    by_difficulty.get(
                        level,
                        0,
                    )
                for level in [
                    "foundation",
                    "standard",
                    "transfer",
                ]
            },

            "reinforcement_bank_items":
                0,

            "original_bank_items":
                180,

            "all_items_draft":
                all(
                    item.get(
                        "quality",
                        {},
                    ).get(
                        "status"
                    )
                    == "draft"
                    for item in items
                ),

            "all_mastery_ineligible":
                all(
                    item.get(
                        "quality",
                        {},
                    ).get(
                        "mastery_eligible"
                    )
                    is False
                    for item in items
                ),
        },

        "items":
            items,
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 8. Idempotencia JSON
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if OUTPUT_JSON.exists():

        try:

            existing = load_json(
                OUTPUT_JSON
            )

        except Exception as exc:

            fail(
                "p2d2_pilot_drafts.json ya existe "
                f"pero no puede leerse: {exc}"
            )

        if existing != package:

            fail(
                "Ya existe un paquete P2-D2 diferente. "
                "No se sobrescribirá."
            )

        print(
            "[OK] JSON P2-D2 existente "
            "ya coincide exactamente."
        )

    else:

        write_json(
            OUTPUT_JSON,
            package,
        )

        print(
            "[OK] JSON de borradores P2-D2 creado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 9. Idempotencia TXT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    txt = build_txt(
        package
    )

    if OUTPUT_TXT.exists():

        existing_txt = OUTPUT_TXT.read_text(

        )

            fail(
                "Ya existe un informe TXT P2-D2 "
                "diferente. No se sobrescribirá."
            )

            "[OK] TXT P2-D2 existente "
            "ya coincide exactamente."
        )

    else:

        OUTPUT_TXT.write_text(
            txt,
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        print(
            "[OK] TXT de borradores P2-D2 creado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 10. Seguridad final
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )
        != P2D0_BANK_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "P2-D2 modificó reinforcement_bank.json."
        )

    if (
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )
        != sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK_P2B_BACKUP
        )
    ):

        fail(
            "P2-D2 modificó question_bank.json."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] reinforcement_bank sigue con 0 preguntas."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] question_bank sigue intacto con 180 preguntas."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 11. Salida para revisión
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    print()
    print(
        "RESUMEN"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 72
    )

    print(
        "Borradores               :",
        len(items),
    )

    print(
        "Targets únicos           :",
        len(set(all_targets)),
    )

    print(
        "Banco reinforcement      : 0"
    )

    print(
        "Banco original           : 180"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "DISTRIBUCIÓN"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 72
    )

    for area in [
        "Física",
        "Lenguaje",
        "Matemática",
        "Química",
    ]:

        print(
            f"{area:<16}: "
            f"{by_area.get(area, 0)}"
        )

    print()
    print(
        "PREGUNTAS PILOTO"
    )

    print(
        "=" * 72
    )

    for item in items:

        print()
        print(
            (
                f"{item['id']} <- "
                f"{item['source_spec_id']} "
                f"| {item['area']} "
                f"| {item['difficulty']}"
            )

        print(

                ]

            item[
                "stem"
            ]
        )

        for key, value in item[

    print(

    print(
        "- Las preguntas siguen en estado draft."
    )

    print(
        "- Ninguna es mastery_eligible."
    )

    print(
        "- Todavía NO se han marcado "
        "las respuestas como verificadas."
    )

    print(
        "- Todavía NO se ha marcado "
        "la cobertura como verificada."
    )

    print(
        "- reinforcement_bank.json sigue vacío."
    )

    print(
        "- question_bank.json sigue intacto."
    )

    print(
        "- Ninguna pregunta es oficial UTN."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "RESULTADO: P2-D2 BORRADORES PILOTO GENERADOS"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
