# ============================================================
# UTILIDADES
# ============================================================

def load_json(path: Path):

    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def write_json(
    path: Path,
    data,
):

    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            data,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def sha256_file(path: Path):

    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open("rb") as handle:

        while True:

            chunk = handle.read(
                1024 * 1024
            )

            if not chunk:
                break

            digest.update(
                chunk
            )

    return digest.hexdigest().upper()


def canonical_sha256(data):

    payload = json.dumps(
        data,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode("utf-8")

    return hashlib.sha256(
        payload
    ).hexdigest().upper()


def fail(message):

    print(
        f"[ERROR] {message}"
    )

    sys.exit(1)


# ============================================================
# CHECKPOINTS
# ============================================================

def verify_checkpoints():

    required = [
        QUESTION_BANK,
        QUESTION_BANK_P2B_BACKUP,

        REINFORCEMENT_SCHEMA,
        REINFORCEMENT_SCHEMA_P2D0_BACKUP,

        REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK_P2D0_BACKUP,

        P2D0_CONTRACT,
        P2D0_CONTRACT_BACKUP,

        P2C3_SPECS,
        P2C3_BACKUP,

        P2D1_MANIFEST,
        P2D1_BACKUP,

        P2D2_DRAFTS,
        P2D2_BACKUP,
    ]

    missing = [
        path
        for path in required
        if not path.exists()
    ]

    if missing:

        for path in missing:

            print(
                "[ERROR] Falta:",
                path,
            )

        sys.exit(1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # P2-C3
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2C3_BACKUP
        )
        != P2C3_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "Backup P2-C3 alterado."
        )

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2C3_SPECS
        )
        != P2C3_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "P2-C3 activo difiere "
            "del checkpoint aprobado."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Checkpoint P2-C3 verificado."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # P2-D0 schema
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_SCHEMA_P2D0_BACKUP
        )
        != P2D0_SCHEMA_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "Backup del schema P2-D0 alterado."
        )

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_SCHEMA
        )
        != P2D0_SCHEMA_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "Schema P2-D0 activo alterado."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Schema P2-D0 preservado."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # P2-D0 bank
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK_P2D0_BACKUP
        )
        != P2D0_BANK_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "Backup del reinforcement bank "
            "P2-D0 alterado."
        )

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )
        != P2D0_BANK_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "reinforcement_bank.json cambió "
            "antes de P2-D3."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] reinforcement_bank P2-D0 preservado."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # P2-D0 contract
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2D0_CONTRACT_BACKUP
        )
        != P2D0_CONTRACT_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "Backup contractual P2-D0 alterado."
        )

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2D0_CONTRACT
        )
        != P2D0_CONTRACT_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "Contrato P2-D0 activo alterado."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Contrato P2-D0 preservado."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # P2-D1
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2D1_BACKUP
        )
        != P2D1_MANIFEST_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "Backup P2-D1 alterado."
        )

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2D1_MANIFEST
        )
        != P2D1_MANIFEST_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "Manifiesto P2-D1 activo alterado."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Checkpoint P2-D1 verificado."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # P2-D2
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2D2_BACKUP
        )
        != P2D2_DRAFTS_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "Backup P2-D2 no coincide con "
            "el SHA-256 aprobado."
        )

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2D2_DRAFTS
        )
        != P2D2_DRAFTS_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "p2d2_pilot_drafts.json cambió "
            "desde su aprobación."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Checkpoint P2-D2 verificado."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Banco original
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )
        != sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK_P2B_BACKUP
        )
    ):

        fail(
            "question_bank.json difiere "
            "del checkpoint P2-B."
        )

    questions = load_json(
        QUESTION_BANK
    )

    if (
        not isinstance(
            questions,
            list,
        )
        or len(questions) != 180
    ):

        fail(
            "question_bank.json no contiene "
            "exactamente 180 preguntas."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Banco original preservado: "
        "180 preguntas."
    )


# ============================================================
# VALIDAR PAQUETE P2-D2
# ============================================================

def validate_drafts(drafts):

    if (
        drafts.get(
            "stage"
        )
        != "P2-D2"
        or
        drafts.get(
            "draft_version"
        )
        != EXPECTED_DRAFT_VERSION
        or
        drafts.get(
            "status"
        )
        != "drafts_authored_pending_validation"
    ):

        fail(
            "El archivo P2-D2 tiene "
            "identidad inesperada."
        )

    if (
        drafts.get(
            "writes_to_reinforcement_bank"
        )
        is not False
        or
        drafts.get(
            "writes_to_original_bank"
        )
        is not False
        or
        drafts.get(
            "official_utn_questions"
        )
        is not False
    ):

        fail(
            "El paquete P2-D2 viola "
            "las restricciones de seguridad."
        )

    items = drafts.get(
        "items",
        []
    )

    if len(items) != 8:

        fail(
            "P2-D2 no contiene "
            "exactamente 8 ítems."
        )

    item_ids = [
        item.get(
            "id"
        )
        for item in items
    ]

    if item_ids != EXPECTED_ITEMS:

        fail(
            "El orden o los IDs de "
            "los 8 borradores cambió."
        )

    if (
        len(item_ids)
        != len(set(item_ids))
    ):

        fail(
            "Existen IDs duplicados "
            "en P2-D2."
        )

    all_targets = []

    for item in items:

        item_id = item.get(
            "id"
        )

        if (
            item.get(
                "source_spec_id"
            )
            != EXPECTED_MAPPING[
                item_id
            ]
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: source_spec_id "
                "inesperado."
            )

        if (
            item.get(
                "answer"
            )
            != EXPECTED_ANSWERS[
                item_id
            ]
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: clave de respuesta "
                "cambió después de la validación."
            )

        if (
            item.get(
                "schema_version"
            )
            != EXPECTED_SCHEMA_VERSION
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: schema_version incorrecta."
            )

        if (
            item.get(
                "origin"
            )
            != "generated_reinforcement"
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: origin incorrecto."
            )

        if (
            item.get(
                "official_utn_question"
            )
            is not False
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: no puede declararse "
                "pregunta oficial UTN."
            )

        quality = item.get(
            "quality",
            {},
        )

        expected_draft_quality = {
            "status":
                "draft",

            "mastery_eligible":
                False,

            "coverage_verified":
                False,

            "answer_verified":
                False,

            "ambiguity_checked":
                False,

            "distractors_checked":
                False,

            "explanation_checked":
                False,

            "flags":
                [
                    "pilot_pending_validation"
                ],
        }

        if quality != expected_draft_quality:

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: el borrador original "
                "ya no conserva quality=draft."
            )

        targets = item.get(
            "target_topic_ids",
            []
        )

        if (
            not isinstance(
                targets,
                list,
            )
            or len(targets) < 1
            or len(targets) > 4
            or len(targets)
            != len(set(targets))
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_id}: target_topic_ids inválidos."
            )

        all_targets.extend(
            targets
        )

    if (
        len(all_targets)
        != EXPECTED_TARGET_COUNT
        or
        len(set(all_targets))
        != EXPECTED_TARGET_COUNT
    ):

        fail(
            "Los 8 borradores ya no conservan "
            "20 targets únicos."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] P2-D2 conserva exactamente "
        "los 8 borradores aprobados."
    )

    return items


# ============================================================
# CONSTRUIR REGISTRO POR ÍTEM
# ============================================================

def build_item_record(item):

    item_id = item[
        "id"
    ]

    return {

        "item_id":
            item_id,

        "source_spec_id":
            item[
                "source_spec_id"
            ],

        "content_sha256":
            canonical_sha256(
                item
            ),

        "area":
            item[
                "area"
            ],

        "target_topic_ids":
            list(
                item[
                    "target_topic_ids"
                ]
            ),

        "answer":
            item[
                "answer"
            ],

        "verification": {

            "content_verified":
                True,

            "answer_verified":
                True,

            "coverage_verified":
                True,

            "ambiguity_checked":
                True,

            "distractors_checked":
                True,

            "explanation_checked":
                True,

            "pdf_independence_verified":
                True,

            "official_status_checked":
                True,
        },

        "validation_basis": {

            "independent_validator":
                "tools/validate_p2d2.py",

            "validator_result":
                "58 checks passed",

            "validator_errors":
                0,

            "validator_warnings":
                0,

            "answer_validation":
                "independently verified",

            "coverage_validation":
                "20 official targets verified",

            "distractor_validation":
                "all incorrect alternatives documented",

            "explanation_validation":
                "summary and four pedagogical layers verified",
        },

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # IMPORTANTE:
        #
        # No modificamos aún el borrador P2-D2.
        # Esta será la calidad que P2-D4 podrá aplicar
        # únicamente si el SHA individual sigue coincidiendo.
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        "approved_quality_for_insertion": {

            "status":
                "validated",

            "mastery_eligible":
                True,

            "coverage_verified":
                True,

            "answer_verified":
                True,

            "ambiguity_checked":
                True,

            "distractors_checked":
                True,

            "explanation_checked":
                True,

            "flags":
                [],
        },

        "insertion_approval": {

            "approved":
                True,

            "target_bank":
                "data/reinforcement_bank.json",

            "requires_exact_content_hash_match":
                True,

            "requires_empty_or_compatible_bank":
                True,

            "may_modify_original_bank":
                False,

            "official_utn_question":
                False,
        },
    }


# ============================================================
# TXT
# ============================================================

def build_txt(record):

    summary = record[
        "summary"
    ]

    lines = []

    lines.append(
        "=" * 72
    )

    lines.append(
        "P2-D3 - REGISTRO FORMAL DE VALIDACIÓN"
    )

    lines.append(
        "=" * 72
    )

    lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        "Estado                 : validated_for_insertion"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Ítems validados        : {summary['validated_items']}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Targets verificados    : {summary['unique_target_topics']}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Errores de validación  : {summary['validator_errors']}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Warnings               : {summary['validator_warnings']}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Banco reinforcement    : {summary['reinforcement_bank_items']}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Banco original         : {summary['original_bank_items']}"
    )

    lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        "DISTRIBUCIÓN POR ÁREA"
    )

    lines.append(
        "-" * 72
    )

    for area in [
        "Física",
        "Lenguaje",
        "Matemática",
        "Química",
    ]:

        lines.append(
            f"{area:<16}: "
            f"{summary['by_area'].get(area, 0)}"
        )

    lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        "ÍTEMS APROBADOS"
    )

    lines.append(
        "-" * 72
    )

    for item in record[
        "items"
    ]:

        lines.append("")

        lines.append(
            (
                f"{item['item_id']} <- "
                f"{item['source_spec_id']} "
                f"| {item['area']}"
            )
        )

        lines.append(
            f"SHA-256 contenido: "
            f"{item['content_sha256']}"
        )

        lines.append(
            "Targets: "
            + ", ".join(
                item[
                    "target_topic_ids"
                ]
            )
        )

        lines.append(
            f"Respuesta: {item['answer']}"
        )

        lines.append(
            "Estado aprobado para inserción: validated"
        )

        lines.append(
            "mastery_eligible después de inserción: true"
        )

    lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        "GARANTÍAS"
    )

    lines.append(
        "-" * 72
    )

    lines.append(
        "- El archivo P2-D2 permanece sin modificar."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- reinforcement_bank.json permanece vacío."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- question_bank.json conserva 180 preguntas."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- Cada borrador tiene un SHA-256 "
        "individual de contenido."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- La futura inserción debe comprobar "
        "ese SHA antes de aceptar el ítem."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- Los 8 ítems fueron aprobados en "
        "58 controles independientes."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- Respuesta, cobertura, ambigüedad, "
        "distractores y explicación fueron verificados."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- Ningún ítem es una pregunta oficial UTN."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- El banco original no puede modificarse."
    )

    lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        "SIGUIENTE PASO"
    )

    lines.append(
        "-" * 72
    )

    lines.append(
        "P2-D4 podrá insertar exactamente estos "
        "8 ítems en reinforcement_bank.json, "
        "solo si todos los hashes continúan coincidiendo."
    )

    return "\n".join(
        lines
    )


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main():

    print()
    print("=" * 72)
    print(
        "P2-D3 - REGISTRO FORMAL DE VALIDACIÓN"
    )
    print("=" * 72)
    print()

    RESULTS_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Checkpoints
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    verify_checkpoints()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Leer y verificar borradores
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    drafts = load_json(
        P2D2_DRAFTS
    )

    items = validate_drafts(
        drafts
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Verificar bancos antes del registro
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    reinforcement = load_json(
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK
    )

    original_bank = load_json(
        QUESTION_BANK
    )

    if (
        reinforcement.get(
            "items"
        )
        != []
    ):

        fail(
            "reinforcement_bank debe seguir vacío "
            "antes de P2-D4."
        )

    if len(
        original_bank
    ) != 180:

        fail(
            "question_bank dejó de tener "
            "180 preguntas."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Ambos bancos conservan "
        "el estado previo a inserción."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Crear actas individuales
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    item_records = [
        build_item_record(
            item
        )
        for item in items
    ]

    content_hashes = [
        item[
            "content_sha256"
        ]
        for item in item_records
    ]

    if (
        len(content_hashes)
        != len(set(content_hashes))
    ):

        fail(
            "Dos borradores producen "
            "el mismo hash de contenido."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] 8 SHA-256 individuales "
        "de contenido calculados."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. Métricas
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    all_targets = [
        topic_id
        for item in items
        for topic_id in item.get(
            "target_topic_ids",
            []
        )
    ]

    area_counts = Counter(
        item.get(
            "area"
        )
        for item in items
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. Registro
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    record = {

        "stage":
            "P2-D3",

        "validation_record_version":
            VALIDATION_RECORD_VERSION,

        "status":
            "validated_for_insertion",

        "purpose":
            (
                "Registrar formalmente la aprobación "
                "independiente de los ocho borradores "
                "piloto antes de su inserción."
            ),

        "source_drafts":
            "results/p2d2_pilot_drafts.json",

        "source_drafts_sha256":
            P2D2_DRAFTS_SHA256,

        "target_bank":
            "data/reinforcement_bank.json",

        "writes_to_reinforcement_bank":
            False,

        "writes_to_original_bank":
            False,

        "official_utn_questions":
            False,

        "checkpoint_verification": {

            "p2c3_specs_sha256":
                P2C3_SHA256,

            "p2d0_schema_sha256":
                P2D0_SCHEMA_SHA256,

            "p2d0_empty_bank_sha256":
                P2D0_BANK_SHA256,

            "p2d0_contract_sha256":
                P2D0_CONTRACT_SHA256,

            "p2d1_manifest_sha256":
                P2D1_MANIFEST_SHA256,

            "p2d2_drafts_sha256":
                P2D2_DRAFTS_SHA256,
        },

        "validator_evidence": {

            "validator":
                "tools/validate_p2d2.py",

            "result":
                "P2-D2 APROBADO",

            "checks_passed":
                58,

            "errors":
                0,

            "warnings":
                0,

            "verified_dimensions": [
                "structure",
                "identity",
                "metadata",
                "answer_correctness",
                "official_topic_coverage",
                "ambiguity",
                "distractors",
                "explanations",
                "pdf_independence",
                "bank_integrity",
                "non_official_status",
            ],
        },

        "insertion_policy": {

            "insertion_allowed":
                True,

            "items_allowed":
                EXPECTED_ITEMS,

            "exactly_this_item_count":
                8,

            "exact_content_hash_required":
                True,

            "all_items_must_match_validation_record":
                True,

            "partial_insertion_allowed":
                False,

            "duplicate_item_ids_allowed":
                False,

            "duplicate_source_spec_ids_allowed":
                False,

            "original_bank_modification_allowed":
                False,

            "generated_items_are_official_utn_questions":
                False,

            "quality_to_apply_on_insertion": {

                "status":
                    "validated",

                "mastery_eligible":
                    True,

                "coverage_verified":
                    True,

                "answer_verified":
                    True,

                "ambiguity_checked":
                    True,

                "distractors_checked":
                    True,

                "explanation_checked":
                    True,

                "flags":
                    [],
            },
        },

        "summary": {

            "validated_items":
                len(
                    items
                ),

            "target_assignments":
                len(
                    all_targets
                ),

            "unique_target_topics":
                len(
                    set(
                        all_targets
                    )
                ),

            "by_area": {
                area:
                    area_counts.get(
                        area,
                        0,
                    )
                for area in [
                    "Física",
                    "Lenguaje",
                    "Matemática",
                    "Química",
                ]
            },

            "validator_checks_passed":
                58,

            "validator_errors":
                0,

            "validator_warnings":
                0,

            "reinforcement_bank_items":
                0,

            "original_bank_items":
                180,

            "all_items_approved_for_insertion":
                True,

            "all_items_mastery_eligible_after_insertion":
                True,
        },

        "items":
            item_records,
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 7. Autovalidación del registro
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if len(
        record[
            "items"
        ]
    ) != 8:

        fail(
            "El registro no contiene "
            "exactamente 8 actas."
        )

    record_ids = [
        item[
            "item_id"
        ]
        for item in record[
            "items"
        ]
    ]

    if record_ids != EXPECTED_ITEMS:

        fail(
            "Los IDs del registro no coinciden "
            "con el piloto aprobado."
        )

    if (
        record[
            "summary"
        ][
            "unique_target_topics"
        ]
        != 20
    ):

        fail(
            "El registro no conserva "
            "los 20 targets."
        )

    if (
        record[
            "summary"
        ][
            "by_area"
        ]
        != EXPECTED_AREA_COUNTS
    ):

        fail(
            "Distribución por área incorrecta."
        )

    for item_record in record[
        "items"
    ]:

        if (
            item_record[
                "insertion_approval"
            ][
                "approved"
            ]
            is not True
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_record['item_id']} "
                "no quedó aprobado para inserción."
            )

        approved_quality = item_record[
            "approved_quality_for_insertion"
        ]

        if (
            approved_quality[
                "status"
            ]
            != "validated"
            or
            approved_quality[
                "mastery_eligible"
            ]
            is not True
            or
            approved_quality[
                "coverage_verified"
            ]
            is not True
            or
            approved_quality[
                "answer_verified"
            ]
            is not True
            or
            approved_quality[
                "ambiguity_checked"
            ]
            is not True
            or
            approved_quality[
                "distractors_checked"
            ]
            is not True
            or
            approved_quality[
                "explanation_checked"
            ]
            is not True
            or
            approved_quality[
                "flags"
            ]
            != []
        ):

            fail(
                f"{item_record['item_id']}: "
                "quality aprobada inconsistente."
            )

    print(
        "[OK] Registro P2-D3 supera "
        "la autovalidación."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 8. Idempotencia JSON
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if OUTPUT_JSON.exists():

        try:

            existing = load_json(
                OUTPUT_JSON
            )

        except Exception as exc:

            fail(
                "p2d3_validation_record.json ya existe "
                f"pero no puede leerse: {exc}"
            )

        if existing != record:

            fail(
                "Ya existe un registro P2-D3 diferente. "
                "No se sobrescribirá."
            )

        print(
            "[OK] JSON P2-D3 existente "
            "ya coincide exactamente."
        )

    else:

        write_json(
            OUTPUT_JSON,
            record,
        )

        print(
            "[OK] Registro JSON P2-D3 creado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 9. Idempotencia TXT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    txt = build_txt(
        record
    )

    if OUTPUT_TXT.exists():

        existing_txt = OUTPUT_TXT.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )

        if existing_txt != txt:

            fail(
                "Ya existe un informe TXT P2-D3 "
                "diferente. No se sobrescribirá."
            )

        print(
            "[OK] TXT P2-D3 existente "
            "ya coincide exactamente."
        )

    else:

        OUTPUT_TXT.write_text(
            txt,
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        print(
            "[OK] Informe TXT P2-D3 creado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 10. Seguridad final
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2D2_DRAFTS
        )
        != P2D2_DRAFTS_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "P2-D3 modificó los borradores P2-D2."
        )

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )
        != P2D0_BANK_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "P2-D3 modificó reinforcement_bank.json."
        )

    if (
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )
        != sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK_P2B_BACKUP
        )
    ):

        fail(
            "P2-D3 modificó question_bank.json."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] P2-D2 permanece byte por byte intacto."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] reinforcement_bank sigue con 0 preguntas."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] question_bank sigue intacto con 180 preguntas."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 11. Salida
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    print()
    print(
        "RESUMEN"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 72
    )

    print(
        "Ítems validados          :",
        record[
            "summary"
        ][
            "validated_items"
        ],
    )

    print(
        "Targets únicos           :",
        record[
            "summary"
        ][
            "unique_target_topics"
        ],
    )

    print(
        "Checks independientes    :",
        record[
            "summary"
        ][
            "validator_checks_passed"
        ],
    )

    print(
        "Errores                  :",
        record[
            "summary"
        ][
            "validator_errors"
        ],
    )

    print(
        "Warnings                 :",
        record[
            "summary"
        ][
            "validator_warnings"
        ],
    )

    print(
        "Banco reinforcement      : 0"
    )

    print(
        "Banco original           : 180"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "HASHES INDIVIDUALES"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 72
    )

    for item in record[
        "items"
    ]:

        print(
            (
                f"{item['item_id']} "
                f"{item['content_sha256']}"
            )
        )

    print()
    print(
        "POLÍTICA DE INSERCIÓN"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 72
    )

    print(
        "Inserción permitida      : True"
    )

    print(
        "Cantidad exacta          : 8"
    )

    print(
        "Inserción parcial        : False"
    )

    print(
        "Hash exacto obligatorio  : True"
    )

    print(
        "Estado al insertar       : validated"
    )

    print(
        "mastery_eligible         : True"
    )

    print(
        "Pregunta oficial UTN     : False"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "ARCHIVOS"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 72
    )

    print(
        OUTPUT_JSON
    )

    print(
        OUTPUT_TXT
    )

    print()
    print(
        "IMPORTANTE:"
    )

    print(
        "- P2-D3 NO insertó preguntas todavía."
    )

    print(
        "- Los borradores P2-D2 permanecen "
        "sin modificar."
    )

    print(
        "- reinforcement_bank.json sigue vacío."
    )

    print(
        "- question_bank.json sigue con 180 preguntas."
    )

    print(
        "- Los 8 contenidos quedan ligados "
        "a hashes SHA-256 individuales."
    )

    print(
        "- P2-D4 deberá rechazar cualquier ítem "
        "cuyo contenido haya cambiado."
    )

    print(
        "- Ningún ítem es una pregunta oficial UTN."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "RESULTADO: P2-D3 REGISTRO DE VALIDACIÓN GENERADO"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# ============================================================
# UTILIDADES
# ============================================================

def fail(message: str) -> None:
    print(f"[ERROR] {message}")
    sys.exit(1)


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        while True:
            chunk = handle.read(1024 * 1024)

            if not chunk:
                break

            digest.update(chunk)

    return digest.hexdigest().upper()


def canonical_sha256(data) -> str:
    payload = json.dumps(
        data,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode("utf-8")

    return hashlib.sha256(
        payload
    ).hexdigest().upper()


def load_json(path: Path):
    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def atomic_write_text(
    path: Path,
    text: str,
) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    fd, temp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(
        prefix=f".{path.name}.",
        suffix=".tmp",
        dir=str(path.parent),
    )

    temp_path = Path(temp_name)

    try:
        with os.fdopen(
            fd,
            "w",
            encoding="utf-8",
            newline="\n",
        ) as handle:
            handle.write(text)
            handle.flush()
            os.fsync(handle.fileno())

        os.replace(
            temp_path,
            path,
        )

    except Exception:
        try:
            temp_path.unlink(
                missing_ok=True
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

        raise


def atomic_write_json(
    path: Path,
    data,
) -> None:
    atomic_write_text(
        path,
        json.dumps(
            data,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        ) + "\n",
    )


def normalize(text: str) -> str:
    text = str(text or "")
    text = unicodedata.normalize(
        "NFKD",
        text,
    )

    text = "".join(
        ch
        for ch in text
        if not unicodedata.combining(ch)
    )

    return (
        text.lower()
        .replace("×", "x")
        .replace("−", "-")
    )


def clean_spaces(text: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(
        r"\s+",
        " ",
        str(text or ""),
    ).strip()


# ============================================================
# EXTRACCIÓN DE PREGUNTAS DESDE LOS PDF
# ============================================================

BOILERPLATE_PREFIXES = (
    "YachayPre Preuniversitario",
    "Simulacro UTN FICA-FICAYA",
    "Instrucciones:",
    "Resolver las 90 preguntas",
    "No está permitido el uso",
    "La evaluación deberá realizarse",
    "Marcar la opción correcta",
    "Si finaliza antes del tiempo",
)


def pdf_text(path: Path) -> str:
    parts = []

    with fitz.open(path) as doc:
        for page in doc:
            parts.append(
                page.get_text("text")
            )

    return "\n".join(parts)


def remove_boilerplate(text: str) -> str:
    output = []

    for raw_line in text.splitlines():
        line = raw_line.strip()

        if not line:
            output.append("")
            continue

        if line.startswith(""):
            continue

        if any(
            line.startswith(prefix)
            for prefix in BOILERPLATE_PREFIXES
        ):
            continue

        output.append(raw_line)

    return "\n".join(output)


def parse_question_blocks(
    text: str,
) -> dict[int, str]:

    blocks = {}
    cursor = 0

    for number in range(1, 91):

        pattern = re.compile(
            rf"(?m)^\s*{number}\.(?:-)?\s*"
        )

        match = pattern.search(
            text,
            cursor,
        )

        if not match:
            fail(
                f"No se encontró la pregunta {number} "
                "durante la extracción del PDF."
            )

        if number < 90:

            next_pattern = re.compile(
                rf"(?m)^\s*{number + 1}\.(?:-)?\s*"
            )

            next_match = next_pattern.search(
                text,
                match.end(),
            )

            if not next_match:
                fail(
                    f"No se encontró la pregunta {number + 1} "
                    "al delimitar el PDF."
                )

            end = next_match.start()

        else:
            end = len(text)

        block = text[
            match.start():
            end
        ].strip()

        blocks[number] = (
            remove_boilerplate(block)
        )

        cursor = match.end()

    return blocks


def split_stem_and_options(
    block: str,
) -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]]:

    body = re.sub(
        r"^\s*\d{1,2}\.(?:-)?\s*",
        "",
        block,
        count=1,
    ).strip()

    option_pattern = re.compile(
        r"(?ms)^\s*([A-Ea-e])\s*[.)]\s*(.*?)"
        r"(?=^\s*[A-Ea-e]\s*[.)]\s*|\Z)"
    )

    matches = list(
        option_pattern.finditer(body)
    )

    if matches:
        stem = body[
            :matches[0].start()
        ].strip()

        options = {
            match.group(1).upper():
                clean_spaces(
                    match.group(2)
                )
            for match in matches
        }

    else:
        stem = body
        options = {}

    return (
        clean_spaces(stem),
        options,
    )


def load_source_questions(
    bank: list[dict],
) -> dict[str, dict]:

    pdf_names = sorted(
        {
            q["pdf"]
            for q in bank
        }
    )

    blocks_by_pdf = {}

    for pdf_name in pdf_names:

        path = (
            SOURCES_DIR
            / pdf_name
        )

        if not path.exists():
            fail(
                f"Falta PDF fuente: {path}"
            )

        text = pdf_text(path)

        blocks = (
            parse_question_blocks(
                text
            )
        )

        if len(blocks) != 90:
            fail(
                f"{pdf_name}: se esperaban "
                "90 preguntas."
            )

        blocks_by_pdf[
            pdf_name
        ] = blocks

        print(
            f"[OK] PDF extraído: "
            f"{pdf_name} -> 90 preguntas."
        )

    result = {}

    for q in bank:

        block = blocks_by_pdf[
            q["pdf"]
        ][
            int(q["number"])
        ]

        stem, options = (
            split_stem_and_options(
                block
            )
        )

        if not stem:
            fail(
                f"{q['id']}: enunciado vacío "
                "tras extraer el PDF."
            )

        result[
            q["id"]
        ] = {
            "stem":
                stem,

            "options":
                options,
        }

    return result

def profile_for(
    q: dict,
    stem: str,
) -> dict[str, str]:

    subject = (
        q.get("area")
        or q.get("subject")
        or "Razonamiento"
    )

    topic = (
        q.get("topic")
        or "contenido de la pregunta"
    )

    skill = (
        q.get("skill")
        or "aplicar el criterio correcto"
    )

    text = normalize(
        " ".join(
            [
                stem,

                    "subject",
                    "",
                ),

        )
    )

    concept = (
        f"Trabaja el tema '{topic}'. "
        f"La habilidad central es: {skill}."

    formula = (
        "Identifica la regla del tema, "

        "que la conclusión sea coherente "

    common_error = (
        "Elegir una alternativa por parecido "
        "sin comprobar el criterio o el "
        "cálculo completo."

        "escribe la regla antes de mirar "
        "las alternativas."
    )

    quick = (
        "Sin mirar la solución, explica qué "

        "del enunciado te indica usarla."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # ESTADÍSTICA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if "varianza" in text:

        concept = (

            "las desviaciones, se elevan al "
            "cuadrado y finalmente se promedian."

        formula = (
            "Varianza poblacional: "
            "σ² = Σ(xᵢ - x̄)² / N."

        common_error = (
            "Confundir varianza poblacional "
            "con varianza muestral y dividir "
            "entre N-1 cuando corresponde "
            "dividir entre N."
        )

        transfer = (
            "Cuando veas una lista completa de "

            "ejercicio trata esos datos como "
            "población o como muestra."
        )

        quick = (

        )

    elif "mediana" in text:

        concept = (

        common_error = (
            "Buscar el valor central sin "

        )

        transfer = (
            "Escribe siempre los datos de menor "
            "a mayor antes de calcular la mediana."
        )

        quick = (
            "¿Qué haces cuando existe un número "
            "par de datos?"
        )

    elif (
        "frecuencia acumulada" in text

        concept = (
            "La frecuencia acumulada suma las "

        )

        formula = (
            "Fᵢ = f₁ + f₂ + ... + fᵢ."
        )

        common_error = (
            "Tomar únicamente la frecuencia "

        )

        transfer = (
            "La palabra 'acumulada' indica "

        )

        quick = (

    elif (

        concept = (

# ============================================================
# DATOS RELEVANTES
# ============================================================

def relevant_data_from(
    stem: str,
    q: dict,
) -> list[str]:

    snippets = []

    for sentence in re.split(
        r"(?<=[.;:?])\s+",
        stem,
    ):

        sentence = clean_spaces(
            sentence
        )

        if not sentence:
            continue

        if re.search(
            r"\d|%|°|kg|m/s|N\b|J\b|Hz|mol|cm|mm",
            sentence,
            re.I,
        ):
            snippets.append(
                sentence
            )

    unique = []
    seen = set()

    for item in snippets:

        key = normalize(item)

        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            unique.append(item)

    if not unique:

        if q.get("topic"):
            unique.append(
                f"Tema: {q['topic']}."
            )

        if q.get("skill"):
            unique.append(
                f"Habilidad: {q['skill']}."
            )

    return unique[:5]


# ============================================================
# RESOLUCIÓN BASE
# ============================================================

def split_base_explanation(
    explanation: str,
) -> list[str]:

    explanation = clean_spaces(
        explanation
    )

    if not explanation:
        return []

    parts = re.split(
        r";\s+|\. (?=[A-ZÁÉÍÓÚÑ])",
        explanation,
    )

    return [
        clean_spaces(part).rstrip(".")
        for part in parts
        if clean_spaces(part)
    ][:6]


# ============================================================
# CASO ESPECIAL: VARIANZA
# ============================================================

def variance_steps(
    stem: str,
    explanation: str,
    answer: str,
):

    text = normalize(
        stem
        + " "
        + explanation
    )

    if "varianza" not in text:
        return None

    numbers = [
        float(
            value.replace(
                ",",
                ".",
            )
        )
        for value in re.findall(
            r"(?<![A-Za-z])"
            r"\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?",
            stem,
        )
    ]

    if not (
        2 <= len(numbers) <= 12
    ):
        return None

    mean = (
        sum(numbers)
        / len(numbers)
    )

    squares = [
        (value - mean) ** 2
        for value in numbers
    ]

    variance = (
        sum(squares)
        / len(numbers)
    )

    def fmt(value):
        if abs(
            value - round(value)
        ) < 1e-9:
            return str(
                int(round(value))
            )

        return f"{value:.4g}"

    return [
        {
            "order": 1,
            "title":
                "Calcula la media",

            "detail":
                (
                    "Suma todos los datos y divide "
                    "para el número de observaciones. "
                    "La media será el punto de referencia."
                ),

            "math":
                (
                    "x̄ = ("
                    + " + ".join(
                        fmt(x)
                        for x in numbers
                    )
                    + f") / {len(numbers)}"
                    + f" = {fmt(mean)}"
                ),
        },
        {
            "order": 2,
            "title":
                "Calcula las desviaciones",

            "detail":
                (
                    "A cada dato réstale la media. "
                    "Esto muestra cuánto se aleja "
                    "cada observación del centro."
                ),

            "math":
                "; ".join(
                    f"{fmt(x)}-{fmt(mean)}="
                    f"{fmt(x-mean)}"
                    for x in numbers
                ),
        },
        {
            "order": 3,
            "title":
                "Eleva las desviaciones al cuadrado",

            "detail":
                (
                    "Al elevar al cuadrado evitas "
                    "que desviaciones positivas y "
                    "negativas se cancelen."
                ),

            "math":
                (
                    " + ".join(
                        fmt(value)
                        for value in squares
                    )
                    + " = "
                    + fmt(
                        sum(squares)
                    )
                ),
        },
        {
            "order": 4,
            "title":
                "Calcula la varianza",

            "detail":
                (
                    "Para la varianza poblacional, "
                    "divide la suma de cuadrados "
                    "para el número total de datos."
                ),

            "math":
                (
                    f"σ²={fmt(sum(squares))}"
                    f"/{len(numbers)}"
                    f"={fmt(variance)}"
                ),
        },
        {
            "order": 5,
            "title":
                "Comprueba la alternativa",

            "detail":
                (
                    f"El resultado se compara con "
                    f"las opciones. La clave "
                    f"registrada es {answer}."
                ),

            "math":
                None,
        },
    ]


# ============================================================
# PASOS GENERALES
# ============================================================

def build_steps(
    q: dict,
    stem: str,
    profile: dict,
) -> list[dict]:

    special = variance_steps(
        stem,
        q.get(
            "explanation",
            "",
        ),
        q["answer"],
    )

    if special:
        return special

    data = relevant_data_from(
        stem,
        q,
    )

    base_parts = (
        split_base_explanation(
            q.get(
                "explanation",
                "",
            )
        )
    )

    steps = [
        {
            "order":
                1,

            "title":
                "Identifica el tipo de problema",

            "detail":
                (
                    f"El ejercicio pertenece a "
                    f"{profile['topic']}. "
                    f"La habilidad central es: "
                    f"{profile['skill']}. "
                    "Antes de operar, identifica "
                    "qué relación necesitas."
                ),

            "math":
                None,
        }
    ]

    if data:

        steps.append(
            {
                "order":
                    len(steps) + 1,

                "title":
                    "Organiza los datos o pistas",

                "detail":
                    (
                        "Elementos relevantes: "
                        + " | ".join(data)
                    ),

                "math":
                    None,
            }
        )

    steps.append(
        {
            "order":
                len(steps) + 1,

            "title":
                "Selecciona la regla o fórmula",

            "detail":
                profile["concept"],

            "math":
                profile["formula"],
        }
    )

    if base_parts:

        for part in base_parts:

            steps.append(
                {
                    "order":
                        len(steps) + 1,

                    "title":
                        "Desarrolla la resolución",

                    "detail":
                        (
                            "La resolución base "
                            "validada del banco "
                            "original establece: "
                            f"{part}."
                        ),

                    "math":
                        (
                            part
                            if any(
                                symbol in part
                                for symbol in [
                                    "=",
                                    "+",
                                    "-",
                                    "·",
                                    "/",
                                    "²",
                                    "³",
                                    "√",
                                ]
                            )
                            else None
                        ),
                }
            )

    else:

        steps.append(
            {
                "order":
                    len(steps) + 1,

                "title":
                    "Aplica el criterio",

                "detail":
                    (
                        "Compara las alternativas "
                        "con la regla anterior y "
                        "descarta las que la "
                        "contradicen."
                    ),

                "math":
                    None,
            }
        )

    steps.append(
        {
            "order":
                len(steps) + 1,

            "title":
                "Concluye y verifica",

            "detail":
                (
                    f"La clave registrada para "
                    f"{q['id']} es {q['answer']}. "
                    "Comprueba que el resultado, "
                    "las unidades, el signo o la "
                    "interpretación sean coherentes."
                ),

            "math":
                None,
        }
    )

    return steps


# ============================================================
# DISTRACTORES
# ============================================================

def build_distractors(
    q: dict,
    options: dict[str, str],
    profile: dict,
) -> list[dict]:

    answer = str(
        q["answer"]
    ).upper()

    output = []

    for letter in sorted(options):

        if letter == answer:
            continue

        option_text = clean_spaces(
            options[letter]
        )

        if not option_text:
            continue

        output.append(
            {
                "choice":
                    f"{letter}) {option_text}",

                "why_wrong":
                    (
                        "Esta alternativa no coincide "
                        "con el criterio o resultado "
                        "de la resolución registrada. "
                        "Para descartarla, vuelve a "
                        "aplicar el procedimiento sin "
                        "saltar pasos."
                    ),

                "error_pattern":
                    profile[
                        "common_error"
                    ],
            }
        )

    return output[:4]


# ============================================================
# SOURCE REVIEW
# ============================================================

def source_review_required(
    q: dict,
) -> bool:

    if (
        q.get("status")
        == "revisar_fuente"
    ):
        return True

    quality = q.get(
        "quality"
    )

    if isinstance(
        quality,
        dict,
    ):
        return bool(
            quality.get(
                "source_review_required"
            )
        )

    return False


# ============================================================
# CONSTRUIR EXPLICACIÓN
# ============================================================

def build_item(
    q: dict,
    source: dict,
) -> dict:

    stem = source[
        "stem"
    ]

    options = source[
        "options"
    ]

    profile = profile_for(
        q,
        stem,
    )

    source_review = (
        source_review_required(q)
    )

    flags = [
        "full_pending_validation"
    ]

    if source_review:
        flags.append(
            "source_review_required"
        )

    why_correct = (
        f"La clave registrada es "
        f"{q['answer']}. "
        "La resolución base validada "
        "del banco original indica: "
        f"{q.get('explanation', '').strip()}"
    )

    if q.get(
        "source_note"
    ):
        why_correct += (
            " Nota de fuente: "
            + q[
                "source_note"
            ].strip()
        )

    return {
        "id":
            f"EX-{q['id']}",

        "schema_version":
            SCHEMA_VERSION,

        "source_question_id":
            q["id"],

        "source_question_sha256":
            canonical_sha256(q),

        "origin":
            "generated_pedagogical_explanation",

        "official_utn_question":
            False,

        "idea_key":
            profile["concept"],

        "what_is_asked":
            (
                "Resuelve o identifica lo "
                "solicitado en el enunciado "
                "original: "
                + stem
            ),

        "relevant_data":
            relevant_data_from(
                stem,
                q,
            ),

        "concept_or_rule":
            profile["concept"],

        "formula_or_framework":
            profile["formula"],

        "steps":
            build_steps(
                q,
                stem,
                profile,
            ),

        "why_correct":
            why_correct,

        "distractor_analysis":
            build_distractors(
                q,
                options,
                profile,
            ),

        "common_error":
            profile[
                "common_error"
            ],

        "transfer_tip":
            profile[
                "transfer"
            ],

        "quick_check":
            profile[
                "quick"
            ],

        "quality": {
            "status":
                "draft",

            "content_verified":
                False,

            "answer_verified":
                False,

            "steps_verified":
                False,

            "distractors_verified":
                False,

            "pedagogical_reviewed":
                False,

            "mastery_eligible":
                False,

            "flags":
                flags,
        },

        "generation": {
            "method":
                "controlled_pedagogical_generation",

            "source_question_locked":
                True,

            "generated_from_original_question":
                True,

            "human_validation_required":
                True,
        },
    }


# ============================================================
# VALIDACIÓN ESTRUCTURAL LOCAL
# ============================================================

def validate_items(
    items: list[dict],
    bank: list[dict],
) -> None:

    if len(items) != 180:
        fail(
            "Se esperaban 180 explicaciones "
            f"y se generaron {len(items)}."
        )

    ids = [
        item["id"]
        for item in items
    ]

    if len(
        set(ids)
    ) != 180:
        fail(
            "Los IDs EX- no son únicos."
        )

    source_ids = [
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item in items
    ]

    expected_source_ids = [
        q["id"]
        for q in bank
    ]

    if (
        source_ids
        != expected_source_ids
    ):
        fail(
            "source_question_id no coincide "
            "con question_bank.json."
        )

    required = {
        "id",
        "schema_version",
        "source_question_id",
        "source_question_sha256",
        "origin",
        "official_utn_question",
        "idea_key",
        "what_is_asked",
        "relevant_data",
        "concept_or_rule",
        "formula_or_framework",
        "steps",
        "why_correct",
        "distractor_analysis",
        "common_error",
        "transfer_tip",
        "quick_check",
        "quality",
        "generation",
    }

    for item, q in zip(
        items,
        bank,
    ):

        if set(item) != required:
            fail(
                f"{item.get('id')}: "
                "campos incompletos."
            )

        if (
            item[
                "source_question_sha256"
            ]
            != canonical_sha256(q)
        ):
            fail(
                f"{item['id']}: "
                "hash fuente incorrecto."
            )

        if not item["steps"]:
            fail(
                f"{item['id']}: "
                "no tiene pasos."
            )

        orders = [
            step["order"]
            for step in item[
                "steps"
            ]
        ]

        if orders != list(
            range(
                1,
                len(orders) + 1,
            )
        ):
            fail(
                f"{item['id']}: "
                "orden de pasos inválido."
            )

        if (
            item["quality"][
                "status"
            ]
            != "draft"
        ):
            fail(
                f"{item['id']}: "
                "FULL debe generar DRAFT."
            )

        if (
            item["quality"][
                "mastery_eligible"
            ]
            is not False
        ):
            fail(
                f"{item['id']}: "
                "un DRAFT no puede contar "
                "como dominio."
            )

    print(
        "[OK] 180 explicaciones "
        "estructuralmente válidas como DRAFT."
    )


# ============================================================
# PRECONDICIONES
# ============================================================

def verify_preconditions():

    required = [
        APP,
        QUESTION_BANK,
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
        SCHEMA_FILE,
        EXPLANATION_BANK,
    ]

    for path in required:

        if not path.exists():
            fail(
                f"Falta archivo requerido: "
                f"{path}"
            )

    if (
        sha256_file(APP)
        != APP_SHA256
    ):
        fail(
            "app.py no coincide con "
            "el checkpoint P2-D5.1."
        )

    if (
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )
        != QUESTION_BANK_SHA256
    ):
        fail(
            "question_bank.json cambió."
        )

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )
        != REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256
    ):
        fail(
            "reinforcement_bank.json cambió."
        )

    if (
        sha256_file(
            SCHEMA_FILE
        )
        != SCHEMA_SHA256
    ):
        fail(
            "original_explanations_schema.json "
            "cambió."
        )

    bank = load_json(
        QUESTION_BANK
    )

    if (
        not isinstance(
            bank,
            list,
        )
        or len(bank) != 180
    ):
        fail(
            "question_bank.json debe "
            "contener 180 preguntas."
        )

    explanation_bank = load_json(
        EXPLANATION_BANK
    )

    if (
        explanation_bank.get(
            "items"
        )
        == []
    ):

        if (
            sha256_file(
                EXPLANATION_BANK
            )
            != EMPTY_BANK_SHA256
        ):
            fail(
                "El banco vacío no coincide "
                "con el contrato aprobado."
            )

    else:

        items = explanation_bank.get(
            "items",
            [],
        )

        if (
            len(items) != 180
            or any(
                item.get(
                    "quality",
                    {},
                ).get(
                    "status"
                )
                != "draft"
                for item in items
            )
        ):
            fail(
                "original_explanations_bank.json "
                "ya contiene un estado distinto "
                "del contrato vacío o del FULL DRAFT."
            )

    print(
        "[OK] app.py preservado en P2-D5.1."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] question_bank.json "
        "preservado: 180."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] reinforcement_bank.json "
        "preservado: 8."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Schema P2-D5.2 preservado."
    )

    return (
        bank,
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        ),
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        ),
        sha256_file(
            APP
        ),
    )


# ============================================================
# REPORTE
# ============================================================

def build_report(
    items,
    bank,
    before_sha,
    after_sha,
    question_sha,
    reinforcement_sha,
    app_sha,
):

    by_subject = Counter(
        (
            q.get("area")
            or q.get("subject")
            or "Sin área"
        )
        for q in bank
    )

    source_review_ids = [
        q["id"]
        for q in bank
        if source_review_required(q)
    ]

    return {
        "stage":
            "P2-D5.2",

        "substage":
            "full_draft_generation",

        "status":
            "180_original_explanations_generated_as_draft",

        "schema_version":
            SCHEMA_VERSION,

        "bank_version":
            BANK_VERSION,

        "counts": {
            "source_questions":
                180,

            "generated_explanations":
                len(items),

            "draft":
                sum(
                    item[
                        "quality"
                    ][
                        "status"
                    ]
                    == "draft"
                    for item in items
                ),

            "validated":
                0,

            "source_review_required":
                len(
                    source_review_ids
                ),
        },

        "by_area_or_subject":
            dict(
                sorted(
                    by_subject.items()
                )
            ),

        "source_review_ids":
            source_review_ids,

        "safety": {
            "question_bank_modified":
                False,

            "reinforcement_bank_modified":
                False,

            "app_modified":
                False,

            "runtime_generation":
                False,

            "human_validation_still_required":
                True,

            "mastery_enabled_for_drafts":
                False,
        },

        "hashes": {
            "app":
                app_sha,

            "question_bank":
                question_sha,

            "reinforcement_bank":
                reinforcement_sha,

            "schema":
                sha256_file(
                    SCHEMA_FILE
                ),

            "explanation_bank_before":
                before_sha,

            "explanation_bank_after":
                after_sha,
        },
    }


def build_txt(
    report,
) -> str:

    counts = report[
        "counts"
    ]

    hashes = report[
        "hashes"
    ]

    return "\n".join(
        [
            "=" * 78,
            (
                "P2-D5.2 FULL - "
                "180 EXPLICACIONES ORIGINALES"
            ),
            "=" * 78,
            "",
            (
                "Preguntas fuente             : "
                f"{counts['source_questions']}"
            ),
            (
                "Explicaciones generadas      : "
                f"{counts['generated_explanations']}"
            ),
            (
                "Estado draft                 : "
                f"{counts['draft']}"
            ),
            (
                "Estado validated             : "
                f"{counts['validated']}"
            ),
            (
                "Revisión fuente requerida    : "
                f"{counts['source_review_required']}"
            ),
            "",
            "SEGURIDAD",
            "- question_bank.json no se modifica.",
            "- reinforcement_bank.json no se modifica.",
            "- app.py no se modifica.",
            "- No hay generación durante runtime.",
            "- Las 180 explicaciones nacen como DRAFT.",
            "- Ningún DRAFT cuenta todavía como dominio.",
            "",
            "HASHES",
            (
                "app.py                 : "
                + hashes["app"]
            ),
            (
                "question_bank          : "
                + hashes[
                    "question_bank"
                ]
            ),
            (
                "reinforcement_bank     : "
                + hashes[
                    "reinforcement_bank"
                ]
            ),
            (
                "schema                 : "
                + hashes["schema"]
            ),
            (
                "explanation_bank antes : "
                + hashes[
                    "explanation_bank_before"
                ]
            ),
            (
                "explanation_bank luego : "
                + hashes[
                    "explanation_bank_after"
                ]
            ),
            "",
            (
                "RESULTADO: "
                "P2-D5.2 FULL DRAFT GENERADO"
            ),
        ]
    )


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main() -> None:

    print()
    print("=" * 78)
    print(
        "P2-D5.2 FULL - "
        "180 EXPLICACIONES PEDAGÓGICAS"
    )
    print("=" * 78)
    print()

    RESULTS_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    (
        bank,
        question_sha,
        reinforcement_sha,
        app_sha,
    ) = verify_preconditions()

    source_questions = (
        load_source_questions(
            bank
        )
    )

    if (
        len(source_questions)
        != 180
    ):
        fail(
            "La extracción de fuentes "
            "no produjo 180 preguntas."
        )

    before_sha = sha256_file(
        EXPLANATION_BANK
    )

    items = [
        build_item(
            q,
            source_questions[
                q["id"]
            ],
        )
        for q in bank
    ]

    validate_items(
        items,
        bank,
    )

    candidate = {
        "schema_version":
            SCHEMA_VERSION,

        "bank_version":
            BANK_VERSION,

        "origin":
            "pedagogical_companion_for_original_bank",

        "official_utn_question":
            False,

        "items":
            items,
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # BACKUP DEL CONTRATO VACÍO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if not EMPTY_BANK_BACKUP.exists():

        if (
            load_json(
                EXPLANATION_BANK
            ).get(
                "items"
            )
            != []
        ):
            fail(
                "No se puede crear el backup: "
                "el banco ya no está vacío."
            )

        shutil.copy2(
            EXPLANATION_BANK,
            EMPTY_BANK_BACKUP,
        )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                EMPTY_BANK_BACKUP
            )
            != EMPTY_BANK_SHA256
        ):
            fail(
                "Backup contractual vacío "
                "con hash inesperado."
            )

        print(
            "[OK] Backup del banco "
            "contractual vacío creado."
        )

    else:

        if (
            sha256_file(
                EMPTY_BANK_BACKUP
            )
            != EMPTY_BANK_SHA256
        ):
            fail(
                "Backup contractual vacío "
                "existente fue alterado."
            )

        print(
            "[OK] Backup contractual "
            "vacío existente correcto."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # ESCRITURA ATÓMICA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:

        atomic_write_json(
            EXPLANATION_BANK,
            candidate,
        )

        written = load_json(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )

        if written != candidate:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "El banco escrito no coincide "
                "con el candidato."
            )

        if (
            sha256_file(APP)
            != app_sha
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "app.py cambió durante "
                "la generación."
            )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                QUESTION_BANK
            )
            != question_sha
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "question_bank.json cambió."
            )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                REINFORCEMENT_BANK
            )
            != reinforcement_sha
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "reinforcement_bank.json cambió."
            )

        after_sha = sha256_file(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )

        report = build_report(
            items,
            bank,
            before_sha,
            after_sha,
            question_sha,
            reinforcement_sha,
            app_sha,
        )

        atomic_write_json(
            REPORT_JSON,
            report,
        )

        atomic_write_text(
            REPORT_TXT,
            build_txt(report),
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        print(
            f"[ERROR] Falló FULL: {exc}"
        )

        print(
            "[INFO] Restaurando banco "
            "complementario..."
        )

        shutil.copy2(
            EMPTY_BANK_BACKUP,
            EXPLANATION_BANK,
        )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                EXPLANATION_BANK
            )
            != EMPTY_BANK_SHA256
        ):
            fail(
                "Rollback del banco "
                "complementario falló."
            )

        fail(
            "P2-D5.2 FULL abortado; "
            "rollback completado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # RESUMEN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    print()
    print("RESUMEN")
    print("-" * 78)

    print(
        "Preguntas originales             : 180"
    )

    print(
        "Explicaciones pedagógicas creadas: 180"
    )

    print(
        "Estado                           : DRAFT"
    )

    print(
        "Validación pendiente             : True"
    )

    print(
        "Mastery habilitado               : False"
    )

    print(
        "question_bank modificado         : False"
    )

    print(
        "reinforcement_bank modificado    : False"
    )

    print(
        "app.py modificado                : False"
    )

    print(
        "Generación en runtime            : False"
    )

    print()
    print("SHA-256")
    print("-" * 78)

    print(
        "app.py                    :",
        sha256_file(APP),
    )

    print(
        "question_bank             :",
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        ),
    )

    print(
        "reinforcement_bank        :",
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        ),
    )

    print(
        "schema                    :",
        sha256_file(
            SCHEMA_FILE
        ),
    )

    print(
        "explanation_bank          :",
        sha256_file(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        ),
    )

    print()
    print("IMPORTANTE")
    print("-" * 78)

    print(
        "- Se generan las 180; no es un piloto."
    )

    print(
        "- Todavía no se muestran en Streamlit."
    )

    print(
        "- Todavía no se marcan como validated."
    )

    print(
        "- La siguiente fase revisará las 180 "
        "antes de integrarlas."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "RESULTADO: "
        "P2-D5.2 FULL DRAFT GENERADO"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
