from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path


# ============================================================
# RUTAS
# ============================================================

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

DATA_DIR = ROOT / "data"
RESULTS_DIR = ROOT / "results"

QUESTION_BANK = DATA_DIR / "question_bank.json"
REINFORCEMENT_BANK = DATA_DIR / "reinforcement_bank.json"

SCHEMA_FILE = (
    DATA_DIR / "original_explanations_schema.json"
)

BANK_FILE = (
    DATA_DIR / "original_explanations_bank.json"
)

REPORT_JSON = (
    RESULTS_DIR
    / "p2d5_2_original_explanation_contract.json"
)

REPORT_TXT = (
    RESULTS_DIR
    / "p2d5_2_original_explanation_contract.txt"
)


# ============================================================
# CHECKPOINTS ACTUALES
# ============================================================

QUESTION_BANK_SHA256 = (
    "0D7935AA56D07F10E41A13AD341D3E5D7B5FF456E00B1221A1F7E37799CB9178"
)

REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256 = (
    "A403B13D7B8C82E826EBE2655C12EE8358E73CD0419544027BB66E8064BB7F76"
)


# ============================================================
# IDENTIDAD DEL CONTRATO
# ============================================================

SCHEMA_VERSION = (
    "p2d5_2_original_explanation_v1"
)

BANK_VERSION = (
    "p2d5_2_original_explanation_bank_v1"
)


# ============================================================
# UTILIDADES
# ============================================================

def fail(message: str) -> None:
    print(f"[ERROR] {message}")
    sys.exit(1)


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        while True:
            chunk = handle.read(1024 * 1024)

            if not chunk:
                break

            digest.update(chunk)

    return digest.hexdigest().upper()


def load_json(path: Path):
    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def canonical_sha256(data) -> str:
    encoded = json.dumps(
        data,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode("utf-8")

    return hashlib.sha256(
        encoded
    ).hexdigest().upper()


def atomic_write_text(
    path: Path,
    text: str,
) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    fd, temp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(
        prefix=f".{path.name}.",
        suffix=".tmp",
        dir=str(path.parent),
    )

    temp_path = Path(temp_name)

    try:
        with os.fdopen(
            fd,
            "w",
            encoding="utf-8",
            newline="\n",
        ) as handle:
            handle.write(text)
            handle.flush()
            os.fsync(handle.fileno())

        os.replace(
            temp_path,
            path,
        )

    except Exception:
        try:
            temp_path.unlink(
                missing_ok=True
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

        raise


def atomic_write_json(
    path: Path,
    data,
) -> None:
    text = json.dumps(
        data,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        indent=2,
    ) + "\n"

    atomic_write_text(
        path,
        text,
    )


def write_if_absent_or_identical(
    path: Path,
    data,
) -> None:
    if path.exists():
        current = load_json(path)

        if current != data:
            fail(
                f"{path.name} ya existe "
                "con contenido diferente."
            )

        print(
            f"[OK] {path.name} ya existe "
            "y coincide exactamente."
        )

        return

    atomic_write_json(
        path,
        data,
    )

    print(
        f"[OK] Creado: {path.name}"
    )


# ============================================================
# VERIFICACIÓN DE ESTADO
# ============================================================

def verify_project_state():
    required = [
        QUESTION_BANK,
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
    ]

    missing = [
        path
        for path in required
        if not path.exists()
    ]

    if missing:
        for path in missing:
            print(
                f"[ERROR] Falta: {path}"
            )

        sys.exit(1)

    question_sha = sha256_file(
        QUESTION_BANK
    )

    reinforcement_sha = sha256_file(
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK
    )

    if (
        question_sha
        != QUESTION_BANK_SHA256
    ):
        fail(
            "question_bank.json no coincide "
            "con el checkpoint aprobado."
        )

    if (
        reinforcement_sha
        != REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256
    ):
        fail(
            "reinforcement_bank.json no coincide "
            "con el checkpoint aprobado."
        )

    questions = load_json(
        QUESTION_BANK
    )

    reinforcement = load_json(
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK
    )

    if (
        not isinstance(
            questions,
            list,
        )
        or len(questions) != 180
    ):
        fail(
            "question_bank.json debe contener "
            "exactamente 180 preguntas."
        )

    reinforcement_items = reinforcement.get(
        "items",
        [],
    )

    if len(
        reinforcement_items
    ) != 8:
        fail(
            "reinforcement_bank.json debe "
            "conservar 8 preguntas."
        )

    question_ids = [
        item.get("id")
        for item in questions
    ]

    if len(
        set(question_ids)
    ) != 180:
        fail(
            "Los IDs del banco original "
            "no son únicos."
        )

    invalid_ids = [
        question_id
        for question_id in question_ids
        if not (
            isinstance(
                question_id,
                str,
            )
            and (
                question_id.startswith("S1-")
                or
                question_id.startswith("S3-")
            )
        )
    ]

    if invalid_ids:
        fail(
            "Existen IDs originales inesperados: "
            + ", ".join(
                invalid_ids[:10]
            )
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Banco original: 180 preguntas."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Banco de refuerzo: 8 preguntas."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Ambos bancos coinciden con "
        "sus checkpoints aprobados."
    )

    return (
        questions,
        question_sha,
        reinforcement_sha,
    )

def build_contract_report(
    questions,
    question_sha: str,
    reinforcement_sha: str,
    schema,
    bank,
):
    source_question_hashes = {
        q["id"]:
            canonical_sha256(q)
        for q in questions
    }

    return {
        "stage":
            "P2-D5.2",

        "substage":
            "contract",

        "status":
            "original_explanation_contract_created",

        "schema_version":
            SCHEMA_VERSION,

        "bank_version":
            BANK_VERSION,

        "purpose": (
            "Provide validated pedagogical, step-by-step "
            "expanded explanations for original S1/S3 questions."
        ),

        "principles": {
            "question_bank_remains_immutable":
                True,

            "reinforcement_bank_remains_immutable":
                True,

            "explanations_are_stored_separately":
                True,

            "expanded_explanation_means_solution_teaching":
                True,

            "curricular_metadata_is_secondary":
                True,

            "automatic_runtime_solution_generation":
                False,

            "validation_required_before_use":
                True,
        },

        "pedagogical_layers": [
            "idea_key",
            "what_is_asked",
            "relevant_data",
            "concept_or_rule",
            "formula_or_framework",
            "steps",
            "why_correct",
            "distractor_analysis",
            "common_error",
            "transfer_tip",
            "quick_check",
        ],

        "source": {
            "question_bank_items":
                len(questions),

            "question_bank_sha256":
                question_sha,

            "reinforcement_bank_sha256":
                reinforcement_sha,

            "source_question_hashes":
                source_question_hashes,
        },

        "initial_bank": {
            "items":
                len(
                    bank["items"]
                ),

            "expected_initial_items":
                0,
        },

        "schema": {
            "required_item_fields":
                schema[
                    "$defs"
                ][
                    "explanation_item"
                ][
                    "required"
                ],

            "quality_states": [
                "draft",
                "validated",
                "rejected",
            ],
        },

        "next_stage": {
            "name":
                "P2-D5.2 pilot",

            "goal":
                (
                    "Create and validate a small pilot "
                    "of pedagogical explanations before "
                    "expanding coverage to all original questions."
                ),
        },
    }

# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main() -> None:
    print()
    print("=" * 76)
    print(
        "P2-D5.2 - CONTRATO DE EXPLICACIONES "
        "PEDAGÓGICAS ORIGINALES"
    )
    print("=" * 76)
    print()

    DATA_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    RESULTS_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    (
        questions,
        question_sha,
        reinforcement_sha,
    ) = verify_project_state()

    schema = build_schema()
    bank = build_empty_bank()

    report = build_contract_report(
        questions,
        question_sha,
        reinforcement_sha,
        schema,
        bank,
    )

    txt = build_txt(
        report
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # ESCRITURA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    write_if_absent_or_identical(
        SCHEMA_FILE,
        schema,
    )

    write_if_absent_or_identical(
        BANK_FILE,
        bank,
    )

    write_if_absent_or_identical(
        REPORT_JSON,
        report,
    )

    if REPORT_TXT.exists():
        current_txt = REPORT_TXT.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )

        if current_txt != txt:
            fail(
                "El informe TXT P2-D5.2 "
                "ya existe con contenido diferente."
            )

        print(
            "[OK] Informe TXT existente "
            "coincide exactamente."
        )

    else:
        atomic_write_text(
            REPORT_TXT,
            txt,
        )

        print(
            "[OK] Creado informe TXT P2-D5.2."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # VERIFICACIÓN POST
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )
        != QUESTION_BANK_SHA256
    ):
        fail(
            "question_bank.json cambió "
            "durante la construcción."
        )

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )
        != REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256
    ):
        fail(
            "reinforcement_bank.json cambió "
            "durante la construcción."
        )

    written_bank = load_json(
        BANK_FILE
    )

    if (
        written_bank.get(
            "items"
        )
        != []
    ):
        fail(
            "El banco complementario "
            "debe iniciar vacío."
        )

    print()
    print("RESUMEN")
    print("-" * 76)

    print(
        "Banco original                   : 180"
    )

    print(
        "Banco refuerzo                   : 8"
    )

    print(
        "Banco explicaciones originales   : 0"
    )

    print(
        "Banco original modificado         : False"
    )

    print(
        "Banco refuerzo modificado         : False"
    )

    print(
        "Explicaciones separadas           : True"
    )

    print(
        "Validación obligatoria            : True"
    )

    print(
        "Generación automática en runtime  : False"
    )

    print()
    print("ARCHIVOS")
    print("-" * 76)

    print(
        "Schema :",
        SCHEMA_FILE.relative_to(ROOT),
    )

    print(
        "Banco  :",
        BANK_FILE.relative_to(ROOT),
    )

    print(
        "Reporte:",
        REPORT_JSON.relative_to(ROOT),
    )

    print()
    print("SHA-256")
    print("-" * 76)

    print(
        "question_bank          :",
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        ),
    )

    print(
        "reinforcement_bank     :",
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        ),
    )

    print(
        "schema explicaciones   :",
        sha256_file(
            SCHEMA_FILE
        ),
    )

    print(
        "bank explicaciones     :",
        sha256_file(
            BANK_FILE
        ),
    )

    print()
    print(
        "RESULTADO: CONTRATO P2-D5.2 CREADO"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# ============================================================
# UTILIDADES
# ============================================================

def fail(message: str) -> None:
    print(f"[ERROR] {message}")
    sys.exit(1)


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        while True:
            chunk = handle.read(1024 * 1024)

            if not chunk:
                break

            digest.update(chunk)

    return digest.hexdigest().upper()


def canonical_sha256(data) -> str:
    payload = json.dumps(
        data,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode("utf-8")

    return hashlib.sha256(
        payload
    ).hexdigest().upper()


def load_json(path: Path):
    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def atomic_write_text(
    path: Path,
    text: str,
) -> None:

    path.parent.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    fd, temporary_name = tempfile.mkstemp(
        prefix=f".{path.name}.",
        suffix=".tmp",
        dir=str(path.parent),
    )

    temporary_path = Path(
        temporary_name
    )

    try:

        with os.fdopen(
            fd,
            "w",
            encoding="utf-8",
            newline="\n",
        ) as handle:

            handle.write(text)
            handle.flush()

            os.fsync(
                handle.fileno()
            )

        os.replace(
            temporary_path,
            path,
        )

    except Exception:

        try:
            temporary_path.unlink(
                missing_ok=True
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

        raise


def atomic_write_json(
    path: Path,
    data,
) -> None:

    atomic_write_text(
        path,
        json.dumps(
            data,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        ) + "\n",
    )


def normalize(value) -> str:
    text = str(
        value or ""
    )

    text = unicodedata.normalize(
        "NFKD",
        text,
    )

    text = "".join(
        ch
        for ch in text
        if not unicodedata.combining(ch)
    )

    text = (
        text.lower()
        .replace("×", "x")
        .replace("−", "-")
    )

    text = re.sub(
        r"\s+",
        " ",
        text,
    )

    return text.strip()


def clean_spaces(value) -> str:
    return re.sub(
        r"\s+",
        " ",
        str(value or ""),
    ).strip()


def trim(
    value: str,
    limit: int = 320,
) -> str:

    value = clean_spaces(
        value
    )

    if len(value) <= limit:
        return value

    return (
        value[: limit - 1]
        .rstrip()
        + "…"
    )


# ============================================================
# PRECONDICIONES
# ============================================================

def verify_preconditions():

    required = [
        APP,
        QUESTION_BANK,
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
        SCHEMA_FILE,
        EXPLANATION_BANK,
        AUDIT_JSON,
    ]

    missing = [
        path
        for path in required
        if not path.exists()
    ]

    if missing:

        for path in missing:
            print(
                f"[ERROR] Falta: {path}"
            )

        sys.exit(1)

    expected_hashes = [
        (
            APP,
            APP_SHA256,
            "app.py",
        ),
        (
            QUESTION_BANK,
            QUESTION_BANK_SHA256,
            "question_bank.json",
        ),
        (
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256,
            "reinforcement_bank.json",
        ),
        (
            SCHEMA_FILE,
            SCHEMA_SHA256,
            "original_explanations_schema.json",
        ),
        (
            EXPLANATION_BANK,
            FULL_DRAFT_BANK_SHA256,
            "original_explanations_bank.json FULL DRAFT",
        ),
    ]

    for path, expected, label in expected_hashes:

        actual = sha256_file(
            path
        )

        if actual != expected:
            fail(
                f"{label} cambió. "
                f"Esperado={expected}, actual={actual}"
            )

    questions = load_json(
        QUESTION_BANK
    )

    reinforcement = load_json(
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK
    )

    explanation_bank = load_json(
        EXPLANATION_BANK
    )

    audit = load_json(
        AUDIT_JSON
    )

    if (
        not isinstance(
            questions,
            list,
        )
        or len(questions) != 180
    ):
        fail(
            "question_bank.json debe "
            "contener 180 preguntas."
        )

    if len(
        reinforcement.get(
            "items",
            [],
        )
    ) != 8:
        fail(
            "reinforcement_bank.json debe "
            "conservar 8 ítems."
        )

    items = explanation_bank.get(
        "items",
        [],
    )

    if len(items) != 180:
        fail(
            "El banco FULL debe "
            "contener 180 explicaciones."
        )

    if any(
        item.get(
            "quality",
            {},
        ).get(
            "status"
        )
        != "draft"
        for item in items
    ):
        fail(
            "Todas las explicaciones deben "
            "seguir en estado DRAFT."
        )

    if (
        audit.get("stage")
        != "P2-D5.2"
        or
        audit.get("substage")
        != "full_draft_audit"
        or
        audit.get(
            "summary",
            {},
        ).get(
            "items_audited"
        )
        != 180
    ):
        fail(
            "El reporte de auditoría FULL "
            "no corresponde a las 180."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Checkpoint FULL DRAFT verificado."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Auditoría de 180 disponible."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] app/question_bank/refuerzo/schema intactos."
    )

    return (
        questions,
        explanation_bank,
        audit,
    )


# ============================================================
# PDF
# ============================================================

BOILERPLATE_PREFIXES = (
    "YachayPre Preuniversitario",
    "Simulacro UTN FICA-FICAYA",
    "Instrucciones:",
    "Resolver las 90 preguntas",
    "No está permitido el uso",
    "La evaluación deberá realizarse",
    "Marcar la opción correcta",
    "Si finaliza antes del tiempo",
)


def pdf_text(path: Path) -> str:

    pieces = []

    with fitz.open(path) as doc:

        for page in doc:
            pieces.append(
                page.get_text(
                    "text"
                )
            )

    return "\n".join(
        pieces
    )


def remove_boilerplate(
    text: str,
) -> str:

    output = []

    for raw_line in text.splitlines():

        line = raw_line.strip()

        if not line:
            output.append("")
            continue

        if line.startswith(""):
            continue

        if any(
            line.startswith(prefix)
            for prefix
            in BOILERPLATE_PREFIXES
        ):
            continue

        output.append(
            raw_line
        )

    return "\n".join(
        output
    )


def parse_question_blocks(
    text: str,
) -> dict[int, str]:

    blocks = {}
    cursor = 0

    for number in range(
        1,
        91,
    ):

        current_pattern = re.compile(
            rf"(?m)^\s*{number}\.(?:-)?\s*"
        )

        match = current_pattern.search(
            text,
            cursor,
        )

        if not match:
            fail(
                f"No se encontró pregunta "
                f"{number} en PDF."
            )

        if number < 90:

            next_pattern = re.compile(
                rf"(?m)^\s*{number + 1}\.(?:-)?\s*"
            )

            next_match = next_pattern.search(
                text,
                match.end(),
            )

            if not next_match:
                fail(
                    f"No se pudo delimitar "
                    f"pregunta {number}."
                )

            end = next_match.start()

        else:
            end = len(text)

        blocks[number] = (
            remove_boilerplate(
                text[
                    match.start():
                    end
                ]
            ).strip()
        )

        cursor = match.end()

    return blocks


def split_stem_and_options(
    block: str,
) -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]]:

    body = re.sub(
        r"^\s*\d{1,2}\.(?:-)?\s*",
        "",
        block,
        count=1,
    ).strip()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Primero: opciones que comienzan línea.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    line_pattern = re.compile(
        r"(?ms)^\s*([A-Ea-e])"
        r"\s*[.)]\s*(.*?)"
        r"(?=^\s*[A-Ea-e]"
        r"\s*[.)]\s*|\Z)"
    )

    line_matches = list(
        line_pattern.finditer(body)
    )

    if len(line_matches) >= 2:

        stem = clean_spaces(
            body[
                :line_matches[0].start()
            ]
        )

        options = {
            match.group(1).upper():
                clean_spaces(
                    match.group(2)
                )
            for match
            in line_matches
        }

        return (
            stem,
            options,
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Segundo intento: opciones inline.
    # Ej. "a) 0J b) 150J c) ..."
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    inline_pattern = re.compile(
        r"(?i)(?<![A-Za-z])"
        r"([A-E])\s*[.)]\s*"
    )

    inline_matches = list(
        inline_pattern.finditer(
            body
        )
    )

    if len(inline_matches) >= 2:

        stem = clean_spaces(
            body[
                :inline_matches[0].start()
            ]
        )

        options = {}

        for index, match in enumerate(
            inline_matches
        ):

            start = match.end()

            if (
                index + 1
                < len(inline_matches)
            ):
                end = (
                    inline_matches[
                        index + 1
                    ].start()
                )
            else:
                end = len(body)

            options[
                match.group(1).upper()
            ] = clean_spaces(
                body[
                    start:end
                ]
            )

        return (
            stem,
            options,
        )

    return (
        clean_spaces(body),
        {},
    )


def extract_pdf_sources(
    questions: list[dict],
) -> dict[str, dict]:

    pdf_names = sorted(
        {
            question["pdf"]
            for question
            in questions
        }
    )

    parsed = {}

    for pdf_name in pdf_names:

        path = (
            SOURCES_DIR
            / pdf_name
        )

        if not path.exists():
            fail(
                f"Falta PDF fuente: {path}"
            )

        blocks = parse_question_blocks(
            pdf_text(path)
        )

        if len(blocks) != 90:
            fail(
                f"{pdf_name}: se esperaban 90 preguntas."
            )

        parsed[
            pdf_name
        ] = blocks

        print(
            f"[OK] {pdf_name}: 90 bloques."
        )

    result = {}

    for question in questions:

        block = parsed[
            question["pdf"]
        ][
            int(
                question["number"]
            )
        ]

        stem, options = (
            split_stem_and_options(
                block
            )
        )

        if not stem:
            fail(
                f"{question['id']}: "
                "stem vacío."
            )

        result[
            question["id"]
        ] = {
            "stem":
                stem,

            "options":
                options,
        }

    if len(result) != 180:
        fail(
            "La extracción PDF no produjo "
            "180 preguntas."
        )

    return result

def make_profile(
    concept: str,
    framework: str,
    common_error: str,
    transfer: str,
    quick: str,
    action: str = "aplicar",
) -> dict:

    return {
        "concept":
            concept,

        "framework":
            framework,

        "common_error":
            common_error,

        "transfer":
            transfer,

        "quick":
            quick,

        "action":
            action,
    }

            "σ² = Σ(xᵢ-x̄)²/N para población.",

            "x̄ = Σx / n.",
            (
                "Dividir entre una cantidad incorrecta "
                "de datos o confundir media con mediana."
            ),
            (
                "Si conoces la media y falta un dato, "

    if (

            "Fᵢ=f₁+f₂+...+fᵢ.",
            (
                "Usar solamente la frecuencia de "
                "la categoría solicitada."
            ),
            (
                "La palabra 'acumulada' significa "
                "que debes arrastrar las frecuencias "
                "anteriores."
            ),
            (
                "¿Puede disminuir Fᵢ cuando avanzas "
                "a la siguiente categoría?"
            ),
            "calcular",
        )

    if (
        "frecuencia absoluta" in text
        and "acumulada" not in text
    ):

        return make_profile(
            (
                "La frecuencia absoluta indica cuántas "

            ),
            (
                "Lee directamente el valor fi de "

            ),
            (
                "Confundir frecuencia absoluta con "

            ),
            (

                "fi, Fi, frecuencia relativa o porcentaje."
            ),
            (

            ),
            "identificar",

    if (
        "histograma" in text
        or "cola prolongada" in text

        return make_profile(

    if (

    ):

    if (

# ============================================================
# INTERPRETAR QUÉ PIDE
# ============================================================

def question_target_phrase(
    stem: str,
) -> str:

    text = clean_spaces(
        stem
    )

    interrogatives = re.findall(
        r"¿([^?]+)\?",
        text,
        flags=re.S,
    )

    if interrogatives:

        target = clean_spaces(
            interrogatives[-1]
        )

    else:

        target = text

    target = re.sub(
        r"^(seleccione|selecciona|subraye|"
        r"elegir|elija)\s+"
        r"(la\s+)?respuesta\s+correcta[:,]?\s*",
        "",
        target,
        flags=re.I,
    )

    target = re.sub(
        r"^(cu[aá]l|cu[aá]les)\s+es\s+",
        "",
        target,
        flags=re.I,
    )

    target = re.sub(
        r"^(cu[aá]l|cu[aá]les)\s+son\s+",
        "",
        target,
        flags=re.I,
    )

    target = re.sub(
        r"^qu[eé]\s+",
        "",
        target,
        flags=re.I,
    )

    target = clean_spaces(
        target
    )

    return trim(
        target,
        240,
    )


def build_what_is_asked(
    question: dict,
    stem: str,
    profile: dict,
) -> str:

    target = question_target_phrase(
        stem
    )

    action_labels = {
        "calcular":
            "calcular",

        "derivar":
            "obtener la derivada de",

        "clasificar":
            "clasificar correctamente",

        "identificar":
            "identificar",

        "interpretar":
            "interpretar",

        "resolver":
            "resolver",

        "relacionar":
            "relacionar correctamente",
    }

    action = action_labels.get(
        profile["action"],
        "resolver",
    )

    if target:

        objective = (
            f"Debes {action} lo siguiente: "
            f"{target}."
        )

    else:

        objective = (
            f"Debes {action} la incógnita "
            "o criterio central del ejercicio."
        )

    # Mantiene trazabilidad textual con el PDF sin limitarse
    # a repetir el stem como supuesto "análisis".
    return (
        objective
        + " "
        + "Para comprobar que estás trabajando sobre "
        + "la información correcta, el enunciado de "
        + "referencia es: "
        + stem
    )


# ============================================================
# DATOS RELEVANTES
# ============================================================

def extract_relevant_data(
    stem: str,
    question: dict,
) -> list[str]:

    candidates = []

    # Valores numéricos, magnitudes y relaciones explícitas.
    sentences = re.split(
        r"(?<=[.;:?])\s+",
        stem,
    )

    for sentence in sentences:

        sentence = clean_spaces(
            sentence
        )

        if not sentence:
            continue

        if re.search(
            r"\d|%|°|kg|g\b|m/s|m/s²|"
            r"N\b|J\b|Hz|mol|cm|km|mm|"
            r"ln|sin|cos|matriz|puntos?\s*\(",
            sentence,
            flags=re.I,
        ):
            candidates.append(
                sentence
            )

    if not candidates:

        # En una pregunta conceptual, el dato relevante
        # es la condición/palabra clave, no necesariamente
        # un número.
        target = question_target_phrase(
            stem
        )

        if target:
            candidates.append(
                "Condición o criterio clave del enunciado: "
                + target
            )

        base = clean_spaces(
            question.get(
                "explanation"
            )
        )

        if base:
            candidates.append(
                "Criterio confirmado por la resolución base: "
                + trim(
                    base,
                    220,
                )
            )

    unique = []
    seen = set()

    for candidate in candidates:

        key = normalize(
            candidate
        )

        if (
            key
            and key not in seen
        ):
            seen.add(key)

            unique.append(
                trim(
                    candidate,
                    300,
                )
            )

    return unique[:6]


# ============================================================
# RESOLUCIÓN BASE
# ============================================================

def split_base_explanation(
    explanation: str,
) -> list[str]:

    explanation = clean_spaces(
        explanation
    )

    if not explanation:
        return []

    chunks = re.split(
        r";\s*|(?<=\.)\s+(?=[A-ZÁÉÍÓÚÑ])",
        explanation,
    )

    output = []

    for chunk in chunks:

        chunk = clean_spaces(
            chunk
        ).rstrip(".")

        if chunk:
            output.append(
                chunk
            )

    return output[:8]


def looks_like_math(
    text: str,
) -> bool:

    text = str(
        text or ""
    )

    symbols = [
        "=",
        "+",
        "-",
        "·",
        "/",
        "√",
        "²",
        "³",
        "%",
        "sin",
        "cos",
        "ln",
        "det",
        "→",
    ]

    return any(
        symbol in text
        for symbol in symbols
    )


# ============================================================
# PASOS ESPECIALES
# ============================================================

def numeric_values(
    text: str,
) -> list[float]:

    values = []

    for match in re.findall(
        r"(?<![A-Za-z])"
        r"-?\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?",
        text,
    ):

        try:
            values.append(
                float(
                    match.replace(
                        ",",
                        ".",
                    )
                )
            )
        except ValueError:
            pass

    return values


def fmt_number(
    value: float,
) -> str:

    if abs(
        value - round(value)
    ) < 1e-9:

        return str(
            int(
                round(value)
            )
        )

    return f"{value:.4g}"


def variance_steps(
    question: dict,
    stem: str,
):

    if "varianza" not in normalize(
        stem
    ):
        return None

    numbers = numeric_values(
        stem
    )

    # El stem contiene también números de pregunta u otros
    # elementos en algunos PDF; para S1-70 sabemos que
    # los datos relevantes son los últimos cuatro valores.
    if question.get("id") == "S1-70":

        numbers = [
            56.0,
            52.0,
            50.0,
            54.0,
        ]

    if not (
        2 <= len(numbers) <= 12
    ):
        return None

    mean = (
        sum(numbers)
        / len(numbers)
    )

    deviations = [
        value - mean
        for value in numbers
    ]

    squares = [
        deviation ** 2
        for deviation
        in deviations
    ]

    square_sum = sum(
        squares
    )

    variance = (
        square_sum
        / len(numbers)
    )

    return [
        {
            "order":
                1,

            "title":
                "Calcula la media",

            "detail":
                (
                    "Suma los valores y divide entre "
                    "el número total de observaciones. "
                    "La media será el centro respecto "
                    "del cual mediremos la dispersión."
                ),

            "math":
                (
                    "x̄=("
                    + "+".join(
                        fmt_number(x)
                        for x in numbers
                    )
                    + f")/{len(numbers)}"
                    + f"={fmt_number(mean)}"
                ),
        },
        {
            "order":
                2,

            "title":
                "Calcula las desviaciones",

            "detail":
                (
                    "Resta la media a cada valor. "
                    "Aquí aparecen desviaciones positivas "
                    "y negativas según el dato esté "
                    "por encima o por debajo de la media."
                ),

            "math":
                "; ".join(
                    (
                        f"{fmt_number(value)}"
                        f"-{fmt_number(mean)}"
                        f"={fmt_number(deviation)}"
                    )
                    for value, deviation
                    in zip(
                        numbers,
                        deviations,
                    )
                ),
        },
        {
            "order":
                3,

            "title":
                "Eleva las desviaciones al cuadrado",

            "detail":
                (
                    "Las desviaciones se elevan al cuadrado "
                    "para evitar que valores positivos "
                    "y negativos se cancelen."
                ),

            "math":
                (
                    " + ".join(
                        fmt_number(square)
                        for square in squares
                    )
                    + " = "
                    + fmt_number(
                        square_sum
                    )
                ),
        },
        {
            "order":
                4,

            "title":
                "Calcula la varianza poblacional",

            "detail":
                (
                    "El enunciado dice que se trata "
                    "de un estudio poblacional; por eso "
                    "la suma de cuadrados se divide entre N, "
                    "no entre N-1."
                ),

            "math":
                (
                    f"σ²={fmt_number(square_sum)}"
                    f"/{len(numbers)}"
                    f"={fmt_number(variance)}"
                ),
        },
        {
            "order":
                5,

            "title":
                "Relaciona el resultado con la alternativa",

            "detail":
                (
                    f"El resultado es {fmt_number(variance)}. "
                    f"Por eso debe coincidir con la opción "
                    f"{question['answer']}."
                ),

            "math":
                None,
        },
    ]


# ============================================================
# PASOS GENERALES ENRIQUECIDOS
# ============================================================

def build_steps(
    question: dict,
    stem: str,
    profile: dict,
    relevant_data: list[str],
    correct_option: str,
) -> list[dict]:

    special = variance_steps(
        question,
        stem,
    )

    if special:
        return special

    steps = []

    target = question_target_phrase(
        stem
    )

    steps.append(
        {
            "order":
                1,

            "title":
                "Define exactamente el objetivo",

            "detail":
                (
                    f"El ejercicio te pide {profile['action']} "
                    f"este objetivo: {target}. "
                    "No empieces por las alternativas; "
                    "primero determina qué resultado "
                    "o criterio debe obtenerse."
                ),

            "math":
                None,
        }
    )

    steps.append(
        {
            "order":
                2,

            "title":
                "Organiza los datos y condiciones",

            "detail":
                (
                    "Usa únicamente la información relevante: "
                    + " | ".join(
                        relevant_data
                    )
                ),

            "math":
                None,
        }
    )

    steps.append(
        {
            "order":
                3,

            "title":
                "Aplica la regla correspondiente",

            "detail":
                profile[
                    "concept"
                ],

            "math":
                profile[
                    "framework"
                ],
        }
    )

    base_parts = split_base_explanation(
        question.get(
            "explanation",
            ""
        )
    )

    if base_parts:

        for part in base_parts:

            steps.append(
                {
                    "order":
                        len(steps) + 1,

                    "title":
                        "Ejecuta el cálculo o criterio",

                    "detail":
                        (
                            "Aplicado específicamente "
                            "a esta pregunta: "
                            + part
                            + "."
                        ),

                    "math":
                        (
                            part
                            if looks_like_math(
                                part
                            )
                            else None
                        ),
                }
            )

    else:

        steps.append(
            {
                "order":
                    len(steps) + 1,

                "title":
                    "Aplica el criterio al caso",

                "detail":
                    (
                        "Compara cada alternativa con "
                        "la regla anterior y elimina "
                        "las que la contradicen."
                    ),

                "math":
                    None,
            }
        )

    conclusion = (
        f"La clave registrada es {question['answer']}."
    )

    if correct_option:
        conclusion += (
            " Esa alternativa dice: "
            + correct_option
            + "."
        )

    conclusion += (
        " Comprueba que sea coherente con "
        "el procedimiento anterior antes de continuar."
    )

    steps.append(
        {
            "order":
                len(steps) + 1,

            "title":
                "Comprueba la respuesta",

            "detail":
                conclusion,

            "math":
                None,
        }
    )

    return steps


# ============================================================
# DISTRACTORES
# ============================================================

def extract_first_numeric_value(
    text: str,
):

    values = numeric_values(
        text
    )

    if not values:
        return None

    return values[0]


def numeric_distractor_reason(
    wrong_text: str,
    correct_text: str,
    profile: dict,
) -> str | None:

    wrong = extract_first_numeric_value(
        wrong_text
    )

    correct = extract_first_numeric_value(
        correct_text
    )

    if (
        wrong is None
        or correct is None
        or math.isclose(
            correct,
            0.0,
            abs_tol=1e-12,
        )
    ):
        return None

    if math.isclose(
        wrong,
        -correct,
        rel_tol=1e-5,
        abs_tol=1e-8,
    ):
        return (
            "Conserva la magnitud pero cambia el signo. "
            "Ese error suele aparecer al perder el sentido "
            "del vector, fuerza, pendiente o término algebraico."
        )

    ratio = abs(
        wrong / correct
    )

    if math.isclose(
        ratio,
        2.0,
        rel_tol=0.03,
    ):
        return (
            "Es aproximadamente el doble del resultado correcto. "
            "Puede aparecer al duplicar un factor o contar "
            "dos veces una contribución."
        )

    if math.isclose(
        ratio,
        0.5,
        rel_tol=0.03,
    ):
        return (
            "Es aproximadamente la mitad del resultado correcto. "
            "Puede aparecer al introducir indebidamente un factor 1/2 "
            "o dividir una cantidad que no correspondía."
        )

    if math.isclose(
        ratio,
        10.0,
        rel_tol=0.03,
    ) or math.isclose(
        ratio,
        0.1,
        rel_tol=0.03,
    ):

        return (
            "Difiere por un factor 10. "
            "Revisa potencias de diez y conversiones "
            "de unidades o decimales."
        )

    if math.isclose(
        ratio,
        100.0,
        rel_tol=0.03,
    ) or math.isclose(
        ratio,
        0.01,
        rel_tol=0.03,
    ):

        return (
            "Difiere por un factor 100. "
            "Es típico de una conversión decimal/porcentaje "
            "o de unidades cuadráticas mal realizada."
        )

    return (
        f"Propone el valor {wrong_text}, pero el procedimiento "
        f"correcto conduce a {correct_text}. "
        f"Para evitar este desvío, aplica explícitamente "
        f"la relación: {profile['framework']}"
    )


def build_distractors(
    question: dict,
    options: dict[str, str],
    profile: dict,
) -> list[dict]:

    answer = str(
        question.get(
            "answer",
            ""
        )
    ).upper()

    correct_text = clean_spaces(
        options.get(
            answer,
            "",
        )
    )

    base = clean_spaces(
        question.get(
            "explanation",
            ""
        )
    )

    output = []

    for letter in sorted(
        options
    ):

        if letter == answer:
            continue

        wrong_text = clean_spaces(
            options[
                letter
            ]
        )

        if not wrong_text:
            continue

        numeric_reason = (
            numeric_distractor_reason(
                wrong_text,
                correct_text,
                profile,
            )
        )

        if numeric_reason:

            why_wrong = (
                numeric_reason
            )

        else:

            why_wrong = (
                f"La opción {letter} afirma "
                f"'{wrong_text}', pero no satisface "
                f"el criterio que sí conduce a la "
                f"alternativa {answer}"
            )

            if correct_text:
                why_wrong += (
                    f" ('{correct_text}')"
                )

            why_wrong += (
                ". La resolución base que permite "
                "descartarla es: "
                + base
            )

        output.append(
            {
                "choice":
                    f"{letter}) {wrong_text}",

                "why_wrong":
                    why_wrong,

                "error_pattern":
                    profile[
                        "common_error"
                    ],
            }
        )

    return output[:4]


# ============================================================
# WHY CORRECT
# ============================================================

def build_why_correct(
    question: dict,
    correct_option: str,
) -> str:

    base = clean_spaces(
        question.get(
            "explanation",
            ""
        )
    )

    answer = question[
        "answer"
    ]

    text = (
        f"La alternativa {answer} es la clave registrada."
    )

    if correct_option:
        text += (
            f" Su contenido es: '{correct_option}'."
        )

    text += (
        " Se obtiene porque, al aplicar el procedimiento "
        "específico del ejercicio, resulta: "
        + base
    )

    source_note = clean_spaces(
        question.get(
            "source_note"
        )
    )

    if source_note:
        text += (
            " La fuente conserva además esta advertencia: "
            + source_note
        )

    return text


# ============================================================
# ENRIQUECER ITEM
# ============================================================

def source_review_required(
    question: dict,
) -> bool:

    if (
        question.get(
            "status"
        )
        == "revisar_fuente"
    ):
        return True

    quality = question.get(
        "quality",
        {},
    )

    if isinstance(
        quality,
        dict,
    ):
        return bool(
            quality.get(
                "source_review_required"
            )
        )

    return False


def enrich_item(
    question: dict,
    old_item: dict,
    source: dict,
) -> dict:

    if (
        old_item.get(
            "source_question_id"
        )
        != question[
            "id"
        ]
    ):
        fail(
            f"{question['id']}: "
            "source_question_id inconsistente."
        )

    expected_hash = canonical_sha256(
        question
    )

    if (
        old_item.get(
            "source_question_sha256"
        )
        != expected_hash
    ):
        fail(
            f"{question['id']}: "
            "source hash inconsistente."
        )

    stem = source[
        "stem"
    ]

    options = source[
        "options"
    ]

    profile = pedagogical_profile(
        question,
        stem,
    )

    relevant_data = (
        extract_relevant_data(
            stem,
            question,
        )
    )

    answer = str(
        question[
            "answer"
        ]
    ).upper()

    correct_option = clean_spaces(
        options.get(
            answer,
            "",
        )
    )

    flags = [
        "p2d5_3_enriched",
        "full_pending_validation",
    ]

    if source_review_required(
        question
    ):
        flags.append(
            "source_review_required"
        )

    return {
        "id":
            old_item[
                "id"
            ],

        "schema_version":
            SCHEMA_VERSION,

        "source_question_id":
            question[
                "id"
            ],

        "source_question_sha256":
            expected_hash,

        "origin":
            "generated_pedagogical_explanation",

        "official_utn_question":
            False,

        "idea_key":
            profile[
                "concept"
            ],

        "what_is_asked":
            build_what_is_asked(
                question,
                stem,
                profile,
            ),

        "relevant_data":
            relevant_data,

        "concept_or_rule":
            profile[
                "concept"
            ],

        "formula_or_framework":
            profile[
                "framework"
            ],

        "steps":
            build_steps(
                question,
                stem,
                profile,
                relevant_data,
                correct_option,
            ),

        "why_correct":
            build_why_correct(
                question,
                correct_option,
            ),

        "distractor_analysis":
            build_distractors(
                question,
                options,
                profile,
            ),

        "common_error":
            profile[
                "common_error"
            ],

        "transfer_tip":
            profile[
                "transfer"
            ],

        "quick_check":
            profile[
                "quick"
            ],

        "quality": {
            "status":
                "draft",

            "content_verified":
                False,

            "answer_verified":
                False,

            "steps_verified":
                False,

            "distractors_verified":
                False,

            "pedagogical_reviewed":
                False,

            "mastery_eligible":
                False,

            "flags":
                flags,
        },

        "generation": {
            "method":
                "controlled_pedagogical_generation",

            "source_question_locked":
                True,

            "generated_from_original_question":
                True,

            "human_validation_required":
                True,
        },
    }


# ============================================================
# VALIDACIÓN LOCAL DEL CANDIDATO
# ============================================================

def validate_candidate(
    candidate: dict,
    questions: list[dict],
) -> None:

    if (
        candidate.get(
            "schema_version"
        )
        != SCHEMA_VERSION
    ):
        fail(
            "schema_version candidato incorrecto."
        )

    if (
        candidate.get(
            "bank_version"
        )
        != BANK_VERSION
    ):
        fail(
            "bank_version candidato incorrecto."
        )

    items = candidate.get(
        "items",
        [],
    )

    if len(items) != 180:
        fail(
            "El candidato no contiene 180 items."
        )

    ids = [
        item[
            "id"
        ]
        for item in items
    ]

    if len(
        set(ids)
    ) != 180:
        fail(
            "IDs EX duplicados."
        )

    for question, item in zip(
        questions,
        items,
    ):

        if (
            item[
                "id"
            ]
            != f"EX-{question['id']}"
        ):
            fail(
                f"{question['id']}: ID EX incorrecto."
            )

        if (
            item[
                "source_question_id"
            ]
            != question[
                "id"
            ]
        ):
            fail(
                f"{question['id']}: vínculo fuente incorrecto."
            )

        if (
            item[
                "source_question_sha256"
            ]
            != canonical_sha256(
                question
            )
        ):
            fail(
                f"{question['id']}: hash fuente incorrecto."
            )

        if (
            item[
                "quality"
            ][
                "status"
            ]
            != "draft"
        ):
            fail(
                f"{question['id']}: "
                "no debe pasar a VALIDATED."
            )

        if (
            item[
                "quality"
            ][
                "mastery_eligible"
            ]
            is not False
        ):
            fail(
                f"{question['id']}: "
                "DRAFT no puede contar como dominio."
            )

        for field in [
            "idea_key",
            "what_is_asked",
            "concept_or_rule",
            "formula_or_framework",
            "why_correct",
            "common_error",
            "transfer_tip",
            "quick_check",
        ]:

            if not clean_spaces(
                item.get(
                    field
                )
            ):
                fail(
                    f"{question['id']}: "
                    f"{field} vacío."
                )

        steps = item.get(
            "steps",
            []
        )

        if len(steps) < 4:
            fail(
                f"{question['id']}: "
                "menos de 4 pasos."
            )

        orders = [
            step[
                "order"
            ]
            for step in steps
        ]

        if orders != list(
            range(
                1,
                len(steps) + 1,
            )
        ):
            fail(
                f"{question['id']}: "
                "orden de pasos inválido."
            )

        # No debe sobrevivir el bloque genérico anterior.
        if item[
            "what_is_asked"
        ].startswith(
            "Resuelve o identifica lo solicitado "
            "en el enunciado original:"
        ):
            fail(
                f"{question['id']}: "
                "what_is_asked sigue genérico."
            )

        if item[
            "concept_or_rule"
        ].startswith(
            "Trabaja el tema '"
        ):
            fail(
                f"{question['id']}: "
                "concept sigue con plantilla antigua."
            )

        for distractor in item.get(
            "distractor_analysis",
            []
        ):

            if (
                "Esta alternativa no coincide "
                "con el criterio o resultado "
                "de la resolución registrada."
                in distractor.get(
                    "why_wrong",
                    ""
                )
            ):
                fail(
                    f"{question['id']}: "
                    "distractor conserva texto genérico antiguo."
                )

    print(
        "[OK] Candidato enriquecido: "
        "180/180 estructuralmente válidos."
    )


# ============================================================
# CONTROL S1-70
# ============================================================

def validate_variance_control(
    items: list[dict],
) -> None:

    by_source = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]:
            item
        for item in items
    }

    item = by_source.get(
        "S1-70"
    )

    if not item:
        fail(
            "Falta EX-S1-70."
        )

    titles = [
        step[
            "title"
        ]
        for step
        in item[
            "steps"
        ]
    ]

    expected = [
        "Calcula la media",
        "Calcula las desviaciones",
        "Eleva las desviaciones al cuadrado",
        "Calcula la varianza poblacional",
        "Relaciona el resultado con la alternativa",
    ]

    if titles != expected:
        fail(
            "EX-S1-70 perdió su resolución "
            "pedagógica específica."
        )

    math_text = normalize(
        " ".join(
            str(
                step.get(
                    "math"
                )
                or ""
            )
            for step
            in item[
                "steps"
            ]
        )
    ).replace(
        " ",
        "",
    )

    if (
        "=53"
        not in math_text
        or
        "=5"
        not in math_text
    ):
        fail(
            "EX-S1-70 no llega a "
            "media=53 y varianza=5."
        )

    if (
        "n-1"
        not in normalize(
            item[
                "common_error"
            ]
        )
    ):
        fail(
            "EX-S1-70 perdió advertencia N vs N-1."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Control EX-S1-70 preservado "
        "con resolución completa."
    )


# ============================================================
# REPORTE
# ============================================================

def build_report(
    old_items: list[dict],
    new_items: list[dict],
    before_hash: str,
    after_hash: str,
    questions: list[dict],
) -> dict:

    changed = sum(
        old != new
        for old, new in zip(
            old_items,
            new_items,
        )
    )

    with_distractors = sum(
        bool(
            item[
                "distractor_analysis"
            ]
        )
        for item
        in new_items
    )

    source_review_ids = [
        question[
            "id"
        ]
        for question
        in questions
        if source_review_required(
            question
        )
    ]

    return {
        "stage":
            "P2-D5.3",

        "substage":
            "full_pedagogical_enrichment",

        "status":
            "180_original_explanations_enriched_as_draft",

        "counts": {
            "source_questions":
                180,

            "items_before":
                len(
                    old_items
                ),

            "items_after":
                len(
                    new_items
                ),

            "items_changed":
                changed,

            "draft_after":
                sum(
                    item[
                        "quality"
                    ][
                        "status"
                    ]
                    == "draft"
                    for item
                    in new_items
                ),

            "validated_after":
                sum(
                    item[
                        "quality"
                    ][
                        "status"
                    ]
                    == "validated"
                    for item
                    in new_items
                ),

            "items_with_distractor_analysis":
                with_distractors,

            "source_review_required":
                len(
                    source_review_ids
                ),
        },

        "global_improvements": {
            "what_is_asked_interpreted":
                True,

            "old_stem_wrapper_removed":
                True,

            "old_generic_distractor_text_removed":
                True,

            "question_specific_steps":
                True,

            "topic_profiles_expanded":
                True,

            "numeric_distractor_reasoning":
                True,

            "transfer_and_quick_check_expanded":
                True,

            "s1_70_variance_control_preserved":
                True,
        },

        "safety": {
            "question_bank_modified":
                False,

            "reinforcement_bank_modified":
                False,

            "app_modified":
                False,

            "schema_modified":
                False,

            "quality_status_promoted":
                False,

            "human_validation_still_required":
                True,

            "mastery_enabled":
                False,
        },

        "source_review_ids":
            source_review_ids,

        "hashes": {
            "app":
                sha256_file(
                    APP
                ),

            "question_bank":
                sha256_file(
                    QUESTION_BANK
                ),

            "reinforcement_bank":
                sha256_file(
                    REINFORCEMENT_BANK
                ),

            "schema":
                sha256_file(
                    SCHEMA_FILE
                ),

            "explanation_bank_before":
                before_hash,

            "explanation_bank_after":
                after_hash,
        },
    }

        ),
        (
            "reinforcement_bank      : "
            + hashes[
                "reinforcement_bank"
            ]
        ),
        (
            "schema                  : "
            + hashes[
                "schema"
            ]
        ),
        (
            "explanation_bank antes  : "
            + hashes[
                "explanation_bank_before"
            ]
        ),
        (
            "explanation_bank luego  : "
            + hashes[
                "explanation_bank_after"
            ]
        ),
        "",
        "RESULTADO: P2-D5.3 FULL ENRIQUECIDO",
    ]

    return "\n".join(
        lines
    )

# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main() -> None:

    print()
    print("=" * 80)
    print(
        "P2-D5.3 FULL - "
        "ENRIQUECIMIENTO PEDAGÓGICO 180/180"
    )
    print("=" * 80)
    print()

    (
        questions,
        explanation_bank,
        audit,
    ) = verify_preconditions()

    original_items = (
        explanation_bank[
            "items"
        ]
    )

    sources = extract_pdf_sources(
        questions
    )

    enriched_items = []

    for question, old_item in zip(
        questions,
        original_items,
    ):

        enriched_items.append(
            enrich_item(
                question,
                old_item,
                sources[
                    question[
                        "id"
                    ]
                ],
            )
        )

    candidate = {
        "schema_version":
            SCHEMA_VERSION,

        "bank_version":
            BANK_VERSION,

        "origin":
            "pedagogical_companion_for_original_bank",

        "official_utn_question":
            False,

        "items":
            enriched_items,
    }

    validate_candidate(
        candidate,
        questions,
    )

    validate_variance_control(
        enriched_items
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Backup exacto del FULL DRAFT anterior
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if FULL_DRAFT_BACKUP.exists():

        if (
            sha256_file(
                FULL_DRAFT_BACKUP
            )
            != FULL_DRAFT_BANK_SHA256
        ):
            fail(
                "Backup pre-enrichment existente "
                "no coincide con FULL DRAFT."
            )

        print(
            "[OK] Backup pre-P2-D5.3 existente correcto."
        )

    else:

        shutil.copy2(
            EXPLANATION_BANK,
            FULL_DRAFT_BACKUP,
        )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                FULL_DRAFT_BACKUP
            )
            != FULL_DRAFT_BANK_SHA256
        ):
            fail(
                "Backup pre-enrichment creado "
                "con hash incorrecto."
            )

        print(
            "[OK] Backup pre-P2-D5.3 creado."
        )

    before_hash = sha256_file(
        EXPLANATION_BANK
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Escritura atómica + rollback
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:

        atomic_write_json(
            EXPLANATION_BANK,
            candidate,
        )

        written = load_json(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )

        if written != candidate:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "El banco escrito no coincide "
                "con el candidato."
            )

        # Archivos estables
        if (
            sha256_file(APP)
            != APP_SHA256
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "app.py cambió."
            )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                QUESTION_BANK
            )
            != QUESTION_BANK_SHA256
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "question_bank.json cambió."
            )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                REINFORCEMENT_BANK
            )
            != REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "reinforcement_bank.json cambió."
            )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                SCHEMA_FILE
            )
            != SCHEMA_SHA256
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "schema cambió."
            )

        after_hash = sha256_file(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )

        if (
            after_hash
            == before_hash
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "El banco enriquecido tiene "
                "el mismo hash que el FULL DRAFT."
            )

        report = build_report(
            original_items,
            enriched_items,
            before_hash,
            after_hash,
            questions,
        )

        atomic_write_json(
            REPORT_JSON,
            report,
        )

        atomic_write_text(
            REPORT_TXT,
            build_txt(
                report
            ),
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        print(
            f"[ERROR] Falló P2-D5.3: {exc}"
        )

        print(
            "[INFO] Ejecutando rollback..."
        )

        shutil.copy2(
            FULL_DRAFT_BACKUP,
            EXPLANATION_BANK,
        )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                EXPLANATION_BANK
            )
            != FULL_DRAFT_BANK_SHA256
        ):
            fail(
                "Rollback falló."
            )

        fail(
            "P2-D5.3 abortado y banco "
            "FULL DRAFT restaurado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Resumen
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    print()
    print("RESUMEN")
    print("-" * 80)

    print(
        "Explicaciones procesadas         : 180"
    )

    print(
        "Explicaciones enriquecidas       :",
        report[
            "counts"
        ][
            "items_changed"
        ],
    )

    print(
        "Estado final                     : DRAFT"
    )

    print(
        "VALIDATED                        : 0"
    )

    print(
        "Mastery habilitado               : False"
    )

    print(
        "Con análisis de distractores     :",
        report[
            "counts"
        ][
            "items_with_distractor_analysis"
        ],
    )

    print(
        "Revisión de fuente               :",
        report[
            "counts"
        ][
            "source_review_required"
        ],
    )

    print()
    print("SEGURIDAD")
    print("-" * 80)

    print(
        "question_bank modificado         : False"
    )

    print(
        "reinforcement_bank modificado    : False"
    )

    print(
        "app.py modificado                : False"
    )

    print(
        "schema modificado                : False"
    )

    print()
    print("SHA-256")
    print("-" * 80)

    print(
        "app.py                   :",
        sha256_file(
            APP
        ),
    )

    print(
        "question_bank            :",
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        ),
    )

    print(
        "reinforcement_bank       :",
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        ),
    )

    print(
        "schema                   :",
        sha256_file(
            SCHEMA_FILE
        ),
    )

    print(
        "explanation_bank antes   :",
        before_hash,
    )

    print(
        "explanation_bank después :",
        sha256_file(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        ),
    )

    print()
    print("IMPORTANTE")
    print("-" * 80)

    print(
        "- Las 180 fueron enriquecidas; "
        "no es un piloto."
    )

    print(
        "- Ninguna explicación fue aprobada "
        "automáticamente."

    )

    print()
    print(

    )

    main()

def fail(message: str) -> None:
    print(f"[ERROR] {message}")
    sys.exit(1)


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        while True:
            chunk = handle.read(
                1024 * 1024
            )

            if not chunk:
                break

            digest.update(chunk)

    return digest.hexdigest().upper()


def canonical_sha256(data) -> str:
    payload = json.dumps(
        data,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode("utf-8")

    return hashlib.sha256(
        payload
    ).hexdigest().upper()


def load_json(path: Path):
    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def atomic_write_text(
    path: Path,
    text: str,
) -> None:

    path.parent.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    fd, temporary_name = tempfile.mkstemp(
        prefix=f".{path.name}.",
        suffix=".tmp",
        dir=str(path.parent),
    )

    temporary_path = Path(
        temporary_name
    )

    try:
        with os.fdopen(
            fd,
            "w",
            encoding="utf-8",
            newline="\n",
        ) as handle:

            handle.write(text)
            handle.flush()
            os.fsync(
                handle.fileno()
            )

        os.replace(
            temporary_path,
            path,
        )

    except Exception:

        try:
            temporary_path.unlink(
                missing_ok=True
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

        raise


def atomic_write_json(
    path: Path,
    data,
) -> None:

    atomic_write_text(
        path,
        json.dumps(
            data,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        ) + "\n",
    )


def clean_spaces(value) -> str:
    return re.sub(
        r"\s+",
        " ",
        str(value or ""),
    ).strip()


def normalize(value) -> str:
    text = str(
        value or ""
    )

    text = unicodedata.normalize(
        "NFKD",
        text,
    )

    text = "".join(
        character
        for character in text
        if not unicodedata.combining(
            character
        )
    )

    text = (
        text.lower()
        .replace("×", "x")
        .replace("−", "-")
    )

    text = re.sub(
        r"\s+",
        " ",
        text,
    )

    return text.strip()


def trim(
    value: str,
    limit: int = 360,
) -> str:

    value = clean_spaces(
        value
    )

    if len(value) <= limit:
        return value

    return (
        value[: limit - 1].rstrip()
        + "…"
    )


def source_review_required(
    question: dict,
) -> bool:

    if (
        question.get("status")
        == "revisar_fuente"
    ):
        return True

    quality = question.get(
        "quality",
        {},
    )

    if isinstance(
        quality,
        dict,
    ):
        return bool(
            quality.get(
                "source_review_required"
            )
        )

    return False
