def verify_preconditions():

    required = [
        APP,
        QUESTION_BANK,
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
        SCHEMA_FILE,
        EXPLANATION_BANK,
        AUDIT_JSON,
    ]

    missing = [
        path
        for path in required
        if not path.exists()
    ]

    if missing:
        for path in missing:
            print(
                f"[ERROR] Falta: {path}"
            )

        sys.exit(1)

    checkpoints = [
        (
            APP,
            APP_SHA256,
            "app.py",
        ),
        (
            QUESTION_BANK,
            QUESTION_BANK_SHA256,
            "question_bank.json",
        ),
        (
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256,
            "reinforcement_bank.json",
        ),
        (
            SCHEMA_FILE,
            SCHEMA_SHA256,
            "schema",
        ),
        (
            EXPLANATION_BANK,
            ENRICHED_BANK_SHA256,
            "original_explanations_bank P2-D5.3",
        ),
    ]

    for path, expected, label in checkpoints:

        actual = sha256_file(
            path
        )

        if actual != expected:
            fail(
                f"{label} cambió. "
                f"Esperado={expected}, actual={actual}"
            )

    questions = load_json(
        QUESTION_BANK
    )

    reinforcement = load_json(
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK
    )

    bank = load_json(
        EXPLANATION_BANK
    )

    audit = load_json(
        AUDIT_JSON
    )

    if (
        not isinstance(
            questions,
            list,
        )
        or
        len(questions) != 180
    ):
        fail(
            "question_bank debe contener 180 preguntas."
        )

    if (
        len(
            reinforcement.get(
                "items",
                [],
            )
        )
        != 8
    ):
        fail(
            "reinforcement_bank debe conservar 8 ítems."
        )

    if (
        bank.get(
            "schema_version"
        )
        != SCHEMA_VERSION
        or
        bank.get(
            "bank_version"
        )
        != BANK_VERSION
    ):
        fail(
            "Identidad del banco de explicaciones incorrecta."
        )

    if (
        len(
            bank.get(
                "items",
                [],
            )
        )
        != 180
    ):
        fail(
            "El banco de explicaciones no contiene 180 ítems."
        )

    if any(
        item.get(
            "quality",
            {},
        ).get(
            "status"
        )
        != "draft"
        for item
        in bank[
            "items"
        ]
    ):
        fail(
            "Las 180 explicaciones deben seguir en DRAFT."
        )

    summary = audit.get(
        "summary",
        {},
    )

    classifications = summary.get(
        "classifications",
        {},
    )

    expected_audit = {
        "validation_candidate":
            169,
        "needs_enrichment":
            4,
        "source_review":
            7,
    }

    for key, expected in expected_audit.items():

        if (
            classifications.get(
                key,
                0,
            )
            != expected
        ):
            fail(
                "La auditoría P2-D5.3 no coincide "
                f"con el checkpoint: {key}."
            )

    if (
        summary.get(
            "fallback_profile_items"
        )
        != 28
    ):
        fail(
            "Se esperaban 28 perfiles fallback."
        )

    if (
        summary.get(
            "items_without_distractors"
        )
        != 1
    ):
        fail(
            "Se esperaba 1 ítem sin distractores."
        )

    if (
        summary.get(
            "items_with_semigeneric_distractors"
        )
        != 177
    ):
        fail(
            "Se esperaban 177 ítems con "
            "distractores semigenéricos."
        )

    if (
        audit.get(
            "hashes",
            {},
        ).get(
            "explanation_bank"
        )
        != ENRICHED_BANK_SHA256
    ):
        fail(
            "El audit P2-D5.3 no corresponde "
            "al banco enriquecido actual."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Checkpoint P2-D5.3 verificado."
    )

    return (
        questions,
        bank,
        audit,
    )


# ============================================================
# PDF
# ============================================================

BOILERPLATE_PREFIXES = (
    "YachayPre Preuniversitario",
    "Simulacro UTN FICA-FICAYA",
    "Instrucciones:",
    "Resolver las 90 preguntas",
    "No está permitido el uso",
    "La evaluación deberá realizarse",
    "Marcar la opción correcta",
    "Si finaliza antes del tiempo",
)


def pdf_text(
    path: Path,
) -> str:

    parts = []

    with fitz.open(path) as document:

        for page in document:

            parts.append(
                page.get_text(
                    "text"
                )
            )

    return "\n".join(
        parts
    )


def remove_boilerplate(
    text: str,
) -> str:

    output = []

    for raw_line in text.splitlines():

        line = raw_line.strip()

        if not line:
            output.append("")
            continue

        if line.startswith(""):
            continue

        if any(
            line.startswith(prefix)
            for prefix
            in BOILERPLATE_PREFIXES
        ):
            continue

        output.append(
            raw_line
        )

    return "\n".join(
        output
    )


def parse_question_blocks(
    text: str,
) -> dict[int, str]:

    blocks = {}
    cursor = 0

    for number in range(
        1,
        91,
    ):

        pattern = re.compile(
            rf"(?m)^\s*{number}\.(?:-)?\s*"
        )

        match = pattern.search(
            text,
            cursor,
        )

        if not match:
            fail(
                f"No se encontró pregunta {number}."
            )

        if number < 90:

            next_pattern = re.compile(
                rf"(?m)^\s*{number + 1}"
                rf"\.(?:-)?\s*"
            )

            next_match = next_pattern.search(
                text,
                match.end(),
            )

            if not next_match:
                fail(
                    f"No se pudo delimitar "
                    f"pregunta {number}."
                )

            end = next_match.start()

        else:
            end = len(text)

        blocks[number] = (
            remove_boilerplate(
                text[
                    match.start():
                    end
                ]
            ).strip()
        )

        cursor = match.end()

    return blocks


# ============================================================
# OVERRIDE DOCUMENTADO
# ============================================================

# El PDF de S3-77 contiene cuatro alternativas visibles.
# La extracción lineal del PDF separa la notación matemática
# en demasiadas líneas y P2-D5.3 no logró reconstruirlas.
#
# No se inventa una quinta opción.
#
S3_77_OPTIONS = {
    "A":
        "f'(x) = 12x³ - 10x + 7",

    "B":
        "f'(x) = 12x⁴ - 10x² + 7",

    "C":
        "f'(x) = 3x³ - 5x + 7",

    "D":
        "f'(x) = 12x³ - 5x + 7",
}


def split_stem_and_options(
    block: str,
    question_id: str,
) -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]]:

    body = re.sub(
        r"^\s*\d{1,2}\.(?:-)?\s*",
        "",
        block,
        count=1,
    ).strip()

    if question_id == "S3-77":

        # El stem termina justo antes de A).
        position = re.search(
            r"(?mi)^\s*A\s*[.)]",
            body,
        )

        if position:
            stem = clean_spaces(
                body[
                    :position.start()
                ]
            )
        else:
            stem = (
                "Determine la derivada de la función "
                "f(x)=3x⁴-5x²+7x-2."
            )

        return (
            stem,
            dict(
                S3_77_OPTIONS
            ),
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Alternativas al inicio de línea
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    line_pattern = re.compile(
        r"(?ms)^\s*([A-Ea-e])"
        r"\s*[.)]\s*(.*?)"
        r"(?=^\s*[A-Ea-e]"
        r"\s*[.)]\s*|\Z)"
    )

    matches = list(
        line_pattern.finditer(
            body
        )
    )

    if len(matches) >= 2:

        stem = clean_spaces(
            body[
                :matches[0].start()
            ]
        )

        options = {
            match.group(1).upper():
                clean_spaces(
                    match.group(2)
                )
            for match
            in matches
        }

        return (
            stem,
            options,
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Alternativas inline
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    inline_pattern = re.compile(
        r"(?i)(?<![A-Za-z])"
        r"([A-E])\s*[.)]\s*"
    )

    inline_matches = list(
        inline_pattern.finditer(
            body
        )
    )

    if len(inline_matches) >= 2:

        stem = clean_spaces(
            body[
                :inline_matches[0].start()
            ]
        )

        options = {}

        for index, match in enumerate(
            inline_matches
        ):

            start = match.end()

            if (
                index + 1
                < len(
                    inline_matches
                )
            ):
                end = (
                    inline_matches[
                        index + 1
                    ].start()
                )

            else:
                end = len(body)

            options[
                match.group(1).upper()
            ] = clean_spaces(
                body[
                    start:end
                ]
            )

        return (
            stem,
            options,
        )

    return (
        clean_spaces(body),
        {},
    )


def extract_sources(
    questions: list[dict],
) -> dict[str, dict]:

    pdf_names = sorted(
        {
            question["pdf"]
            for question
            in questions
        }
    )

    parsed = {}

    for pdf_name in pdf_names:

        path = (
            SOURCES_DIR
            / pdf_name
        )

        if not path.exists():
            fail(
                f"Falta PDF: {path}"
            )

        blocks = parse_question_blocks(
            pdf_text(
                path
            )
        )

        if len(blocks) != 90:
            fail(
                f"{pdf_name}: no produjo 90 bloques."
            )

        parsed[
            pdf_name
        ] = blocks

        print(
            f"[OK] {pdf_name}: 90 bloques."
        )

    result = {}

    for question in questions:

        question_id = question[
            "id"
        ]

        block = parsed[
            question[
                "pdf"
            ]
        ][
            int(
                question[
                    "number"
                ]
            )
        ]

        stem, options = (
            split_stem_and_options(
                block,
                question_id,
            )
        )

        if not stem:
            fail(
                f"{question_id}: stem vacío."
            )

        result[
            question_id
        ] = {
            "stem":
                stem,

            "options":
                options,
        }

    return result


# ============================================================
# DEUDA DE LA AUDITORÍA
# ============================================================

def get_debt_sets(
    audit: dict,
):

    fallback_ids = set(
        audit.get(
            "fallback_profile_ids",
            [],
        )
    )

    no_distractor_ids = set(
        audit.get(
            "ids_without_distractors",
            [],
        )
    )

    semigeneric_ids = set(
        audit.get(
            "ids_with_semigeneric_distractors",
            [],
        )
    )

    relevant_data_ids = set()

    needs_enrichment_ids = set()

    for audit_item in audit.get(
        "items",
        [],
    ):

        source_id = audit_item.get(
            "source_question_id"
        )

        reasons = set(
            audit_item.get(
                "enrichment_reasons",
                [],
            )
        )

        if (
            "relevant_data_weak"
            in reasons
        ):
            relevant_data_ids.add(
                source_id
            )

        if (
            audit_item.get(
                "classification"
            )
            == "needs_enrichment"
        ):
            needs_enrichment_ids.add(
                source_id
            )

    return {
        "fallback":
            fallback_ids,

        "no_distractors":
            no_distractor_ids,

        "semigeneric":
            semigeneric_ids,

        "relevant_data":
            relevant_data_ids,

        "needs_enrichment":
            needs_enrichment_ids,
    }


# ============================================================
# OBJETIVO / DATOS
# ============================================================

def question_target_phrase(
    stem: str,
) -> str:

    text = clean_spaces(
        stem
    )

    questions = re.findall(
        r"¿([^?]+)\?",
        text,
        flags=re.S,
    )

    if questions:
        target = clean_spaces(
            questions[-1]
        )

    else:
        target = text

    target = re.sub(
        r"^(seleccione|selecciona|subraye|"
        r"elegir|elija|identifique|determine|"
        r"calcule|calcular)\s*[:,]?\s*",
        "",
        target,
        flags=re.I,
    )

    return trim(
        target,
        260,
    )


def extract_quantity_fragments(
    stem: str,
) -> list[str]:

    fragments = []

    # Expresiones entre paréntesis útiles:
    # puntos, datos, unidades, condiciones.
    for match in re.findall(
        r"\([^()]{2,100}\)",
        stem,
    ):

        if re.search(
            r"\d|=|°|%|kg|m/s|N\b|J\b|Hz|mol",
            match,
            flags=re.I,
        ):
            fragments.append(
                clean_spaces(
                    match
                )
            )

    # Oraciones o segmentos con valores.
    for segment in re.split(
        r"[.;:?]\s*",
        stem,
    ):

        segment = clean_spaces(
            segment
        )

        if (
            segment
            and
            re.search(
                r"\d|%|°|kg|g\b|m/s|m/s²|"
                r"N\b|J\b|Hz|mol|cm|km|mm|"
                r"µ|μ|x\)|y\)|det\(|ln\(",
                segment,
                flags=re.I,
            )
        ):
            fragments.append(
                trim(
                    segment,
                    280,
                )
            )

    unique = []
    seen = set()

    for fragment in fragments:

        key = normalize(
            fragment
        )

        if (
            key
            and
            key not in seen
        ):
            seen.add(
                key
            )

            unique.append(
                fragment
            )

    return unique[:5]


def build_specific_relevant_data(
    question: dict,
    stem: str,
) -> list[str]:

    target = question_target_phrase(
        stem
    )

    base = clean_spaces(
        question.get(
            "explanation"
        )
    )

    data = []

    if target:
        data.append(
            "Objetivo concreto del ejercicio: "
            + target
        )

    for fragment in extract_quantity_fragments(
        stem
    ):
        data.append(
            "Dato o condición del enunciado: "
            + fragment
        )

    if base:
        data.append(
            "Relación de resolución ya comprobada "
            "para esta pregunta: "
            + trim(
                base,
                280,
            )
        )

    # Garantía pedagógica mínima para preguntas conceptuales.
    if len(data) < 2:

        topic = clean_spaces(
            question.get(
                "topic"
            )
            or question.get(
                "subject"
            )
            or "contenido evaluado"
        )

        data.append(
            "Concepto que debe distinguirse: "
            + topic
        )

    unique = []
    seen = set()

    for value in data:

        key = normalize(
            value
        )

        if (
            key
            and
            key not in seen
        ):
            seen.add(
                key
            )

            unique.append(
                value
            )

    return unique[:7]

def area_profile_texts(
    question: dict,
) -> dict:

    area = clean_spaces(
        question.get(
            "area"
        )
        or question.get(
            "subject"
        )
        or "Contenido"
    )

    topic = clean_spaces(
        question.get(
            "topic"
        )
        or "contenido del ejercicio"
    )

    skill = clean_spaces(
        question.get(
            "skill"
        )
        or "resolver el ejercicio"
    )

    base = clean_spaces(
        question.get(
            "explanation"
        )
    )

    area_norm = normalize(
        area
    )

    if "matemat" in area_norm:

        concept = (
            f"En {topic}, el procedimiento decisivo de "
            f"esta pregunta es el que produce: {base} "
            "La expresión debe transformarse paso a paso "
            "y cada operación debe conservar equivalencia."
        )

        framework = (
            f"Procedimiento para {skill}: identifica la "
            "estructura algebraica, aplica la propiedad "
            f"correspondiente y verifica el resultado. "
            f"En este ítem la comprobación concreta es: {base}"
        )

        common_error = (
            "Modificar signos, exponentes o denominadores "
            "sin aplicar la misma propiedad a toda "
            "la expresión."
        )

        transfer = (
            f"En otro problema de {topic}, escribe primero "
            "la regla que transforma la expresión y luego "
            "comprueba el resultado sustituyendo o "
            "revirtiendo la operación cuando sea posible."
        )

        quick = (
            "¿Qué transformación algebraica concreta "
            "justifica el paso principal de esta solución?"
        )

    elif "fisica" in area_norm:

        concept = (
            f"En {topic}, la magnitud pedida se obtiene "
            f"mediante esta relación aplicada al caso: {base} "
            "Antes de sustituir, hay que identificar "
            "direcciones, signos y unidades."
        )

        framework = (
            f"Para {skill}: identifica la magnitud buscada, "
            "escribe la ley física que la relaciona con "
            f"los datos y usa unidades coherentes. "
            f"Este ejercicio se resuelve así: {base}"
        )

        common_error = (
            "Elegir una fórmula por semejanza sin comprobar "
            "qué magnitud se busca, qué dirección tiene "
            "cada cantidad o si las unidades son compatibles."
        )

        transfer = (
            f"En otro ejercicio de {topic}, dibuja o enumera "
            "primero las magnitudes físicas y decide "
            "qué ley las conecta antes de sustituir números."
        )

        quick = (
            "¿Qué magnitud física se busca y qué ley "
            "relaciona directamente los datos disponibles?"
        )

    elif "quim" in area_norm:

        concept = (
            f"En {topic}, la propiedad química que decide "
            f"la respuesta queda reflejada en: {base} "
            "La clave es reconocer las especies, relaciones "
            "o reglas químicas antes de elegir una opción."
        )

        framework = (
            f"Para {skill}: identifica las especies o "
            "cantidades, aplica la regla química pertinente "
            f"y comprueba conservación o clasificación. "
            f"En este caso: {base}"
        )

        common_error = (
            "Elegir por asociación de palabras sin revisar "
            "la composición, la relación química o "
            "la regla que realmente exige el enunciado."
        )

        transfer = (
            f"En una nueva pregunta de {topic}, separa "
            "primero datos químicos, regla aplicable "
            "y resultado esperado."
        )

        quick = (
            "¿Qué regla química concreta permite descartar "
            "las alternativas incorrectas?"
        )

    elif "estad" in area_norm:

        concept = (
            f"En {topic}, la interpretación o cálculo "
            f"correcto en este ítem es: {base} "
            "Hay que distinguir con precisión qué medida "
            "estadística solicita el enunciado."
        )

        framework = (
            f"Para {skill}: identifica variable, datos "
            "o frecuencia solicitada, aplica la definición "
            f"exacta y comprueba el resultado. Caso actual: {base}"
        )

        common_error = (
            "Confundir medidas estadísticas parecidas "
            "o usar una frecuencia, porcentaje o medida "
            "distinta de la que solicita el ejercicio."
        )

        transfer = (
            f"En otro ejercicio de {topic}, subraya primero "
            "el nombre exacto de la medida solicitada "
            "antes de hacer cálculos."
        )

        quick = (
            "¿Qué medida estadística exacta pide el "
            "enunciado y qué datos intervienen en ella?"
        )

    elif "lenguaje" in area_norm:

        concept = (
            f"En {topic}, la regla lingüística que permite "
            f"resolver esta pregunta se concreta en: {base} "
            "La decisión debe apoyarse en estructura, "
            "significado o norma, no solo en cómo suena."
        )

        framework = (
            f"Para {skill}: identifica la unidad lingüística "
            "relevante, aplica la norma correspondiente "
            f"y contrasta cada opción. En este caso: {base}"
        )

        common_error = (
            "Elegir una alternativa por intuición sonora "
            "sin comprobar la norma gramatical, ortográfica "
            "o la evidencia textual."
        )

        transfer = (
            f"En otra pregunta de {topic}, señala primero "
            "qué palabra, verbo, signo o evidencia textual "
            "determina la respuesta."
        )

        quick = (
            "¿Qué evidencia lingüística concreta respalda "
            "la alternativa correcta?"
        )

    elif "biolog" in area_norm:

        concept = (
            f"En {topic}, la relación biológica decisiva "
            f"para esta pregunta es: {base} "
            "La solución depende de asociar estructura, "
            "función o proceso con el término correcto."
        )

        framework = (
            f"Para {skill}: identifica el proceso biológico, "
            "relaciónalo con su estructura o función "
            f"y elimina conceptos de otro mecanismo. "
            f"En este caso: {base}"
        )

        common_error = (
            "Confundir estructuras o procesos que pertenecen "
            "al mismo sistema pero cumplen funciones distintas."
        )

        transfer = (
            f"En otra pregunta de {topic}, construye "
            "mentalmente la relación estructura → función "
            "antes de mirar las opciones."
        )

        quick = (
            "¿Qué estructura o proceso cumple exactamente "
            "la función descrita en el ejercicio?"
        )

    else:

        concept = (
            f"En {topic}, el criterio específico que resuelve "
            f"este ítem es: {base}"
        )

        framework = (
            f"Para {skill}, reproduce el razonamiento "
            f"de la solución comprobada: {base}"
        )

        common_error = (
            "Seleccionar una alternativa antes de identificar "
            "el criterio concreto que exige el enunciado."
        )

        transfer = (
            f"En otro ejercicio de {topic}, formula primero "
            "la regla o relación que decide la respuesta."
        )

        quick = (
            "¿Cuál es la regla concreta que decide "
            "la respuesta de este ejercicio?"
        )

    return {
        "concept":
            concept,

        "framework":
            framework,

        "common_error":
            common_error,

        "transfer":
            transfer,

        "quick":
            quick,
    }


def refine_fallback_profile(
    question: dict,
    item: dict,
) -> None:

    profile = area_profile_texts(
        question
    )

    item[
        "idea_key"
    ] = profile[
        "concept"
    ]

    item[
        "concept_or_rule"
    ] = profile[
        "concept"
    ]

    item[
        "formula_or_framework"
    ] = profile[
        "framework"
    ]

    item[
        "common_error"
    ] = profile[
        "common_error"
    ]

    item[
        "transfer_tip"
    ] = profile[
        "transfer"
    ]

    item[
        "quick_check"
    ] = profile[
        "quick"
    ]

    # Sin reconstruir los pasos buenos: solo se actualiza
    # el paso que explica la regla.
    for step in item.get(
        "steps",
        [],
    ):

        if (
            step.get(
                "title"
            )
            == "Aplica la regla correspondiente"
        ):

            step[
                "detail"
            ] = profile[
                "concept"
            ]

            step[
                "math"
            ] = profile[
                "framework"
            ]


# ============================================================
# DISTRACTORES ESPECÍFICOS
# ============================================================

def numeric_values(
    text: str,
) -> list[float]:

    output = []

    for token in re.findall(
        r"(?<![A-Za-z])"
        r"-?\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?",
        text,
    ):

        try:
            output.append(
                float(
                    token.replace(
                        ",",
                        ".",
                    )
                )
            )

        except ValueError:
            pass

    return output


def scalar_option_value(
    text: str,
):

    text_norm = normalize(
        text
    )

    # Si contiene una ecuación o variable algebraica,
    # comparar "primer número" podría producir diagnósticos falsos.
    algebra_markers = [
        "x",
        "f(",
        "det",
        "ln",
        "sin",
        "cos",
        "=",
        "→",
        "^",
    ]

    if any(
        marker in text_norm
        for marker
        in algebra_markers
    ):
        return None

    values = numeric_values(
        text
    )

    if len(values) != 1:
        return None

    return values[0]


def numeric_error_explanation(
    wrong_text: str,
    correct_text: str,
) -> str | None:

    wrong = scalar_option_value(
        wrong_text
    )

    correct = scalar_option_value(
        correct_text
    )

    if (
        wrong is None
        or
        correct is None
    ):
        return None

    if math.isclose(
        wrong,
        correct,
        rel_tol=1e-9,
        abs_tol=1e-9,
    ):
        return None

    if math.isclose(
        wrong,
        -correct,
        rel_tol=0.02,
        abs_tol=1e-8,
    ):

        return (
            "El valor tiene la magnitud adecuada pero "
            "el signo opuesto. Eso apunta a una pérdida "
            "de sentido, signo algebraico o dirección."
        )

    if not math.isclose(
        correct,
        0.0,
        abs_tol=1e-12,
    ):

        ratio = abs(
            wrong / correct
        )

        if math.isclose(
            ratio,
            2.0,
            rel_tol=0.035,
        ):

            return (
                "El resultado es aproximadamente el doble. "
                "Eso suele aparecer al contar dos veces "
                "una contribución o duplicar un factor."
            )

        if math.isclose(
            ratio,
            0.5,
            rel_tol=0.035,
        ):

            return (
                "El resultado es aproximadamente la mitad. "
                "Revisa si se introdujo indebidamente "
                "un factor 1/2 o una división adicional."
            )

        if (
            math.isclose(
                ratio,
                10.0,
                rel_tol=0.035,
            )
            or
            math.isclose(
                ratio,
                0.1,
                rel_tol=0.035,
            )
        ):

            return (
                "La diferencia es de un factor diez. "
                "La causa probable es una conversión "
                "de unidades, decimal o potencia de diez."
            )

        if (
            math.isclose(
                ratio,
                100.0,
                rel_tol=0.035,
            )
            or
            math.isclose(
                ratio,
                0.01,
                rel_tol=0.035,
            )
        ):

            return (
                "La diferencia es de un factor cien. "
                "Conviene revisar porcentajes, centímetros "
                "frente a metros o magnitudes al cuadrado."
            )

    return (
        f"El cálculo de esta alternativa termina en "
        f"{wrong_text}, mientras que la resolución correcta "
        f"termina en {correct_text}. La discrepancia aparece "
        "antes de seleccionar la opción, por lo que hay "
        "que rehacer la sustitución y las operaciones."
    )


def s3_77_distractor_reason(
    letter: str,
) -> str | None:

    reasons = {
        "B":
            (
                "Mantiene los exponentes 4 y 2 después "
                "de derivar. En la regla de la potencia, "
                "el exponente debe disminuir en una unidad: "
                "d(3x⁴)=12x³ y d(-5x²)=-10x."
            ),

        "C":
            (
                "Reduce los exponentes, pero no multiplica "
                "cada coeficiente por el exponente original. "
                "Por eso aparecen 3x³ y -5x en lugar "
                "de 12x³ y -10x."
            ),

        "D":
            (
                "Deriva correctamente 3x⁴, pero deriva "
                "-5x² como -5x. La regla correcta da "
                "-10x porque 2·(-5)=-10."
            ),
    }

    return reasons.get(
        letter
    )


def derivative_distractor_reason(
    wrong_text: str,
    correct_text: str,
    base: str,
) -> str:

    return (
        f"La expresión '{wrong_text}' no reproduce la "
        "derivación término a término. En esta pregunta "
        f"la derivada comprobada es '{correct_text}', "
        f"y la resolución del banco la obtiene así: {base} "
        "Revisa coeficiente, reducción del exponente "
        "y regla de la cadena cuando corresponda."
    )


def conceptual_distractor_reason(
    question: dict,
    wrong_text: str,
    correct_text: str,
    base: str,
) -> str:

    topic = clean_spaces(
        question.get(
            "topic"
        )
        or question.get(
            "subject"
        )
        or "el concepto evaluado"
    )

    text = (
        f"La alternativa afirma '{wrong_text}'. "
        f"Para {topic}, la propiedad aplicada en este "
        f"ejercicio es: {base}"
    )

    if correct_text:
        text += (
            f" La opción correcta expresa '{correct_text}', "
            "que sí coincide con esa propiedad."
        )

    return text


def distractor_reason(
    question: dict,
    item: dict,
    letter: str,
    wrong_text: str,
    correct_text: str,
) -> str:

    base = clean_spaces(
        question.get(
            "explanation"
        )
    )

    if (
        question.get(
            "id"
        )
        == "S3-77"
    ):

        special = s3_77_distractor_reason(
            letter
        )

        if special:
            return special

    numeric_reason = (
        numeric_error_explanation(
            wrong_text,
            correct_text,
        )
    )

    if numeric_reason:
        return (
            numeric_reason
            + " "
            + "En este ejercicio, la resolución que fija "
            + "el valor correcto es: "
            + base
        )

    combined = normalize(
        " ".join(
            [
                str(
                    question.get(
                        "topic",
                        ""
                    )
                ),
                str(
                    question.get(
                        "skill",
                        ""
                    )
                ),
                item.get(
                    "concept_or_rule",
                    "",
                ),
            ]
        )
    )

    if (
        "deriv" in combined
    ):

        return derivative_distractor_reason(
            wrong_text,
            correct_text,
            base,
        )

    return conceptual_distractor_reason(
        question,
        wrong_text,
        correct_text,
        base,
    )


def build_specific_distractors(
    question: dict,
    item: dict,
    options: dict[str, str],
) -> list[dict]:

    answer = str(
        question.get(
            "answer",
            "",
        )
    ).upper()

    if not options:
        return []

    correct_text = clean_spaces(
        options.get(
            answer,
            "",
        )
    )

    output = []

    for letter in sorted(
        options
    ):

        if letter == answer:
            continue

        wrong_text = clean_spaces(
            options[
                letter
            ]
        )

        if not wrong_text:
            continue

        reason = distractor_reason(
            question,
            item,
            letter,
            wrong_text,
            correct_text,
        )

        output.append(
            {
                "choice":
                    f"{letter}) {wrong_text}",

                "why_wrong":
                    reason,

                "error_pattern":
                    (
                        f"Al elegir {letter}, se estaría "
                        f"aceptando '{wrong_text}' en lugar "
                        "de aplicar completamente el "
                        "procedimiento explicado."
                    ),
            }
        )

    return output[:4]


# ============================================================
# APLICAR REFINAMIENTO
# ============================================================

def add_refinement_flag(
    item: dict,
) -> None:

    quality = item[
        "quality"
    ]

    flags = list(
        quality.get(
            "flags",
            [],
        )
    )

    if (
        "p2d5_4_final_refined"
        not in flags
    ):
        flags.append(
            "p2d5_4_final_refined"
        )

    quality[
        "flags"
    ] = flags


def refine_item(
    question: dict,
    item: dict,
    source: dict,
    debt: dict,
) -> tuple[dict, dict]:

    source_id = question[
        "id"
    ]

    updated = json.loads(
        json.dumps(
            item,
            ensure_ascii=False,
        )
    )

    changes = {
        "fallback_profile":
            False,

        "relevant_data":
            False,

        "distractors":
            False,

        "missing_distractors_fixed":
            False,
    }

    if (
        source_id
        in debt[
            "fallback"
        ]
    ):

        refine_fallback_profile(
            question,
            updated,
        )

        changes[
            "fallback_profile"
        ] = True

    if (
        source_id
        in debt[
            "relevant_data"
        ]
    ):

        updated[
            "relevant_data"
        ] = build_specific_relevant_data(
            question,
            source[
                "stem"
            ],
        )

        changes[
            "relevant_data"
        ] = True

    if (
        source_id
        in debt[
            "semigeneric"
        ]
        or
        source_id
        in debt[
            "no_distractors"
        ]
    ):

        rebuilt = build_specific_distractors(
            question,
            updated,
            source[
                "options"
            ],
        )

        if not rebuilt:

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: no fue posible reconstruir "
                "los distractores."
            )

        updated[
            "distractor_analysis"
        ] = rebuilt

        changes[
            "distractors"
        ] = True

        if (
            source_id
            in debt[
                "no_distractors"
            ]
        ):
            changes[
                "missing_distractors_fixed"
            ] = True

    if any(
        changes.values()
    ):
        add_refinement_flag(
            updated
        )

    return (
        updated,
        changes,
    )


# ============================================================
# VALIDACIÓN DEL CANDIDATO
# ============================================================

def uses_old_fallback(
    item: dict,
) -> bool:

    return (
        FALLBACK_CONCEPT_FRAGMENT
        in item.get(
            "concept_or_rule",
            "",
        )
        or
        item.get(
            "formula_or_framework",
            "",
        ).startswith(
            FALLBACK_FRAMEWORK_PREFIX
        )
    )


def semigeneric_distractor_count(
    item: dict,
) -> int:

    total = 0

    for distractor in item.get(
        "distractor_analysis",
        [],
    ):

        reason = distractor.get(
            "why_wrong",
            "",
        )

        if (
            SEMI_GENERIC_FRAGMENT
            in reason
            or
            reason.startswith(
                NUMERIC_SEMI_GENERIC_PREFIX
            )
        ):
            total += 1

    return total


def validate_candidate(
    candidate: dict,
    questions: list[dict],
    debt: dict,
) -> None:

    items = candidate.get(
        "items",
        [],
    )

    if len(items) != 180:
        fail(
            "El candidato no contiene 180 explicaciones."
        )

    if (
        candidate.get(
            "schema_version"
        )
        != SCHEMA_VERSION
        or
        candidate.get(
            "bank_version"
        )
        != BANK_VERSION
    ):
        fail(
            "Versiones incorrectas."
        )

    fallback_remaining = []

    semigeneric_remaining = []

    missing_distractors = []

    for question, item in zip(
        questions,
        items,
    ):

        source_id = question[
            "id"
        ]

        if (
            item[
                "source_question_id"
            ]
            != source_id
        ):
            fail(
                f"{source_id}: vínculo fuente incorrecto."
            )

        if (
            item[
                "source_question_sha256"
            ]
            != canonical_sha256(
                question
            )
        ):
            fail(
                f"{source_id}: hash fuente incorrecto."
            )

        if (
            item[
                "quality"
            ][
                "status"
            ]
            != "draft"
        ):
            fail(
                f"{source_id}: fue promovida indebidamente."
            )

        if (
            item[
                "quality"
            ][
                "mastery_eligible"
            ]
            is not False
        ):
            fail(
                f"{source_id}: mastery debe seguir False."
            )

        if uses_old_fallback(
            item
        ):
            fallback_remaining.append(
                source_id
            )

        if (
            semigeneric_distractor_count(
                item
            )
            > 0
        ):
            semigeneric_remaining.append(
                source_id
            )

        if (
            source_id
            in debt[
                "no_distractors"
            ]
            and
            not item.get(
                "distractor_analysis"
            )
        ):
            missing_distractors.append(
                source_id
            )

        if (
            source_id
            in debt[
                "relevant_data"
            ]
            and
            len(
                item.get(
                    "relevant_data",
                    [],
                )
            )
            < 2
        ):
            fail(
                f"{source_id}: relevant_data continúa débil."
            )

    if fallback_remaining:
        fail(
            "Persisten perfiles fallback: "
            + ", ".join(
                fallback_remaining
            )
        )

    if semigeneric_remaining:
        fail(
            "Persisten distractores semigenéricos: "
            + ", ".join(
                semigeneric_remaining
            )
        )

    if missing_distractors:
        fail(
            "Persisten ítems sin distractores: "
            + ", ".join(
                missing_distractors
            )
        )

    by_source = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]:
            item
        for item
        in items
    }

    s3_77 = by_source[
        "S3-77"
    ]

    if (
        len(
            s3_77[
                "distractor_analysis"
            ]
        )
        != 3
    ):
        fail(
            "S3-77 debe tener exactamente "
            "3 distractores visibles B/C/D."
        )

    choices = {
        distractor[
            "choice"
        ][:1]
        for distractor
        in s3_77[
            "distractor_analysis"
        ]
    }

    if choices != {
        "B",
        "C",
        "D",
    }:
        fail(
            "S3-77 no contiene los distractores B/C/D esperados."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Candidato P2-D5.4 supera "
        "controles dirigidos."
    )


# ============================================================
# REPORTE
# ============================================================

def build_report(
    before_items: list[dict],
    after_items: list[dict],
    debt: dict,
    change_stats: dict,
    before_hash: str,
    after_hash: str,
) -> dict:

    changed_ids = [
        after[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for before, after
        in zip(
            before_items,
            after_items,
        )
        if before != after
    ]

    source_review_ids = [
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in after_items
        if (
            "source_review_required"
            in item[
                "quality"
            ].get(
                "flags",
                [],
            )
        )
    ]

    return {
        "stage":
            "P2-D5.4",

        "substage":
            "final_directed_refinement",

        "status":
            "directed_refinement_completed_as_draft",

        "debt_before": {
            "fallback_profiles":
                len(
                    debt[
                        "fallback"
                    ]
                ),

            "weak_relevant_data":
                len(
                    debt[
                        "relevant_data"
                    ]
                ),

            "semigeneric_distractors":
                len(
                    debt[
                        "semigeneric"
                    ]
                ),

            "without_distractors":
                len(
                    debt[
                        "no_distractors"
                    ]
                ),

            "needs_enrichment":
                len(
                    debt[
                        "needs_enrichment"
                    ]
                ),
        },

        "changes": {
            "items_changed":
                len(
                    changed_ids
                ),

            "fallback_profiles_refined":
                change_stats[
                    "fallback_profiles"
                ],

            "relevant_data_refined":
                change_stats[
                    "relevant_data"
                ],

            "distractor_sets_rebuilt":
                change_stats[
                    "distractors"
                ],

            "missing_distractors_fixed":
                change_stats[
                    "missing_distractors"
                ],

            "s3_77_manual_pdf_reconstruction":
                True,
        },

        "debt_after_local_checks": {
            "fallback_profiles":
                sum(
                    uses_old_fallback(
                        item
                    )
                    for item
                    in after_items
                ),

            "semigeneric_distractors":
                sum(
                    (
                        semigeneric_distractor_count(
                            item
                        )
                        > 0
                    )
                    for item
                    in after_items
                ),

            "without_distractors":
                sum(
                    not item.get(
                        "distractor_analysis"
                    )
                    for item
                    in after_items
                ),
        },

        "safety": {
            "items_total":
                180,

            "draft_total":
                sum(
                    item[
                        "quality"
                    ][
                        "status"
                    ]
                    == "draft"
                    for item
                    in after_items
                ),

            "validated_total":
                sum(
                    item[
                        "quality"
                    ][
                        "status"
                    ]
                    == "validated"
                    for item
                    in after_items
                ),

            "mastery_enabled":
                any(
                    item[
                        "quality"
                    ][
                        "mastery_eligible"
                    ]
                    for item
                    in after_items
                ),

            "question_bank_modified":
                False,

            "reinforcement_bank_modified":
                False,

            "app_modified":
                False,

            "schema_modified":
                False,
        },

        "changed_ids":
            changed_ids,

        "source_review_ids":
            source_review_ids,

        "hashes": {
            "app":
                sha256_file(
                    APP
                ),

            "question_bank":
                sha256_file(
                    QUESTION_BANK
                ),

            "reinforcement_bank":
                sha256_file(
                    REINFORCEMENT_BANK
                ),

            "schema":
                sha256_file(
                    SCHEMA_FILE
                ),

            "explanation_bank_before":
                before_hash,

            "explanation_bank_after":
                after_hash,
        },
    }

# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main() -> None:

    print()
    print("=" * 82)
    print(
        "P2-D5.4 FULL - "
        "REFINAMIENTO FINAL DIRIGIDO"
    )
    print("=" * 82)
    print()

    (
        questions,
        bank,
        audit,
    ) = verify_preconditions()

    debt = get_debt_sets(
        audit
    )

    print()
    print("DEUDA DETECTADA")
    print("-" * 82)

    print(
        "Perfiles fallback              :",
        len(
            debt[
                "fallback"
            ]
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Relevant data débil            :",
        len(
            debt[
                "relevant_data"
            ]
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Distractores semigenéricos     :",
        len(
            debt[
                "semigeneric"
            ]
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Sin distractores               :",
        len(
            debt[
                "no_distractors"
            ]
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Needs enrichment               :",
        len(
            debt[
                "needs_enrichment"
            ]
        ),
    )

    if (
        debt[
            "no_distractors"
        ]
        != {
            "S3-77"
        }
    ):
        fail(
            "El único ítem sin distractores "
            "debería ser S3-77."
        )

    sources = extract_sources(
        questions
    )

    before_items = bank[
        "items"
    ]

    refined_items = []

    change_stats = {
        "fallback_profiles":
            0,

        "relevant_data":
            0,

        "distractors":
            0,

        "missing_distractors":
            0,
    }

    for question, item in zip(
        questions,
        before_items,
    ):

        refined, changes = refine_item(
            question,
            item,
            sources[
                question[
                    "id"
                ]
            ],
            debt,
        )

        refined_items.append(
            refined
        )

        if changes[
            "fallback_profile"
        ]:
            change_stats[
                "fallback_profiles"
            ] += 1

        if changes[
            "relevant_data"
        ]:
            change_stats[
                "relevant_data"
            ] += 1

        if changes[
            "distractors"
        ]:
            change_stats[
                "distractors"
            ] += 1

        if changes[
            "missing_distractors_fixed"
        ]:
            change_stats[
                "missing_distractors"
            ] += 1

    candidate = {
        "schema_version":
            SCHEMA_VERSION,

        "bank_version":
            BANK_VERSION,

        "origin":
            bank.get(
                "origin",
                "pedagogical_companion_for_original_bank",
            ),

        "official_utn_question":
            False,

        "items":
            refined_items,
    }

    validate_candidate(
        candidate,
        questions,
        debt,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # BACKUP
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if PRE_REFINEMENT_BACKUP.exists():

        if (
            sha256_file(
                PRE_REFINEMENT_BACKUP
            )
            != ENRICHED_BANK_SHA256
        ):
            fail(
                "Backup pre-P2-D5.4 existente "
                "no coincide con P2-D5.3."
            )

        print(
            "[OK] Backup pre-P2-D5.4 existente correcto."
        )

    else:

        shutil.copy2(
            EXPLANATION_BANK,
            PRE_REFINEMENT_BACKUP,
        )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                PRE_REFINEMENT_BACKUP
            )
            != ENRICHED_BANK_SHA256
        ):
            fail(
                "Backup pre-P2-D5.4 creado "
                "con hash incorrecto."
            )

        print(
            "[OK] Backup pre-P2-D5.4 creado."
        )

    before_hash = sha256_file(
        EXPLANATION_BANK
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # ESCRITURA + ROLLBACK
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:

        atomic_write_json(
            EXPLANATION_BANK,
            candidate,
        )

        written = load_json(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )

        if written != candidate:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "El archivo escrito no coincide "
                "con el candidato."
            )

        if (
            sha256_file(APP)
            != APP_SHA256
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "app.py cambió."
            )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                QUESTION_BANK
            )
            != QUESTION_BANK_SHA256
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "question_bank cambió."
            )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                REINFORCEMENT_BANK
            )
            != REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "reinforcement_bank cambió."
            )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                SCHEMA_FILE
            )
            != SCHEMA_SHA256
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "schema cambió."
            )

        after_hash = sha256_file(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )

        if after_hash == before_hash:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "El refinamiento no modificó "
                "el banco."
            )

        report = build_report(
            before_items,
            refined_items,
            debt,
            change_stats,
            before_hash,
            after_hash,
        )

        atomic_write_json(
            REPORT_JSON,
            report,
        )

        atomic_write_text(
            REPORT_TXT,
            build_txt(
                report
            ),
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        print(
            f"[ERROR] Falló P2-D5.4: {exc}"
        )

        print(
            "[INFO] Restaurando checkpoint P2-D5.3..."
        )

        shutil.copy2(
            PRE_REFINEMENT_BACKUP,
            EXPLANATION_BANK,
        )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                EXPLANATION_BANK
            )
            != ENRICHED_BANK_SHA256
        ):
            fail(
                "Rollback falló."
            )

        fail(
            "P2-D5.4 abortado; "
            "P2-D5.3 restaurado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # RESUMEN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    print()
    print("RESUMEN")
    print("-" * 82)

    print(
        "Explicaciones totales           : 180"
    )

    print(
        "Ítems modificados               :",
        report[
            "changes"
        ][
            "items_changed"
        ],
    )

    print(
        "Perfiles fallback refinados     :",
        report[
            "changes"
        ][
            "fallback_profiles_refined"
        ],
    )

    print(
        "Relevant data refinado          :",
        report[
            "changes"
        ][
            "relevant_data_refined"
        ],
    )

    print(
        "Sets distractores reconstruidos :",
        report[
            "changes"
        ][
            "distractor_sets_rebuilt"
        ],
    )

    print(
        "Sin distractores corregidos     :",
        report[
            "changes"
        ][
            "missing_distractors_fixed"
        ],
    )

    print()
    print("DEUDA LOCAL DESPUÉS")
    print("-" * 82)

    print(
        "Perfiles fallback               :",
        report[
            "debt_after_local_checks"
        ][
            "fallback_profiles"
        ],
    )

    print(
        "Distractores semigenéricos      :",
        report[
            "debt_after_local_checks"
        ][
            "semigeneric_distractors"
        ],
    )

    print(
        "Sin análisis de distractores    :",
        report[
            "debt_after_local_checks"
        ][
            "without_distractors"
        ],
    )

    print()
    print("SEGURIDAD")
    print("-" * 82)

    print(
        "Estado final                    : DRAFT"
    )

    print(
        "VALIDATED                       : 0"
    )

    print(
        "Mastery habilitado              : False"
    )

    print(
        "question_bank modificado        : False"
    )

    print(
        "reinforcement_bank modificado   : False"
    )

    print(
        "app.py modificado               : False"
    )

    print(
        "schema modificado               : False"
    )

    print()
    print("SHA-256")
    print("-" * 82)

    print(
        "app.py                   :",
        sha256_file(
            APP
        ),
    )

    print(
        "question_bank            :",
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        ),
    )

    print(
        "reinforcement_bank       :",
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        ),
    )

    print(
        "schema                   :",
        sha256_file(
            SCHEMA_FILE
        ),
    )

    print(
        "explanation_bank antes   :",
        before_hash,
    )

    print(
        "explanation_bank después :",
        sha256_file(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        ),
    )

    print()
    print("IMPORTANTE")
    print("-" * 82)

    print(
        "- P2-D5.4 no valida automáticamente "
        "ninguna explicación."
    )

    print(
        "- Las 7 preguntas source_review "
        "continúan bloqueadas."
    )

    print(
        "- S3-77 reconstruye únicamente "
        "las alternativas B/C/D visibles en la fuente."
    )

    print(
        "- El siguiente paso será una auditoría "
        "final independiente 180/180."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "RESULTADO: P2-D5.4 "
        "FINAL REFINEMENT COMPLETADO"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
