    "p2c3_seed_specs_v1"
)

SCHEMA_VERSION = (
    "p2d_reinforcement_bank_v1"
)

BANK_VERSION = (
    "p2d0_empty_v1"
)


# ============================================================
# UTILIDADES
# ============================================================

def load_json(
    path: Path,
):

    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def write_json(
    path: Path,
    data,
):

    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            data,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


# ============================================================
# CONTRATO DE UNA PREGUNTA GENERADA
# ============================================================

def build_item_contract():

    return {

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # IDENTIDAD
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        "required_fields": [

            "id",
            "schema_version",
            "origin",
            "source_spec_id",
            "official_utn_question",

            "area",
            "unit",
            "cluster",

            "primary_topic_id",
            "secondary_topic_ids",
            "target_topic_ids",

            "difficulty",
            "cognitive_target",
            "learning_role",

            "stem",
            "choices",
            "answer",

            "explanation",
            "explanation_layers",

            "distractor_analysis",

            "quality",
            "generation",
        ],

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # CAMPOS
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        "fields": {

            "id": {
                "type":
                    "string",

                "pattern":
                    "^R-[0-9]{3}$",

                "example":
                    "R-001",

                "description":
                    (
                        "Identificador único dentro del "
                        "reinforcement_bank."
                    ),
            },

            "schema_version": {
                "type":
                    "string",

                "const":
                    SCHEMA_VERSION,
            },

            "origin": {
                "type":
                    "string",

                "const":
                    "generated_reinforcement",
            },

            "source_spec_id": {
                "type":
                    "string",

                "pattern":
                    "^SEED-[0-9]{3}$",

                "description":
                    (
                        "Spec P2-C3 que originó "
                        "la pregunta."
                    ),
            },

            "official_utn_question": {
                "type":
                    "boolean",

                "const":
                    False,

                "description":
                    (
                        "Debe ser siempre false. "
                        "El material generado nunca se "
                        "presenta como pregunta oficial UTN."
                    ),
            },

            # ------------------------------------------------
            # TAXONOMÍA OFICIAL
            # ------------------------------------------------

            "area": {
                "type":
                    "string",

                "allowed": [
                    "Matemática",
                    "Física",
                    "Química",
                    "Lenguaje",
                    "Estadística",
                ],
            },

            "unit": {
                "type":
                    "string",

                "nonempty":
                    True,
            },

            "cluster": {
                "type":
                    "string",

                "nonempty":
                    True,
            },

            "primary_topic_id": {
                "type":
                    "string",

                "nonempty":
                    True,
            },

            "secondary_topic_ids": {
                "type":
                    "array",

                "items":
                    "string",

                "unique":
                    True,
            },

            "target_topic_ids": {
                "type":
                    "array",

                "items":
                    "string",

                "min_items":
                    1,

                "max_items":
                    4,

                "unique":
                    True,

                "description":
                    (
                        "Subtemas oficiales que la pregunta "
                        "realmente evalúa."
                    ),
            },

            # ------------------------------------------------
            # PERFIL PEDAGÓGICO
            # ------------------------------------------------

            "difficulty": {
                "type":
                    "string",

                "allowed": [
                    "foundation",
                    "standard",
                    "transfer",
                ],
            },

            "cognitive_target": {
                "type":
                    "string",

                "allowed": [
                    "concept_identification",
                    "direct_application",
                    "transfer_and_integration",
                ],
            },

            "learning_role": {
                "type":
                    "string",

                "const":
                    "coverage_seed",
            },

            # ------------------------------------------------
            # CONTENIDO
            # ------------------------------------------------

            "stem": {
                "type":
                    "string",

                "nonempty":
                    True,

                "description":
                    (
                        "Enunciado completo y autónomo. "
                        "No debe depender del PDF original."
                    ),
            },

            "choices": {
                "type":
                    "object",

                "allowed_keys": [
                    "A",
                    "B",
                    "C",
                    "D",
                    "E",
                ],

                "minimum_present":
                    4,

                "maximum_present":
                    5,

                "all_values_nonempty":
                    True,

                "description":
                    (
                        "Opciones explícitas. "
                        "Deben existir 4 o 5."
                    ),
            },

            "answer": {
                "type":
                    "string",

                "allowed": [
                    "A",
                    "B",
                    "C",
                    "D",
                    "E",
                ],

                "description":
                    (
                        "Debe coincidir con una clave "
                        "existente en choices."
                    ),
            },

            # ------------------------------------------------
            # EXPLICACIÓN
            # ------------------------------------------------

            "explanation": {
                "type":
                    "string",

                "nonempty":
                    True,

                "description":
                    (
                        "Explicación resumida para "
                        "compatibilidad con la interfaz."
                    ),
            },

            "explanation_layers": {
                "type":
                    "object",

                "required_keys": [
                    "intuition",
                    "step_by_step",
                    "common_error",
                    "why_correct",
                ],

                "all_values_nonempty":
                    True,

                "description":
                    (
                        "Capas pedagógicas que luego "
                        "utilizará el modo tutor."
                    ),
            },

            # ------------------------------------------------
            # DISTRACTORES
            # ------------------------------------------------

            "distractor_analysis": {
                "type":
                    "object",

                "description":
                    (
                        "Explica qué error diagnostica "
                        "cada alternativa incorrecta."
                    ),

                "requirements": {
                    "incorrect_choices_only":
                        True,

                    "all_incorrect_choices_documented":
                        True,

                    "all_descriptions_nonempty":
                        True,
                },
            },

            # ------------------------------------------------
            # CALIDAD
            # ------------------------------------------------

            "quality": {
                "type":
                    "object",

                "required_keys": [
                    "status",
                    "mastery_eligible",
                    "coverage_verified",
                    "answer_verified",
                    "ambiguity_checked",
                    "distractors_checked",
                    "explanation_checked",
                    "flags",
                ],

                "fields": {

                    "status": {
                        "allowed": [
                            "draft",
                            "validated",
                            "rejected",
                        ],
                    },

                    "mastery_eligible": {
                        "type":
                            "boolean",
                    },

                    "coverage_verified": {
                        "type":
                            "boolean",
                    },

                    "answer_verified": {
                        "type":
                            "boolean",
                    },

                    "ambiguity_checked": {
                        "type":
                            "boolean",
                    },

                    "distractors_checked": {
                        "type":
                            "boolean",
                    },

                    "explanation_checked": {
                        "type":
                            "boolean",
                    },

                    "flags": {
                        "type":
                            "array",

                        "items":
                            "string",
                    },
                },

                "validation_rule":
                    (
                        "mastery_eligible solo puede ser true "
                        "si status=validated y todas las "
                        "verificaciones son true."
                    ),
            },

            # ------------------------------------------------
            # TRAZABILIDAD DE GENERACIÓN
            # ------------------------------------------------

            "generation": {
                "type":
                    "object",

                "required_keys": [
                    "generation_stage",
                    "generator_type",
                    "human_review_required",
                    "source_material",
                ],

                "fields": {

                    "generation_stage": {
                        "const":
                            "P2-D",
                    },

                    "generator_type": {
                        "const":
                            "synthetic_reinforcement",
                    },

                    "human_review_required": {
                        "const":
                            True,
                    },

                    "source_material": {
                        "type":
                            "array",

                        "required_values": [
                            (
                                "UTN FICA 2P2026 "
                                "official syllabus"
                            ),
                            (
                                "P2-C3 seed specification"
                            ),
                        ],
                    },
                },
            },

            # ------------------------------------------------
            # CAMPOS OPCIONALES FUTUROS
            # ------------------------------------------------

            "optional_fields": {

                "skill": {
                    "type":
                        "string",
                },

                "subskill": {
                    "type":
                        "string",
                },

                "estimated_time_seconds": {
                    "type":
                        "integer",

                    "minimum":
                        10,
                },

                "visual": {
                    "type":
                        "object",

                    "description":
                        (
                            "Reservado para diagramas "
                            "generados propios."
                        ),
                },

                "tags": {
                    "type":
                        "array",

                    "items":
                        "string",
                },

                "notes": {
                    "type":
                        "string",
                },
            },
        },

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # REGLAS ENTRE CAMPOS
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        "cross_field_rules": [

            (
                "primary_topic_id debe ser igual "
                "al primer elemento de target_topic_ids."
            ),

            (
                "secondary_topic_ids debe ser igual "
                "a target_topic_ids[1:]."
            ),

            (
                "answer debe existir como clave "
                "dentro de choices."
            ),

            (
                "distractor_analysis debe documentar "
                "todas las opciones incorrectas y nunca "
                "la respuesta correcta."
            ),

            (
                "area, unit, cluster y target_topic_ids "
                "deben coincidir exactamente con "
                "source_spec_id en P2-C3."
            ),

            (
                "difficulty, cognitive_target y "
                "learning_role deben coincidir "
                "con source_spec_id en P2-C3."
            ),

            (
                "Una pregunta no puede otorgar cobertura "
                "a un topic_id que no figure en "
                "target_topic_ids."
            ),

            (
                "Una mención superficial de un tema "
                "no basta para declararlo cubierto."
            ),

            (
                "El enunciado debe poder resolverse "
                "sin consultar los simulacros PDF."
            ),

            (
                "El contenido no debe copiar literalmente "
                "ninguna pregunta del banco original."
            ),

            (
                "El contenido no debe presentarse como "
                "pregunta auténtica de admisión UTN."
            ),
        ],
    }


# ============================================================
# ESTRUCTURA DEL BANCO
# ============================================================

def build_bank_contract():

    return {

        "schema_version":
            SCHEMA_VERSION,

        "file":
            "data/reinforcement_bank.json",

        "purpose":
            (
                "Banco separado de preguntas generadas "
                "para refuerzo y cobertura del temario FICA."
            ),

        "must_remain_separate_from":
            "data/question_bank.json",

        "original_question_bank_count":
            180,

        "seed_target_count":
            76,

        "top_level_structure": {

            "schema_version":
                "string",

            "bank_version":
                "string",

            "stage":
                "string",

            "origin":
                "string",

            "official_utn_question_bank":
                "boolean",

            "source_specs":
                "string",

            "items":
                "array",
        },

        "top_level_constraints": {

            "schema_version":
                SCHEMA_VERSION,

            "origin":
                "generated_reinforcement",

            "official_utn_question_bank":
                False,

            "source_specs":
                "results/p2c3_seed_specs.json",

            "items_unique_by_id":
                True,

            "items_unique_by_source_spec_id":
                True,

            "maximum_seed_items":
                76,
        },

        "item_contract":
            build_item_contract(),
    }


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main():

    print()
    print("=" * 72)
    print(
        "P2-D0 - CONTRATO DEL REINFORCEMENT BANK"
    )
    print("=" * 72)
    print()

    DATA_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    RESULTS_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. VALIDAR P2-C3
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if not SPECS_FILE.exists():

        print(
            "[ERROR] No existe:"
        )

        print(
            SPECS_FILE
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    try:

        specs_report = load_json(
            SPECS_FILE
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        print(
            "[ERROR] No se pudo leer P2-C3:"
        )

        print(
            exc
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    if (
        specs_report.get(
            "stage"
        )
        != "P2-C3"
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] El archivo de specs "
            "no corresponde a P2-C3."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    if (
        specs_report.get(
            "spec_version"
        )
        != EXPECTED_SPEC_VERSION
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] spec_version inesperada:"
        )

        print(
            specs_report.get(
                "spec_version"
            )
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    specs = specs_report.get(
        "specs",
        [],
    )

    if (
        len(
            specs
        )
        != EXPECTED_SPECS
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] Se esperaban 76 specs; "
            f"se encontraron {len(specs)}."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    summary = specs_report.get(
        "summary",
        {},
    )

    if (
        summary.get(
            "unique_target_topics"
        )
        != EXPECTED_TARGET_TOPICS
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] P2-C3 no conserva "
            "los 142 objetivos esperados."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    print(
        "[OK] Checkpoint P2-C3 reconocido."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. VALIDAR IDS DE SPECS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    spec_ids = [
        spec.get(
            "spec_id"
        )
        for spec in specs
    ]

    expected_spec_ids = [
        f"SEED-{index:03d}"
        for index in range(
            1,
            EXPECTED_SPECS + 1,
        )
    ]

    if (
        spec_ids
        != expected_spec_ids
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] Los spec_id no son "
            "SEED-001..SEED-076."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    print(
        "[OK] 76 spec_id secuenciales."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. CREAR CONTRATO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    schema = build_bank_contract()

    write_json(
        SCHEMA_FILE,
        schema,
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Schema del reinforcement bank creado."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. CREAR BANCO VACÍO
    #
    # IMPORTANTE:
    # Esto NO genera preguntas.
    # Solo crea el contenedor contractual.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    empty_bank = {

        "schema_version":
            SCHEMA_VERSION,

        "bank_version":
            BANK_VERSION,

        "stage":
            "P2-D0",

        "origin":
            "generated_reinforcement",

        "official_utn_question_bank":
            False,

        "source_specs":
            "results/p2c3_seed_specs.json",

        "items":
            [],
    }

    # Seguridad:
    # no sobrescribir silenciosamente un banco
    # que ya contenga preguntas.
    if EMPTY_BANK_FILE.exists():

        try:

            existing = load_json(
                EMPTY_BANK_FILE
            )

        except Exception as exc:

            print(
                "[ERROR] Ya existe reinforcement_bank.json "
                "pero no puede leerse:"
            )

            print(
                exc
            )

            sys.exit(1)

        existing_items = existing.get(
            "items",
            None,
        )

        if not isinstance(
            existing_items,
            list,
        ):

            print(
                "[ERROR] reinforcement_bank.json existente "
                "tiene una estructura desconocida."
            )

            sys.exit(1)

        if existing_items:

            print(
                "[ERROR] reinforcement_bank.json ya "
                "contiene preguntas."
            )

            print(
                "No se sobrescribirá."
            )

            print(
                "Cantidad actual:",
                len(
                    existing_items
                ),
            )

            sys.exit(1)

    write_json(
        EMPTY_BANK_FILE,
        empty_bank,
    )

    print(
        "[OK] reinforcement_bank.json creado "
        "con 0 preguntas."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. AUTOVALIDACIÓN DEL BANCO VACÍO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    loaded_bank = load_json(
        EMPTY_BANK_FILE
    )

    expected_top_level = {
        "schema_version",
        "bank_version",
        "stage",
        "origin",
        "official_utn_question_bank",
        "source_specs",
        "items",
    }

    if (
        set(
            loaded_bank.keys()
        )
        != expected_top_level
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] Estructura superior "
            "del banco incorrecta."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    if (
        loaded_bank[
            "schema_version"
        ]
        != SCHEMA_VERSION
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] schema_version "
            "incorrecta."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    if (
        loaded_bank[
            "origin"
        ]
        != "generated_reinforcement"
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] origin incorrecto."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    if (
        loaded_bank[
            "official_utn_question_bank"
        ]
        is not False
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] El banco generado fue marcado "
            "incorrectamente como oficial UTN."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    if (
        loaded_bank[
            "source_specs"
        ]
        != "results/p2c3_seed_specs.json"
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] source_specs incorrecto."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    if (
        loaded_bank[
            "items"
        ]
        != []
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] P2-D0 debe comenzar "
            "con banco vacío."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    print(
        "[OK] Banco vacío cumple el contrato P2-D0."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. SEGURIDAD DEL BANCO ORIGINAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    original_bank = (
        DATA_DIR
        / "question_bank.json"
    )

    if not original_bank.exists():

        print(
            "[ERROR] No existe el banco original "
            "question_bank.json."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    try:

        original_questions = load_json(
            original_bank
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        print(
            "[ERROR] No se pudo leer "
            "question_bank.json:"
        )

        print(
            exc
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    if (
        not isinstance(
            original_questions,
            list,
        )
        or len(
            original_questions
        )
        != 180
    ):

        print(
            "[ERROR] El banco original ya no "
            "contiene exactamente 180 preguntas."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    print(
        "[OK] question_bank.json conserva "
        "sus 180 preguntas."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 7. INFORME CONTRACTUAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    contract_report = {

        "stage":
            "P2-D0",

        "schema_version":
            SCHEMA_VERSION,

        "status":
            "contract_created",

        "source_specs": {
            "file":
                "results/p2c3_seed_specs.json",

            "spec_count":
                len(
                    specs
                ),

            "unique_target_topics":
                summary.get(
                    "unique_target_topics"
                ),
        },

        "files_created": {
            "schema":
                "data/reinforcement_bank_schema.json",

            "empty_bank":
                "data/reinforcement_bank.json",
        },

        "reinforcement_bank": {
            "current_item_count":
                0,

            "seed_capacity":
                76,

            "separate_from_original_bank":
                True,

            "original_bank_question_count":
                180,

            "official_utn_question_bank":
                False,
        },

        "next_stage": {
            "name":
                "P2-D1",

            "purpose":
                (
                    "Generar un lote piloto pequeño "
                    "a partir de las primeras specs."
                ),

            "full_generation_allowed":
                False,

            "pilot_required_first":
                True,
        },
    }

    write_json(
        CONTRACT_REPORT_JSON,
        contract_report,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 8. INFORME TXT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    lines = []

    lines.append(
        "=" * 72
    )

    lines.append(
        "P2-D0 - CONTRATO DEL REINFORCEMENT BANK"
    )

    lines.append(
        "=" * 72
    )

    lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        f"Schema version       : {SCHEMA_VERSION}"
    )

    lines.append(
        "Specs fuente         : 76"
    )

    lines.append(
        "Objetivos oficiales  : 142"
    )

    lines.append(
        "Banco original       : 180 preguntas"
    )

    lines.append(
        "Banco reinforcement  : 0 preguntas"
    )

    lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        "ARCHIVOS"
    )

    lines.append(
        "-" * 72
    )

    lines.append(
        "data/reinforcement_bank_schema.json"
    )

    lines.append(
        "data/reinforcement_bank.json"
    )

    lines.append(
        "results/p2d0_reinforcement_contract.json"
    )

    lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        "REGLAS PRINCIPALES"
    )

    lines.append(
        "-" * 72
    )

    lines.append(
        "- El banco generado permanece separado "
        "de question_bank.json."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- Cada pregunta se vincula a un "
        "SEED-xxx de P2-C3."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- Cada pregunta tiene entre 1 y 4 "
        "subtemas oficiales objetivo."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- Cada ítem tiene 4 o 5 alternativas "
        "y una sola respuesta correcta."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- Cada distractor incorrecto debe "
        "tener propósito diagnóstico."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- Cada pregunta incluye explicación "
        "resumida y cuatro capas pedagógicas."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- mastery_eligible no puede activarse "
        "hasta completar todas las validaciones."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- Las preguntas generadas nunca se "
        "presentan como preguntas oficiales UTN."
    )

    lines.append(
        "- P2-D0 no genera ninguna pregunta."
    )

    lines.append("")

    lines.append(
        "SIGUIENTE PASO"
    )

    lines.append(
        "-" * 72
    )

    lines.append(
        "P2-D1 generará primero un lote piloto "
        "pequeño antes de producir las 76 preguntas."
    )

    CONTRACT_REPORT_TXT.write_text(
        "\n".join(
            lines
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 9. SALIDA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    print()
    print(
        "CONTRATO"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 72
    )

    print(
        "Schema version        :",
        SCHEMA_VERSION,
    )

    print(
        "Specs disponibles     :",
        len(
            specs
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Objetivos oficiales   :",
        summary.get(
            "unique_target_topics"
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Banco original        :",
        len(
            original_questions
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Banco reinforcement   :",
        len(
            loaded_bank[
                "items"
            ]
        ),
    )

    print()
    print(

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path


# ============================================================
# EXPORTADOR COMPLETO DEL PROYECTO
# ============================================================
#
# OBJETIVO
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Generar un único TXT que contenga:
#
# 1. Información general del proyecto.
# 2. Árbol completo de archivos.
# 3. Inventario con tamaño y SHA-256.
# 4. Contenido completo de archivos de código/configuración.
# 5. Contenido de bancos JSON.
# 6. Inventario de PDFs/DOCX y otros binarios.
# 7. Detección de archivos potencialmente sensibles.
#
# NO modifica ningún archivo del proyecto.
#
# ============================================================


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

OUTPUT = (
    ROOT
    / "PROYECTO_COMPLETO_PARA_REVISION.txt"
)


# ============================================================
# DIRECTORIOS QUE NO APORTAN AL ANÁLISIS DEL CÓDIGO
# ============================================================

EXCLUDED_DIR_NAMES = {
    ".git",
    ".venv",
    "venv",
    "env",
    "__pycache__",
    ".pytest_cache",
    ".mypy_cache",
    ".ruff_cache",
    ".idea",
    ".vscode",
    "node_modules",
}


# ============================================================
# ARCHIVOS QUE NUNCA DEBEN EXPORTARSE EN TEXTO
# ============================================================

SENSITIVE_FILE_NAMES = {
    ".env",
    ".env.local",
    ".env.production",
    "secrets.toml",
    "credentials.json",
    "service_account.json",
    "token.json",
    "tokens.json",
}


# ============================================================
# EXTENSIONES DE TEXTO
# ============================================================

TEXT_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".py",
    ".json",
    ".txt",
    ".md",
    ".rst",
    ".toml",
    ".ini",
    ".cfg",
    ".conf",
    ".yaml",
    ".yml",
    ".csv",
    ".tsv",
    ".bat",
    ".cmd",
    ".ps1",
    ".sh",
    ".html",
    ".htm",
    ".css",
    ".js",
    ".ts",
    ".xml",
    ".sql",
    ".gitignore",
}


# ============================================================
# DOCUMENTOS / BINARIOS A INVENTARIAR
# ============================================================

DOCUMENT_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".pdf",
    ".docx",
    ".doc",
    ".xlsx",
    ".xls",
    ".pptx",
    ".ppt",
    ".png",
    ".jpg",
    ".jpeg",
    ".webp",
    ".gif",
    ".zip",
}


# ============================================================
# BACKUPS / ARTEFACTOS ANTIGUOS
#
# Se muestran en estructura e inventario,
# pero no se vuelca su contenido para evitar duplicar
# miles de líneas innecesariamente.
# ============================================================

BACKUP_PATTERNS = (
    "backup",
    "_pre_",
    "_before_",
    "_old",
    ".bak",
)


# ============================================================
# RESULTADOS GENERADOS QUE SÍ QUEREMOS INVENTARIAR
# PERO NO NECESARIAMENTE VOLCAR COMPLETOS.
# ============================================================

GENERATED_DIR_NAMES = {
    "results",
}


# ============================================================
# SECRETOS / TOKENS
# ============================================================

SECRET_PATTERNS = [
    re.compile(
        r"(?i)"
        r"(api[_-]?key|secret|password|token)"
        r"\s*[:=]\s*"
        r"['\"]([^'\"]{8,})['\"]"
    ),
    re.compile(
        r"\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{15,}\b"
    ),
]


# ============================================================
# UTILIDADES
# ============================================================

def sha256_file(
    path: Path,
) -> str:

    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open(
        "rb"
    ) as handle:

        while True:

            chunk = handle.read(
                1024 * 1024
            )

            if not chunk:
                break

            digest.update(
                chunk
            )

    return digest.hexdigest().upper()


def human_size(
    size: int,
) -> str:

    value = float(
        size
    )

    units = [
        "B",
        "KB",
        "MB",
        "GB",
    ]

    for unit in units:

        if (
            value < 1024
            or
            unit == units[-1]
        ):

            if unit == "B":

                return (
                    f"{int(value)} {unit}"
                )

            return (
                f"{value:.2f} {unit}"
            )

        value /= 1024

    return (
        f"{size} B"
    )


def relative(
    path: Path,
) -> str:

    try:

        return str(
            path.relative_to(
                ROOT
            )
        )

    except ValueError:

        return str(
            path
        )


def should_ignore_directory(
    path: Path,
) -> bool:

    return any(
        part in EXCLUDED_DIR_NAMES
        for part
        in path.parts
    )


def is_sensitive(
    path: Path,
) -> bool:

    name = path.name.lower()

    if name in {
        x.lower()
        for x
        in SENSITIVE_FILE_NAMES
    }:

        return True

    if (
        ".streamlit"
        in path.parts
        and
        name
        == "secrets.toml"
    ):

        return True

    return False


def is_backup(
    path: Path,
) -> bool:

    name = path.name.lower()

    return any(
        pattern in name
        for pattern
        in BACKUP_PATTERNS
    )


def is_text_file(
    path: Path,
) -> bool:

    if path.name == ".gitignore":

        return True

    return (
        path.suffix.lower()
        in TEXT_EXTENSIONS
    )


def is_generated_result(
    path: Path,
) -> bool:

    return any(
        part.lower()
        in GENERATED_DIR_NAMES
        for part
        in path.parts
    )


def safe_read_text(
    path: Path,
):

    encodings = [
        "utf-8",
        "utf-8-sig",
        "cp1252",
        "latin-1",
    ]

    for encoding in encodings:

        try:

            return (
                path.read_text(
                    encoding=encoding
                ),
                encoding,
            )

        except UnicodeDecodeError:

            continue

        except Exception:

            break

    return (
        None,
        None,
    )


def redact_secrets(
    text: str,
):

    redacted = text
    count = 0

    for pattern in SECRET_PATTERNS:

        def replace(
            match,
        ):

            nonlocal count

            count += 1

            full = match.group(
                0
            )

            if "=" in full:

                prefix = full.split(
                    "=",
                    1,
                )[
                    0
                ]

                return (
                    prefix
                    + "=<REDACTED>"
                )

            if ":" in full:

                prefix = full.split(
                    ":",
                    1,
                )[
                    0
                ]

                return (
                    prefix
                    + ": <REDACTED>"
                )

            return (
                "<REDACTED_SECRET>"
            )

        redacted = pattern.sub(
            replace,
            redacted,
        )

    return (
        redacted,
        count,
    )


# ============================================================
# RECOLECTAR ARCHIVOS
# ============================================================

def collect_files():

    files = []

    for path in ROOT.rglob(
        "*"
    ):

        if should_ignore_directory(
            path
        ):

            continue

        if not path.is_file():

            continue

        # No incluir el propio archivo de salida
        # si ya existe de una ejecución anterior.

        if path.resolve() == OUTPUT.resolve():

            continue

        files.append(
            path
        )

    return sorted(
        files,
        key=lambda p: (
            str(
                p.relative_to(
                    ROOT
                )
            ).lower()
        ),
    )


# ============================================================
# ÁRBOL
# ============================================================

def build_tree(
    files,
):

    tree = {}

    for path in files:

        parts = path.relative_to(
            ROOT
        ).parts

        node = tree

        for part in parts[:-1]:

            node = node.setdefault(
                part,
                {}
            )

        node[
            parts[-1]
        ] = None

    lines = []


    def render(
        node,
        prefix="",
    ):

        items = sorted(
            node.items(),
            key=lambda x: (
                x[
                    1
                ]
                is None,
                x[
                    0
                ].lower(),
            ),
        )

        for index, (
            name,
            child,
        ) in enumerate(
            items
        ):

            last = (
                index
                == len(
                    items
                )
                - 1
            )

            branch = (
                "└── "
                if last
                else
                "├── "
            )

            lines.append(
                prefix
                + branch
                + name
            )

            if child is not None:

                render(
                    child,
                    prefix
                    + (
                        "    "
                        if last
                        else
                        "│   "
                    ),
                )


    lines.append(
        ROOT.name
    )

    render(
        tree
    )

    return "\n".join(
        lines
    )


# ============================================================
# CLASIFICACIÓN
# ============================================================

def classify(
    path: Path,
) -> str:

    if is_sensitive(
        path
    ):

        return (
            "SENSITIVE_NOT_EXPORTED"
        )

    if is_backup(
        path
    ):

        return (
            "BACKUP_INVENTORY_ONLY"
        )

    if path.suffix.lower() in DOCUMENT_EXTENSIONS:

        return (
            "DOCUMENT_BINARY"
        )

    if is_text_file(
        path
    ):

        if is_generated_result(
            path
        ):

            # Los informes pequeños sí ayudan,
            # por lo que se exportan si no son enormes.

            if path.stat().st_size <= (
                500 * 1024
            ):

                return (
                    "TEXT_GENERATED"
                )

            return (
                "GENERATED_INVENTORY_ONLY"
            )

        return (
            "TEXT_SOURCE"
        )

    return (
        "BINARY_OR_OTHER"
    )


# ============================================================
# RESUMEN JSON
# ============================================================

def inspect_json(
    path: Path,
):

    try:

        payload = json.loads(
            path.read_text(
                encoding="utf-8"
            )
        )

    except Exception:

        return None

    info = {
        "type":
            type(
                payload
            ).__name__,
    }

    if isinstance(
        payload,
        list,
    ):

        info[
            "items"
        ] = len(
            payload
        )

        if payload and isinstance(
            payload[
                0
            ],
            dict,
        ):

            info[
                "first_item_keys"
            ] = sorted(
                payload[
                    0
                ].keys()
            )

    elif isinstance(
        payload,
        dict,
    ):

        info[
            "keys"
        ] = sorted(
            payload.keys()
        )

        if isinstance(
            payload.get(
                "items"
            ),
            list,
        ):

            info[
                "items"
            ] = len(
                payload[
                    "items"
                ]
            )

    return info


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main():

    files = collect_files()

    generated_at = (
        datetime.now().isoformat(
            timespec="seconds"
        )
    )

    inventory = []

    total_size = 0

    text_source_count = 0
    document_count = 0
    backup_count = 0
    sensitive_count = 0

    for path in files:

        size = path.stat().st_size

        total_size += size

        category = classify(
            path
        )

        if category == "TEXT_SOURCE":

            text_source_count += 1

        elif category == "DOCUMENT_BINARY":

            document_count += 1

        elif category == "BACKUP_INVENTORY_ONLY":

            backup_count += 1

        elif category == "SENSITIVE_NOT_EXPORTED":

            sensitive_count += 1

        inventory.append(
            {
                "path":
                    relative(
                        path
                    ),

                "size":
                    size,

                "sha256":
                    sha256_file(
                        path
                    ),

                "category":
                    category,
            }
        )


    with OUTPUT.open(
        "w",
        encoding="utf-8",
        newline="\n",
    ) as out:

        # ====================================================
        # CABECERA
        # ====================================================

        out.write(
            "=" * 100
            + "\n"
        )

        out.write(
            "EXPORTACIÓN COMPLETA DEL PROYECTO\n"
        )

        out.write(
            "=" * 100
            + "\n\n"
        )

        out.write(
            f"Proyecto        : {ROOT.name}\n"
        )

        out.write(
            f"Ruta            : {ROOT}\n"
        )

        out.write(
            f"Generado        : {generated_at}\n"
        )

        out.write(
            f"Python          : {sys.version.split()[0]}\n"
        )

        out.write(
            f"Archivos        : {len(files)}\n"
        )

        out.write(
            f"Tamaño total    : {human_size(total_size)}\n"
        )

        out.write(
            (
                "Fuentes texto   : "
                f"{text_source_count}\n"
            )
        )

        out.write(
            (
                "Documentos      : "
                f"{document_count}\n"
            )
        )

        out.write(
            (
                "Backups         : "
                f"{backup_count}\n"
            )
        )

        out.write(
            (
                "Sensibles       : "
                f"{sensitive_count}\n"
            )
        )

        out.write(
            "\n"
        )

        out.write(
            "NOTA DE SEGURIDAD\n"
        )

        out.write(
            "-" * 100
            + "\n"
        )

        out.write(
            (
                "Archivos como .env, secrets.toml, "
                "tokens y credenciales NO se vuelcan.\n"
            )
        )

        out.write(
            (
                "Patrones que parezcan API keys, "
                "tokens, passwords o secrets se redactan.\n"
            )
        )

        out.write(
            (
                "PDF/DOCX/imágenes se inventarían "
                "con hash y tamaño, pero no se codifican "
                "en base64 dentro del TXT.\n"
            )
        )

        out.write(
            "\n\n"
        )


        # ====================================================
        # ESTRUCTURA
        # ====================================================

        out.write(
            "=" * 100
            + "\n"
        )

        out.write(
            "1. ESTRUCTURA DEL PROYECTO\n"
        )

        out.write(
            "=" * 100
            + "\n\n"
        )

        out.write(
            build_tree(
                files
            )
        )

        out.write(
            "\n\n"
        )


        # ====================================================
        # INVENTARIO
        # ====================================================

        out.write(
            "=" * 100
            + "\n"
        )

        out.write(
            "2. INVENTARIO Y SHA-256\n"
        )

        out.write(
            "=" * 100
            + "\n\n"
        )

        for item in inventory:

            out.write(
                (
                    f"PATH     : {item['path']}\n"
                    f"TYPE     : {item['category']}\n"
                    f"SIZE     : {human_size(item['size'])}\n"
                    f"SHA-256  : {item['sha256']}\n"
                )
            )

            out.write(
                "-" * 100
                + "\n"
            )

        out.write(
            "\n"
        )


        # ====================================================
        # RESUMEN DE JSON
        # ====================================================

        out.write(
            "=" * 100
            + "\n"
        )

        out.write(
            "3. RESUMEN DE ARCHIVOS JSON\n"
        )

        out.write(
            "=" * 100
            + "\n\n"
        )

        for path in files:

            if path.suffix.lower() != ".json":

                continue

            if is_sensitive(
                path
            ):

                continue

            summary = inspect_json(
                path
            )

            if summary is None:

                continue

            out.write(
                f"FILE: {relative(path)}\n"
            )

            out.write(
                json.dumps(
                    summary,
                    ensure_ascii=False,
                    indent=2,
                )
            )

            out.write(
                "\n"
            )

            out.write(
                "-" * 100
                + "\n"
            )

        out.write(
            "\n"
        )


        # ====================================================
        # DOCUMENTOS
        # ====================================================

        out.write(
            "=" * 100
            + "\n"
        )

        out.write(
            "4. DOCUMENTOS Y BINARIOS\n"
        )

        out.write(
            "=" * 100
            + "\n\n"
        )

        document_items = [
            item
            for item
            in inventory
            if item[
                "category"
            ]
            in {
                "DOCUMENT_BINARY",
                "BINARY_OR_OTHER",
            }
        ]

        if not document_items:

            out.write(
                "No se encontraron documentos/binarios.\n"
            )

        else:

            for item in document_items:

                out.write(
                    f"FILE    : {item['path']}\n"
                )

                out.write(
                    (
                        f"SIZE    : "
                        f"{human_size(item['size'])}\n"
                    )
                )

                out.write(
                    f"SHA-256 : {item['sha256']}\n"
                )

                out.write(
                    "-" * 100
                    + "\n"
                )

        out.write(
            "\n"
        )


        # ====================================================
        # CONTENIDO DE ARCHIVOS
        # ====================================================

        out.write(
            "=" * 100
            + "\n"
        )

        out.write(
            "5. CÓDIGO Y CONTENIDO TEXTUAL ACTIVO\n"
        )

        out.write(
            "=" * 100
            + "\n\n"
        )

        total_redactions = 0
        exported_text_files = 0

        for path in files:

            category = classify(
                path
            )

            if category not in {
                "TEXT_SOURCE",
                "TEXT_GENERATED",
            }:

                continue

            text, encoding = safe_read_text(
                path
            )

            if text is None:

                continue

            redacted, redactions = redact_secrets(
                text
            )

            total_redactions += redactions
            exported_text_files += 1

            out.write(
                "\n"
                + "#" * 100
                + "\n"
            )

            out.write(
                (
                    "FILE: "
                    f"{relative(path)}\n"
                )
            )

            out.write(
                (
                    "ENCODING: "
                    f"{encoding}\n"
                )
            )

            out.write(
                (
                    "SHA-256: "
                    f"{sha256_file(path)}\n"
                )
            )

            out.write(
                "#" * 100
                + "\n\n"
            )

            out.write(
                redacted
            )

            if not redacted.endswith(
                "\n"
            ):

                out.write(
                    "\n"
                )

        out.write(
            "\n"
        )


        # ====================================================
        # BACKUPS
        # ====================================================

        out.write(
            "=" * 100
            + "\n"
        )

        out.write(
            "6. BACKUPS / CHECKPOINTS NO VOLCADOS\n"
        )

        out.write(
            "=" * 100
            + "\n\n"
        )

        backups = [
            item
            for item
            in inventory
            if item[
                "category"
            ]
            == "BACKUP_INVENTORY_ONLY"
        ]

        if not backups:

            out.write(
                "No se detectaron backups.\n"
            )

        else:

            for item in backups:

                out.write(
                    (
                        f"{item['path']}\n"
                        f"  SIZE    : "
                        f"{human_size(item['size'])}\n"
                        f"  SHA-256 : "
                        f"{item['sha256']}\n"
                    )
                )

        out.write(
            "\n"
        )


        # ====================================================
        # SEGURIDAD
        # ====================================================

        out.write(
            "=" * 100
            + "\n"
        )

        out.write(
            "7. SEGURIDAD DE LA EXPORTACIÓN\n"
        )

        out.write(
            "=" * 100
            + "\n\n"
        )

        out.write(
            (
                "Archivos textuales exportados : "
                f"{exported_text_files}\n"
            )
        )

        out.write(
            (
                "Valores sensibles redactados  : "
                f"{total_redactions}\n"
            )
        )

        out.write(
            (
                "Archivos sensibles omitidos   : "
                f"{sensitive_count}\n"
            )
        )

        out.write(
            "\n"
        )


        # ====================================================
        # FIN
        # ====================================================

        out.write(
            "=" * 100
            + "\n"
        )

        out.write(
            "FIN DE LA EXPORTACIÓN\n"
        )

        out.write(
            "=" * 100
            + "\n"
        )


    # ========================================================
    # VALIDACIÓN DEL ARCHIVO GENERADO
    # ========================================================

    if not OUTPUT.exists():

        raise RuntimeError(
            "No se creó el archivo de exportación."
        )

    if OUTPUT.stat().st_size < 1000:

        raise RuntimeError(
            (
                "La exportación es demasiado pequeña; "
                "probablemente quedó incompleta."
            )
        )


    # ========================================================
    # SALIDA
    # ========================================================

    print(
        "=" * 88
    )

    print(
        "EXPORTACIÓN COMPLETA DEL PROYECTO"
    )

    print(
        "=" * 88
    )

    print(
        "Proyecto               :",
        ROOT,
    )

    print(
        "Archivos inventariados :",
        len(
            files
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Fuentes texto          :",
        text_source_count,
    )

    print(
        "Documentos/binarios    :",
        document_count,
    )

    print(
        "Backups inventariados  :",
        backup_count,
    )

    print(
        "Sensibles omitidos     :",
        sensitive_count,
    )

    print(
        "Tamaño del proyecto    :",
        human_size(
            total_size
        ),
    )

    print()

    print(
        "ARCHIVO GENERADO"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 88
    )

    print(
        OUTPUT
    )

    print(
        "Tamaño:",
        human_size(
            OUTPUT.stat().st_size
        ),
    )

    print(
        "SHA-256:",
        sha256_file(
            OUTPUT
        ),
    )

    print()

    print(
        "RESULTADO: EXPORTACIÓN COMPLETADA"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":

    main()
