MANAGER_SOURCE = textwrap.dedent(r'''\
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import tempfile
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
MANIFEST_SCHEMA = "p2e0_simulacro_manifest_v1"
CATALOG_SCHEMA = "p2e0_content_catalog_v1"
REGISTRY_SCHEMA = "p2e0_content_id_registry_v1"
RUNTIME_SCHEMA = "p2e0_runtime_question_bank_v1"
VALIDATION_FLAGS = (
    "structure_reviewed", "source_reviewed", "answers_reviewed",
    "taxonomy_reviewed", "pedagogical_reviewed", "mastery_approved",
)
PACKAGE_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{1,63}$")
PREFIX_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{0,7}$")


def _now():
    return datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds")


def _sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()


def _read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def _write(path, payload):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, tmp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(
        prefix=path.name + ".",
        suffix=".tmp",
        dir=str(path.parent),
    )
    tmp = Path(tmp_name)

    try:
        with os.fdopen(
            fd,
            "w",
            encoding="utf-8",
            newline="\n",
        ) as f:
            json.dump(
                payload,
                f,
                ensure_ascii=False,
                indent=2,
            )
            f.write("\n")

        os.replace(
            tmp,
            path,
        )

    except Exception:
        tmp.unlink(
            missing_ok=True
        )
        raise


def _paths(root=None):
    root = (
        Path(root)
        if root is not None
        else ROOT
    )

    return {
        "root":
            root,

        "data":
            root / "data",

        "sources":
            root / "sources",

        "packages":
            root / "content" / "simulacros",

        "runtime":
            root / "data" / "runtime_banks",

        "catalog":
            root / "data" / "content_catalog.json",

        "registry":
            root / "data" / "content_id_registry.json",
    }


def _registry(path, core):
    ids = sorted(
        str(
            q.get(
                "id",
                "",
            )
        ).strip()
        for q in core
    )

    if (
        any(
            not x
            for x in ids
        )
        or
        len(ids)
        != len(
            set(ids)
        )
    ):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "IDs inválidos o duplicados en question_bank.json"
        )

    if not Path(
        path
    ).exists():
        return {
            "schema_version":
                REGISTRY_SCHEMA,

            "created_at":
                _now(),

            "updated_at":
                _now(),

            "legacy_ids":
                ids,

            "packages":
                {},
        }

    try:
        data = _read(
            path
        )

    except Exception as exc:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Registro de IDs ilegible: {exc}"
        ) from exc

    if (
        not isinstance(
            data,
            dict,
        )
        or
        data.get(
            "schema_version"
        )
        != REGISTRY_SCHEMA
        or
        not isinstance(
            data.get(
                "legacy_ids"
            ),
            list,
        )
        or
        not isinstance(
            data.get(
                "packages"
            ),
            dict,
        )
    ):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Schema inválido en content_id_registry.json"
        )

    if (
        set(
            data[
                "legacy_ids"
            ]
        )
        !=
        set(
            ids
        )
    ):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Los IDs legado no coinciden con el registro estable"
        )

    return data


def _name(value, field):
    if (
        not isinstance(
            value,
            str,
        )
        or
        not value.strip()
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            f"{field}_missing"
        )

    value = value.strip()

    if (
        Path(
            value
        ).name
        != value
        or
        value
        in {
            ".",
            "..",
        }
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            f"{field}_invalid"
        )

    return value


def _manifest_errors(m, folder):
    if not isinstance(
        m,
        dict,
    ):
        return [
            "manifest_not_object"
        ]

    e = []

    if (
        m.get(
            "schema_version"
        )
        != MANIFEST_SCHEMA
    ):
        e.append(
            "manifest_schema_invalid"
        )

    pid = str(
        m.get(
            "package_id",
            "",
        )
    ).strip()

    name = str(
        m.get(
            "display_name",
            "",
        )
    ).strip()

    prefix = str(
        m.get(
            "id_prefix",
            "",
        )
    ).strip()

    if not PACKAGE_RE.fullmatch(
        pid
    ):
        e.append(
            "package_id_invalid"
        )

    if not name:
        e.append(
            "display_name_missing"
        )

    elif name.startswith(
        "Mixto"
    ):
        e.append(
            "display_name_reserved"
        )

    if not PREFIX_RE.fullmatch(
        prefix
    ):
        e.append(
            "id_prefix_invalid"
        )

    try:
        pdf = (
            folder
            /
            _name(
                m.get(
                    "source_pdf"
                ),
                "source_pdf",
            )
        )

        raw = (
            pdf.read_bytes()
            if pdf.exists()
            else b""
        )

        if (
            not pdf.exists()
            or
            len(
                raw
            )
            < 8
            or
            not raw.startswith(
                b"%PDF-"
            )
        ):
            e.append(
                "source_pdf_invalid"
            )

    except Exception:
        e.append(
            "source_pdf_invalid"
        )

    try:
        qf = (
            folder
            /
            _name(
                m.get(
                    "questions_file",
                    "questions.json",
                ),
                "questions_file",
            )
        )

        if not qf.exists():
            e.append(
                "questions_file_missing"
            )

    except Exception:
        e.append(
            "questions_file_invalid"
        )

    if (
        not isinstance(
            m.get(
                "expected_question_count"
            ),
            int,
        )
        or
        m.get(
            "expected_question_count",
            0,
        )
        < 1
    ):
        e.append(
            "expected_question_count_invalid"
        )

    if (
        m.get(
            "official_utn_question"
        )
        not in {
            True,
            False,
        }
    ):
        e.append(
            "official_utn_question_must_be_boolean"
        )

    v = m.get(
        "validation"
    )

    if not isinstance(
        v,
        dict,
    ):
        e.append(
            "validation_block_missing"
        )

    else:
        if (
            v.get(
                "publication_status"
            )
            != "validated"
        ):
            e.append(
                "publication_status_not_validated"
            )

        e.extend(
            f"validation_{flag}_required"
            for flag
            in VALIDATION_FLAGS
            if (
                v.get(
                    flag
                )
                is not True
            )
        )

        if not str(
            v.get(
                "reviewed_by",
                "",
            )
        ).strip():
            e.append(
                "reviewed_by_missing"
            )

        if not str(
            v.get(
                "reviewed_at",
                "",
            )
        ).strip():
            e.append(
                "reviewed_at_missing"
            )

    return e


def _has_answer(
    choices,
    answer,
):
    a = str(
        answer
    ).strip().upper()

    return any(
        str(
            c
        ).strip().upper()
        == a
        or
        str(
            c
        ).strip().upper().startswith(
            a + "."
        )
        or
        str(
            c
        ).strip().upper().startswith(
            a + ")"
        )
        for c
        in choices
    )


def _questions(m, folder):
    raw = _read(
        folder
        /
        _name(
            m.get(
                "questions_file",
                "questions.json",
            ),
            "questions_file",
        )
    )

    if not isinstance(
        raw,
        list,
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "questions_not_list"
        )

    if (
        len(
            raw
        )
        != m[
            "expected_question_count"
        ]
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "question_count_mismatch:"
            f"{len(raw)}!="
            f"{m['expected_question_count']}"
        )

    pid = m[
        "package_id"
    ]

    display = m[
        "display_name"
    ]

    prefix = m[
        "id_prefix"
    ]

    pdf = _name(
        m[
            "source_pdf"
        ],
        "source_pdf",
    )

    pattern = re.compile(
        rf"^{re.escape(prefix)}-\d{{2,4}}$"
    )

    ids = set()
    nums = set()
    out = []

    for i, raw_q in enumerate(
        raw,
        1,
    ):
        if not isinstance(
            raw_q,
            dict,
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                f"question_{i}_not_object"
            )

        q = dict(
            raw_q
        )

        qid = str(
            q.get(
                "id",
                "",
            )
        ).strip()

        if not pattern.fullmatch(
            qid
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                f"{qid or i}:id_invalid"
            )

        if qid in ids:
            raise ValueError(
                f"duplicate_id:{qid}"
            )

        ids.add(
            qid
        )

        n = q.get(
            "number"
        )

        if (
            not isinstance(
                n,
                int,
            )
            or
            n < 1
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                f"{qid}:number_invalid"
            )

        if n in nums:
            raise ValueError(
                f"duplicate_number:{n}"
            )

        nums.add(
            n
        )

        if (
            not isinstance(
                q.get(
                    "page"
                ),
                int,
            )
            or
            q[
                "page"
            ]
            < 1
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                f"{qid}:page_invalid"
            )

        if not str(
            q.get(
                "subject",
                "",
            )
        ).strip():
            raise ValueError(
                f"{qid}:subject_missing"
            )

        answer = str(
            q.get(
                "answer",
                "",
            )
        ).strip()

        choices = q.get(
            "choices"
        )

        if not answer:
            raise ValueError(
                f"{qid}:answer_missing"
            )

        if (
            not isinstance(
                choices,
                list,
            )
            or
            len(
                choices
            )
            < 2
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                f"{qid}:choices_invalid"
            )

        if not _has_answer(
            choices,
            answer,
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                f"{qid}:answer_not_in_choices"
            )

        if not str(
            q.get(
                "explanation",
                "",
            )
        ).strip():
            raise ValueError(
                f"{qid}:explanation_missing"
            )

        for field in (
            "area",
            "topic",
            "skill",
            "subskill",
        ):
            if not str(
                q.get(
                    field,
                    "",
                )
            ).strip():
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{qid}:{field}_missing"
                )

        if (
            q.get(
                "taxonomy_status"
            )
            == "source_review"
            or
            q.get(
                "status"
            )
            == "revisar_fuente"
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                f"{qid}:source_review_not_publishable"
            )

        quality = q.get(
            "quality"
        )

        if (
            not isinstance(
                quality,
                dict,
            )
            or
            quality.get(
                "status"
            )
            != "validated"
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                f"{qid}:quality_not_validated"
            )

        if (
            quality.get(
                "mastery_eligible"
            )
            is not True
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                f"{qid}:mastery_not_eligible"
            )

        q.update(
            {
                "id":
                    qid,

                "simulacro":
                    display,

                "answer":
                    answer,

                "pdf":
                    f"imported/{pid}/{pdf}",

                "official_utn_question":
                    m[
                        "official_utn_question"
                    ],

                "content_package_id":
                    pid,

                "content_origin":
                    "extension_package",
            }
        )

        q.setdefault(
            "source_note",
            "",
        )

        out.append(
            q
        )

    return out


def _stable_stage(
    reg,
    m,
    questions,
    seen,
):
    pid = m[
        "package_id"
    ]

    prefix = m[
        "id_prefix"
    ]

    old = reg.get(
        "packages",
        {},
    ).get(
        pid
    )

    if (
        old
        and
        old.get(
            "id_prefix"
        )
        != prefix
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "stable_id_prefix_violation"
        )

    legacy = set(
        reg[
            "legacy_ids"
        ]
    )

    numbers = {}

    for q in questions:
        qid = q[
            "id"
        ]

        key = str(
            q[
                "number"
            ]
        )

        if qid in legacy:
            raise ValueError(
                f"id_collision_with_legacy:{qid}"
            )

        if qid in seen:
            raise ValueError(
                f"id_collision_between_packages:{qid}"
            )

        if old:
            old_id = old.get(
                "numbers",
                {},
            ).get(
                key
            )

            if (
                old_id
                is not None
                and
                old_id
                != qid
            ):
                raise ValueError(
                    "stable_id_violation:"
                    f"number_{key}:"
                    f"{old_id}->{qid}"
                )

        numbers[
            key
        ] = qid

    return {
        "id_prefix":
            prefix,

        "display_name":
            m[
                "display_name"
            ],

        "numbers":
            numbers,
    }


def refresh_catalog(
    project_root=None,
):
    p = _paths(
        project_root
    )

    for key in (
        "data",
        "sources",
        "packages",
        "runtime",
    ):
        p[
            key
        ].mkdir(
            parents=True,
            exist_ok=True,
        )

    core_file = (
        p[
            "data"
        ]
        /
        "question_bank.json"
    )

    if not core_file.exists():
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Falta data/question_bank.json"
        )

    core = _read(
        core_file
    )

    if not isinstance(
        core,
        list,
    ):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "question_bank.json no es una lista"
        )

    reg = _registry(
        p[
            "registry"
        ],
        core,
    )

    seen = {
        str(
            q[
                "id"
            ]
        ).strip()
        for q
        in core
    }

    published = []
    blocked = []
    staged = {}

    folders = sorted(
        x
        for x
        in p[
            "packages"
        ].iterdir()
        if (
            x.is_dir()
            and
            not x.name.startswith(
                "_"
            )
        )
    )

    for folder in folders:
        entry = {
            "folder":
                folder.name,

            "published":
                False,

            "errors":
                [],
        }

        mf = (
            folder
            /
            "manifest.json"
        )

        if not mf.exists():
            entry[
                "errors"
            ] = [
                "manifest_missing"
            ]

            blocked.append(
                entry
            )

            continue

        try:
            m = _read(
                mf
            )

        except Exception as exc:
            entry[
                "errors"
            ] = [
                f"manifest_unreadable:{exc}"
            ]

            blocked.append(
                entry
            )

            continue

        entry.update(
            {
                "package_id":
                    str(
                        m.get(
                            "package_id",
                            "",
                        )
                    ).strip(),

                "display_name":
                    str(
                        m.get(
                            "display_name",
                            "",
                        )
                    ).strip(),
            }
        )

        errors = _manifest_errors(
            m,
            folder,
        )

        if errors:
            entry[
                "errors"
            ] = errors

            blocked.append(
                entry
            )

            continue

        try:
            qs = _questions(
                m,
                folder,
            )

            stage = _stable_stage(
                reg,
                m,
                qs,
                seen,
            )

        except Exception as exc:
            entry[
                "errors"
            ] = [
                str(
                    exc
                )
            ]

            blocked.append(
                entry
            )

            continue

        bank_path = (
            p[
                "runtime"
            ]
            /
            f"{m['package_id']}.json"
        )

        _write(
            bank_path,
            {
                "schema_version":
                    RUNTIME_SCHEMA,

                "package_id":
                    m[
                        "package_id"
                    ],

                "display_name":
                    m[
                        "display_name"
                    ],

                "generated_at":
                    _now(),

                "items":
                    qs,
            }
        )

        pdf_name = _name(
            m[
                "source_pdf"
            ],
            "source_pdf",
        )

        src = (
            folder
            /
            pdf_name
        )

        dst = (
            p[
                "sources"
            ]
            /
            "imported"
            /
            m[
                "package_id"
            ]
            /
            pdf_name
        )

        dst.parent.mkdir(
            parents=True,
            exist_ok=True,
        )

        if (
            not dst.exists()
            or
            _sha(
                dst
            )
            !=
            _sha(
                src
            )
        ):
            shutil.copy2(
                src,
                dst,
            )

        seen.update(
            q[
                "id"
            ]
            for q
            in qs
        )

        staged[
            m[
                "package_id"
            ]
        ] = stage

        entry.update(
            {
                "published":
                    True,

                "errors":
                    [],

                "id_prefix":
                    m[
                        "id_prefix"
                    ],

                "question_count":
                    len(
                        qs
                    ),

                "questions_file":
                    str(
                        bank_path.relative_to(
                            p[
                                "root"
                            ]
                        )
                    ).replace(
                        "\\",
                        "/",
                    ),

                "questions_sha256":
                    _sha(
                        bank_path
                    ),

                "source_pdf":
                    str(
                        dst.relative_to(
                            p[
                                "root"
                            ]
                        )
                    ).replace(
                        "\\",
                        "/",
                    ),

                "source_pdf_sha256":
                    _sha(
                        dst
                    ),

                "official_utn_question":
                    m[
                        "official_utn_question"
                    ],

                "validation":
                    dict(
                        m[
                            "validation"
                        ]
                    ),
            }
        )

        published.append(
            entry
        )

    for pid, stage in staged.items():
        old_numbers = dict(
            reg.setdefault(
                "packages",
                {},
            ).get(
                pid,
                {},
            ).get(
                "numbers",
                {},
            )
        )

        old_numbers.update(
            stage[
                "numbers"
            ]
        )

        reg[
            "packages"
        ][
            pid
        ] = {
            "id_prefix":
                stage[
                    "id_prefix"
                ],

            "display_name":
                stage[
                    "display_name"
                ],

            "numbers":
                old_numbers,
        }

    reg[
        "updated_at"
    ] = _now()

    catalog = {
        "schema_version":
            CATALOG_SCHEMA,

        "generated_at":
            _now(),

        "legacy": {
            "question_count":
                len(
                    core
                ),

            "question_bank":
                "data/question_bank.json",

            "question_bank_sha256":
                _sha(
                    core_file
                ),

            "source_names":
                sorted(
                    {
                        str(
                            q.get(
                                "simulacro",
                                "",
                            )
                        ).strip()
                        for q
                        in core
                        if str(
                            q.get(
                                "simulacro",
                                "",
                            )
                        ).strip()
                    }
                ),
        },

        "published_packages":
            published,

        "blocked_packages":
            blocked,

        "published_question_count":
            sum(
                x[
                    "question_count"
                ]
                for x
                in published
            ),

        "runtime_total_question_count":
            len(
                core
            )
            +
            sum(
                x[
                    "question_count"
                ]
                for x
                in published
            ),
    }

    _write(
        p[
            "registry"
        ],
        reg,
    )

    _write(
        p[
            "catalog"
        ],
        catalog,
    )

    return catalog


def load_runtime_question_bank(
    core_file=None,
    project_root=None,
):
    p = _paths(
        project_root
    )

    core_path = (
        Path(
            core_file
        )
        if core_file is not None
        else
        p[
            "data"
        ]
        /
        "question_bank.json"
    )

    core = _read(
        core_path
    )

    if not isinstance(
        core,
        list,
    ):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Banco original inválido"
        )

    try:
        catalog = refresh_catalog(
            p[
                "root"
            ]
        )

    except Exception:
        return list(
            core
        )

    out = list(
        core
    )

    seen = {
        str(
            q.get(
                "id",
                "",
            )
        ).strip()
        for q
        in core
    }

    for entry in catalog.get(
        "published_packages",
        [],
    ):
        try:
            path = (
                p[
                    "root"
                ]
                /
                entry[
                    "questions_file"
                ]
            )

            if (
                _sha(
                    path
                )
                !=
                entry[
                    "questions_sha256"
                ]
            ):
                continue

            payload = _read(
                path
            )

            if (
                payload.get(
                    "schema_version"
                )
                != RUNTIME_SCHEMA
                or
                payload.get(
                    "package_id"
                )
                != entry[
                    "package_id"
                ]
            ):
                continue

            items = payload.get(
                "items",
                [],
            )

            ids = [
                str(
                    q.get(
                        "id",
                        "",
                    )
                ).strip()
                for q
                in items
            ]

            if (
                len(
                    items
                )
                != entry[
                    "question_count"
                ]
                or
                any(
                    not x
                    for x
                    in ids
                )
            ):
                continue

            if (
                len(
                    ids
                )
                != len(
                    set(
                        ids
                    )
                )
                or
                any(
                    x in seen
                    for x
                    in ids
                )
            ):
                continue

            out.extend(
                items
            )

            seen.update(
                ids
            )

        except Exception:
            continue

    return out

    catalog = refresh_catalog(

    )

    bank = load_runtime_question_bank(

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(
        Path(
            path
        ).read_bytes()
    ).hexdigest().upper()


def write_text(
    path,
    text,
):
    path = Path(
        path
    )

    path.parent.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    tmp = path.with_name(
        path.name
        + ".tmp"
    )

    tmp.write_text(
        text,
        encoding="utf-8",
        newline="\n",
    )

    tmp.replace(
        path
    )


def write_json(
    path,
    payload,
):
    write_text(
        path,
        json.dumps(
            payload,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )
        + "\n",
    )


def verify_frozen():
    for path, expected in {
        Q:
            Q_SHA,

        R:
            R_SHA,

        S:
            S_SHA,

        E:
            E_SHA,
    }.items():

        if not path.exists():
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Falta {path}"
            )

        actual = sha(
            path
        )

        if actual != expected:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Hash inesperado en {path.name}: {actual}"
            )


def fn(
    tree,
    name,
):
    matches = [
        x
        for x
        in tree.body
        if (
            isinstance(
                x,
                ast.FunctionDef,
            )
            and
            x.name
            == name
        )
    ]

    if len(
        matches
    ) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"No existe exactamente una función {name}()."
        )

    return matches[
        0
    ]


def target_assign(
    function,
    target,
    selector_label=None,
):
    matches = []

    for node in ast.walk(
        function
    ):
        if not isinstance(
            node,
            ast.Assign,
        ):
            continue

        if not any(
            isinstance(
                t,
                ast.Name,
            )
            and
            t.id
            == target
            for t
            in node.targets
        ):
            continue

        if selector_label is not None:
            call = node.value

            if (
                not isinstance(
                    call,
                    ast.Call,
                )
                or
                not isinstance(
                    call.func,
                    ast.Attribute,
                )
                or
                call.func.attr
                != "selectbox"
            ):
                continue

            if (
                not call.args
                or
                not isinstance(
                    call.args[
                        0
                    ],
                    ast.Constant,
                )
                or
                call.args[
                    0
                ].value
                != selector_label
            ):
                continue

        matches.append(
            node
        )

    if len(
        matches
    ) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Asignación no única: {target}"
        )

    return matches[
        0
    ]


def patch_app(source):
    if any(
        x in source
        for x in (
            IMPORT_LINE,
            LOAD_MARKER,
            SOURCE_MARKER,
        )
    ):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "P2-E0 ya parece integrado."
        )

    tree = ast.parse(
        source
    )

    load = fn(
        tree,
        "load_bank",
    )

    config = fn(
        tree,
        "configure_exam",
    )

    source_assign = target_assign(
        config,
        "source",
        "Banco",
    )

    subset_assign = target_assign(
        config,
        "original_subset",
    )

    nl = (
        "\r\n"
        if "\r\n"
        in source
        else "\n"
    )

    lines = source.splitlines(
        keepends=True
    )

    load_start = min(
        [
            load.lineno
        ]
        +
        [
            d.lineno
            for d
            in load.decorator_list
        ]
    )

    replacements = [
        (
            load_start,
            load.end_lineno,
            (
                f"@st.cache_data(ttl=2){nl}"
                f"def load_bank():{nl}"
                f"    {LOAD_MARKER}{nl}"
                f"    return load_runtime_question_bank(DATA_FILE){nl}"
            ),
        ),

        (
            source_assign.lineno,
            source_assign.end_lineno,
            (
                " "
                * source_assign.col_offset
                + SOURCE_MARKER
                + nl
                +
                " "
                * source_assign.col_offset
                +
                (
                    "available_sources = sorted({"
                    "str(q.get('simulacro', '')).strip() "
                    "for q in bank "
                    "if str(q.get('simulacro', '')).strip()"
                    "})"
                )
                + nl
                +
                " "
                * source_assign.col_offset
                +
                "source_options = list(available_sources)"
                + nl
                +
                " "
                * source_assign.col_offset
                +
                "if len(available_sources) > 1:"
                + nl
                +
                " "
                * (
                    source_assign.col_offset
                    + 4
                )
                +
                "source_options.append('Mixto (todos)')"
                + nl
                +
                " "
                * source_assign.col_offset
                +
                "source = st.selectbox('Banco', source_options)"
                + nl
            ),
        ),

        (
            subset_assign.lineno,
            subset_assign.end_lineno,
            (
                " "
                * subset_assign.col_offset
                + SUBSET_MARKER
                + nl
                +
                " "
                * subset_assign.col_offset
                +
                "original_subset = ("
                + nl
                +
                " "
                * (
                    subset_assign.col_offset
                    + 4
                )
                +
                "list(bank)"
                + nl
                +
                " "
                * (
                    subset_assign.col_offset
                    + 4
                )
                +
                "if source.startswith('Mixto')"
                + nl
                +
                " "
                * (
                    subset_assign.col_offset
                    + 4
                )
                +
                (
                    "else [q for q in bank "
                    "if q.get('simulacro') == source]"
                )
                + nl
                +
                " "
                * subset_assign.col_offset
                +
                ")"
                + nl
            ),
        ),
    ]

    for start, end, repl in sorted(
        replacements,
        reverse=True,
    ):
        lines[
            start - 1:
            end
        ] = [
            repl
        ]

    candidate = "".join(
        lines
    )

    anchor = (
        "import streamlit as st"
        + nl
    )

    if candidate.count(
        anchor
    ) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Import de Streamlit no único"
        )

    candidate = candidate.replace(
        anchor,
        anchor
        + IMPORT_LINE
        + nl,
        1,
    )

    compile(
        candidate,
        str(
            APP
        ),
        "exec",
    )

    for required in (
        IMPORT_LINE,
        LOAD_MARKER,
        SOURCE_MARKER,
        SUBSET_MARKER,
        "source_options.append('Mixto (todos)')",
    ):
        if candidate.count(
            required
        ) != 1:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Patch incompleto: {required}"
            )

    return candidate


def load_manager(name):
    spec = (
        importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
            name,
            MANAGER,
        )
    )

    if (
        spec is None
        or
        spec.loader is None
    ):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "No se pudo cargar content_manager.py"
        )

    module = (
        importlib.util.module_from_spec(
            spec
        )
    )

    spec.loader.exec_module(
        module
    )

    return module


def valid_manifest(
    pid,
    display,
    prefix,
):
    m = dict(
        TEMPLATE_MANIFEST
    )

    m.update(
        {
            "package_id":
                pid,

            "display_name":
                display,

            "id_prefix":
                prefix,

            "source_pdf":
                "source.pdf",
        }
    )

    m[
        "validation"
    ] = {
        "publication_status":
            "validated",

        "structure_reviewed":
            True,

        "source_reviewed":
            True,

        "answers_reviewed":
            True,

        "taxonomy_reviewed":
            True,

        "pedagogical_reviewed":
            True,

        "mastery_approved":
            True,

        "reviewed_by":
            "p2e0_selftest",

        "reviewed_at":
            "2026-08-22T00:00:00-05:00",
    }

    return m


def valid_question(qid):
    q = dict(
        TEMPLATE_QUESTIONS[
            0
        ]
    )

    q[
        "id"
    ] = qid

    return q

    )

    created = []

    try:
        if (
            not APP.exists()
            or
            sha(
                APP
            )
            != APP_SHA
        ):
            actual = (
                sha(

                else "MISSING"

        )

            ),
            "exec",
        )

        print(
            "[OK] app.py y content_manager.py "
            "compilan antes de escribir."
        )

        old_app = APP.read_bytes()

        if BACKUP.exists():
            if (
                sha(
                    BACKUP
                )
                != APP_SHA
            ):
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "Backup P2-E0 con hash inesperado"
                )

        else:
            BACKUP.write_bytes(
                old_app
            )

            created.append(
                BACKUP
            )

        write_text(
            MANAGER,
            MANAGER_SOURCE,
        )

        created.append(
            MANAGER

                )

        write_text(
            APP,

        )

        compile(

            ),

                APP
            ),
            "exec",

        compile(

INTEGRATION_BLOCK = r'''
# ============================================================
# P2-D5.6 ORIGINAL PEDAGOGICAL EXPLANATIONS
#
# Companion bank independiente:
# - solo originales VALIDATED
# - solo mastery_eligible=True
# - las source_review quedan fuera

# - no altera Evaluación

@st.cache_data
def load_validated_original_explanations():
    path = (
        BASE
        / 'data'
        / 'original_explanations_bank.json'
    )

    if not path.exists():
        return {}

    try:
        payload = json.loads(
            path.read_text(
                encoding='utf-8'
            )
        )
    except Exception:
        return {}

    if not isinstance(
        payload,
        dict,
    ):
        return {}

    if (
        payload.get(
            'schema_version'
        )
        != 'p2d5_2_original_explanation_v1'
    ):
        return {}

    if (
        payload.get(
            'bank_version'
        )
        != 'p2d5_2_original_explanation_bank_v1'
    ):
        return {}

    items = payload.get(
        'items',
        [],
    )

    if (
        not isinstance(
            items,
            list,
        )
        or
        len(
            items
        )
        != 180
    ):
        return {}

    verification_fields = (
        'content_verified',
        'answer_verified',
        'steps_verified',
        'distractors_verified',
        'pedagogical_reviewed',
    )

    validated = {}

    for item in items:
        if not isinstance(
            item,
            dict,
        ):
            continue

        source_id = item.get(
            'source_question_id'
        )

        quality = item.get(
            'quality',
            {},
        )

        if not source_id:
            continue

        if not isinstance(
            quality,
            dict,
        ):
            continue

        if (
            quality.get(
                'status'
            )
            != 'validated'
        ):
            continue

        if (
            quality.get(
                'mastery_eligible'
            )
            is not True
        ):
            continue

        if not all(
            quality.get(
                field
            )
            is True
            for field
            in verification_fields
        ):
            continue

        if (
            'source_review_required'
            in quality.get(
                'flags',
                [],
            )
        ):
            continue

        if (
            item.get(
                'official_utn_question'
            )
            is not False
        ):
            continue

        validated[
            source_id
        ] = item

    if len(
        validated
    ) != 173:
        return {}

    return validated


def render_original_pedagogical_companion(q):
    bank = (
        load_validated_original_explanations()
    )

    source_id = q.get(
        'id'
    )

    item = bank.get(
        source_id
    )

    if not item:
        return

    with st.expander(
        'Ver resolución pedagógica completa',
        expanded=False,
    ):
        idea_key = item.get(
            'idea_key'
        )

        if idea_key:
            st.markdown(
                '##### Idea clave'
            )

            st.write(
                idea_key
            )

        what_is_asked = item.get(
            'what_is_asked'
        )

        if what_is_asked:
            st.markdown(
                '##### Qué te pide realmente'
            )

            st.write(
                what_is_asked
            )

        relevant_data = item.get(
            'relevant_data',
            [],
        )

        if (
            isinstance(
                relevant_data,
                list,
            )
            and relevant_data
        ):
            st.markdown(
                '##### Datos y pistas relevantes'
            )

            for value in relevant_data:
                if value:
                    st.markdown(
                        f'- {value}'
                    )

        concept = item.get(
            'concept_or_rule'
        )

        if concept:
            st.markdown(
                '##### Concepto o regla'
            )

            st.write(
                concept
            )

        framework = item.get(
            'formula_or_framework'
        )

        if framework:
            st.markdown(
                '##### Fórmula o marco de resolución'
            )

            st.write(
                framework
            )

        steps = item.get(
            'steps',
            [],
        )

        if (
            isinstance(
                steps,
                list,
            )
            and steps
        ):
            st.markdown(
                '##### Paso a paso'
            )

            for step in steps:
                if not isinstance(
                    step,
                    dict,
                ):
                    continue

                order = step.get(
                    'order',
                    ''
                )

                title = step.get(
                    'title',
                    ''
                )

                detail = step.get(
                    'detail',
                    ''
                )

                math_text = step.get(
                    'math'
                )

                heading = (
                    f'**{order}. {title}**'
                    if order
                    else f'**{title}**'
                )

                if title:
                    st.markdown(
                        heading
                    )

                if detail:
                    st.write(
                        detail
                    )

                if math_text:
                    st.code(
                        str(
                            math_text
                        ),
                        language=None,
                    )

        why_correct = item.get(
            'why_correct'
        )

        if why_correct:
            st.markdown(
                '##### Por qué la respuesta es correcta'
            )

            st.write(
                why_correct
            )

        distractors = item.get(
            'distractor_analysis',
            [],
        )

        if (
            isinstance(
                distractors,
                list,
            )
            and distractors
        ):
            st.markdown(
                '##### Cómo descartar las otras opciones'
            )

            for distractor in distractors:
                if not isinstance(
                    distractor,
                    dict,
                ):
                    continue

                choice = distractor.get(
                    'choice',
                    ''
                )

                why_wrong = distractor.get(
                    'why_wrong',
                    ''
                )

                error_pattern = distractor.get(
                    'error_pattern',
                    ''
                )

                if choice:
                    st.markdown(
                        f'**{choice}**'
                    )

                if why_wrong:
                    st.write(
                        why_wrong
                    )

                if error_pattern:
                    st.caption(
                        'Patrón de error: '
                        f'{error_pattern}'
                    )

        common_error = item.get(
            'common_error'
        )

        if common_error:
            st.markdown(
                '##### Error común'
            )

            st.warning(
                common_error
            )

        transfer_tip = item.get(
            'transfer_tip'
        )

        if transfer_tip:
            st.markdown(
                '##### Cómo transferirlo a otro ejercicio'
            )

            st.write(
                transfer_tip
            )

        quick_check = item.get(
            'quick_check'
        )

        if quick_check:
            st.markdown(
                '##### Comprobación rápida'
            )

            st.info(
                quick_check
            )

        st.caption(
            'Explicación pedagógica validada. '
            'El enunciado y la pregunta original '
            'permanecen sin modificaciones.'
        )


def render_original_explanation(q):
    # Conserva íntegramente el renderizador P2-D5.1.
    render_original_explanation_base(
        q
    )

    # Añade el companion únicamente cuando su estado
    # pedagógico fue validado en P2-D5.5.
    render_original_pedagogical_companion(
        q
    )


'''


# ============================================================
# UTILIDADES
# ============================================================

def fail(
    message: str,
) -> None:

    print(
        f"[ERROR] {message}"
    )

    sys.exit(
        1
    )


def sha256_file(
    path: Path,
) -> str:

    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open(
        "rb"
    ) as handle:

        while True:

            chunk = handle.read(
                1024 * 1024
            )

            if not chunk:
                break

            digest.update(
                chunk
            )

    return digest.hexdigest().upper()


def load_json(
    path: Path,
):

    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def atomic_write_text(
    path: Path,
    text: str,
) -> None:

    path.parent.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    fd, temp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(
        prefix=f".{path.name}.",
        suffix=".tmp",
        dir=str(
            path.parent
        ),
    )

    temp_path = Path(
        temp_name
    )

    try:

        with os.fdopen(
            fd,
            "w",
            encoding="utf-8",
            newline="\n",
        ) as handle:

            handle.write(
                text
            )

            handle.flush()

            os.fsync(
                handle.fileno()
            )

        os.replace(
            temp_path,
            path,
        )

    except Exception:

        try:
            temp_path.unlink(
                missing_ok=True
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

        raise


def atomic_write_json(
    path: Path,
    data,
) -> None:

    atomic_write_text(
        path,
        json.dumps(
            data,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )
        + "\n",
    )


# ============================================================
# PRECONDICIONES
# ============================================================

def verify_files() -> None:

    required = [
        APP,
        QUESTION_BANK,
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
        SCHEMA_FILE,
        EXPLANATION_BANK,
        POST_VALIDATION_AUDIT,
    ]

    missing = [
        path
        for path
        in required
        if not path.exists()
    ]

    if missing:

        for path in missing:
            print(
                f"[ERROR] Falta archivo requerido: {path}"
            )

        sys.exit(
            1
        )

    expected_hashes = [
        (
            APP,
            APP_BEFORE_SHA256,
            "app.py",
        ),
        (
            QUESTION_BANK,
            QUESTION_BANK_SHA256,
            "question_bank",
        ),
        (
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256,
            "reinforcement_bank",
        ),
        (
            SCHEMA_FILE,
            SCHEMA_SHA256,
            "schema",
        ),
        (
            EXPLANATION_BANK,
            EXPLANATION_BANK_SHA256,
            "explanation_bank",
        ),
    ]

    for (
        path,
        expected,
        label,
    ) in expected_hashes:

        actual = sha256_file(
            path
        )

        if actual != expected:

            fail(
                f"{label} cambió. "
                f"Esperado={expected}; "
                f"actual={actual}"
            )

    print(
        "[OK] Checkpoints de archivos verificados."
    )


def verify_explanation_bank() -> None:

    bank = load_json(
        EXPLANATION_BANK
    )

    if (
        bank.get(
            "schema_version"
        )
        != SCHEMA_VERSION
        or
        bank.get(
            "bank_version"
        )
        != BANK_VERSION
    ):

        fail(
            "Identidad del banco pedagógico incorrecta."
        )

    items = bank.get(
        "items",
        [],
    )

    if len(
        items
    ) != 180:

        fail(
            "El banco pedagógico debe contener exactamente 180 explicaciones."
        )

    validated_ids = set()
    draft_ids = set()
    mastery_ids = set()
    fully_verified_ids = set()
    source_review_ids = set()

    verification_fields = [
        "content_verified",
        "answer_verified",
        "steps_verified",
        "distractors_verified",
        "pedagogical_reviewed",
    ]

    for item in items:

        source_id = item.get(
            "source_question_id"
        )

        quality = item.get(
            "quality",
            {},
        )

        status = quality.get(
            "status"
        )

        if status == "validated":
            validated_ids.add(
                source_id
            )

        elif status == "draft":
            draft_ids.add(
                source_id
            )

        else:
            fail(
                f"{source_id}: estado pedagógico inesperado {status!r}."
            )

        if (
            quality.get(
                "mastery_eligible"
            )
            is True
        ):
            mastery_ids.add(
                source_id
            )

        if all(
            quality.get(
                field
            )
            is True
            for field
            in verification_fields
        ):
            fully_verified_ids.add(
                source_id
            )

        if (
            "source_review_required"
            in quality.get(
                "flags",
                [],
            )
        ):
            source_review_ids.add(
                source_id
            )

    if len(
        validated_ids
    ) != 173:

        fail(
            f"Se esperaban 173 VALIDATED; hay {len(validated_ids)}."
        )

    if (
        draft_ids
        != EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "Los 7 DRAFT no coinciden exactamente con source_review."
        )

    if (
        source_review_ids
        != EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "El flag source_review_required no coincide con las 7 bloqueadas."
        )

    if (
        mastery_ids
        != validated_ids
    ):

        fail(
            "mastery_eligible=True no coincide exactamente con VALIDATED."
        )

    if (
        fully_verified_ids
        != validated_ids
    ):

        fail(
            "Las verificaciones completas no coinciden exactamente con VALIDATED."
        )

    if (
        validated_ids
        & EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "Una source_review aparece indebidamente VALIDATED."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Banco pedagógico confirma 173 VALIDATED + 7 DRAFT."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Las 7 source_review continúan excluidas de integración."
    )


def verify_post_validation_audit() -> None:

    audit = load_json(
        POST_VALIDATION_AUDIT
    )

    if (
        audit.get(
            "stage"
        )
        != "P2-D5.5"
    ):

        fail(
            "La auditoría post-validación no corresponde a P2-D5.5."
        )

    if (
        audit.get(
            "substage"
        )
        != "independent_post_validation_audit"
    ):

        fail(
            "Substage inesperado en auditoría post-validación."
        )

    summary = audit.get(
        "summary",
        {},
    )

    if (
        summary.get(
            "ready_for_app_integration"
        )
        is not True
    ):

        fail(
            "La auditoría no autoriza integración en app."
        )

    if (
        summary.get(
            "decision"
        )
        != READY_DECISION
    ):

        fail(
            "Decision code distinto de READY_FOR_APP_INTEGRATION."
        )

    expected = {
        "validated": 173,
        "draft": 7,
        "source_review_draft": 7,
        "mastery_true": 173,
        "fully_verified": 173,
        "changed_items": 173,
        "authorized_transitions": 173,
        "unauthorized_transitions": 0,
        "pedagogical_content_modified": 0,
        "items_changed_outside_quality": 0,
        "source_review_modified": 0,
    }

    for (
        field,
        expected_value,
    ) in expected.items():

        actual = summary.get(
            field
        )

        if actual != expected_value:

            fail(
                f"Auditoría post-validación: "
                f"{field} esperado={expected_value}, "
                f"actual={actual}."
            )

    hashes = audit.get(
        "hashes",
        {},
    )

    if (
        hashes.get(
            "current_bank"
        )
        != EXPLANATION_BANK_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "La auditoría post-validación no corresponde "
            "al explanation_bank actual."
        )

    if (
        set(
            audit.get(
                "source_review_ids",
                [],
            )
        )
        != EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "Auditoría post-validación: source_review inesperadas."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Auditoría independiente autoriza READY_FOR_APP_INTEGRATION."
    )


# ============================================================
# CONSTRUIR PARCHE
# ============================================================

def build_candidate(
    original: str,
) -> str:

    if (
        INTEGRATION_MARKER
        in original
    ):

        fail(
            "P2-D5.6 ya parece estar integrado en app.py."
        )

    if (
        original.count(
            OLD_RENDER_DEF
        )
        != 1
    ):

        fail(
            "No existe exactamente un "
            "def render_original_explanation(q):"
        )

    if (
        original.count(
            BASE_RENDER_DEF
        )
        != 0
    ):

        fail(
            "Ya existe render_original_explanation_base."
        )

    if (
        original.count(
            REINFORCEMENT_RENDER_DEF
        )
        != 1
    ):

        fail(
            "No existe exactamente un "
            "def render_reinforcement_explanation(q):"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Renombrar el renderizador actual.
    #
    # Todo su cuerpo queda byte-a-byte igual.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    candidate = original.replace(
        OLD_RENDER_DEF,
        BASE_RENDER_DEF,
        1,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Insertar loader + companion + wrapper justo antes
    #    del renderer de refuerzo.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    anchor = (
        "\n"
        + REINFORCEMENT_RENDER_DEF
    )

    if (
        candidate.count(
            anchor
        )
        != 1
    ):

        fail(
            "No se pudo localizar de forma inequívoca "
            "el ancla del renderer de refuerzo."
        )

    candidate = candidate.replace(
        anchor,
        (
            "\n"
            + INTEGRATION_BLOCK.rstrip()
            + "\n\n"
            + REINFORCEMENT_RENDER_DEF
        ),
        1,
    )

    return candidate


# ============================================================
# VALIDAR PARCHE
# ============================================================

def validate_candidate(
    original: str,
    candidate: str,
) -> None:

    if (
        original
        == candidate
    ):

        fail(
            "El candidato no contiene cambios."
        )

    if (
        candidate.count(
            INTEGRATION_MARKER
        )
        != 1
    ):

        fail(
            "El marcador P2-D5.6 no aparece exactamente una vez."
        )

    if (
        candidate.count(
            BASE_RENDER_DEF
        )
        != 1
    ):

        fail(
            "El renderer base no aparece exactamente una vez."
        )

    if (
        candidate.count(
            OLD_RENDER_DEF
        )
        != 1
    ):

        fail(
            "El nuevo wrapper original no aparece exactamente una vez."
        )

    if (
        candidate.count(
            REINFORCEMENT_RENDER_DEF
        )
        != 1
    ):

        fail(
            "El renderer de refuerzo cambió estructuralmente."
        )

    required_new_fragments = [
        "def load_validated_original_explanations():",
        "def render_original_pedagogical_companion(q):",
        "render_original_explanation_base(",
        "render_original_pedagogical_companion(",
        "'status'",
        "'validated'",
        "'mastery_eligible'",
        "'source_review_required'",
        "len(\n        validated\n    ) != 173",
        "Idea clave",
        "Qué te pide realmente",
        "Datos y pistas relevantes",
        "Concepto o regla",
        "Fórmula o marco de resolución",
        "Por qué la respuesta es correcta",
        "Cómo descartar las otras opciones",
        "Cómo transferirlo a otro ejercicio",
        "Comprobación rápida",
    ]

    missing_fragments = [
        fragment
        for fragment
        in required_new_fragments
        if fragment
        not in candidate
    ]

    if missing_fragments:

        fail(
            "Faltan fragmentos requeridos en integración: "
            f"{missing_fragments}"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # PRUEBA DE REVERSIBILIDAD TEXTUAL
    #
    # Quitamos exactamente lo añadido y revertimos el único
    # rename. Debemos recuperar app.py byte-a-byte.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    reverse = candidate

    inserted = (
        "\n"
        + INTEGRATION_BLOCK.rstrip()
        + "\n\n"
        + REINFORCEMENT_RENDER_DEF
    )

    if (
        reverse.count(
            inserted
        )
        != 1
    ):

        fail(
            "No se puede aislar inequívocamente "
            "el bloque P2-D5.6."
        )

    reverse = reverse.replace(
        inserted,
        (
            "\n"
            + REINFORCEMENT_RENDER_DEF
        ),
        1,
    )

    reverse = reverse.replace(
        BASE_RENDER_DEF,
        OLD_RENDER_DEF,
        1,
    )

    if (
        reverse
        != original
    ):

        fail(
            "El parche no es textualmente reversible; "
            "se detectó algún cambio fuera del scope."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # BARRERAS DE FLUJO EXISTENTES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    required_existing_fragments = [
        "def load_reinforcement_bank():",
        "def render_reinforcement_explanation(q):",
        "def exam_screen(bank):",
        "st.session_state.mode",
        "== 'Práctica'",
        "if reinforcement:",
        "render_reinforcement_explanation(",
        "render_original_explanation(",
        "bank = load_bank()",
        "reinforcement_bank = load_reinforcement_bank()",
    ]

    missing_existing = [
        fragment
        for fragment
        in required_existing_fragments
        if fragment
        not in candidate
    ]

    if missing_existing:

        fail(
            "Se perdió un ancla de comportamiento existente: "
            f"{missing_existing}"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # COMPILACIÓN DEL app.py CANDIDATO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:

        compile(
            candidate,
            str(
                APP
            ),
            "exec",
        )

    except SyntaxError as exc:

        fail(
            f"El app.py candidato no compila: {exc}"
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Parche limitado a rename + bloque P2-D5.6."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] El renderizador P2-D5.1 queda preservado íntegramente."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Renderer de refuerzo y flujo de Práctica conservados."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] app.py candidato compila correctamente."
    )

# MAIN

def main() -> None:

    print()

    print(
        "=" * 88
    )

    print(
        "P2-D5.6 - INTEGRACIÓN DE EXPLICACIONES "
        "ORIGINALES VALIDADAS"
    )

    print(
        "=" * 88
    )

    print()

    verify_files()

    verify_explanation_bank()

    verify_post_validation_audit()

    original = APP.read_text(
        encoding="utf-8"
    )

    before_hash = sha256_file(
        APP
    )

    candidate = build_candidate(
        original
    )

    validate_candidate(
        original,
        candidate,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # BACKUP
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if APP_BACKUP.exists():

        backup_hash = sha256_file(
            APP_BACKUP
        )

        if (
            backup_hash
            != APP_BEFORE_SHA256
        ):

            fail(
                "El backup app pre-P2-D5.6 existente "
                "no coincide con el checkpoint esperado."
            )

        print(
            "[OK] Backup app pre-P2-D5.6 existente y correcto."
        )

    else:

        shutil.copy2(
            APP,
            APP_BACKUP,
        )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                APP_BACKUP
            )
            != APP_BEFORE_SHA256
        ):

            fail(
                "El backup app pre-P2-D5.6 se creó "
                "con hash incorrecto."
            )

        print(
            "[OK] Backup app pre-P2-D5.6 creado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # ESCRITURA + ROLLBACK
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:

        atomic_write_text(
            APP,
            candidate,
        )

        written = APP.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )

        if (
            written
            != candidate
        ):

            raise RuntimeError(
                "app.py escrito no coincide con el candidato."
            )

        try:

            compile(
                written,
                str(
                    APP
                ),
                "exec",
            )

        except SyntaxError as exc:

            raise RuntimeError(
                f"app.py escrito no compila: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Archivos que NO pueden cambiar
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        if (
            sha256_file(
                QUESTION_BANK
            )
            != QUESTION_BANK_SHA256
        ):

            raise RuntimeError(
                "question_bank cambió."
            )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                REINFORCEMENT_BANK
            )
            != REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256
        ):

            raise RuntimeError(
                "reinforcement_bank cambió."
            )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                SCHEMA_FILE
            )
            != SCHEMA_SHA256
        ):

            raise RuntimeError(
                "schema cambió."
            )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                EXPLANATION_BANK
            )
            != EXPLANATION_BANK_SHA256
        ):

            raise RuntimeError(
                "explanation_bank cambió."
            )

        after_hash = sha256_file(
            APP
        )

        if (
            after_hash
            == before_hash
        ):

            raise RuntimeError(
                "app.py no cambió después de la integración."
            )

        report = build_report(
            before_hash,
            after_hash,
        )

        atomic_write_json(
            REPORT_JSON,
            report,
        )

        atomic_write_text(
            REPORT_TXT,
            build_txt(
                report
            ),
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        print(
            f"[ERROR] Falló P2-D5.6: {exc}"
        )

        print(
            "[INFO] Restaurando app.py desde checkpoint..."
        )

        shutil.copy2(
            APP_BACKUP,
            APP,
        )

        restored_hash = sha256_file(
            APP
        )

        if (
            restored_hash
            != APP_BEFORE_SHA256
        ):

            fail(
                "Rollback falló: app.py no volvió "
                "al checkpoint previo."
            )

        fail(
            "P2-D5.6 abortado; app.py restaurado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # RESUMEN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    print()

    print(
        "RESUMEN"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 88
    )

    print(
        "Companion originales VALIDATED   : 173"
    )

    print(
        "source_review excluidas           : 7"
    )

    print(
        "P2-D5.1 preservado                : True"
    )

    print(
        "Evaluación modificada             : False"
    )

    print(
        "Flujo de refuerzo modificado      : False"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "SEGURIDAD"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 88
    )

    print(
        "question_bank modificado          : False"
    )

    print(
        "reinforcement_bank modificado     : False"
    )

    print(
        "schema modificado                 : False"
    )

    print(
        "explanation_bank modificado       : False"
    )

    print(
        "source_review promovidas          : False"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "SHA-256"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 88
    )

    print(
        "app.py antes              :",
        before_hash,
    )

    print(
        "app.py después            :",
        sha256_file(
            APP
        ),
    )

    print(
        "question_bank             :",
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        ),
    )

    print(
        "reinforcement_bank        :",
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        ),
    )

    print(
        "schema                    :",
        sha256_file(
            SCHEMA_FILE
        ),
    )

    print(
        "explanation_bank          :",
        sha256_file(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        ),
    )

    print()

    print(
        "ARCHIVOS"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 88
    )

    print(
        "Backup app  :",
        APP_BACKUP.relative_to(
            ROOT
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Report JSON :",
        REPORT_JSON.relative_to(
            ROOT
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Report TXT  :",
        REPORT_TXT.relative_to(
            ROOT
        ),
    )

    print()

    print(
        "IMPORTANTE"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 88
    )

    print(
        "- La integración añade el companion únicamente "
        "a originales VALIDATED."
    )

    print(
        "- Las 7 source_review siguen usando únicamente "
        "el comportamiento original."
    )

    print(
        "- P2-D5.1 se conserva íntegramente como renderer base."
    )

    print(
        "- Evaluación todavía no muestra feedback durante "
        "la resolución."
    )

    print(
        "- No ejecutar todavía la app: primero corresponde "
        "la auditoría estructural post-integración."
    )

    print()

    print(
        "RESULTADO: P2-D5.6 ORIGINAL EXPLANATIONS "
        "INTEGRATION COMPLETADA"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# ============================================================
# UTILIDADES
# ============================================================

def fail(message: str) -> None:
    print(
        f"[ERROR] {message}"
    )
    sys.exit(1)


def sha256_file(
    path: Path,
) -> str:

    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open(
        "rb"
    ) as handle:

        while True:

            chunk = handle.read(
                1024 * 1024
            )

            if not chunk:
                break

            digest.update(
                chunk
            )

    return digest.hexdigest().upper()


def canonical_sha256(
    data,
) -> str:

    payload = json.dumps(
        data,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode(
        "utf-8"
    )

    return hashlib.sha256(
        payload
    ).hexdigest().upper()


def load_json(
    path: Path,
):

    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def atomic_write_text(
    path: Path,
    text: str,
) -> None:

    path.parent.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    fd, temporary_name = tempfile.mkstemp(
        prefix=f".{path.name}.",
        suffix=".tmp",
        dir=str(
            path.parent
        ),
    )

    temporary_path = Path(
        temporary_name
    )

    try:

        with os.fdopen(
            fd,
            "w",
            encoding="utf-8",
            newline="\n",
        ) as handle:

            handle.write(
                text
            )

            handle.flush()

            os.fsync(
                handle.fileno()
            )

        os.replace(
            temporary_path,
            path,
        )

    except Exception:

        try:
            temporary_path.unlink(
                missing_ok=True
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

        raise


def atomic_write_json(
    path: Path,
    data,
) -> None:

    atomic_write_text(
        path,
        json.dumps(
            data,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        ) + "\n",
    )


def clean_spaces(
    value,
) -> str:

    return re.sub(
        r"\s+",
        " ",
        str(
            value or ""
        ),
    ).strip()


def normalize(
    value,
) -> str:

    text = str(
        value or ""
    )

    text = unicodedata.normalize(
        "NFKD",
        text,
    )

    text = "".join(
        character
        for character
        in text
        if not unicodedata.combining(
            character
        )
    )

    text = (
        text.lower()
        .replace(
            "×",
            "x",
        )
        .replace(
            "−",
            "-",
        )
    )

    text = re.sub(
        r"\s+",
        " ",
        text,
    )

    return text.strip()


def source_review_ids_from_bank(
    bank: dict,
) -> set[str]:

    return {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in bank.get(
            "items",
            [],
        )
        if (
            "source_review_required"
            in item.get(
                "quality",
                {},
            ).get(
                "flags",
                [],
            )
        )
    }


def distractor_letters(
    item: dict,
) -> list[str]:

    output = []

    for distractor in item.get(
        "distractor_analysis",
        [],
    ):

        choice = clean_spaces(
            distractor.get(
                "choice"
            )
        )

        match = re.match(
            r"^([A-E])\)",
            choice,
            flags=re.I,
        )

        if match:

            output.append(
                match.group(
                    1
                ).upper()
            )

    return output
