def verify_preconditions():

    required = [
        APP,
        QUESTION_BANK,
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
        SCHEMA_FILE,
        EXPLANATION_BANK,
    ]

    missing = [
        path
        for path
        in required
        if not path.exists()
    ]

    if missing:

        for path in missing:

            print(
                f"[ERROR] Falta: {path}"
            )

        sys.exit(
            1
        )

    checkpoints = [
        (
            APP,
            APP_SHA256,
            "app.py",
        ),
        (
            QUESTION_BANK,
            QUESTION_BANK_SHA256,
            "question_bank",
        ),
        (
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256,
            "reinforcement_bank",
        ),
        (
            SCHEMA_FILE,
            SCHEMA_SHA256,
            "schema",
        ),
        (
            EXPLANATION_BANK,
            P2D5_4_BANK_SHA256,
            "explanation_bank P2-D5.4",
        ),
    ]

    for (
        path,
        expected,
        label,
    ) in checkpoints:

        actual = sha256_file(
            path
        )

        if actual != expected:

            fail(
                f"{label} cambió. "
                f"Esperado={expected}; "
                f"actual={actual}"
            )

    questions = load_json(
        QUESTION_BANK
    )

    reinforcement = load_json(
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK
    )

    bank = load_json(
        EXPLANATION_BANK
    )

    if (
        not isinstance(
            questions,
            list,
        )
        or
        len(
            questions
        )
        != 180
    ):

        fail(
            "question_bank debe contener 180 preguntas."
        )

    if (
        len(
            reinforcement.get(
                "items",
                [],
            )
        )
        != 8
    ):

        fail(
            "reinforcement_bank debe conservar 8 ítems."
        )

    if (
        bank.get(
            "schema_version"
        )
        != SCHEMA_VERSION
        or
        bank.get(
            "bank_version"
        )
        != BANK_VERSION
    ):

        fail(
            "Identidad del banco pedagógico incorrecta."
        )

    items = bank.get(
        "items",
        [],
    )

    if len(
        items
    ) != 180:

        fail(
            "El banco pedagógico debe contener 180 ítems."
        )

    if any(
        item.get(
            "quality",
            {},
        ).get(
            "status"
        )
        != "draft"
        for item
        in items
    ):

        fail(
            "Las 180 explicaciones deben seguir DRAFT."
        )

    if any(
        item.get(
            "quality",
            {},
        ).get(
            "mastery_eligible"
        )
        is not False
        for item
        in items
    ):

        fail(
            "mastery_eligible debe seguir False 180/180."
        )

    for (
        question,
        item,
    ) in zip(
        questions,
        items,
    ):

        if (
            item.get(
                "source_question_id"
            )
            != question.get(
                "id"
            )
        ):

            fail(
                f"Vínculo fuente incorrecto: "
                f"{question.get('id')}"
            )

        if (
            item.get(
                "source_question_sha256"
            )
            != canonical_sha256(
                question
            )
        ):

            fail(
                f"Hash fuente incorrecto: "
                f"{question.get('id')}"
            )

    source_review_ids = (
        source_review_ids_from_bank(
            bank
        )
    )

    if (
        source_review_ids
        != EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "El conjunto source_review cambió."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Checkpoint P2-D5.4 verificado."
    )

    return (
        questions,
        bank,
    )


# ============================================================
# PDF
# ============================================================

BOILERPLATE_PREFIXES = (
    "YachayPre Preuniversitario",
    "Simulacro UTN FICA-FICAYA",
    "Instrucciones:",
    "Resolver las 90 preguntas",
    "No está permitido el uso",
    "La evaluación deberá realizarse",
    "Marcar la opción correcta",
    "Si finaliza antes del tiempo",
)


def pdf_text(
    path: Path,
) -> str:

    pieces = []

    with fitz.open(
        path
    ) as document:

        for page in document:

            pieces.append(
                page.get_text(
                    "text"
                )
            )

    return "\n".join(
        pieces
    )


def remove_boilerplate(
    text: str,
) -> str:

    output = []

    for raw_line in text.splitlines():

        line = raw_line.strip()

        if not line:

            output.append(
                ""
            )

            continue

        if line.startswith(
            ""
        ):

            continue

        if any(
            line.startswith(
                prefix
            )
            for prefix
            in BOILERPLATE_PREFIXES
        ):

            continue

        output.append(
            raw_line
        )

    return "\n".join(
        output
    )


def parse_question_blocks(
    text: str,
) -> dict[int, str]:

    blocks = {}
    cursor = 0

    for number in range(
        1,
        91,
    ):

        pattern = re.compile(
            rf"(?m)^\s*{number}\.(?:-)?\s*"
        )

        match = pattern.search(
            text,
            cursor,
        )

        if not match:

            fail(
                f"No se encontró pregunta {number}."
            )

        if number < 90:

            next_pattern = re.compile(
                rf"(?m)^\s*{number + 1}"
                rf"\.(?:-)?\s*"
            )

            next_match = next_pattern.search(
                text,
                match.end(),
            )

            if not next_match:

                fail(
                    f"No se pudo delimitar "
                    f"pregunta {number}."
                )

            end = next_match.start()

        else:

            end = len(
                text
            )

        blocks[
            number
        ] = remove_boilerplate(
            text[
                match.start():
                end
            ]
        ).strip()

        cursor = match.end()

    return blocks


# ============================================================
# PARSER LEGACY
# ============================================================

def legacy_split(
    block: str,
    question_id: str,
) -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]]:

    body = re.sub(
        r"^\s*\d{1,2}\.(?:-)?\s*",
        "",
        block,
        count=1,
    ).strip()

    if question_id == "S3-77":

        return (
            (
                "Determine la derivada de la función "
                "f(x)=3x⁴-5x²+7x-2."
            ),
            dict(
                S3_77_OPTIONS
            ),
        )

    line_pattern = re.compile(
        r"(?ms)^\s*([A-Ea-e])"
        r"\s*[.)]\s*(.*?)"
        r"(?=^\s*[A-Ea-e]"
        r"\s*[.)]\s*|\Z)"
    )

    matches = list(
        line_pattern.finditer(
            body
        )
    )

    if len(
        matches
    ) >= 2:

        stem = clean_spaces(
            body[
                :matches[0].start()
            ]
        )

        options = {
            match.group(1).upper():
                clean_spaces(
                    match.group(2)
                )
            for match
            in matches
        }

        return (
            stem,
            options,
        )

    inline_pattern = re.compile(
        r"(?i)(?<![A-Za-z])"
        r"([A-E])\s*[.)]\s*"
    )

    inline_matches = list(
        inline_pattern.finditer(
            body
        )
    )

    if len(
        inline_matches
    ) >= 2:

        stem = clean_spaces(
            body[
                :inline_matches[0].start()
            ]
        )

        options = {}

        for (
            index,
            match,
        ) in enumerate(
            inline_matches
        ):

            start = match.end()

            if (
                index + 1
                < len(
                    inline_matches
                )
            ):

                end = (
                    inline_matches[
                        index + 1
                    ].start()
                )

            else:

                end = len(
                    body
                )

            options[
                match.group(1).upper()
            ] = clean_spaces(
                body[
                    start:end
                ]
            )

        return (
            stem,
            options,
        )

    return (
        clean_spaces(
            body
        ),
        {},
    )


# ============================================================
# PARSER REPARADO
# ============================================================

OPTION_MARKER_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"(?i)(?<!\S)([A-E])\s*[.)]\s*"
)


def ordered_option_candidates(
    body: str,
) -> list[list[re.Match]]:

    matches = list(
        OPTION_MARKER_PATTERN.finditer(
            body
        )
    )

    candidates = []

    for start_index, match in enumerate(
        matches
    ):

        if (
            match.group(
                1
            ).upper()
            != "A"
        ):

            continue

        selected = [
            match
        ]

        expected_ord = ord(
            "B"
        )

        for next_match in matches[
            start_index + 1:
        ]:

            if expected_ord > ord(
                "E"
            ):

                break

            expected_letter = chr(
                expected_ord
            )

            actual_letter = (
                next_match.group(
                    1
                ).upper()
            )

            if (
                actual_letter
                == expected_letter
            ):

                selected.append(
                    next_match
                )

                expected_ord += 1

            else:

                # Una secuencia real de alternativas
                # debe ser A, B, C, D, E sin saltos.
                break

        if len(
            selected
        ) >= 2:

            candidates.append(
                selected
            )

    return candidates


def repaired_split(
    block: str,
    question_id: str,
) -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]]:

    body = re.sub(
        r"^\s*\d{1,2}\.(?:-)?\s*",
        "",
        block,
        count=1,
    ).strip()

    if question_id == "S3-77":

        position = re.search(
            r"(?mi)^\s*A\s*[.)]",
            body,
        )

        if position:

            stem = clean_spaces(
                body[
                    :position.start()
                ]
            )

        else:

            stem = (
                "Determine la derivada de la función "
                "f(x)=3x⁴-5x²+7x-2."
            )

        return (
            stem,
            dict(
                S3_77_OPTIONS
            ),
        )

    candidates = ordered_option_candidates(
        body
    )

    if not candidates:

        return (
            clean_spaces(
                body
            ),
            {},
        )

    # Primero gana la secuencia con más opciones.
    # En empate gana la que aparece más tarde.
    #
    # Esto evita confundir, por ejemplo, etiquetas A/B/C/D
    # dentro del enunciado con las alternativas reales
    # que aparecen después.
    selected = max(
        candidates,
        key=lambda candidate: (
            len(
                candidate
            ),
            candidate[
                0
            ].start(),
        ),
    )

    stem = clean_spaces(
        body[
            :selected[
                0
            ].start()
        ]
    )

    options = {}

    for (
        index,
        match,
    ) in enumerate(
        selected
    ):

        start = match.end()

        if (
            index + 1
            < len(
                selected
            )
        ):

            end = selected[
                index + 1
            ].start()

        else:

            end = len(
                body
            )

        letter = (
            match.group(
                1
            ).upper()
        )

        options[
            letter
        ] = clean_spaces(
            body[
                start:end
            ]
        )

    return (
        stem,
        options,
    )


# ============================================================
# EXTRAER AMBAS VERSIONES
# ============================================================

def extract_sources(
    questions: list[dict],
):

    pdf_names = sorted(
        {
            question[
                "pdf"
            ]
            for question
            in questions
        }
    )

    parsed = {}

    for pdf_name in pdf_names:

        path = (
            SOURCES_DIR
            / pdf_name
        )

        if not path.exists():

            fail(
                f"Falta PDF fuente: {path}"
            )

        blocks = parse_question_blocks(
            pdf_text(
                path
            )
        )

        if len(
            blocks
        ) != 90:

            fail(
                f"{pdf_name}: no produjo 90 preguntas."
            )

        parsed[
            pdf_name
        ] = blocks

        print(
            f"[OK] {pdf_name}: 90 bloques."
        )

    legacy_sources = {}
    repaired_sources = {}

    for question in questions:

        source_id = question[
            "id"
        ]

        block = parsed[
            question[
                "pdf"
            ]
        ][
            int(
                question[
                    "number"
                ]
            )
        ]

        (
            legacy_stem,
            legacy_options,
        ) = legacy_split(
            block,
            source_id,
        )

        (
            repaired_stem,
            repaired_options,
        ) = repaired_split(
            block,
            source_id,
        )

        legacy_sources[
            source_id
        ] = {
            "stem":
                legacy_stem,

            "options":
                legacy_options,
        }

        repaired_sources[
            source_id
        ] = {
            "stem":
                repaired_stem,

            "options":
                repaired_options,
        }

    return (
        legacy_sources,
        repaired_sources,
    )


# ============================================================
# VALIDAR PARSER REPARADO
# ============================================================

def validate_parser(
    questions: list[dict],
    legacy_sources: dict,
    repaired_sources: dict,
) -> None:

    changed_key_ids = set()

    invalid_counts = []

    answer_missing = []

    for question in questions:

        source_id = question[
            "id"
        ]

        legacy_keys = sorted(
            legacy_sources[
                source_id
            ][
                "options"
            ].keys()
        )

        repaired_keys = sorted(
            repaired_sources[
                source_id
            ][
                "options"
            ].keys()
        )

        if (
            legacy_keys
            != repaired_keys
        ):

            changed_key_ids.add(
                source_id
            )

        expected_count = (
            EXPECTED_NON4_COUNTS.get(
                source_id,
                4,
            )
        )

        if (
            len(
                repaired_keys
            )
            != expected_count
        ):

            invalid_counts.append(
                (
                    source_id,
                    expected_count,
                    repaired_keys,
                )
            )

        answer = str(
            question.get(
                "answer",
                "",
            )
        ).upper()

        if (
            answer
            not in repaired_keys
        ):

            answer_missing.append(
                (
                    source_id,
                    answer,
                    repaired_keys,
                )
            )

    if invalid_counts:

        print(
            "[ERROR] Conteos de opciones inesperados:"
        )

        for row in invalid_counts:

            print(
                "       ",
                row,
            )

        sys.exit(
            1
        )

    if answer_missing:

        print(
            "[ERROR] Claves ausentes tras reparación:"
        )

        for row in answer_missing:

            print(
                "       ",
                row,
            )

        sys.exit(
            1
        )

    if (
        changed_key_ids
        != EXPECTED_REPAIR_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "El conjunto de preguntas corregidas por "
            "el parser no coincide con las 9 esperadas. "
            f"Detectado={sorted(changed_key_ids)}"
        )

    for source_id in sorted(
        EXPECTED_REPAIR_IDS
    ):

        legacy_keys = sorted(
            legacy_sources[
                source_id
            ][
                "options"
            ].keys()
        )

        repaired_keys = sorted(
            repaired_sources[
                source_id
            ][
                "options"
            ].keys()
        )

        if (
            legacy_keys
            != EXPECTED_LEGACY_KEYS[
                source_id
            ]
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: las claves legacy "
                f"no coinciden. {legacy_keys}"
            )

        if (
            repaired_keys
            != [
                "A",
                "B",
                "C",
                "D",
            ]
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: el parser reparado "
                f"no reconstruyó A/B/C/D. "
                f"{repaired_keys}"
            )

    print(
        "[OK] Parser reparado: exactamente "
        "9 preguntas corrigen su conjunto de opciones."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Las 180 claves registradas existen "
        "entre las opciones reconstruidas."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Se respetan preguntas legítimas "
        "de 3, 4 y 5 alternativas."
    )


# ============================================================
# RAZONAMIENTO DE DISTRACTORES
# ============================================================

def numeric_values(
    text: str,
) -> list[float]:

    output = []

    for token in re.findall(
        r"(?<![A-Za-z])"
        r"-?\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?",
        text,
    ):

        try:

            output.append(
                float(
                    token.replace(
                        ",",
                        ".",
                    )
                )
            )

        except ValueError:
            pass

    return output


def scalar_option_value(
    text: str,
):

    text_norm = normalize(
        text
    )

    algebra_markers = [
        "x",
        "f(",
        "det",
        "ln",
        "sin",
        "cos",
        "=",
        "→",
        "^",
    ]

    if any(
        marker
        in text_norm
        for marker
        in algebra_markers
    ):

        return None

    values = numeric_values(
        text
    )

    if len(
        values
    ) != 1:

        return None

    return values[
        0
    ]


def numeric_error_explanation(
    wrong_text: str,
    correct_text: str,
) -> str | None:

    wrong = scalar_option_value(
        wrong_text
    )

    correct = scalar_option_value(
        correct_text
    )

    if (
        wrong is None
        or
        correct is None
    ):

        return None

    if math.isclose(
        wrong,
        correct,
        rel_tol=1e-9,
        abs_tol=1e-9,
    ):

        return None

    if math.isclose(
        wrong,
        -correct,
        rel_tol=0.02,
        abs_tol=1e-8,
    ):

        return (
            "La magnitud coincide aproximadamente, "
            "pero el signo es opuesto. Eso indica "
            "un error de signo, sentido o dirección "
            "durante el procedimiento."
        )

    if not math.isclose(
        correct,
        0.0,
        abs_tol=1e-12,
    ):

        ratio = abs(
            wrong
            / correct
        )

        if math.isclose(
            ratio,
            2.0,
            rel_tol=0.035,
        ):

            return (
                "El resultado es aproximadamente el doble "
                "del correcto. Conviene revisar si se contó "
                "dos veces una contribución o se duplicó "
                "algún factor."
            )

        if math.isclose(
            ratio,
            0.5,
            rel_tol=0.035,
        ):

            return (
                "El resultado es aproximadamente la mitad "
                "del correcto. Revisa si apareció una "
                "división adicional o un factor 1/2 "
                "que no corresponde."
            )

        if (
            math.isclose(
                ratio,
                10.0,
                rel_tol=0.035,
            )
            or
            math.isclose(
                ratio,
                0.1,
                rel_tol=0.035,
            )
        ):

            return (
                "La diferencia es de un factor diez. "
                "Esto suele señalar un error de decimal, "
                "potencia de diez o conversión de unidades."
            )

        if (
            math.isclose(
                ratio,
                100.0,
                rel_tol=0.035,
            )
            or
            math.isclose(
                ratio,
                0.01,
                rel_tol=0.035,
            )
        ):

            return (
                "La diferencia es de un factor cien. "
                "Hay que revisar porcentajes, conversiones "
                "o magnitudes que hayan sido elevadas "
                "al cuadrado."
            )

    return (
        f"La alternativa obtiene {wrong_text}, "
        f"pero el procedimiento correcto conduce a "
        f"{correct_text}. La diferencia debe localizarse "
        "en la aplicación de la fórmula, la sustitución "
        "o las operaciones intermedias."
    )


def build_wrong_reason(
    question: dict,
    item: dict,
    wrong_text: str,
    correct_text: str,
) -> str:

    base = clean_spaces(
        question.get(
            "explanation"
        )
    )

    numeric_reason = (
        numeric_error_explanation(
            wrong_text,
            correct_text,
        )
    )

    if numeric_reason:

        return (
            numeric_reason
            + " En esta pregunta, la resolución "
            + "comprobada del banco es: "
            + base
        )

    topic = clean_spaces(
        question.get(
            "topic"
        )
        or question.get(
            "subject"
        )
        or "el contenido evaluado"
    )

    concept = clean_spaces(
        item.get(
            "concept_or_rule"
        )
    )

    return (
        f"La alternativa '{wrong_text}' no coincide con "
        f"el criterio que se aplica en {topic}. "
        f"La resolución comprobada es: {base} "
        f"El concepto utilizado en la explicación es: "
        f"{concept} "
        f"Por ello, debe preferirse '{correct_text}'."
    )


def build_distractors(
    question: dict,
    item: dict,
    options: dict[str, str],
) -> list[dict]:

    answer = str(
        question.get(
            "answer",
            "",
        )
    ).upper()

    if (
        answer
        not in options
    ):

        fail(
            f"{question['id']}: "
            "la respuesta correcta no está "
            "en las opciones reparadas."
        )

    correct_text = clean_spaces(
        options[
            answer
        ]
    )

    output = []

    for letter in sorted(
        options
    ):

        if letter == answer:
            continue

        wrong_text = clean_spaces(
            options[
                letter
            ]
        )

        if not wrong_text:

            fail(
                f"{question['id']}: "
                f"opción {letter} vacía."
            )

        why_wrong = build_wrong_reason(
            question,
            item,
            wrong_text,
            correct_text,
        )

        output.append(
            {
                "choice":
                    f"{letter}) {wrong_text}",

                "why_wrong":
                    why_wrong,

                "error_pattern":
                    (
                        f"Elegir {letter} significa aceptar "
                        f"'{wrong_text}' sin completar "
                        "correctamente el razonamiento "
                        "explicado para este ejercicio."
                    ),
            }
        )

    return output[:4]


# ============================================================
# REPARAR SOLO 9
# ============================================================

def add_repair_flag(
    item: dict,
) -> None:

    flags = list(
        item[
            "quality"
        ].get(
            "flags",
            [],
        )
    )

    if (
        "p2d5_4_1_option_parser_repair"
        not in flags
    ):

        flags.append(
            "p2d5_4_1_option_parser_repair"
        )

    item[
        "quality"
    ][
        "flags"
    ] = flags


def expected_wrong_letters(
    question: dict,
    source: dict,
) -> list[str]:

    answer = str(
        question.get(
            "answer",
            "",
        )
    ).upper()

    return [
        letter
        for letter
        in sorted(
            source[
                "options"
            ]
        )
        if letter
        != answer
    ][
        :4
    ]


def current_mismatch_ids(
    questions: list[dict],
    items: list[dict],
    repaired_sources: dict,
) -> set[str]:

    result = set()

    for (
        question,
        item,
    ) in zip(
        questions,
        items,
    ):

        source_id = question[
            "id"
        ]

        expected = expected_wrong_letters(
            question,
            repaired_sources[
                source_id
            ],
        )

        actual = distractor_letters(
            item
        )

        if (
            actual
            != expected
        ):

            result.add(
                source_id
            )

    return result


def build_candidate(
    questions: list[dict],
    bank: dict,
    repaired_sources: dict,
) -> tuple[dict, list[str]]:

    candidate = json.loads(
        json.dumps(
            bank,
            ensure_ascii=False,
        )
    )

    changed_ids = []

    for (
        question,
        item,
    ) in zip(
        questions,
        candidate[
            "items"
        ],
    ):

        source_id = question[
            "id"
        ]

        if (
            source_id
            not in EXPECTED_REPAIR_IDS
        ):

            continue

        item[
            "distractor_analysis"
        ] = build_distractors(
            question,
            item,
            repaired_sources[
                source_id
            ][
                "options"
            ],
        )

        add_repair_flag(
            item
        )

        changed_ids.append(
            source_id
        )

    return (
        candidate,
        changed_ids,
    )


# ============================================================
# VALIDAR CANDIDATO
# ============================================================

def validate_candidate(
    original_bank: dict,
    candidate: dict,
    questions: list[dict],
    repaired_sources: dict,
) -> None:

    before_items = original_bank[
        "items"
    ]

    after_items = candidate[
        "items"
    ]

    if len(
        after_items
    ) != 180:

        fail(
            "El candidato no contiene 180 ítems."
        )

    actual_changed_ids = set()

    for (
        question,
        before,
        after,
    ) in zip(
        questions,
        before_items,
        after_items,
    ):

        source_id = question[
            "id"
        ]

        if (
            before
            != after
        ):

            actual_changed_ids.add(
                source_id
            )

        if (
            source_id
            not in EXPECTED_REPAIR_IDS
            and
            before
            != after
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: se modificó "
                "aunque no pertenece a los 9 reparados."
            )

        if (
            after.get(
                "quality",
                {},
            ).get(
                "status"
            )
            != "draft"
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: status dejó de ser DRAFT."
            )

        if (
            after.get(
                "quality",
                {},
            ).get(
                "mastery_eligible"
            )
            is not False
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: mastery_eligible cambió."
            )

        if (
            after.get(
                "source_question_sha256"
            )
            != canonical_sha256(
                question
            )
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: hash fuente cambió."
            )

    if (
        actual_changed_ids
        != EXPECTED_REPAIR_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "No se modificaron exactamente "
            f"los 9 objetivos. "
            f"Detectado={sorted(actual_changed_ids)}"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Verificar que en los 9 solo cambian:
    # - distractor_analysis
    # - quality.flags
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    before_by_id = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]:
            item
        for item
        in before_items
    }

    after_by_id = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]:
            item
        for item
        in after_items
    }

    for source_id in sorted(
        EXPECTED_REPAIR_IDS
    ):

        before = json.loads(
            json.dumps(
                before_by_id[
                    source_id
                ],
                ensure_ascii=False,
            )
        )

        after = json.loads(
            json.dumps(
                after_by_id[
                    source_id
                ],
                ensure_ascii=False,
            )
        )

        before.pop(
            "distractor_analysis",
            None,
        )

        after.pop(
            "distractor_analysis",
            None,
        )

        before_flags = before[
            "quality"
        ].pop(
            "flags",
            [],
        )

        after_flags = after[
            "quality"
        ].pop(
            "flags",
            [],
        )

        if before != after:

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: cambió un campo "
                "pedagógico fuera de distractor_analysis/flags."
            )

        expected_after_flags = list(
            before_flags
        )

        if (
            "p2d5_4_1_option_parser_repair"
            not in expected_after_flags
        ):

            expected_after_flags.append(
                "p2d5_4_1_option_parser_repair"
            )

        if (
            after_flags
            != expected_after_flags
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: flags inesperados."
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Cobertura exacta 180/180
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    mismatches = current_mismatch_ids(
        questions,
        after_items,
        repaired_sources,
    )

    if mismatches:

        fail(
            "Persisten inconsistencias entre "
            "opciones fuente y distractores: "
            + ", ".join(
                sorted(
                    mismatches
                )
            )
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Source review
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        source_review_ids_from_bank(
            candidate
        )
        != EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "Las 7 source_review no fueron preservadas."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Candidato modifica únicamente "
        "los 9 análisis afectados."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Cobertura de distractores "
        "coincide con la fuente 180/180."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Las 180 explicaciones siguen DRAFT."
    )


# ============================================================
# REPORTE
# ============================================================

def build_report(
    questions: list[dict],
    legacy_sources: dict,
    repaired_sources: dict,
    changed_ids: list[str],
    before_hash: str,
    after_hash: str,
) -> dict:

    parser_changes = {}

    for source_id in sorted(
        EXPECTED_REPAIR_IDS
    ):

        parser_changes[
            source_id
        ] = {
            "legacy_option_keys":
                sorted(
                    legacy_sources[
                        source_id
                    ][
                        "options"
                    ].keys()
                ),

            "repaired_option_keys":
                sorted(
                    repaired_sources[
                        source_id
                    ][
                        "options"
                    ].keys()
                ),
        }

    legitimate_non4 = {
        source_id: {
            "option_count":
                len(
                    repaired_sources[
                        source_id
                    ][
                        "options"
                    ]
                ),

            "keys":
                sorted(
                    repaired_sources[
                        source_id
                    ][
                        "options"
                    ].keys()
                ),
        }
        for source_id
        in sorted(
            EXPECTED_NON4_COUNTS
        )
    }

    return {
        "stage":
            "P2-D5.4.1",

        "substage":
            "source_option_parser_repair",

        "status":
            "repair_completed_as_draft",

        "cause": (
            "legacy parser accepted partial line-based "
            "option sets before evaluating the complete "
            "inline A-B-C-D sequence"
        ),

        "summary": {
            "questions_total":
                180,

            "items_repaired":
                len(
                    changed_ids
                ),

            "items_untouched":
                180
                - len(
                    changed_ids
                ),

            "parser_keyset_repairs":
                len(
                    EXPECTED_REPAIR_IDS
                ),

            "source_review_preserved":
                7,

            "draft_total":
                180,

            "validated_total":
                0,

            "mastery_enabled":
                False,

            "distractor_coverage_mismatches_after":
                0,

            "answer_missing_after":
                0,
        },

        "repair_ids":
            sorted(
                changed_ids
            ),

        "parser_changes":
            parser_changes,

        "legitimate_non4_option_questions":
            legitimate_non4,

        "safety": {
            "question_bank_modified":
                False,

            "reinforcement_bank_modified":
                False,

            "app_modified":
                False,

            "schema_modified":
                False,

            "other_explanation_items_modified":
                False,
        },

        "hashes": {
            "app":
                sha256_file(
                    APP
                ),

            "question_bank":
                sha256_file(
                    QUESTION_BANK
                ),

            "reinforcement_bank":
                sha256_file(
                    REINFORCEMENT_BANK
                ),

            "schema":
                sha256_file(
                    SCHEMA_FILE
                ),

            "explanation_bank_before":
                before_hash,

            "explanation_bank_after":
                after_hash,
        },
    }


def build_txt(
    report: dict,
) -> str:

    summary = report[
        "summary"
    ]

    hashes = report[
        "hashes"
    ]

    lines = [
        "=" * 84,
        "P2-D5.4.1 - REPARACIÓN DEL PARSER DE OPCIONES",
        "=" * 84,
        "",
        "RESUMEN",
        "-" * 84,
        (
            "Preguntas fuente               : "
            f"{summary['questions_total']}"
        ),
        (
            "Explicaciones reparadas        : "
            f"{summary['items_repaired']}"
        ),
        (
            "Explicaciones sin tocar        : "
            f"{summary['items_untouched']}"
        ),
        (
            "Keysets del parser corregidos  : "
            f"{summary['parser_keyset_repairs']}"
        ),
        (
            "Mismatch distractores después  : "
            f"{summary['distractor_coverage_mismatches_after']}"
        ),
        (
            "Claves ausentes después        : "
            f"{summary['answer_missing_after']}"
        ),
        "",
        "IDS REPARADOS",
        "-" * 84,
        ", ".join(
            report[
                "repair_ids"
            ]
        ),
        "",
        "SEGURIDAD",
        "-" * 84,
        "Estado de las 180               : DRAFT",
        "VALIDATED                       : 0",
        "Mastery habilitado              : False",
        "source_review preservadas       : 7",
        "question_bank modificado        : False",
        "reinforcement_bank modificado   : False",
        "app.py modificado               : False",
        "schema modificado               : False",
        "Otras explicaciones modificadas : False",
        "",
        "SHA-256",
        "-" * 84,
        (
            "app.py                   : "
            + hashes[
                "app"
            ]
        ),
        (
            "question_bank            : "
            + hashes[
                "question_bank"
            ]
        ),
        (
            "reinforcement_bank       : "
            + hashes[
                "reinforcement_bank"
            ]
        ),
        (
            "schema                   : "
            + hashes[
                "schema"
            ]
        ),
        (
            "explanation_bank antes   : "
            + hashes[
                "explanation_bank_before"
            ]
        ),
        (
            "explanation_bank después : "
            + hashes[
                "explanation_bank_after"
            ]
        ),
        "",
        (
            "RESULTADO: P2-D5.4.1 "
            "OPTION PARSER REPAIR COMPLETADO"
        ),
    ]

    return "\n".join(
        lines
    )


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main() -> None:

    print()

    print(
        "=" * 84
    )

    print(
        "P2-D5.4.1 - REPARACIÓN "
        "DEL PARSER DE OPCIONES"
    )

    print(
        "=" * 84
    )

    print()

    (
        questions,
        bank,
    ) = verify_preconditions()

    (
        legacy_sources,
        repaired_sources,
    ) = extract_sources(
        questions
    )

    validate_parser(
        questions,
        legacy_sources,
        repaired_sources,
    )

    before_items = bank[
        "items"
    ]

    pre_mismatch = current_mismatch_ids(
        questions,
        before_items,
        repaired_sources,
    )

    if (
        pre_mismatch
        != EXPECTED_REPAIR_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "Antes de reparar, los mismatches del banco "
            "no coinciden exactamente con los 9 "
            "confirmados. "
            f"Detectado={sorted(pre_mismatch)}"
        )

    print(
        "[OK] El banco actual presenta exactamente "
        "los 9 mismatches esperados."
    )

    (
        candidate,
        changed_ids,
    ) = build_candidate(
        questions,
        bank,
        repaired_sources,
    )

    if (
        set(
            changed_ids
        )
        != EXPECTED_REPAIR_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "build_candidate no produjo "
            "exactamente los 9 IDs."
        )

    validate_candidate(
        bank,
        candidate,
        questions,
        repaired_sources,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # BACKUP
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if PRE_REPAIR_BACKUP.exists():

        if (
            sha256_file(
                PRE_REPAIR_BACKUP
            )
            != P2D5_4_BANK_SHA256
        ):

            fail(
                "El backup pre-P2-D5.4.1 existente "
                "no coincide con P2-D5.4."
            )

        print(
            "[OK] Backup pre-P2-D5.4.1 "
            "existente y correcto."
        )

    else:

        shutil.copy2(
            EXPLANATION_BANK,
            PRE_REPAIR_BACKUP,
        )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                PRE_REPAIR_BACKUP
            )
            != P2D5_4_BANK_SHA256
        ):

            fail(
                "El backup pre-P2-D5.4.1 "
                "se creó con hash incorrecto."
            )

        print(
            "[OK] Backup pre-P2-D5.4.1 creado."
        )

    before_hash = sha256_file(
        EXPLANATION_BANK
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # ESCRITURA + ROLLBACK
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:

        atomic_write_json(
            EXPLANATION_BANK,
            candidate,
        )

        written = load_json(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )

        if (
            written
            != candidate
        ):

            raise RuntimeError(
                "El banco escrito no coincide "
                "con el candidato validado."
            )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                APP
            )
            != APP_SHA256
        ):

            raise RuntimeError(
                "app.py cambió."
            )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                QUESTION_BANK
            )
            != QUESTION_BANK_SHA256
        ):

            raise RuntimeError(
                "question_bank cambió."
            )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                REINFORCEMENT_BANK
            )
            != REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256
        ):

            raise RuntimeError(
                "reinforcement_bank cambió."
            )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                SCHEMA_FILE
            )
            != SCHEMA_SHA256
        ):

            raise RuntimeError(
                "schema cambió."
            )

        after_hash = sha256_file(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )

        if (
            after_hash
            == before_hash
        ):

            raise RuntimeError(
                "La reparación no modificó el banco."
            )

        final_bank = load_json(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )

        final_mismatch = current_mismatch_ids(
            questions,
            final_bank[
                "items"
            ],
            repaired_sources,
        )

        if final_mismatch:

            raise RuntimeError(
                "Persisten mismatches después de escribir: "
                + ", ".join(
                    sorted(
                        final_mismatch
                    )
                )
            )

        report = build_report(
            questions,
            legacy_sources,
            repaired_sources,
            changed_ids,
            before_hash,
            after_hash,
        )

        atomic_write_json(
            REPORT_JSON,
            report,
        )

        atomic_write_text(
            REPORT_TXT,
            build_txt(
                report
            ),
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        print(
            f"[ERROR] Falló P2-D5.4.1: {exc}"
        )

        print(
            "[INFO] Restaurando checkpoint P2-D5.4..."
        )

        shutil.copy2(
            PRE_REPAIR_BACKUP,
            EXPLANATION_BANK,
        )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                EXPLANATION_BANK
            )
            != P2D5_4_BANK_SHA256
        ):

            fail(
                "Rollback falló."
            )

        fail(
            "P2-D5.4.1 abortado; "
            "P2-D5.4 restaurado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # RESUMEN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    print()

    print(
        "RESUMEN"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 84
    )

    print(
        "Preguntas fuente                : 180"
    )

    print(
        "Explicaciones reparadas         :",
        len(
            changed_ids
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Explicaciones sin tocar         :",
        180
        - len(
            changed_ids
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Mismatch distractores después   : 0"
    )

    print(
        "Claves ausentes después         : 0"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "IDS REPARADOS"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 84
    )

    print(
        ", ".join(
            sorted(
                changed_ids
            )
        )
    )

    print()

    print(
        "SEGURIDAD"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 84
    )

    print(
        "Estado final                    : DRAFT"
    )

    print(
        "VALIDATED                       : 0"
    )

    print(
        "Mastery habilitado              : False"
    )

    print(
        "source_review preservadas       : 7"
    )

    print(
        "question_bank modificado        : False"
    )

    print(
        "reinforcement_bank modificado   : False"
    )

    print(
        "app.py modificado               : False"
    )

    print(
        "schema modificado               : False"
    )

    print(
        "Otras 171 explicaciones tocadas : False"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "SHA-256"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 84
    )

    print(
        "app.py                   :",
        sha256_file(
            APP
        ),
    )

    print(
        "question_bank            :",
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        ),
    )

    print(
        "reinforcement_bank       :",
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        ),
    )

    print(
        "schema                   :",
        sha256_file(
            SCHEMA_FILE
        ),
    )

    print(
        "explanation_bank antes   :",
        before_hash,
    )

    print(
        "explanation_bank después :",
        sha256_file(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        ),
    )

    print()

    print(
        "IMPORTANTE"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 84
    )

    print(
        "- Solo se repararon los análisis de "
        "distractores de las 9 preguntas afectadas."
    )

    print(
        "- No se promovió ninguna explicación "
        "a VALIDATED."
    )

    print(
        "- Las 7 source_review siguen bloqueadas."
    )

    print(
        "- El siguiente paso será volver a ejecutar "
        "la auditoría con el parser corregido."
    )

    print()

    print(
        "RESULTADO: P2-D5.4.1 "
        "OPTION PARSER REPAIR COMPLETADO"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    RESULTS_DIR
    / "p2d5_4_2_pedagogical_debt_repair_report.json"
)
