# ============================================================
# UTILIDADES
# ============================================================

def fail(
    message: str,
) -> None:

    print(
        f"[ERROR] {message}"
    )

    sys.exit(
        1
    )


def sha256_file(
    path: Path,
) -> str:

    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open(
        "rb"
    ) as handle:

        while True:

            chunk = handle.read(
                1024 * 1024
            )

            if not chunk:
                break

            digest.update(
                chunk
            )

    return digest.hexdigest().upper()


def canonical_sha256(
    data,
) -> str:

    payload = json.dumps(
        data,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode(
        "utf-8"
    )

    return hashlib.sha256(
        payload
    ).hexdigest().upper()


def load_json(
    path: Path,
):

    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def atomic_write_text(
    path: Path,
    text: str,
) -> None:

    path.parent.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    fd, temp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(
        prefix=f".{path.name}.",
        suffix=".tmp",
        dir=str(
            path.parent
        ),
    )

    temp_path = Path(
        temp_name
    )

    try:

        with os.fdopen(
            fd,
            "w",
            encoding="utf-8",
            newline="\n",
        ) as handle:

            handle.write(
                text
            )

            handle.flush()

            os.fsync(
                handle.fileno()
            )

        os.replace(
            temp_path,
            path,
        )

    except Exception:

        try:
            temp_path.unlink(
                missing_ok=True
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

        raise


def atomic_write_json(
    path: Path,
    data,
) -> None:

    atomic_write_text(
        path,
        json.dumps(
            data,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )
        + "\n",
    )


def source_review_ids_from_bank(
    bank: dict,
) -> set[str]:

    return {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in bank.get(
            "items",
            [],
        )
        if (
            "source_review_required"
            in item.get(
                "quality",
                {},
            ).get(
                "flags",
                [],
            )
        )
    }


def add_repair_flag(
    item: dict,
) -> None:

    flags = list(
        item[
            "quality"
        ].get(
            "flags",
            [],
        )
    )

    if (
        REPAIR_FLAG
        not in flags
    ):

        flags.append(
            REPAIR_FLAG
        )

    item[
        "quality"
    ][
        "flags"
    ] = flags


def relevant_data_is_strong(
    item: dict,
) -> bool:

    values = item.get(
        "relevant_data",
        [],
    )

    if (
        not isinstance(
            values,
            list,
        )
        or
        not values
    ):

        return False

    cleaned = [
        str(
            value
        ).strip()
        for value in values
        if str(
            value
        ).strip()
    ]

    if len(
        cleaned
    ) >= 2:

        return True

    return False


# ============================================================
# PRECONDICIONES
# ============================================================

def verify_preconditions():

    required = [
        APP,
        QUESTION_BANK,
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
        SCHEMA_FILE,
        EXPLANATION_BANK,
        PREVIOUS_AUDIT,
    ]

    missing = [
        path
        for path
        in required
        if not path.exists()
    ]

    if missing:

        for path in missing:

            print(
                f"[ERROR] Falta: {path}"
            )

        sys.exit(
            1
        )

    checkpoints = [
        (
            APP,
            APP_SHA256,
            "app.py",
        ),
        (
            QUESTION_BANK,
            QUESTION_BANK_SHA256,
            "question_bank",
        ),
        (
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256,
            "reinforcement_bank",
        ),
        (
            SCHEMA_FILE,
            SCHEMA_SHA256,
            "schema",
        ),
        (
            EXPLANATION_BANK,
            P2D5_4_1_BANK_SHA256,
            "explanation_bank P2-D5.4.1",
        ),
    ]

    for (
        path,
        expected,
        label,
    ) in checkpoints:

        actual = sha256_file(
            path
        )

        if (
            actual
            != expected
        ):

            fail(
                f"{label} cambió. "
                f"Esperado={expected}; actual={actual}"
            )

    questions = load_json(
        QUESTION_BANK
    )

    reinforcement = load_json(
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK
    )

    bank = load_json(
        EXPLANATION_BANK
    )

    audit = load_json(
        PREVIOUS_AUDIT
    )

    if (
        not isinstance(
            questions,
            list,
        )
        or
        len(
            questions
        )
        != 180
    ):

        fail(
            "question_bank debe contener exactamente 180 preguntas."
        )

    if (
        len(
            reinforcement.get(
                "items",
                [],
            )
        )
        != 8
    ):

        fail(
            "reinforcement_bank debe conservar exactamente 8 ítems."
        )

    if (
        bank.get(
            "schema_version"
        )
        != SCHEMA_VERSION
        or
        bank.get(
            "bank_version"
        )
        != BANK_VERSION
    ):

        fail(
            "La identidad del banco pedagógico no coincide con P2-D5.2."
        )

    items = bank.get(
        "items",
        [],
    )

    if (
        len(
            items
        )
        != 180
    ):

        fail(
            "El banco pedagógico debe contener exactamente 180 ítems."
        )

    if (
        FRAMEWORK_IDS
        & RELEVANT_DATA_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "Hay solapamiento inesperado entre reparaciones de framework y relevant_data."
        )

    if (
        len(
            FRAMEWORK_IDS
        )
        != 33
    ):

        fail(
            f"Se esperaban 33 frameworks; definidos={len(FRAMEWORK_IDS)}."
        )

    if (
        len(
            RELEVANT_DATA_IDS
        )
        != 3
    ):

        fail(
            f"Se esperaban 3 relevant_data; definidos={len(RELEVANT_DATA_IDS)}."
        )

    if (
        len(
            TARGET_IDS
        )
        != 36
    ):

        fail(
            f"Se esperaban 36 objetivos; definidos={len(TARGET_IDS)}."
        )

    bank_ids = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in items
    }

    if not TARGET_IDS.issubset(
        bank_ids
    ):

        fail(
            "Algún ID objetivo no existe en el banco pedagógico."
        )

    if (
        TARGET_IDS
        & EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "La reparación intenta tocar una pregunta source_review."
        )

    if any(
        item.get(
            "quality",
            {},
        ).get(
            "status"
        )
        != "draft"
        for item
        in items
    ):

        fail(
            "Las 180 explicaciones deben continuar en estado DRAFT."
        )

    if any(
        item.get(
            "quality",
            {},
        ).get(
            "mastery_eligible"
        )
        is not False
        for item
        in items
    ):

        fail(
            "mastery_eligible debe seguir False en 180/180."
        )

    for (
        question,
        item,
    ) in zip(
        questions,
        items,
    ):

        if (
            item.get(
                "source_question_id"
            )
            != question.get(
                "id"
            )
        ):

            fail(
                f"Orden 1:1 incorrecto en {question.get('id')}."
            )

        if (
            item.get(
                "source_question_sha256"
            )
            != canonical_sha256(
                question
            )
        ):

            fail(
                f"Hash fuente incorrecto en {question.get('id')}."
            )

    if (
        source_review_ids_from_bank(
            bank
        )
        != EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "El conjunto de 7 source_review cambió."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Checkpoint P2-D5.4.1 verificado."
    )

    return (
        questions,
        bank,
        audit,
    )


# ============================================================
# VALIDAR LA AUDITORÍA QUE JUSTIFICA EL PARCHE
# ============================================================

def verify_previous_audit(
    audit: dict,
) -> None:

    if (
        audit.get(
            "stage"
        )
        != "P2-D5.4.1"
    ):

        fail(
            "El reporte previo no corresponde a P2-D5.4.1."
        )

    if (
        audit.get(
            "hashes",
            {},
        ).get(
            "explanation_bank"
        )
        != P2D5_4_1_BANK_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "La auditoría previa no corresponde al banco actual."
        )

    classifications = (
        audit.get(
            "summary",
            {},
        ).get(
            "classifications",
            {},
        )
    )

    expected_counts = {
        "validation_candidate":
            EXPECTED_VALIDATION_CANDIDATES,

        "needs_enrichment":
            EXPECTED_NEEDS_ENRICHMENT,

        "needs_correction":
            EXPECTED_NEEDS_CORRECTION,

        "source_review":
            EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW,
    }

    for (
        classification,
        expected_count,
    ) in expected_counts.items():

        actual_count = int(
            classifications.get(
                classification,
                0,
            )
        )

        if (
            actual_count
            != expected_count
        ):

            fail(
                f"Conteo inesperado para {classification}: "
                f"esperado={expected_count}, actual={actual_count}."
            )

    audited_items = audit.get(
        "items",
        [],
    )

    if (
        len(
            audited_items
        )
        != 180
    ):

        fail(
            "La auditoría previa no contiene 180 ítems."
        )

    enrichment_items = [
        item
        for item
        in audited_items
        if (
            item.get(
                "classification"
            )
            == "needs_enrichment"
        )
    ]

    enrichment_ids = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in enrichment_items
    }

    if (
        enrichment_ids
        != TARGET_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "Los 36 needs_enrichment no coinciden exactamente "
            "con los objetivos de P2-D5.4.2. "
            f"Detectado={sorted(enrichment_ids)}"
        )

    framework_ids = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in enrichment_items
        if (
            "framework_weak"
            in item.get(
                "enrichment_reasons",
                [],
            )
        )
    }

    relevant_data_ids = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in enrichment_items
        if (
            "relevant_data_weak"
            in item.get(
                "enrichment_reasons",
                [],
            )
        )
    }

    if (
        framework_ids
        != EXPECTED_FRAMEWORK_ENRICHMENT_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "Los framework_weak de needs_enrichment no coinciden con los 33 esperados."
        )

    if (
        relevant_data_ids
        != EXPECTED_RELEVANT_DATA_ENRICHMENT_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "Los relevant_data_weak no coinciden con los 3 esperados."
        )

    unexpected_reasons = []

    for item in enrichment_items:

        reasons = set(
            item.get(
                "enrichment_reasons",
                [],
            )
        )

        allowed = set()

        source_id = item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]

        if (
            source_id
            in FRAMEWORK_IDS
        ):

            allowed.add(
                "framework_weak"
            )

        if (
            source_id
            in RELEVANT_DATA_IDS
        ):

            allowed.add(
                "relevant_data_weak"
            )

        if (
            reasons
            != allowed
        ):

            unexpected_reasons.append(
                (
                    source_id,
                    sorted(
                        reasons
                    ),
                )
            )

    if unexpected_reasons:

        fail(
            "Hay motivos de enriquecimiento adicionales no contemplados: "
            f"{unexpected_reasons}"
        )

    # El resumen general reportó 35 framework_weak:
    # 33 son needs_enrichment y los otros 2 deben pertenecer
    # exclusivamente a source_review. No se reparan aquí.
    all_framework_weak = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in audited_items
        if (
            "framework_weak"
            in item.get(
                "enrichment_reasons",
                [],
            )
        )
    }

    residual_framework_ids = (
        all_framework_weak
        - FRAMEWORK_IDS
    )

    residual_non_source_review = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in audited_items
        if (
            item[
                "source_question_id"
            ]
            in residual_framework_ids
            and
            item.get(
                "classification"
            )
            != "source_review"
        )
    }

    if (
        len(
            all_framework_weak
        )
        != 35
    ):

        fail(
            f"Se esperaban 35 framework_weak globales; "
            f"detectados={len(all_framework_weak)}."
        )

    if (
        len(
            residual_framework_ids
        )
        != 2
        or
        residual_non_source_review
    ):

        fail(
            "Los 2 framework_weak residuales no pertenecen exclusivamente a source_review."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Auditoría P2-D5.4.1 confirma exactamente "
        "33 framework_weak + 3 relevant_data_weak reparables."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Los 2 framework_weak restantes están bloqueados por source_review y no se tocarán."
    )


# ============================================================
# VALIDAR CONTENIDO NUEVO
# ============================================================

def validate_repair_payload() -> None:

    short_frameworks = {
        source_id:
            text
        for (
            source_id,
            text,
        ) in FRAMEWORK_REPAIRS.items()
        if (
            len(
                text.strip()
            )
            < 30
        )
    }

    if short_frameworks:

        fail(
            "Algún framework nuevo sigue por debajo del mínimo pedagógico: "
            f"{sorted(short_frameworks)}"
        )

    generic_frameworks = []

    forbidden_framework_fragments = [
        "criterio central",
        "resolución registrada",
        "identifica la regla del tema",
        "trabaja el tema",
        "enunciado original",
    ]

    for (
        source_id,
        text,
    ) in FRAMEWORK_REPAIRS.items():

        lowered = text.lower()

        if any(
            fragment
            in lowered
            for fragment
            in forbidden_framework_fragments
        ):

            generic_frameworks.append(
                source_id
            )

    if generic_frameworks:

        fail(
            "Algún framework nuevo contiene lenguaje genérico prohibido: "
            f"{generic_frameworks}"
        )

    weak_data = []

    for (
        source_id,
        values,
    ) in RELEVANT_DATA_REPAIRS.items():

        if (
            not isinstance(
                values,
                list,
            )
            or
            len(
                values
            )
            < 2
            or
            any(
                len(
                    str(
                        value
                    ).strip()
                )
                < 25
                for value
                in values
            )
        ):

            weak_data.append(
                source_id
            )

    if weak_data:

        fail(
            "Algún relevant_data nuevo no es suficientemente específico: "
            f"{weak_data}"
        )

    # Control explícito del error pedagógico detectado en S3-72.
    s3_72 = FRAMEWORK_REPAIRS[
        "S3-72"
    ].lower()

    if (
        "proporcionalidad"
        not in s3_72
        or
        "médicos"
        not in s3_72
        or
        "horas"
        not in s3_72
        or
        "w=f"
        in s3_72.replace(
            " ",
            "",
        )
    ):

        fail(
            "S3-72 no quedó corregida como proporcionalidad compuesta."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Los 36 contenidos nuevos superan las validaciones pedagógicas locales."
    )


# ============================================================
# CONSTRUIR CANDIDATO
# ============================================================

def build_candidate(
    bank: dict,
) -> dict:

    candidate = copy.deepcopy(
        bank
    )

    for item in candidate[
        "items"
    ]:

        source_id = item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]

        if (
            source_id
            in FRAMEWORK_IDS
        ):

            item[
                "formula_or_framework"
            ] = FRAMEWORK_REPAIRS[
                source_id
            ]

            add_repair_flag(
                item
            )

        elif (
            source_id
            in RELEVANT_DATA_IDS
        ):

            item[
                "relevant_data"
            ] = copy.deepcopy(
                RELEVANT_DATA_REPAIRS[
                    source_id
                ]
            )

            add_repair_flag(
                item
            )

    return candidate


# ============================================================
# VALIDACIÓN DEL DIFF
# ============================================================

def validate_candidate(
    questions: list[dict],
    before_bank: dict,
    candidate: dict,
) -> None:

    before_items = before_bank[
        "items"
    ]

    after_items = candidate[
        "items"
    ]

    if (
        len(
            before_items
        )
        != 180
        or
        len(
            after_items
        )
        != 180
    ):

        fail(
            "El banco antes/después debe contener 180 ítems."
        )

    changed_ids = set()

    for (
        question,
        before,
        after,
    ) in zip(
        questions,
        before_items,
        after_items,
    ):

        source_id = question[
            "id"
        ]

        if (
            before
            != after
        ):

            changed_ids.add(
                source_id
            )

        if (
            source_id
            not in TARGET_IDS
            and
            before
            != after
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: fue modificado aunque no pertenece a los 36 objetivos."
            )

        if (
            after.get(
                "quality",
                {},
            ).get(
                "status"
            )
            != "draft"
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: dejó de estar DRAFT."
            )

        if (
            after.get(
                "quality",
                {},
            ).get(
                "mastery_eligible"
            )
            is not False
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: mastery_eligible cambió."
            )

        verification_fields = [
            "content_verified",
            "answer_verified",
            "steps_verified",
            "distractors_verified",
            "pedagogical_reviewed",
        ]

        if any(
            after.get(
                "quality",
                {},
            ).get(
                field
            )
            is not False
            for field
            in verification_fields
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: algún campo de verificación pasó a True."
            )

        if (
            after.get(
                "source_question_sha256"
            )
            != canonical_sha256(
                question
            )
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: source_question_sha256 cambió."
            )

    if (
        changed_ids
        != TARGET_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "No se modificaron exactamente las 36 explicaciones esperadas. "
            f"Detectado={sorted(changed_ids)}"
        )

    before_by_id = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]:
            item
        for item
        in before_items
    }

    after_by_id = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]:
            item
        for item
        in after_items
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 33 frameworks:
    # solo formula_or_framework + quality.flags
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    for source_id in sorted(
        FRAMEWORK_IDS
    ):

        before = copy.deepcopy(
            before_by_id[
                source_id
            ]
        )

        after = copy.deepcopy(
            after_by_id[
                source_id
            ]
        )

        before_framework = before.pop(
            "formula_or_framework"
        )

        after_framework = after.pop(
            "formula_or_framework"
        )

        before_flags = before[
            "quality"
        ].pop(
            "flags",
            [],
        )

        after_flags = after[
            "quality"
        ].pop(
            "flags",
            [],
        )

        if (
            before
            != after
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: cambió un campo fuera de formula_or_framework/quality.flags."
            )

        if (
            before_framework
            == after_framework
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: el framework no cambió."
            )

        if (
            after_framework
            != FRAMEWORK_REPAIRS[
                source_id
            ]
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: el framework escrito no coincide con el definido."
            )

        expected_flags = list(
            before_flags
        )

        if (
            REPAIR_FLAG
            not in expected_flags
        ):

            expected_flags.append(
                REPAIR_FLAG
            )

        if (
            after_flags
            != expected_flags
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: flags inesperados."
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 3 relevant_data:
    # solo relevant_data + quality.flags
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    for source_id in sorted(
        RELEVANT_DATA_IDS
    ):

        before = copy.deepcopy(
            before_by_id[
                source_id
            ]
        )

        after = copy.deepcopy(
            after_by_id[
                source_id
            ]
        )

        before_data = before.pop(
            "relevant_data"
        )

        after_data = after.pop(
            "relevant_data"
        )

        before_flags = before[
            "quality"
        ].pop(
            "flags",
            [],
        )

        after_flags = after[
            "quality"
        ].pop(
            "flags",
            [],
        )

        if (
            before
            != after
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: cambió un campo fuera de relevant_data/quality.flags."
            )

        if (
            before_data
            == after_data
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: relevant_data no cambió."
            )

        if (
            after_data
            != RELEVANT_DATA_REPAIRS[
                source_id
            ]
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: relevant_data escrito no coincide con el definido."
            )

        if not relevant_data_is_strong(
            after_by_id[
                source_id
            ]
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: relevant_data sigue siendo débil."
            )

        expected_flags = list(
            before_flags
        )

        if (
            REPAIR_FLAG
            not in expected_flags
        ):

            expected_flags.append(
                REPAIR_FLAG
            )

        if (
            after_flags
            != expected_flags
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: flags inesperados."
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Source review intactas
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        source_review_ids_from_bank(
            candidate
        )
        != EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "Las 7 source_review no fueron preservadas."
        )

    for source_id in EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS:

        if (
            before_by_id[
                source_id
            ]
            != after_by_id[
                source_id
            ]
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: una source_review fue modificada."
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Flag exacto
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    flagged_ids = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in after_items
        if (
            REPAIR_FLAG
            in item.get(
                "quality",
                {},
            ).get(
                "flags",
                [],
            )
        )
    }

    if (
        flagged_ids
        != TARGET_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "El flag P2-D5.4.2 no aparece exactamente en los 36 objetivos."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Frameworks locales >= 30
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    for source_id in FRAMEWORK_IDS:

        value = str(
            after_by_id[
                source_id
            ].get(
                "formula_or_framework",
                "",
            )
        ).strip()

        if (
            len(
                value
            )
            < 30
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: framework sigue por debajo de 30 caracteres."
            )

    print(
        "[OK] Candidato modifica exactamente 36 explicaciones."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] 33 cambios limitados a formula_or_framework + flags."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] 3 cambios limitados a relevant_data + flags."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Las otras 144 explicaciones permanecen idénticas."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Las 7 source_review permanecen intactas."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Las 180 explicaciones siguen DRAFT y mastery=False."
    )


# ============================================================
# REPORTE
# ============================================================

def build_report(
    before_bank: dict,
    after_bank: dict,
    before_hash: str,
    after_hash: str,
) -> dict:

    before_by_id = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]:
            item
        for item
        in before_bank[
            "items"
        ]
    }

    after_by_id = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]:
            item
        for item
        in after_bank[
            "items"
        ]
    }

    framework_changes = {}

    for source_id in sorted(
        FRAMEWORK_IDS
    ):

        framework_changes[
            source_id
        ] = {
            "before":
                before_by_id[
                    source_id
                ][
                    "formula_or_framework"
                ],

            "after":
                after_by_id[
                    source_id
                ][
                    "formula_or_framework"
                ],
        }

    relevant_data_changes = {}

    for source_id in sorted(
        RELEVANT_DATA_IDS
    ):

        relevant_data_changes[
            source_id
        ] = {
            "before":
                before_by_id[
                    source_id
                ][
                    "relevant_data"
                ],

            "after":
                after_by_id[
                    source_id
                ][
                    "relevant_data"
                ],
        }

    return {
        "stage":
            "P2-D5.4.2",

        "substage":
            "targeted_pedagogical_debt_repair",

        "status":
            "repair_completed_as_draft",

        "basis": {
            "previous_audit":
                str(
                    PREVIOUS_AUDIT.relative_to(
                        ROOT
                    )
                ),

            "previous_validation_candidates":
                137,

            "previous_needs_enrichment":
                36,

            "previous_needs_correction":
                0,

            "previous_source_review":
                7,

            "repair_scope":
                (
                    "Only the 36 needs_enrichment items "
                    "from P2-D5.4.1"
                ),
        },

        "summary": {
            "items_total":
                180,

            "items_modified":
                36,

            "items_untouched":
                144,

            "frameworks_repaired":
                33,

            "relevant_data_repaired":
                3,

            "source_review_preserved":
                7,

            "draft_total":
                180,

            "validated_total":
                0,

            "mastery_enabled":
                False,
        },

        "framework_ids":
            sorted(
                FRAMEWORK_IDS
            ),

        "relevant_data_ids":
            sorted(
                RELEVANT_DATA_IDS
            ),

        "target_ids":
            sorted(
                TARGET_IDS
            ),

        "framework_changes":
            framework_changes,

        "relevant_data_changes":
            relevant_data_changes,

        "special_corrections": {
            "S3-72": (
                "Incorrect work/energy framework replaced "
                "with compound direct proportionality."
            ),
        },

        "safety": {
            "question_bank_modified":
                False,

            "reinforcement_bank_modified":
                False,

            "app_modified":
                False,

            "schema_modified":
                False,

            "source_review_modified":
                False,

            "status_promoted":
                False,

            "mastery_enabled":
                False,
        },

        "hashes": {
            "app":
                sha256_file(
                    APP
                ),

            "question_bank":
                sha256_file(
                    QUESTION_BANK
                ),

            "reinforcement_bank":
                sha256_file(
                    REINFORCEMENT_BANK
                ),

            "schema":
                sha256_file(
                    SCHEMA_FILE
                ),

            "explanation_bank_before":
                before_hash,

            "explanation_bank_after":
                after_hash,
        },
    }


def build_txt(
    report: dict,
) -> str:

    summary = report[
        "summary"
    ]

    hashes = report[
        "hashes"
    ]

    lines = [
        "=" * 86,
        "P2-D5.4.2 - REPARACIÓN DIRIGIDA DE DEUDA PEDAGÓGICA",
        "=" * 86,
        "",
        "RESUMEN",
        "-" * 86,
        (
            "Explicaciones totales           : "
            f"{summary['items_total']}"
        ),
        (
            "Explicaciones modificadas       : "
            f"{summary['items_modified']}"
        ),
        (
            "Explicaciones sin tocar         : "
            f"{summary['items_untouched']}"
        ),
        (
            "Frameworks reparados            : "
            f"{summary['frameworks_repaired']}"
        ),
        (
            "Relevant data reparado          : "
            f"{summary['relevant_data_repaired']}"
        ),
        (
            "source_review preservadas       : "
            f"{summary['source_review_preserved']}"
        ),
        "",
        "SEGURIDAD",
        "-" * 86,
        "Estado final                      : DRAFT",
        "VALIDATED                         : 0",
        "Mastery habilitado                : False",
        "question_bank modificado          : False",
        "reinforcement_bank modificado     : False",
        "app.py modificado                 : False",
        "schema modificado                 : False",
        "source_review modificadas         : False",
        "",
        "FRAMEWORK IDS",
        "-" * 86,
    ]

    for start in range(
        0,
        len(
            sorted(
                FRAMEWORK_IDS
            )
        ),
        10,
    ):

        lines.append(
            ", ".join(
                sorted(
                    FRAMEWORK_IDS
                )[
                    start:
                    start + 10
                ]
            )
        )

    lines.extend(
        [
            "",
            "RELEVANT_DATA IDS",
            "-" * 86,
            ", ".join(
                sorted(
                    RELEVANT_DATA_IDS
                )
            ),
            "",
            "CORRECCIÓN ESPECIAL",
            "-" * 86,
            (
                "S3-72: se reemplazó el framework erróneo de "
                "trabajo/energía por proporcionalidad compuesta directa."
            ),
            "",
            "SHA-256",
            "-" * 86,
            (
                "app.py                   : "
                + hashes[
                    "app"
                ]
            ),
            (
                "question_bank            : "
                + hashes[
                    "question_bank"
                ]
            ),
            (
                "reinforcement_bank       : "
                + hashes[
                    "reinforcement_bank"
                ]
            ),
            (
                "schema                   : "
                + hashes[
                    "schema"
                ]
            ),
            (
                "explanation_bank antes   : "
                + hashes[
                    "explanation_bank_before"
                ]
            ),
            (
                "explanation_bank después : "
                + hashes[
                    "explanation_bank_after"
                ]
            ),
            "",
            "IMPORTANTE",
            "-" * 86,
            (
                "- P2-D5.4.2 no valida automáticamente "
                "ninguna explicación."
            ),
            (
                "- Las 7 preguntas source_review "
                "continúan bloqueadas e intactas."
            ),
            (
                "- El siguiente paso será una nueva "
                "auditoría independiente 180/180."
            ),
            "",
            (
                "RESULTADO: P2-D5.4.2 "
                "PEDAGOGICAL DEBT REPAIR COMPLETADO"
            ),
        ]
    )

    return "\n".join(
        lines
    )


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main() -> None:

    print()

    print(
        "=" * 86
    )

    print(
        "P2-D5.4.2 - REPARACIÓN DIRIGIDA "
        "DE DEUDA PEDAGÓGICA"
    )

    print(
        "=" * 86
    )

    print()

    (
        questions,
        bank,
        audit,
    ) = verify_preconditions()

    verify_previous_audit(
        audit
    )

    validate_repair_payload()

    candidate = build_candidate(
        bank
    )

    validate_candidate(
        questions,
        bank,
        candidate,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # BACKUP
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        PRE_REPAIR_BACKUP.exists()
    ):

        backup_hash = sha256_file(
            PRE_REPAIR_BACKUP
        )

        if (
            backup_hash
            != P2D5_4_1_BANK_SHA256
        ):

            fail(
                "El backup pre-P2-D5.4.2 existente "
                "no coincide con el checkpoint P2-D5.4.1."
            )

        print(
            "[OK] Backup pre-P2-D5.4.2 existente y correcto."
        )

    else:

        shutil.copy2(
            EXPLANATION_BANK,
            PRE_REPAIR_BACKUP,
        )

        backup_hash = sha256_file(
            PRE_REPAIR_BACKUP
        )

        if (
            backup_hash
            != P2D5_4_1_BANK_SHA256
        ):

            fail(
                "El backup pre-P2-D5.4.2 se creó con hash incorrecto."
            )

        print(
            "[OK] Backup pre-P2-D5.4.2 creado."
        )

    before_hash = sha256_file(
        EXPLANATION_BANK
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # ESCRITURA + ROLLBACK
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:

        atomic_write_json(
            EXPLANATION_BANK,
            candidate,
        )

        written = load_json(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )

        if (
            written
            != candidate
        ):

            raise RuntimeError(
                "El banco escrito no coincide con el candidato validado."
            )

        # Archivos estables.
        if (
            sha256_file(
                APP
            )
            != APP_SHA256
        ):

            raise RuntimeError(
                "app.py cambió."
            )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                QUESTION_BANK
            )
            != QUESTION_BANK_SHA256
        ):

            raise RuntimeError(
                "question_bank cambió."
            )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                REINFORCEMENT_BANK
            )
            != REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256
        ):

            raise RuntimeError(
                "reinforcement_bank cambió."
            )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                SCHEMA_FILE
            )
            != SCHEMA_SHA256
        ):

            raise RuntimeError(
                "schema cambió."
            )

        after_hash = sha256_file(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )

        if (
            after_hash
            == before_hash
        ):

            raise RuntimeError(
                "La reparación no modificó el banco."
            )

        final_bank = load_json(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )

        validate_candidate(
            questions,
            bank,
            final_bank,
        )

        report = build_report(
            bank,
            final_bank,
            before_hash,
            after_hash,
        )

        atomic_write_json(
            REPORT_JSON,
            report,
        )

        atomic_write_text(
            REPORT_TXT,
            build_txt(
                report
            ),
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        print(
            f"[ERROR] Falló P2-D5.4.2: {exc}"
        )

        print(
            "[INFO] Restaurando checkpoint P2-D5.4.1..."
        )

        shutil.copy2(
            PRE_REPAIR_BACKUP,
            EXPLANATION_BANK,
        )

        restored_hash = sha256_file(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )

        if (
            restored_hash
            != P2D5_4_1_BANK_SHA256
        ):

            fail(
                "Rollback falló: el banco no volvió al hash P2-D5.4.1."
            )

        fail(
            "P2-D5.4.2 abortado; checkpoint P2-D5.4.1 restaurado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # RESUMEN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    print()

    print(
        "RESUMEN"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 86
    )

    print(
        "Explicaciones totales            : 180"
    )

    print(
        "Explicaciones modificadas        : 36"
    )

    print(
        "Explicaciones sin tocar          : 144"
    )

    print(
        "Frameworks pedagógicos reparados : 33"
    )

    print(
        "Relevant data reparado           : 3"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "FRAMEWORK IDS"

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

SOURCE = ROOT / "data" / "question_bank_p2a1_backup.json"
TARGET = ROOT / "data" / "question_bank.json"


def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open("rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(65536), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)

    return digest.hexdigest()


def main():

    print()
    print("=" * 72)
    print("RESTAURACIÓN SEGURA - CHECKPOINT P2-A.1")
    print("=" * 72)

    if not SOURCE.exists():
        print(
            "[ERROR] No existe "
            "question_bank_p2a1_backup.json"
        )
        sys.exit(1)

    try:
        source_hash = sha256(SOURCE)

        shutil.copy2(
            SOURCE,
            TARGET,
        )

        target_hash = sha256(TARGET)

    except Exception as exc:
        print(
            f"[ERROR] Falló la restauración: {exc}"
        )
        sys.exit(1)

    if source_hash != target_hash:
        print(
            "[ERROR] El archivo restaurado NO es "
            "idéntico al checkpoint P2-A.1."
        )
        print(f"Origen : {source_hash}")
        print(f"Destino: {target_hash}")
        sys.exit(1)

    print(
        "[OK] Banco restaurado desde P2-A.1"
    )

    print(
        "[OK] SHA-256 origen y destino coinciden"
    )

    print(
        f"SHA-256: {source_hash}"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "RESULTADO: RESTAURACIÓN P2-A.1 VERIFICADA"
    )

    sys.exit(0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

SHA-256: DE186DC3AD0E791AD2821E460E6C52A27102B0DE266B216F1574B43FEB98A38C
####################################################################################################

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

BANK_FILE = (
    ROOT / "data" / "question_bank.json"
)

BACKUP_FILE = (
    ROOT / "data" / "question_bank_p0_backup.json"
)

EXPECTED_TOTAL = 180
EXPECTED_REVIEW = 7
EXPECTED_SHORT = 12
EXPECTED_CLASSIFICATION_REVIEW = 3

PROTECTED_FIELDS = [
    "id",
    "simulacro",
    "number",
    "page",
    "pdf",
    "subject",
    "answer",
    "choices",
    "explanation",
    "status",
    "source_note",
]


def load(path):
    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    )


def fail(message):
    print(f"[ERROR] {message}")
    return False


def ok(message):
    print(f"[OK]    {message}")
    return True


def main():

    print()
    print("=" * 72)
    print("P1-B - VALIDACIÓN AUTOMÁTICA")
    print("=" * 72)

    if not BANK_FILE.exists():
        print("[ERROR] Falta question_bank.json")
        sys.exit(1)

    if not BACKUP_FILE.exists():
        print(
            "[ERROR] Falta "
            "question_bank_p0_backup.json"
        )
        sys.exit(1)

    bank = load(BANK_FILE)
    original = load(BACKUP_FILE)

    passed = True

    # ------------------------------------------------------
    # Número de preguntas
    # ------------------------------------------------------

    if len(bank) == EXPECTED_TOTAL:
        ok("El banco conserva 180 preguntas")
    else:
        passed = fail(
            f"Banco actual tiene {len(bank)} preguntas"
        ) and passed

    # ------------------------------------------------------
    # Comparación con baseline
    # ------------------------------------------------------

    old_map = {
        q["id"]: q
        for q in original
    }

    new_map = {
        q["id"]: q
        for q in bank
    }

    if set(old_map) == set(new_map):
        ok("Los IDs son idénticos al baseline P0")
    else:
        passed = fail(
            "Los IDs cambiaron respecto a P0"
        ) and passed

    protected_changes = []

    for qid in old_map.keys():

        old = old_map[qid]
        new = new_map[qid]

        for field in PROTECTED_FIELDS:

            if old.get(field) != new.get(field):

                protected_changes.append(
                    f"{qid}.{field}"
                )

    if not protected_changes:

        ok(
            "Ningún campo original fue modificado"
        )

    else:

        passed = fail(
            "Se modificaron campos protegidos: "
            + ", ".join(
                protected_changes[:20]
            )
        ) and passed

    # ------------------------------------------------------
    # Quality presente
    # ------------------------------------------------------

    missing_quality = [
        q["id"]
        for q in bank
        if not isinstance(
            q.get("quality"),
            dict,
        )
    ]

    if not missing_quality:
        ok(
            "Las 180 preguntas tienen metadata quality"
        )
    else:
        passed = fail(
            "Sin quality: "
            + str(missing_quality[:20])
        ) and passed

    # ------------------------------------------------------
    # Conteos
    # ------------------------------------------------------

    review = [
        q
        for q in bank
        if not q["quality"][
            "mastery_eligible"
        ]
    ]

    short = [
        q
        for q in bank
        if q["quality"][
            "short_explanation"
        ]
    ]

    classification = [
        q
        for q in bank
        if q["quality"][
            "classification_review"
        ]
    ]

    if len(review) == EXPECTED_REVIEW:
        ok(
            "7 preguntas excluidas del dominio"
        )
    else:
        passed = fail(
            f"Excluidas del dominio: {len(review)}"
        ) and passed

    if len(short) == EXPECTED_SHORT:
        ok("12 explicaciones cortas detectadas")
    else:
        passed = fail(
            f"Explicaciones cortas: {len(short)}"
        ) and passed

    if (
        len(classification)
        == EXPECTED_CLASSIFICATION_REVIEW
    ):
        ok(
            "3 clasificaciones pendientes detectadas"
        )
    else:
        passed = fail(
            "Clasificaciones pendientes: "
            f"{len(classification)}"
        ) and passed

    # ------------------------------------------------------
    # Regla crítica:
    # revisar_fuente nunca puede contribuir al dominio
    # ------------------------------------------------------

    violations = []

    for q in bank:

        if (
            q.get("status")
            == "revisar_fuente"
            and q["quality"][
                "mastery_eligible"
            ]
        ):
            violations.append(q["id"])

    if not violations:
        ok(
            "REVISAR FUENTE queda fuera del dominio"
        )
    else:
        passed = fail(
            "Preguntas dudosas habilitadas "
            "para dominio: "
            + str(violations)
        ) and passed

    # ------------------------------------------------------
    # Clasificaciones específicas
    # ------------------------------------------------------

    expected_ids = {
        "S1-73",
        "S1-76",
        "S1-77",
    }

    actual_ids = {
        q["id"]
        for q in classification
    }

    if actual_ids == expected_ids:

        ok(
            "Clasificación dudosa depurada "
            "(sin falsos positivos)"
        )

    else:

        passed = fail(
            "Clasificación dudosa inesperada: "
            f"{sorted(actual_ids)}"
        ) and passed

    print()
    print("=" * 72)

    if passed:

        print("RESULTADO: P1-B APROBADO")
        print(
            "El banco conserva íntegro el baseline "
            "y añade metadata de calidad."
        )
        sys.exit(0)

    print("RESULTADO: P1-B RECHAZADO")
    print(
        "No continuar con P2."
    )

    sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

####################################################################################################
FILE: tools\validate_p2a.py
