SHA-256: D2F9431814E897A67E17CC6B1BA4167BAF842B5BED8502C3827775641B58B2D9
####################################################################################################

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

BANK_FILE = ROOT / "data" / "question_bank.json"
P1_BACKUP = ROOT / "data" / "question_bank_p1_backup.json"

EXPECTED_TOTAL = 180

TAXONOMY_FIELDS = {
    "area",
    "topic",
    "skill",
    "subskill",
    "taxonomy_status",
}
# Campos añadidos por parches posteriores y permitidos
# durante las pruebas de regresión de P2-A.
APPROVED_LATER_FIELDS = {
    "utn_official",
}
ALLOWED_TAXONOMY_STATUS = {
    "classified",
    "source_review",
}


def load_json(path: Path):
    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    )


def ok(message):
    print(f"[OK]    {message}")


def fail(message):
    print(f"[ERROR] {message}")


def main():

    print()
    print("=" * 72)
    print("P2-A - VALIDACIÓN AUTOMÁTICA DE TAXONOMÍA")
    print("=" * 72)

    passed = True

    # ========================================================
    # 1. ARCHIVOS
    # ========================================================

    if not BANK_FILE.exists():
        fail("No existe question_bank.json")
        sys.exit(1)

    if not P1_BACKUP.exists():
        fail("No existe question_bank_p1_backup.json")
        sys.exit(1)

    try:
        current = load_json(BANK_FILE)
        baseline = load_json(P1_BACKUP)

    except Exception as exc:
        fail(f"No se pudo leer JSON: {exc}")
        sys.exit(1)

    # ========================================================
    # 2. TOTAL
    # ========================================================

    if len(current) == EXPECTED_TOTAL:
        ok("El banco conserva 180 preguntas")
    else:
        fail(
            f"El banco tiene {len(current)} preguntas; "
            f"se esperaban {EXPECTED_TOTAL}"
        )
        passed = False

    if len(baseline) != EXPECTED_TOTAL:
        fail(
            "El backup P1 no contiene 180 preguntas. "
            "No es seguro continuar."
        )
        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 3. IDS
    # ========================================================

    current_map = {
        q["id"]: q
        for q in current
        if "id" in q
    }

    baseline_map = {
        q["id"]: q
        for q in baseline
        if "id" in q
    }

    if set(current_map) == set(baseline_map):
        ok("Los 180 IDs son idénticos al checkpoint P1")
    else:

        missing = sorted(
            set(baseline_map) - set(current_map)
        )

        extra = sorted(
            set(current_map) - set(baseline_map)
        )

        fail(
            f"IDs modificados. "
            f"Faltantes={missing} | Nuevos={extra}"
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 4. NINGÚN CAMPO P1 PUEDE CAMBIAR
    # ========================================================

    protected_changes = []

    for qid in set(current_map) & set(baseline_map):

        old = baseline_map[qid]
        new = current_map[qid]

        # Todos los campos existentes en P1 son protegidos.
        for field in old.keys():

            if new.get(field) != old.get(field):

                protected_changes.append(
                    f"{qid}.{field}"
                )

    if not protected_changes:

        ok(
            "Ningún campo existente en P1 fue modificado"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "P2-A modificó campos protegidos: "
            + ", ".join(
                protected_changes[:30]
            )
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 5. SOLO SE PERMITEN LOS 5 CAMPOS NUEVOS
    # ========================================================

    unexpected_fields = []

    for qid in set(current_map) & set(baseline_map):

        old_fields = set(
            baseline_map[qid].keys()
        )

        new_fields = set(
            current_map[qid].keys()
        )

        added = new_fields - old_fields

        unexpected = (
            added 
            - TAXONOMY_FIELDS
            - APPROVED_LATER_FIELDS
        )

        if unexpected:

            unexpected_fields.append(
                (
                    qid,
                    sorted(unexpected),
                )
            )

    if not unexpected_fields:

        ok(
            "Los campos de P2-A son válidos y "
            "las extensiones posteriores están autorizadas"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "Se añadieron campos inesperados: "
            f"{unexpected_fields[:20]}"
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 6. TODAS LAS PREGUNTAS TIENEN TAXONOMÍA
    # ========================================================

    missing_taxonomy = []

    for q in current:

        missing = [
            field
            for field in TAXONOMY_FIELDS
            if field not in q
        ]

        if missing:

            missing_taxonomy.append(
                (
                    q.get("id"),
                    missing,
                )
            )

    if not missing_taxonomy:

        ok(
            "Las 180 preguntas tienen "
            "los 5 campos de taxonomía"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "Preguntas sin taxonomía completa: "
            f"{missing_taxonomy[:20]}"
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 7. NINGÚN VALOR DE TAXONOMÍA PUEDE ESTAR VACÍO
    # ========================================================

    empty_fields = []

    for q in current:

        for field in [
            "area",
            "topic",
            "skill",
            "subskill",
        ]:

            value = q.get(field)

            if (
                not isinstance(value, str)
                or not value.strip()
            ):

                empty_fields.append(
                    f"{q.get('id')}.{field}"
                )

    if not empty_fields:

        ok(
            "No existen campos pedagógicos vacíos"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "Campos pedagógicos vacíos: "
            + ", ".join(
                empty_fields[:30]
            )
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 8. TAXONOMY_STATUS
    # ========================================================

    invalid_status = []

    for q in current:

        status = q.get(
            "taxonomy_status"
        )

        if status not in ALLOWED_TAXONOMY_STATUS:

            invalid_status.append(
                (
                    q.get("id"),
                    status,
                )
            )

    if not invalid_status:

        ok(
            "Todos los taxonomy_status son válidos"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "taxonomy_status inválidos: "
            f"{invalid_status[:20]}"
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 9. SOURCE_REVIEW DEBE COINCIDIR EXACTAMENTE
    #    CON revisar_fuente
    # ========================================================

    source_review_ids = {
        q["id"]
        for q in current
        if q.get("taxonomy_status")
        == "source_review"
    }

    original_review_ids = {
        q["id"]
        for q in current
        if q.get("status")
        == "revisar_fuente"
    }

    if source_review_ids == original_review_ids:

        ok(
            "source_review coincide exactamente "
            "con las 7 preguntas REVISAR FUENTE"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "source_review no coincide con revisar_fuente. "
            f"Taxonomía={sorted(source_review_ids)} | "
            f"Fuente={sorted(original_review_ids)}"
        )

        passed = False

    if len(source_review_ids) == 7:

        ok(
            "Se mantienen exactamente 7 preguntas "
            "bajo revisión de fuente"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            f"Se encontraron {len(source_review_ids)} "
            "preguntas source_review; se esperaban 7"
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 10. QUALITY P1 DEBE SEGUIR INTACTO
    # ========================================================

    quality_changes = []

    for qid in set(current_map) & set(baseline_map):

        if (
            current_map[qid].get("quality")
            != baseline_map[qid].get("quality")
        ):

            quality_changes.append(qid)

    if not quality_changes:

        ok(
            "La metadata quality de P1 permanece intacta"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "quality fue modificada en: "
            + ", ".join(
                quality_changes[:30]
            )
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 11. REGLA DE SEGURIDAD DE DOMINIO
    # ========================================================

    mastery_violations = []

    for q in current:

        if (
            q.get("taxonomy_status")
            == "source_review"
            and q.get("quality", {}).get(
                "mastery_eligible"
            ) is not False
        ):

            mastery_violations.append(
                q["id"]
            )

    if not mastery_violations:

        ok(
            "Ninguna pregunta dudosa puede "
            "contribuir al futuro dominio"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "Preguntas source_review habilitadas "
            "para dominio: "
            + ", ".join(
                mastery_violations
            )
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 12. CASOS DE RECLASIFICACIÓN P1
    # ========================================================

    expected_math = {
        "S1-73",
        "S1-76",
        "S1-77",
    }

    wrong_math = []

    for qid in expected_math:

        q = current_map.get(qid)

        if (
            not q
            or q.get("area")
            != "Matemática"
        ):

            wrong_math.append(qid)

    if not wrong_math:

        ok(
            "S1-73, S1-76 y S1-77 fueron "
            "clasificadas pedagógicamente como Matemática"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "Reclasificación pendiente en: "
            + ", ".join(wrong_math)
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 13. DIVERSIDAD DE TAXONOMÍA
    # ========================================================

    areas = {
        q["area"]
        for q in current
        if q.get("area")
    }

    topics = {
        (
            q["area"],
            q["topic"],
        )
        for q in current
        if q.get("area")
        and q.get("topic")
    }

    skills = {
        (
            q["area"],
            q["topic"],
            q["skill"],
        )
        for q in current
        if q.get("area")
        and q.get("topic")
        and q.get("skill")
    }

    subskills = {
        (
            q["area"],
            q["topic"],
            q["skill"],
            q["subskill"],
        )
        for q in current
        if q.get("area")
        and q.get("topic")
        and q.get("skill")
        and q.get("subskill")
    }

    print()
    print("COBERTURA PEDAGÓGICA")
    print("-" * 72)
    print(
        f"Áreas únicas        : {len(areas)}"
    )
    print(
        f"Temas únicos        : {len(topics)}"
    )
    print(
        f"Habilidades únicas  : {len(skills)}"
    )
    print(
        f"Subhabilidades      : {len(subskills)}"
    )

    if (
        len(areas) >= 5
        and len(topics) >= 15
        and len(skills) >= 25
        and len(subskills) >= 40
    ):

        ok(
            "La taxonomía tiene granularidad suficiente "
            "para continuar"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "La taxonomía parece demasiado poco granular"
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # RESULTADO
    # ========================================================

    print()
    print("=" * 72)

    if passed:

        print("RESULTADO: P2-A APROBADO")
        print(
            "La taxonomía fue incorporada sin "
            "modificar el checkpoint P1."
        )

        print(
            "El proyecto puede ejecutar la "
            "regresión completa P0."
        )

        sys.exit(0)

    else:

        print("RESULTADO: P2-A RECHAZADO")
        print(
            "El banco debe restaurarse desde "
            "question_bank_p1_backup.json."
        )

        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

####################################################################################################
FILE: tools\validate_p2a1.py
ENCODING: utf-8
SHA-256: 7504FFD3661AB2FCAA952457A2CC29FC237C61176253F628596877D31AD5D917
####################################################################################################

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

BANK_FILE = ROOT / "data" / "question_bank.json"
P2A_BACKUP = ROOT / "data" / "question_bank_p2a_backup.json"

EXPECTED_TOTAL = 180
EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW = 7


def load_json(path: Path):
    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    )


def ok(message):
    print(f"[OK]    {message}")


def fail(message):
    print(f"[ERROR] {message}")


def main():

    print()
    print("=" * 72)
    print("P2-A.1 - VALIDACIÓN DE NORMALIZACIÓN")
    print("=" * 72)

    passed = True

    # ========================================================
    # 1. ARCHIVOS
    # ========================================================

    if not BANK_FILE.exists():
        fail("No existe question_bank.json")
        sys.exit(1)

    if not P2A_BACKUP.exists():
        fail(
            "No existe question_bank_p2a_backup.json"
        )
        sys.exit(1)

    try:
        current = load_json(BANK_FILE)
        baseline = load_json(P2A_BACKUP)

    except Exception as exc:
        fail(f"No se pudo leer JSON: {exc}")
        sys.exit(1)

    # ========================================================
    # 2. TOTAL
    # ========================================================

    if (
        len(current) == EXPECTED_TOTAL
        and len(baseline) == EXPECTED_TOTAL
    ):
        ok("Ambos bancos contienen 180 preguntas")
    else:
        fail(
            f"Conteos inesperados: "
            f"actual={len(current)}, "
            f"backup={len(baseline)}"
        )
        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 3. MAPAS POR ID
    # ========================================================

    current_map = {
        q["id"]: q
        for q in current
    }

    baseline_map = {
        q["id"]: q
        for q in baseline
    }

    if set(current_map) == set(baseline_map):
        ok(
            "Los IDs permanecen idénticos "
            "al checkpoint P2-A"
        )
    else:
        fail(
            "Los IDs cambiaron respecto "
            "al checkpoint P2-A"
        )
        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 4. SOLO SKILL PUEDE CAMBIAR
    # ========================================================

    illegal_changes = []
    skill_changes = []

    for qid in set(current_map) & set(baseline_map):

        old = baseline_map[qid]
        new = current_map[qid]

        all_fields = (
            set(old.keys())
            | set(new.keys())
        )

        for field in all_fields:

            if field == "skill":
                continue

            # Campos que pueden ser añadidos por parches
            # posteriores sin invalidar P2-A.1.

            if (
                field == "utn_official"
                and field not in old
            ):
                continue

            if old.get(field) != new.get(field):

                illegal_changes.append(
                    f"{qid}.{field}"
                )
                
        if old.get("skill") != new.get("skill"):
            skill_changes.append(qid)

    if not illegal_changes:

        ok(
            "Únicamente el campo skill "
            "puede haber sido modificado"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "Se modificaron campos prohibidos: "
            + ", ".join(
                illegal_changes[:30]
            )
        )

        passed = False

    if skill_changes:

        ok(
            f"skill fue normalizado en "
            f"{len(skill_changes)} preguntas"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "Ninguna habilidad cambió; "
            "la normalización no parece haberse aplicado"
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 5. AREA, TOPIC Y SUBSKILL INTACTOS
    # ========================================================

    for field in [
        "area",
        "topic",
        "subskill",
        "taxonomy_status",
    ]:

        differences = [
            qid
            for qid in current_map
            if (
                current_map[qid].get(field)
                != baseline_map[qid].get(field)
            )
        ]

        if not differences:

            ok(
                f"{field} permanece intacto"
            )

        else:

            fail(
                f"{field} cambió en: "
                + ", ".join(
                    differences[:20]
                )
            )

            passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 6. QUALITY P1 INTACTO
    # ========================================================

    quality_changes = [
        qid
        for qid in current_map
        if (
            current_map[qid].get("quality")
            != baseline_map[qid].get("quality")
        )
    ]

    if not quality_changes:

        ok(
            "La metadata quality de P1 "
            "permanece intacta"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "quality cambió en: "
            + ", ".join(
                quality_changes[:20]
            )
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 7. HABILIDADES NO VACÍAS
    # ========================================================

    empty_skills = [
        q["id"]
        for q in current
        if (
            not isinstance(
                q.get("skill"),
                str,
            )
            or not q["skill"].strip()
        )
    ]

    if not empty_skills:

        ok(
            "Las 180 preguntas conservan "
            "una habilidad válida"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "Habilidades vacías: "
            + ", ".join(
                empty_skills[:20]
            )
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 8. REDUCCIÓN REAL DE GRANULARIDAD
    # ========================================================

    before_skills = {
        q["skill"]
        for q in baseline
    }

    after_skills = {
        q["skill"]
        for q in current
    }

    print()
    print("GRANULARIDAD")
    print("-" * 72)

    print(
        f"Habilidades antes : {len(before_skills)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Habilidades ahora : {len(after_skills)}"
    )

    if len(after_skills) < len(before_skills):

        ok(
            "La cantidad de habilidades fue reducida"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "La normalización no redujo "
            "la cantidad de habilidades"
        )

        passed = False

    # Umbral de seguridad.
    # No exigimos un número exacto para no hacer
    # frágil el validador, pero buscamos una
    # taxonomía claramente menos fragmentada.

    if len(after_skills) <= 60:

        ok(
            "La granularidad final es apropiada "
            "para construir métricas de dominio"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            f"Aún existen {len(after_skills)} "
            "habilidades; siguen demasiado fragmentadas"
        )

        passed = False

    if len(after_skills) >= 25:

        ok(
            "La normalización no colapsó "
            "excesivamente la taxonomía"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "Hay demasiado pocas habilidades; "
            "se perdió resolución pedagógica"
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 9. SUBHABILIDADES DEBEN CONSERVARSE EXACTAMENTE
    # ========================================================

    before_subskills = [
        (
            q["id"],
            q.get("subskill"),
        )
        for q in baseline
    ]

    after_subskills = [
        (
            q["id"],
            q.get("subskill"),
        )
        for q in current
    ]

    if before_subskills == after_subskills:

        ok(
            "Las subhabilidades conservaron "
            "todo el detalle de P2-A"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "Alguna subhabilidad fue modificada"
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 10. SOURCE REVIEW
    # ========================================================

    review_ids = {
        q["id"]
        for q in current
        if (
            q.get("taxonomy_status")
            == "source_review"
        )
    }

    if len(review_ids) == EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW:

        ok(
            "Se mantienen exactamente "
            "7 preguntas source_review"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            f"source_review={len(review_ids)}, "
            f"se esperaban 7"
        )

        passed = False

    mastery_violations = []

    for q in current:

        if (
            q.get("taxonomy_status")
            == "source_review"
            and q.get("quality", {}).get(
                "mastery_eligible"
            ) is not False
        ):

            mastery_violations.append(
                q["id"]
            )

    if not mastery_violations:

        ok(
            "Las preguntas dudosas continúan "
            "excluidas del futuro dominio"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "Violaciones de mastery_eligible: "
            + ", ".join(
                mastery_violations
            )
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 11. DISTRIBUCIÓN
    # ========================================================

    counts = Counter(
        q["skill"]
        for q in current
    )

    singleton_skills = [
        skill
        for skill, count in counts.items()
        if count == 1
    ]

    print()
    print("DISTRIBUCIÓN")
    print("-" * 72)

    print(
        f"Habilidades totales       : "
        f"{len(counts)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Habilidades con 1 pregunta: "
        f"{len(singleton_skills)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Mayor cobertura           : "
        f"{max(counts.values()) if counts else 0} "
        "preguntas"
    )

    # No hacemos fallar P2-A.1 por habilidades
    # singleton porque algunas áreas tienen muy
    # pocas preguntas en los simulacros.
    # Pero dejamos el dato disponible para P2-B/P6.

    if len(singleton_skills) <= 20:

        ok(
            "La fragmentación residual "
            "es baja"
        )

    else:

        print(
            f"[INFO]  Persisten {len(singleton_skills)} "
            "habilidades con una sola pregunta"
        )

        print(
            "[INFO]  No se considera error: "
            "la escasez de evidencia se controlará "
            "en el futuro motor de dominio."
        )
    
    # ========================================================
    # RESULTADO
    # ========================================================

    print()
    print("=" * 72)

    if passed:

        print(
            "RESULTADO: P2-A.1 APROBADO"
        )

        print(
            "Las habilidades fueron normalizadas "
            "sin alterar ningún otro dato."
        )

        print(
            "La taxonomía está preparada para "
            "el futuro motor de dominio."
        )

        sys.exit(0)

    else:

        print(
            "RESULTADO: P2-A.1 RECHAZADO"
        )

        print(
            "Restaurar desde "
            "question_bank_p2a_backup.json."
        )

        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

####################################################################################################
FILE: tools\validate_p2b.py
ENCODING: utf-8
SHA-256: 28CFAE1DB72A0C9B5EEC95AAC7EFFD6EEF1934FAC6C0457CD60972F589B88831
####################################################################################################

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

BANK_FILE = ROOT / "data" / "question_bank.json"
BASELINE_FILE = ROOT / "data" / "question_bank_p2a1_backup.json"
REPORT_FILE = ROOT / "results" / "utn_mapping_p2b.json"

EXPECTED_TOTAL = 180
EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW = 7

ALLOWED_ALIGNMENTS = {
    "exact",
    "related",
    "out_of_scope",
    "uncertain",
}

ALLOWED_CONFIDENCE = {
    "high",
    "medium",
    "low",
}

OFFICIAL_AREAS = {
    "Matemática",
    "Física",
    "Química",
    "Lenguaje",
    "Estadística",
}

REQUIRED_MAPPING_FIELDS = {
    "mapping_version",
    "period",
    "group",
    "area",
    "unit",
    "topic",
    "alignment",
    "confidence",
    "coverage_eligible",
    "source_review_excluded",
    "note",
    "source_title",
    "source_section",
    "source_pages",
    "source_url",
}


def load_json(path: Path):

    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def ok(message):
    print(f"[OK]    {message}")


def info(message):
    print(f"[INFO]  {message}")


def fail(message):
    print(f"[ERROR] {message}")


def main():

    print()
    print("=" * 72)
    print("P2-B - VALIDACIÓN DEL MAPEO OFICIAL UTN/FICA 2P2026")
    print("=" * 72)

    passed = True

    # ========================================================
    # 1. ARCHIVOS
    # ========================================================

    if not BANK_FILE.exists():
        fail("No existe question_bank.json")
        sys.exit(1)

    if not BASELINE_FILE.exists():
        fail(
            "No existe question_bank_p2a1_backup.json"
        )
        sys.exit(1)

    if not REPORT_FILE.exists():
        fail(
            "No existe results/utn_mapping_p2b.json"
        )
        sys.exit(1)

    try:

        current = load_json(
            BANK_FILE
        )

        baseline = load_json(
            BASELINE_FILE
        )

        report = load_json(
            REPORT_FILE
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        fail(
            f"No se pudieron leer los archivos JSON: {exc}"
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    # ========================================================
    # 2. TOTAL
    # ========================================================

    if (
        len(current) == EXPECTED_TOTAL
        and len(baseline) == EXPECTED_TOTAL
    ):

        ok(
            "Banco actual y checkpoint P2-A.1 "
            "contienen 180 preguntas"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            f"Conteos inesperados: "
            f"actual={len(current)}, "
            f"baseline={len(baseline)}"
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 3. IDS
    # ========================================================

    current_map = {
        q["id"]: q
        for q in current
        if "id" in q
    }

    baseline_map = {
        q["id"]: q
        for q in baseline
        if "id" in q
    }

    if set(current_map) == set(baseline_map):

        ok(
            "Los IDs son idénticos "
            "al checkpoint P2-A.1"
        )

    else:

        missing = sorted(
            set(baseline_map)
            - set(current_map)
        )

        extra = sorted(
            set(current_map)
            - set(baseline_map)
        )

        fail(
            f"IDs modificados. "
            f"Faltantes={missing} | "
            f"Nuevos={extra}"
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 4. SOLO UTN_OFFICIAL PUEDE SER NUEVO
    # ========================================================

    illegal_changes = []
    unexpected_added_fields = []

    for qid in (
        set(current_map)
        & set(baseline_map)
    ):

        old = baseline_map[qid]
        new = current_map[qid]

        for field in old:

            if new.get(field) != old.get(field):

                illegal_changes.append(
                    f"{qid}.{field}"
                )

        added_fields = (
            set(new.keys())
            - set(old.keys())
        )

        unexpected = (
            added_fields
            - {"utn_official"}
        )

        if unexpected:

            unexpected_added_fields.append(
                (
                    qid,
                    sorted(unexpected),
                )
            )

    if not illegal_changes:

        ok(
            "Ningún campo del checkpoint "
            "P2-A.1 fue modificado"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "Campos protegidos modificados: "
            + ", ".join(
                illegal_changes[:30]
            )
        )

        passed = False

    if not unexpected_added_fields:

        ok(
            "P2-B solo añadió el objeto "
            "utn_official"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "Se añadieron campos inesperados: "
            f"{unexpected_added_fields[:20]}"
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 5. LAS 180 PREGUNTAS DEBEN TENER MAPEO
    # ========================================================

    missing_mapping = [
        q["id"]
        for q in current
        if "utn_official" not in q
    ]

    if not missing_mapping:

        ok(
            "Las 180 preguntas tienen "
            "metadata utn_official"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "Preguntas sin utn_official: "
            + ", ".join(
                missing_mapping[:30]
            )
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 6. ESTRUCTURA DEL OBJETO UTN
    # ========================================================

    bad_structure = []

    for q in current:

        mapping = q.get(
            "utn_official"
        )

        if not isinstance(
            mapping,
            dict,
        ):

            bad_structure.append(
                q["id"]
            )

            continue

        fields = set(
            mapping.keys()
        )

        if fields != REQUIRED_MAPPING_FIELDS:

            missing = sorted(
                REQUIRED_MAPPING_FIELDS
                - fields
            )

            extra = sorted(
                fields
                - REQUIRED_MAPPING_FIELDS
            )

            bad_structure.append(
                f"{q['id']} "
                f"missing={missing} "
                f"extra={extra}"
            )

    if not bad_structure:

        ok(
            "Los 180 objetos utn_official "
            "tienen estructura válida"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "Estructura utn_official inválida: "
            + " | ".join(
                bad_structure[:20]
            )
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 7. VERSIÓN, PERÍODO Y GRUPO
    # ========================================================

    metadata_errors = []

    for q in current:

        mapping = q.get(
            "utn_official",
            {},
        )

        if (
            mapping.get(
                "mapping_version"
            )
            != "p2b"
        ):

            metadata_errors.append(
                f"{q['id']}.mapping_version"
            )

        if (
            mapping.get("period")
            != "2P2026"
        ):

            metadata_errors.append(
                f"{q['id']}.period"
            )

        if (
            mapping.get("group")
            != "FICA"
        ):

            metadata_errors.append(
                f"{q['id']}.group"
            )

    if not metadata_errors:

        ok(
            "Versión, período y grupo UTN "
            "son consistentes"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "Metadata UTN inconsistente: "
            + ", ".join(
                metadata_errors[:30]
            )
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 8. ALIGNMENT Y CONFIDENCE
    # ========================================================

    invalid_alignment = []
    invalid_confidence = []

    for q in current:

        mapping = q.get(
            "utn_official",
            {},
        )

        alignment = mapping.get(
            "alignment"
        )

        confidence = mapping.get(
            "confidence"
        )

        if alignment not in ALLOWED_ALIGNMENTS:

            invalid_alignment.append(
                (
                    q["id"],
                    alignment,
                )
            )

        if confidence not in ALLOWED_CONFIDENCE:

            invalid_confidence.append(
                (
                    q["id"],
                    confidence,
                )
            )

    if not invalid_alignment:

        ok(
            "Todos los valores alignment son válidos"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "alignment inválidos: "
            f"{invalid_alignment[:20]}"
        )

        passed = False

    if not invalid_confidence:

        ok(
            "Todos los niveles de confianza son válidos"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "confidence inválidos: "
            f"{invalid_confidence[:20]}"
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 9. REGLAS DE CONFIANZA
    # ========================================================

    confidence_errors = []

    expected_confidence = {
        "exact": "high",
        "related": "medium",
        "out_of_scope": "high",
        "uncertain": "low",
    }

    for q in current:

        mapping = q.get(
            "utn_official",
            {},
        )

        alignment = mapping.get(
            "alignment"
        )

        confidence = mapping.get(
            "confidence"
        )

        if (
            alignment in expected_confidence
            and confidence
            != expected_confidence[
                alignment
            ]
        ):

            confidence_errors.append(
                q["id"]
            )

    if not confidence_errors:

        ok(
            "La confianza coincide con "
            "el tipo de alineación"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "Confianza inconsistente en: "
            + ", ".join(
                confidence_errors[:30]
            )
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 10. ÁREAS OFICIALES
    # ========================================================

    invalid_areas = []

    for q in current:

        mapping = q.get(
            "utn_official",
            {},
        )

        alignment = mapping.get(
            "alignment"
        )

        area = mapping.get(
            "area"
        )

        unit = mapping.get(
            "unit"
        )

        topic = mapping.get(
            "topic"
        )

        if alignment in {
            "exact",
            "related",
        }:

            if area not in OFFICIAL_AREAS:

                invalid_areas.append(
                    f"{q['id']}: area={area}"
                )

            if (
                not isinstance(
                    unit,
                    str,
                )
                or not unit.strip()
            ):

                invalid_areas.append(
                    f"{q['id']}: unit vacío"
                )

            if (
                not isinstance(
                    topic,
                    str,
                )
                or not topic.strip()
            ):

                invalid_areas.append(
                    f"{q['id']}: topic vacío"
                )

        elif alignment in {
            "out_of_scope",
            "uncertain",
        }:

            if (
                area is not None
                or unit is not None
                or topic is not None
            ):

                invalid_areas.append(
                    f"{q['id']}: "
                    "fuera/incierto con tema oficial asignado"
                )

    if not invalid_areas:

        ok(
            "Las áreas oficiales y temas "
            "son coherentes con alignment"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "Mapeo oficial incoherente: "
            + " | ".join(
                invalid_areas[:30]
            )
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 11. SOURCE REVIEW
    # ========================================================

    source_review_ids = {
        q["id"]
        for q in current
        if (
            q.get("status")
            == "revisar_fuente"
            or q.get(
                "quality",
                {},
            ).get(
                "source_review_required"
            )
            is True
        )
    }

    if len(source_review_ids) == EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW:

        ok(
            "Se detectan exactamente "
            "7 preguntas source_review"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            f"Se detectaron "
            f"{len(source_review_ids)} "
            "source_review; se esperaban 7"
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 12. SOURCE REVIEW NUNCA PUEDE CONTAR COBERTURA
    # ========================================================

    review_coverage_violations = []

    for q in current:

        mapping = q.get(
            "utn_official",
            {},
        )

        if (
            q["id"] in source_review_ids
            and mapping.get(
                "coverage_eligible"
            )
            is not False
        ):

            review_coverage_violations.append(
                q["id"]
            )

    if not review_coverage_violations:

        ok(
            "Ninguna pregunta source_review "
            "cuenta como cobertura oficial"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "source_review con cobertura habilitada: "
            + ", ".join(
                review_coverage_violations
            )
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 13. SOURCE_REVIEW_EXCLUDED
    # ========================================================

    exclusion_flag_errors = []

    for q in current:

        mapping = q.get(
            "utn_official",
            {},
        )

        expected = (
            q["id"]
            in source_review_ids
        )

        if (
            mapping.get(
                "source_review_excluded"
            )
            is not expected
        ):

            exclusion_flag_errors.append(
                q["id"]
            )

    if not exclusion_flag_errors:

        ok(
            "source_review_excluded coincide "
            "con la metadata de calidad"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "source_review_excluded incorrecto en: "
            + ", ".join(
                exclusion_flag_errors[:30]
            )
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 14. REGLAS DE COVERAGE_ELIGIBLE
    # ========================================================

    coverage_errors = []

    eligible_ids = []

    for q in current:

        mapping = q.get(
            "utn_official",
            {},
        )

        alignment = mapping.get(
            "alignment"
        )

        expected_eligible = (
            alignment
            in {
                "exact",
                "related",
            }
            and q["id"]
            not in source_review_ids
        )

        actual = mapping.get(
            "coverage_eligible"
        )

        if actual is not expected_eligible:

            coverage_errors.append(
                q["id"]
            )

        if actual is True:

            eligible_ids.append(
                q["id"]
            )

    if not coverage_errors:

        ok(
            "coverage_eligible aplica "
            "correctamente todas las reglas"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "coverage_eligible incorrecto en: "
            + ", ".join(
                coverage_errors[:30]
            )
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 15. BIOLOGÍA NO PUEDE CONTAR COMO FICA
    # ========================================================

    biology_ids = {
        "S3-60",
        "S3-61",
        "S3-62",
    }

    biology_errors = []

    for qid in biology_ids:

        q = current_map.get(
            qid
        )

        if not q:
            biology_errors.append(
                f"{qid}: ausente"
            )
            continue

        mapping = q.get(
            "utn_official",
            {},
        )

        if (
            mapping.get(
                "alignment"
            )
            != "out_of_scope"
            or mapping.get(
                "coverage_eligible"
            )
            is not False
        ):

            biology_errors.append(
                qid
            )

    if not biology_errors:

        ok(
            "Las 3 preguntas de Biología "
            "quedan fuera de cobertura FICA"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "Biología mal clasificada: "
            + ", ".join(
                biology_errors
            )
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 16. PREGUNTA INCIERTA S3-14
    # ========================================================

    s314 = current_map.get(
        "S3-14",
        {},
    ).get(
        "utn_official",
        {},
    )

    if (
        s314.get("alignment")
        == "uncertain"
        and s314.get(
            "coverage_eligible"
        )
        is False
    ):

        ok(
            "S3-14 permanece incierta "
            "y fuera de cobertura"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "S3-14 no conserva la regla "
            "de incertidumbre"
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 17. SOURCE METADATA
    # ========================================================

    source_errors = []

    for q in current:

        mapping = q.get(
            "utn_official",
            {},
        )

        url = mapping.get(
            "source_url"
        )

        title = mapping.get(
            "source_title"
        )

        section = mapping.get(
            "source_section"
        )

        pages = mapping.get(
            "source_pages"
        )

        if (
            not isinstance(
                url,
                str,
            )
            or "utn.edu.ec" not in url
        ):

            source_errors.append(
                f"{q['id']}.source_url"
            )

        if (
            not isinstance(
                title,
                str,
            )
            or not title.strip()
        ):

            source_errors.append(
                f"{q['id']}.source_title"
            )

        if (
            not isinstance(
                section,
                str,
            )
            or "FICA" not in section
        ):

            source_errors.append(
                f"{q['id']}.source_section"
            )

        if (
            not isinstance(
                pages,
                str,
            )
            or not pages.strip()
        ):

            source_errors.append(
                f"{q['id']}.source_pages"
            )

    if not source_errors:

        ok(
            "Las 180 preguntas conservan "
            "la referencia oficial UTN"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "Referencia oficial inválida: "
            + ", ".join(
                source_errors[:30]
            )
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 18. ESTADÍSTICAS DEL BANCO
    # ========================================================

    alignment_counts = Counter(
        q["utn_official"][
            "alignment"
        ]
        for q in current
    )

    official_area_counts = Counter(
        q["utn_official"][
            "area"
        ]
        for q in current
        if q["utn_official"][
            "area"
        ]
        is not None
    )

    eligible_topic_counts = defaultdict(
        int
    )

    for q in current:

        mapping = q[
            "utn_official"
        ]

        if mapping[
            "coverage_eligible"
        ]:

            key = (
                mapping["area"],
                mapping["unit"],
                mapping["topic"],
            )

            eligible_topic_counts[
                key
            ] += 1

    print()
    print("RESUMEN DEL MAPEO")
    print("-" * 72)

    for alignment in [
        "exact",
        "related",
        "out_of_scope",
        "uncertain",
    ]:

        print(
            f"{alignment:<16}: "
            f"{alignment_counts.get(alignment, 0)}"
        )

    print()
    print(
        f"Cobertura elegible  : "
        f"{len(eligible_ids)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Temas con evidencia : "
        f"{len(eligible_topic_counts)}"
    )

    print()
    print("ÁREAS OFICIALES")
    print("-" * 72)

    for area in sorted(
        OFFICIAL_AREAS
    ):

        print(
            f"{area:<20}: "
            f"{official_area_counts.get(area, 0)}"
        )

    # ========================================================
    # 19. INFORME JSON DEBE COINCIDIR CON EL BANCO
    # ========================================================

    report_errors = []

    if (
        report.get(
            "mapping_version"
        )
        != "p2b"
    ):

        report_errors.append(
            "mapping_version"
        )

    if (
        report.get(
            "utn_period"
        )
        != "2P2026"
    ):

        report_errors.append(
            "utn_period"
        )

    if (
        report.get(
            "utn_group"
        )
        != "FICA"
    ):

        report_errors.append(
            "utn_group"
        )

    if (
        report.get(
            "total_questions"
        )
        != EXPECTED_TOTAL
    ):

        report_errors.append(
            "total_questions"
        )

    if (
        report.get(
            "coverage_eligible_questions"
        )
        != len(eligible_ids)
    ):

        report_errors.append(
            "coverage_eligible_questions"
        )

    if (
        report.get(
            "source_review_excluded"
        )
        != EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW
    ):

        report_errors.append(
            "source_review_excluded"
        )

    expected_alignment_counts = dict(
        sorted(
            alignment_counts.items()
        )
    )

    if (
        report.get(
            "alignment_counts"
        )
        != expected_alignment_counts
    ):

        report_errors.append(
            "alignment_counts"
        )

    expected_area_counts = dict(
        sorted(
            official_area_counts.items()
        )
    )

    if (
        report.get(
            "official_area_counts"
        )
        != expected_area_counts
    ):

        report_errors.append(
            "official_area_counts"
        )

    expected_out = sorted(
        q["id"]
        for q in current
        if q[
            "utn_official"
        ][
            "alignment"
        ]
        == "out_of_scope"
    )

    if (
        report.get(
            "out_of_scope_ids"
        )
        != expected_out
    ):

        report_errors.append(
            "out_of_scope_ids"
        )

    expected_uncertain = sorted(
        q["id"]
        for q in current
        if q[
            "utn_official"
        ][
            "alignment"
        ]
        == "uncertain"
    )

    if (
        report.get(
            "uncertain_ids"
        )
        != expected_uncertain
    ):

        report_errors.append(
            "uncertain_ids"
        )

    if not report_errors:

        ok(
            "utn_mapping_p2b.json coincide "
            "con el banco actual"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "Informe P2-B inconsistente en: "
            + ", ".join(
                report_errors
            )
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # 20. NO HAY PREGUNTAS NUEVAS TODAVÍA
    # ========================================================

    if (
        len(current) == 180
        and set(current_map)
        == set(baseline_map)
    ):

        ok(
            "P2-B no añadió ni eliminó preguntas"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            "P2-B alteró la población del banco"
        )

        passed = False

    # ========================================================
    # RESULTADO
    # ========================================================

    print()
    print("=" * 72)

    if passed:

        print(
            "RESULTADO: P2-B APROBADO"
        )

        print(
            "Las 180 preguntas fueron mapeadas "
            "contra UTN/FICA 2P2026 sin alterar "
            "el checkpoint P2-A.1."
        )

        print(
            "El banco está listo para analizar "
            "vacíos de cobertura."
        )

        sys.exit(0)

    else:

        print(
            "RESULTADO: P2-B RECHAZADO"
        )

        print(
            "No continuar. Restaurar desde "
            "question_bank_p2a1_backup.json."
        )

        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
