                "      ",
                item,
            )

        if (
            len(
                requirement_errors
            )
            > 20
        ):

            print(
                "      ...",
                len(
                    requirement_errors
                )
                - 20,
                "errores adicionales",
            )

    else:

        ok(
            "T29 Contrato de opción múltiple "
            "y explicaciones correcto."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T30 - COVERAGE RULE Y NOTAS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    contract_text_errors = []

    for spec in specs:

        coverage_rule = str(
            spec.get(
                "coverage_rule",
                ""
            )
        )

        notes = spec.get(
            "generation_notes",
            [],
        )

        combined_notes = " ".join(
            str(
                note
            )
            for note in notes
        )

        if (
            "target_topic_ids"
            not in coverage_rule
        ):

            contract_text_errors.append(
                (
                    spec.get(
                        "spec_id"
                    ),
                    "coverage_rule",
                )
            )

        if (
            "No presentar"
            not in combined_notes
            and
            "no presentar"
            not in combined_notes
        ):

            contract_text_errors.append(
                (
                    spec.get(
                        "spec_id"
                    ),
                    "authenticidad",
                )
            )

        if (
            "ponderación específica"
            not in combined_notes
        ):

            contract_text_errors.append(
                (
                    spec.get(
                        "spec_id"
                    ),
                    "ponderación",
                )
            )

    if contract_text_errors:

        fail(
            "T30 Faltan reglas semánticas "
            "en alguna spec."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T30 Todas las specs exigen cobertura real "
            "y mantienen las restricciones FICA."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T31 - TARGET OCCURRENCES DEL INFORME
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    declared_occurrences = specs_report.get(
        "target_topic_occurrences",
        {},
    )

    reconstructed_occurrences = dict(
        sorted(
            target_occurrences.items()
        )
    )

    if (
        declared_occurrences
        != reconstructed_occurrences
    ):

        fail(
            "T31 target_topic_occurrences "
            "no coincide con las specs."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T31 target_topic_occurrences "
            "reconstruido correctamente."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T32 - SUMMARY DEL INFORME
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    report_summary = specs_report.get(
        "summary",
        {},
    )

    target_distribution = Counter(
        spec.get(
            "target_topic_count"
        )
        for spec in specs
    )

    expected_target_distribution = {
        str(
            key
        ):
            value
        for key, value
        in sorted(
            target_distribution.items()
        )
    }

    summary_errors = []

    if (
        report_summary.get(
            "spec_count"
        )
        != len(
            specs
        )
    ):

        summary_errors.append(
            "spec_count"
        )

    if (
        report_summary.get(
            "clusters_represented"
        )
        != len(
            specs_by_cluster
        )
    ):

        summary_errors.append(
            "clusters_represented"
        )

    if (
        report_summary.get(
            "unique_target_topics"
        )
        != len(
            unique_target_ids
        )
    ):

        summary_errors.append(
            "unique_target_topics"
        )

    if (
        report_summary.get(
            "total_target_assignments"
        )
        != actual_assignments
    ):

        summary_errors.append(
            "total_target_assignments"
        )

    if (
        report_summary.get(
            "repeated_target_assignments"
        )
        != repeated_assignments
    ):

        summary_errors.append(
            "repeated_target_assignments"
        )

    if (
        report_summary.get(
            "max_target_topics_per_spec"
        )
        != max(
            spec.get(
                "target_topic_count"
            )
            for spec in specs
        )
    ):

        summary_errors.append(
            "max_target_topics_per_spec"
        )

    declared_area_summary = {
        area:
            report_summary.get(
                "specs_by_area",
                {},
            ).get(
                area,
                0,
            )
        for area in sorted(
            OFFICIAL_AREAS
        )
    }

    if (
        declared_area_summary
        != EXPECTED_AREA_SPECS
    ):

        summary_errors.append(
            "specs_by_area"
        )

    declared_difficulty = {
        key:
            report_summary.get(
                "specs_by_difficulty",
                {},
            ).get(
                key,
                0,
            )
        for key in EXPECTED_DIFFICULTY
    }

    if (
        declared_difficulty
        != EXPECTED_DIFFICULTY
    ):

        summary_errors.append(
            "specs_by_difficulty"
        )

    declared_cognitive = {
        key:
            report_summary.get(
                "specs_by_cognitive_target",
                {},
            ).get(
                key,
                0,
            )
        for key in EXPECTED_COGNITIVE
    }

    if (
        declared_cognitive
        != EXPECTED_COGNITIVE
    ):

        summary_errors.append(
            "specs_by_cognitive_target"
        )

    if (
        report_summary.get(
            "target_count_distribution"
        )
        != expected_target_distribution
    ):

        summary_errors.append(
            "target_count_distribution"
        )

    if summary_errors:

        fail(
            "T32 summary inconsistente: "
            + ", ".join(
                summary_errors
            )
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T32 Summary P2-C3 coincide "
            "con las 76 specs reales."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T33 - GENERATION CONTRACT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    contract = specs_report.get(
        "generation_contract",
        {},
    )

    contract_ok = (
        contract.get(
            "question_count"
        )
        == EXPECTED_SEED_SPECS
        and
        contract.get(
            "target_topic_count"
        )
        == EXPECTED_ZERO_TOPICS
        and
        contract.get(
            "generated_items_are_official_utn_questions"
        )
        is False
        and
        contract.get(
            "generated_items_modify_original_bank"
        )
        is False
        and
        contract.get(
            "intended_output_bank"
        )
        == "data/reinforcement_bank.json"
        and
        contract.get(
            "adaptive_followup_included"
        )
        is False
    )

    if not contract_ok:

        fail(
            "T33 generation_contract inconsistente."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T33 Contrato correcto: 76 ítems futuros "
            "en reinforcement_bank separado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T34 - CAMPOS OBLIGATORIOS NO VACÍOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    required_nonempty_fields = [
        "spec_id",
        "spec_version",
        "stage",
        "origin",
        "intended_bank",
        "area",
        "unit",
        "cluster",
        "cluster_priority",
        "primary_topic_id",
        "primary_topic_label",
        "difficulty",
        "cognitive_target",
        "learning_role",
        "design_intent",
        "coverage_rule",
    ]

    empty_required = []

    for spec in specs:

        for field in required_nonempty_fields:

            value = spec.get(
                field
            )

            if (
                value is None
                or
                (
                    isinstance(
                        value,
                        str,
                    )
                    and not value.strip()
                )
            ):

                empty_required.append(
                    (
                        spec.get(
                            "spec_id"
                        ),
                        field,
                    )
                )

    if empty_required:

        fail(
            "T34 Existen campos obligatorios vacíos."
        )

        for item in empty_required[:20]:

            print(
                "      ",
                item,
            )

    else:

        ok(
            "T34 Ninguna spec tiene campos "
            "obligatorios vacíos."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T35 - NINGUNA SPEC ALTERA EL BANCO ORIGINAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    original_bank_risk = []

    for spec in specs:

        if (
            spec.get(
                "intended_bank"
            )
            != "reinforcement_bank"
            or
            spec.get(
                "origin"
            )
            != "generated_reinforcement_spec"
            or
            spec.get(
                "official_utn_question"
            )
            is not False
        ):

            original_bank_risk.append(
                spec.get(
                    "spec_id"
                )
            )

    if original_bank_risk:

        fail(
            "T35 Alguna spec podría mezclarse "
            "con el banco original."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T35 Las specs permanecen separadas "
            "del banco original de 180 preguntas."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # FINAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    finish()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

checks = 0
errors = []
warnings = []


def ok(message):

    global checks

    checks += 1

    print(
        f"[OK] {message}"
    )


def fail(message):

    errors.append(
        message
    )

    print(
        f"[ERROR] {message}"
    )


def warn(message):

    warnings.append(
        message
    )

    print(
        f"[WARN] {message}"
    )


# ============================================================
# UTILIDADES
# ============================================================

def load_json(
    path: Path,
):

    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def sha256_file(
    path: Path,
):

    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open(
        "rb"
    ) as handle:

        while True:

            chunk = handle.read(
                1024 * 1024
            )

            if not chunk:

                break

            digest.update(
                chunk
            )

    return digest.hexdigest().upper()


def finish():

    print()
    print("=" * 72)
    print(
        "RESUMEN DE VALIDACIÓN P2-D0"
    )
    print("=" * 72)

    print(
        f"Checks aprobados : {checks}"
    )

    print(
        f"Errores          : {len(errors)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Warnings         : {len(warnings)}"
    )

    if warnings:

        print()
        print(
            "WARNINGS"
        )
        print(
            "-" * 72
        )

        for item in warnings:

            print(
                f"- {item}"
            )

    if errors:

        print()
        print(
            "ERRORES"
        )
        print(
            "-" * 72
        )

        for item in errors:

            print(
                f"- {item}"
            )

        print()
        print(
            "RESULTADO: P2-D0 NO APROBADO"
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    print()
    print(
        "[OK] Checkpoint P2-C3 preservado."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Banco original preservado."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Schema P2-D0 coherente."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] reinforcement_bank comienza vacío."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Material generado separado del banco original."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Ningún contenido se declara oficial UTN."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] P2-D1 exige lote piloto antes de generación completa."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "RESULTADO: P2-D0 APROBADO"
    )

    sys.exit(0)


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main():

    print()
    print("=" * 72)
    print(
        "VALIDACIÓN INDEPENDIENTE P2-D0"
    )
    print("=" * 72)
    print()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T01 - ARCHIVOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    required_files = [
        QUESTION_BANK,
        QUESTION_BANK_BACKUP,
        SYLLABUS_FILE,
        SCHEMA_FILE,
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
        P2C3_SPECS,
        P2C3_BACKUP,
        CONTRACT_JSON,
        CONTRACT_TXT,
    ]

    missing = [
        path
        for path in required_files
        if not path.exists()
    ]

    if missing:

        for path in missing:

            fail(
                f"T01 No existe: {path}"
            )

        finish()

    ok(
        "T01 Todos los archivos requeridos existen."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T02 - JSON LEGIBLES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:

        question_bank = load_json(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )

        question_backup = load_json(
            QUESTION_BANK_BACKUP
        )

        syllabus = load_json(
            SYLLABUS_FILE
        )

        schema = load_json(
            SCHEMA_FILE
        )

        reinforcement = load_json(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )

        specs_report = load_json(
            P2C3_SPECS
        )

        specs_backup = load_json(
            P2C3_BACKUP
        )

        contract = load_json(
            CONTRACT_JSON
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        fail(
            f"T02 Algún JSON no puede leerse: {exc}"
        )

        finish()

    ok(
        "T02 Todos los JSON se leen correctamente."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T03 - CHECKPOINT P2-C3 HASH
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    actual_backup_hash = sha256_file(
        P2C3_BACKUP
    )

    if (
        actual_backup_hash
        != EXPECTED_P2C3_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "T03 El checkpoint P2-C3 no coincide "
            "con el SHA-256 aprobado. "
            f"Actual={actual_backup_hash}"
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T03 SHA-256 del checkpoint P2-C3 correcto."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T04 - P2-C3 ACTIVO = CHECKPOINT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    active_specs_hash = sha256_file(
        P2C3_SPECS
    )

    if (
        active_specs_hash
        != actual_backup_hash
    ):

        fail(
            "T04 p2c3_seed_specs.json difiere "
            "del checkpoint aprobado."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T04 P2-C3 activo es idéntico al checkpoint."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T05 - P2-C3 ESTRUCTURAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    specs = specs_report.get(
        "specs",
        [],
    )

    summary = specs_report.get(
        "summary",
        {},
    )

    if (
        specs_report.get(
            "stage"
        )
        != "P2-C3"
        or
        specs_report.get(
            "spec_version"
        )
        != EXPECTED_SPEC_VERSION
        or
        len(
            specs
        )
        != EXPECTED_SPECS
        or
        summary.get(
            "unique_target_topics"
        )
        != EXPECTED_TARGET_TOPICS
    ):

        fail(
            "T05 El origen P2-C3 no conserva "
            "76 specs / 142 objetivos."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T05 Fuente P2-C3 = 76 specs y 142 objetivos."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T06 - IDS P2-C3
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    actual_spec_ids = [
        spec.get(
            "spec_id"
        )
        for spec in specs
    ]

    expected_spec_ids = [
        f"SEED-{index:03d}"
        for index in range(
            1,
            EXPECTED_SPECS + 1,
        )
    ]

    if (
        actual_spec_ids
        != expected_spec_ids
    ):

        fail(
            "T06 Los spec_id fuente no son "
            "SEED-001..SEED-076."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T06 Los 76 spec_id fuente son secuenciales."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T07 - TEMARIO FICA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    area_count = len(
        syllabus.get(
            "areas",
            [],
        )
    )

    if area_count != 5:

        fail(
            "T07 El registro FICA no contiene "
            "exactamente 5 áreas."
        )

    else:

        area_names = [
            area.get(
                "name"
            )
            for area in syllabus.get(
                "areas",
                [],
            )
        ]

        if (
            set(
                area_names
            )
            != set(
                OFFICIAL_AREAS
            )
        ):

            fail(
                "T07 Las áreas del registro FICA "
                "no son las cinco esperadas."
            )

        else:

            ok(
                "T07 Registro canónico mantiene "
                "las cinco áreas FICA."
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T08 - BANCO ORIGINAL = 180
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        not isinstance(
            question_bank,
            list,
        )
        or
        len(
            question_bank
        )
        != EXPECTED_ORIGINAL_QUESTIONS
    ):

        fail(
            "T08 question_bank.json no contiene "
            "exactamente 180 preguntas."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T08 question_bank.json conserva 180 preguntas."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T09 - BACKUP ORIGINAL = 180
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        not isinstance(
            question_backup,
            list,
        )
        or
        len(
            question_backup
        )
        != EXPECTED_ORIGINAL_QUESTIONS
    ):

        fail(
            "T09 question_bank_p2b_backup.json "
            "no contiene 180 preguntas."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T09 Checkpoint P2-B contiene 180 preguntas."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T10 - BANCO ORIGINAL IDÉNTICO A P2-B
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    original_hash = sha256_file(
        QUESTION_BANK
    )

    backup_hash = sha256_file(
        QUESTION_BANK_BACKUP
    )

    if original_hash != backup_hash:

        fail(
            "T10 question_bank.json fue modificado "
            "desde el checkpoint P2-B."
        )

        print(
            "      activo :",
            original_hash,
        )

        print(
            "      backup :",
            backup_hash,
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T10 Banco original idéntico "
            "al checkpoint P2-B."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T11 - SCHEMA VERSION
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        schema.get(
            "schema_version"
        )
        != EXPECTED_SCHEMA_VERSION
    ):

        fail(
            "T11 schema_version incorrecta."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T11 schema_version P2-D correcta."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T12 - IDENTIDAD DEL SCHEMA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        schema.get(
            "file"
        )
        != "data/reinforcement_bank.json"
        or
        schema.get(
            "must_remain_separate_from"
        )
        != "data/question_bank.json"
        or
        schema.get(
            "original_question_bank_count"
        )
        != 180
        or
        schema.get(
            "seed_target_count"
        )
        != 76
    ):

        fail(
            "T12 Metadata principal del schema incorrecta."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T12 Schema declara separación 180 + 76."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T13 - TOP LEVEL STRUCTURE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    expected_top_structure = {
        "schema_version":
            "string",

        "bank_version":
            "string",

        "stage":
            "string",

        "origin":
            "string",

        "official_utn_question_bank":
            "boolean",

        "source_specs":
            "string",

        "items":
            "array",
    }

    if (
        schema.get(
            "top_level_structure"
        )
        != expected_top_structure
    ):

        fail(
            "T13 top_level_structure del schema incorrecta."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T13 Estructura superior del banco definida."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T14 - TOP LEVEL CONSTRAINTS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    constraints = schema.get(
        "top_level_constraints",
        {},
    )

    top_constraints_ok = (
        constraints.get(
            "schema_version"
        )
        == EXPECTED_SCHEMA_VERSION
        and
        constraints.get(
            "origin"
        )
        == "generated_reinforcement"
        and
        constraints.get(
            "official_utn_question_bank"
        )
        is False
        and
        constraints.get(
            "source_specs"
        )
        == "results/p2c3_seed_specs.json"
        and
        constraints.get(
            "items_unique_by_id"
        )
        is True
        and
        constraints.get(
            "items_unique_by_source_spec_id"
        )
        is True
        and
        constraints.get(
            "maximum_seed_items"
        )
        == 76
    )

    if not top_constraints_ok:

        fail(
            "T14 Restricciones superiores incorrectas."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T14 Restricciones superiores correctas."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T15 - REQUIRED ITEM FIELDS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    item_contract = schema.get(
        "item_contract",
        {},
    )

    if (
        item_contract.get(
            "required_fields"
        )
        != EXPECTED_REQUIRED_ITEM_FIELDS
    ):

        fail(
            "T15 Lista de campos obligatorios "
            "del ítem incorrecta."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T15 Contrato exige los 22 campos "
            "principales del ítem."
        )

    fields = item_contract.get(
        "fields",
        {},
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T16 - IDENTIDAD DEL ÍTEM
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    identity_ok = (
        fields.get(
            "id",
            {},
        ).get(
            "pattern"
        )
        == "^R-[0-9]{3}$"
        and
        fields.get(
            "schema_version",
            {},
        ).get(
            "const"
        )
        == EXPECTED_SCHEMA_VERSION
        and
        fields.get(
            "origin",
            {},
        ).get(
            "const"
        )
        == "generated_reinforcement"
        and
        fields.get(
            "source_spec_id",
            {},
        ).get(
            "pattern"
        )
        == "^SEED-[0-9]{3}$"
        and
        fields.get(
            "official_utn_question",
            {},
        ).get(
            "const"
        )
        is False
    )

    if not identity_ok:

        fail(
            "T16 Contrato de identidad "
            "del ítem incorrecto."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T16 Identidad R-xxx / SEED-xxx "
            "y no-oficial correcta."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T17 - ÁREAS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        fields.get(
            "area",
            {},
        ).get(
            "allowed"
        )
        != OFFICIAL_AREAS
    ):

        fail(
            "T17 Áreas permitidas del schema incorrectas."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T17 Solo se permiten las cinco áreas FICA."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T18 - TARGET TOPICS 1..4
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    target_contract = fields.get(
        "target_topic_ids",
        {},
    )

    target_ok = (
        target_contract.get(
            "type"
        )
        == "array"
        and
        target_contract.get(
            "items"
        )
        == "string"
        and
        target_contract.get(
            "min_items"
        )
        == 1
        and
        target_contract.get(
            "max_items"
        )
        == 4
        and
        target_contract.get(
            "unique"
        )
        is True
    )

    if not target_ok:

        fail(
            "T18 target_topic_ids no exige "
            "entre 1 y 4 objetivos únicos."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T18 Cada pregunta admite 1..4 "
            "subtemas oficiales únicos."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T19 - PERFIL PEDAGÓGICO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    pedagogy_ok = (
        fields.get(
            "difficulty",
            {},
        ).get(
            "allowed"
        )
        == [
            "foundation",
            "standard",
            "transfer",
        ]
        and
        fields.get(
            "cognitive_target",
            {},
        ).get(
            "allowed"
        )
        == [
            "concept_identification",
            "direct_application",
            "transfer_and_integration",
        ]
        and
        fields.get(
            "learning_role",
            {},
        ).get(
            "const"
        )
        == "coverage_seed"
    )

    if not pedagogy_ok:

        fail(
            "T19 Perfil pedagógico del schema incorrecto."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T19 Perfiles pedagógicos P2-C3 preservados."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T20 - STEM AUTÓNOMO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    stem_contract = fields.get(
        "stem",
        {},
    )

    if (
        stem_contract.get(
            "type"
        )
        != "string"
        or
        stem_contract.get(
            "nonempty"
        )
        is not True
    ):

        fail(
            "T20 El enunciado no está obligado "
            "a ser texto no vacío."
        )

    else:

        description = str(
            stem_contract.get(
                "description",
                ""
            )
        ).lower()

        if (
            "autónomo"
            not in description
            or
            "pdf"
            not in description
        ):

            fail(
                "T20 No se documenta independencia "
                "del PDF original."
            )

        else:

            ok(
                "T20 Enunciado autónomo y sin "
                "dependencia del PDF."
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T21 - OPCIONES 4 O 5
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    choices_contract = fields.get(
        "choices",
        {},
    )

    choices_ok = (
        choices_contract.get(
            "type"
        )
        == "object"
        and
        choices_contract.get(
            "allowed_keys"
        )
        == [
            "A",
            "B",
            "C",
            "D",
            "E",
        ]
        and
        choices_contract.get(
            "minimum_present"
        )
        == 4
        and
        choices_contract.get(
            "maximum_present"
        )
        == 5
        and
        choices_contract.get(
            "all_values_nonempty"
        )
        is True
    )

    if not choices_ok:

        fail(
            "T21 Contrato de alternativas incorrecto."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T21 El ítem exige 4 o 5 alternativas."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T22 - RESPUESTA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    answer_contract = fields.get(
        "answer",
        {},
    )

    if (
        answer_contract.get(
            "allowed"
        )
        != [
            "A",
            "B",
            "C",
            "D",
            "E",
        ]
    ):

        fail(
            "T22 Contrato de respuesta incorrecto."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T22 Respuesta limitada a A-E."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T23 - EXPLICACIÓN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    explanation_ok = (
        fields.get(
            "explanation",
            {},
        ).get(
            "nonempty"
        )
        is True
        and
        fields.get(
            "explanation_layers",
            {},
        ).get(
            "required_keys"
        )
        == EXPECTED_EXPLANATION_LAYERS
        and
        fields.get(
            "explanation_layers",
            {},
        ).get(
            "all_values_nonempty"
        )
        is True
    )

    if not explanation_ok:

        fail(
            "T23 Contrato de explicaciones incompleto."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T23 Explicación breve + cuatro "
            "capas pedagógicas obligatorias."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T24 - DISTRACTORES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    distractors = fields.get(
        "distractor_analysis",
        {},
    ).get(
        "requirements",
        {},
    )

    distractor_ok = (
        distractors.get(
            "incorrect_choices_only"
        )
        is True
        and
        distractors.get(
            "all_incorrect_choices_documented"
        )
        is True
        and
        distractors.get(
            "all_descriptions_nonempty"
        )
        is True
    )

    if not distractor_ok:

        fail(
            "T24 Contrato diagnóstico "
            "de distractores incompleto."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T24 Todos los distractores incorrectos "
            "deben quedar diagnosticados."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T25 - QUALITY
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    quality_contract = fields.get(
        "quality",
        {},
    )

    if (
        quality_contract.get(
            "required_keys"
        )
        != EXPECTED_QUALITY_KEYS
    ):

        fail(
            "T25 Campos de quality incorrectos."
        )

    else:

        quality_fields = quality_contract.get(
            "fields",
            {},
        )

        quality_ok = (
            quality_fields.get(
                "status",
                {},
            ).get(
                "allowed"
            )
            == [
                "draft",
                "validated",
                "rejected",
            ]
            and
            quality_fields.get(
                "mastery_eligible",
                {},
            ).get(
                "type"
            )
            == "boolean"
            and
            quality_fields.get(
                "coverage_verified",
                {},
            ).get(
                "type"
            )
            == "boolean"
            and
            quality_fields.get(
                "answer_verified",
                {},
            ).get(
                "type"
            )
            == "boolean"
            and
            quality_fields.get(
                "ambiguity_checked",
                {},
            ).get(
                "type"
            )
            == "boolean"
            and
            quality_fields.get(
                "distractors_checked",
                {},
            ).get(
                "type"
            )
            == "boolean"
            and
            quality_fields.get(
                "explanation_checked",
                {},
            ).get(
                "type"
            )
            == "boolean"
        )

        if not quality_ok:

            fail(
                "T25 Verificaciones quality incorrectas."
            )

        else:

            ok(
                "T25 Quality exige revisión completa "
                "antes de dominio."
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T26 - MASTERY ELIGIBLE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    validation_rule = str(
        quality_contract.get(
            "validation_rule",
            ""
        )
    )

    if (
        "mastery_eligible"
        not in validation_rule
        or
        "status=validated"
        not in validation_rule
        or
        "todas las verificaciones"
        not in validation_rule
    ):

        fail(
            "T26 Regla de mastery_eligible incompleta."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T26 mastery_eligible requiere "
            "validación completa."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T27 - TRAZABILIDAD
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    generation_contract = fields.get(
        "generation",
        {},
    )

    generation_fields = generation_contract.get(
        "fields",
        {},
    )

    generation_ok = (
        generation_contract.get(
            "required_keys"
        )
        == EXPECTED_GENERATION_KEYS
        and
        generation_fields.get(
            "generation_stage",
            {},
        ).get(
            "const"
        )
        == "P2-D"
        and
        generation_fields.get(
            "generator_type",
            {},
        ).get(
            "const"
        )
        == "synthetic_reinforcement"
        and
        generation_fields.get(
            "human_review_required",
            {},
        ).get(
            "const"
        )
        is True
    )

    if not generation_ok:

        fail(
            "T27 Contrato de trazabilidad incorrecto."
        )

    else:

        required_sources = generation_fields.get(
            "source_material",
            {},
        ).get(
            "required_values",
            [],
        )

        if (
            required_sources
            != [
                "UTN FICA 2P2026 official syllabus",
                "P2-C3 seed specification",
            ]
        ):

            fail(
                "T27 Fuentes de generación incorrectas."
            )

        else:

            ok(
                "T27 Cada pregunta requiere "
                "trazabilidad UTN + spec P2-C3."
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T28 - REGLAS ENTRE CAMPOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    cross_rules = item_contract.get(
        "cross_field_rules",
        [],
    )

    cross_text = " ".join(
        str(
            rule
        )
        for rule in cross_rules
    ).lower()

    required_rule_fragments = [
        "primary_topic_id",
        "secondary_topic_ids",
        "answer",
        "distractor_analysis",
        "source_spec_id",
        "difficulty",
        "cognitive_target",
        "target_topic_ids",
        "mención superficial",
        "simulacros pdf",
        "banco original",
        "admisión utn",
    ]

    missing_rule_fragments = [
        fragment
        for fragment in required_rule_fragments
        if fragment.lower() not in cross_text
    ]

    if missing_rule_fragments:

        fail(
            "T28 Faltan reglas cruzadas: "
            + ", ".join(
                missing_rule_fragments
            )
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T28 Reglas cruzadas de cobertura, "
            "respuesta y autenticidad presentes."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T29 - BANCO VACÍO: CLAVES EXACTAS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    expected_bank_keys = {
        "schema_version",
        "bank_version",
        "stage",
        "origin",
        "official_utn_question_bank",
        "source_specs",
        "items",
    }

    if (
        set(
            reinforcement.keys()
        )
        != expected_bank_keys
    ):

        fail(
            "T29 reinforcement_bank.json tiene "
            "claves superiores inesperadas."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T29 Estructura superior del banco vacío correcta."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T30 - BANCO VACÍO: IDENTIDAD
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    bank_identity_ok = (
        reinforcement.get(
            "schema_version"
        )
        == EXPECTED_SCHEMA_VERSION
        and
        reinforcement.get(
            "bank_version"
        )
        == EXPECTED_BANK_VERSION
        and
        reinforcement.get(
            "stage"
        )
        == "P2-D0"
        and
        reinforcement.get(
            "origin"
        )
        == "generated_reinforcement"
        and
        reinforcement.get(
            "official_utn_question_bank"
        )
        is False
        and
        reinforcement.get(
            "source_specs"
        )
        == "results/p2c3_seed_specs.json"
    )

    if not bank_identity_ok:

        fail(
            "T30 Identidad del banco vacío incorrecta."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T30 Banco identificado como "
            "refuerzo sintético no oficial."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T31 - BANCO VACÍO REALMENTE VACÍO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    items = reinforcement.get(
        "items"
    )

    if (
        not isinstance(
            items,
            list,
        )
        or
        len(
            items
        )
        != 0
    ):

        fail(
            "T31 P2-D0 debe contener exactamente "
            "0 preguntas."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T31 reinforcement_bank contiene 0 preguntas."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T32 - CONTRACT REPORT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    contract_source = contract.get(
        "source_specs",
        {},
    )

    contract_bank = contract.get(
        "reinforcement_bank",
        {},
    )

    contract_ok = (
        contract.get(
            "stage"
        )
        == "P2-D0"
        and
        contract.get(
            "schema_version"
        )
        == EXPECTED_SCHEMA_VERSION
        and
        contract.get(
            "status"
        )
        == "contract_created"
        and
        contract_source.get(
            "file"
        )
        == "results/p2c3_seed_specs.json"
        and
        contract_source.get(
            "spec_count"
        )
        == 76
        and
        contract_source.get(
            "unique_target_topics"
        )
        == 142
        and
        contract_bank.get(
            "current_item_count"
        )
        == 0
        and
        contract_bank.get(
            "seed_capacity"
        )
        == 76
        and
        contract_bank.get(
            "separate_from_original_bank"
        )
        is True
        and
        contract_bank.get(
            "original_bank_question_count"
        )
        == 180
        and
        contract_bank.get(
            "official_utn_question_bank"
        )
        is False
    )

    if not contract_ok:

        fail(
            "T32 Informe contractual JSON inconsistente."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T32 Informe JSON coincide con "
            "180 originales + 0 reinforcement."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T33 - ARCHIVOS DECLARADOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    files_created = contract.get(
        "files_created",
        {},
    )

    if (
        files_created.get(
            "schema"
        )
        != "data/reinforcement_bank_schema.json"
        or
        files_created.get(
            "empty_bank"
        )
        != "data/reinforcement_bank.json"
    ):

        fail(
            "T33 El informe no referencia "
            "los archivos P2-D0 correctos."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T33 Rutas contractuales de P2-D0 correctas."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T34 - P2-D1 DEBE SER PILOTO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    next_stage = contract.get(
        "next_stage",
        {},
    )

    if (
        next_stage.get(
            "name"
        )
        != "P2-D1"
        or
        next_stage.get(
            "full_generation_allowed"
        )
        is not False
        or
        next_stage.get(
            "pilot_required_first"
        )
        is not True
    ):

        fail(
            "T34 P2-D0 no obliga a ejecutar "
            "un piloto antes de las 76 preguntas."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T34 P2-D1 queda restringido "
            "a lote piloto primero."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T35 - INFORME TXT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:

        txt = CONTRACT_TXT.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        fail(
            f"T35 No se pudo leer el informe TXT: {exc}"
        )

        txt = ""

    required_txt_fragments = [
        "P2-D0 - CONTRATO DEL REINFORCEMENT BANK",
        "Specs fuente         : 76",
        "Objetivos oficiales  : 142",
        "Banco original       : 180 preguntas",
        "Banco reinforcement  : 0 preguntas",
        "data/reinforcement_bank_schema.json",
        "data/reinforcement_bank.json",
        "mastery_eligible",
        "nunca se presentan como preguntas oficiales UTN",
        "P2-D1",
        "lote piloto",
    ]

    missing_txt = [
        fragment
        for fragment in required_txt_fragments
        if fragment not in txt
    ]

    if missing_txt:

        fail(
            "T35 Informe TXT incompleto: "
            + " | ".join(
                missing_txt
            )
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T35 Informe TXT documenta "
            "las restricciones esenciales."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T36 - NO EXISTEN PREGUNTAS R-xxx TODAVÍA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    serialized_bank = json.dumps(
        reinforcement,
        ensure_ascii=False,
    )

    if (
        '"id": "R-'
        in serialized_bank
    ):

        fail(
            "T36 Se detectó al menos un ítem R-xxx "
            "antes de P2-D1."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T36 P2-D0 todavía no contiene "
            "preguntas generadas."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T37 - NADA OFICIAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        reinforcement.get(
            "official_utn_question_bank"
        )
        is not False
        or
        fields.get(
            "official_utn_question",
            {},
        ).get(
            "const"
        )
        is not False
    ):

        fail(
            "T37 Algún contrato podría presentar "
            "material generado como oficial UTN."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T37 Banco e ítems generados "
            "se declaran explícitamente no oficiales."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T38 - SEPARACIÓN FÍSICA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        QUESTION_BANK.resolve()
        == REINFORCEMENT_BANK.resolve()
    ):

        fail(
            "T38 Banco original y reinforcement "
            "apuntan al mismo archivo."
        )

    elif (
        schema.get(
            "must_remain_separate_from"
        )
        != "data/question_bank.json"
    ):

        fail(
            "T38 El contrato no exige separación física."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T38 Banco original y reinforcement "
            "son archivos separados."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # FINAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    finish()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
