checks = 0
errors = []
warnings = []


def ok(message):

    global checks

    checks += 1

    print(
        f"[OK] {message}"
    )


def fail(message):

    errors.append(
        message
    )

    print(
        f"[ERROR] {message}"
    )


def warn(message):

    warnings.append(
        message
    )

    print(
        f"[WARN] {message}"
    )


# ============================================================
# UTILIDADES
# ============================================================

def load_json(path: Path):

    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def sha256_file(path: Path):

    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open("rb") as handle:

        while True:

            chunk = handle.read(
                1024 * 1024
            )

            if not chunk:
                break

            digest.update(chunk)

    return digest.hexdigest().upper()


def normalize(text):

    text = str(text).replace("Δ", "delta").replace("δ", "delta")

    text = unicodedata.normalize(
        "NFD",
        text,
    )

    text = "".join(
        char
        for char in text
        if unicodedata.category(char)
        != "Mn"
    )

    return text.casefold()


def item_full_text(item):

    pieces = [
        item.get(
            "stem",
            "",
        ),
        item.get(
            "explanation",
            "",
        ),
    ]

    pieces.extend(
        item.get(
            "choices",
            {},
        ).values()
    )

    pieces.extend(
        item.get(
            "explanation_layers",
            {},
        ).values()
    )

    pieces.extend(
        item.get(
            "distractor_analysis",
            {},
        ).values()
    )

    return normalize(
        " ".join(
            str(piece)
            for piece in pieces
        )
    )


def finish():

    print()
    print("=" * 72)
    print(
        "RESUMEN DE VALIDACIÓN P2-D2"
    )
    print("=" * 72)

    print(
        f"Checks aprobados : {checks}"
    )

    print(
        f"Errores          : {len(errors)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Warnings         : {len(warnings)}"
    )

    if warnings:

        print()
        print(
            "WARNINGS"
        )
        print(
            "-" * 72
        )

        for item in warnings:

            print(
                f"- {item}"
            )

    if errors:

        print()
        print(
            "ERRORES"
        )
        print(
            "-" * 72
        )

        for item in errors:

            print(
                f"- {item}"
            )

        print()
        print(
            "RESULTADO: P2-D2 NO APROBADO"
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    print()
    print(
        "[OK] 8 borradores preservados."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] 20 targets oficiales conservados."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Respuestas verificadas independientemente."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Cobertura conceptual comprobada."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Distractores estructuralmente válidos."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Explicaciones pedagógicas presentes."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] No se detectaron dependencias del PDF."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] reinforcement_bank continúa vacío."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] question_bank continúa con 180 preguntas."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Los borradores siguen sin habilitar mastery."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "RESULTADO: P2-D2 APROBADO"
    )

    sys.exit(0)


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main():

    print()
    print("=" * 72)
    print(
        "VALIDACIÓN INDEPENDIENTE P2-D2"
    )
    print("=" * 72)
    print()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T01 - ARCHIVOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    required = [
        QUESTION_BANK,
        QUESTION_BANK_P2B_BACKUP,
        REINFORCEMENT_SCHEMA,
        REINFORCEMENT_SCHEMA_P2D0_BACKUP,
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK_P2D0_BACKUP,
        P2D0_CONTRACT,
        P2D0_CONTRACT_BACKUP,
        P2C3_SPECS,
        P2C3_BACKUP,
        P2D1_MANIFEST,
        P2D1_BACKUP,
        P2D2_DRAFTS,
        P2D2_TXT,
    ]

    missing = [
        path
        for path in required
        if not path.exists()
    ]

    if missing:

        for path in missing:

            fail(
                f"T01 No existe: {path}"
            )

        finish()

    ok(
        "T01 Todos los archivos requeridos existen."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T02 - JSON
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:

        question_bank = load_json(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )

        schema = load_json(
            REINFORCEMENT_SCHEMA
        )

        reinforcement = load_json(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )

        p2d1 = load_json(
            P2D1_MANIFEST
        )

        drafts = load_json(
            P2D2_DRAFTS
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        fail(
            f"T02 JSON inválido: {exc}"
        )

        finish()

    ok(
        "T02 JSON principales legibles."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T03 - P2-C3
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(P2C3_BACKUP)
        != P2C3_SHA256
        or
        sha256_file(P2C3_SPECS)
        != P2C3_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "T03 Checkpoint P2-C3 alterado."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T03 Checkpoint P2-C3 preservado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T04 - SCHEMA P2-D0
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_SCHEMA_P2D0_BACKUP
        )
        != P2D0_SCHEMA_SHA256
        or
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_SCHEMA
        )
        != P2D0_SCHEMA_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "T04 Schema P2-D0 alterado."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T04 Schema P2-D0 preservado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T05 - BANCO P2-D0
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK_P2D0_BACKUP
        )
        != P2D0_BANK_SHA256
        or
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )
        != P2D0_BANK_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "T05 reinforcement_bank cambió."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T05 reinforcement_bank continúa "
            "idéntico al checkpoint vacío."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T06 - CONTRACT P2-D0
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2D0_CONTRACT_BACKUP
        )
        != P2D0_CONTRACT_SHA256
        or
        sha256_file(
            P2D0_CONTRACT
        )
        != P2D0_CONTRACT_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "T06 Contrato P2-D0 alterado."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T06 Contrato P2-D0 preservado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T07 - P2-D1
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2D1_BACKUP
        )
        != P2D1_MANIFEST_SHA256
        or
        sha256_file(
            P2D1_MANIFEST
        )
        != P2D1_MANIFEST_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "T07 Checkpoint P2-D1 alterado."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T07 Checkpoint P2-D1 preservado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T08 - BANCO ORIGINAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )
        != sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK_P2B_BACKUP
        )
    ):

        fail(
            "T08 question_bank difiere "
            "del checkpoint P2-B."
        )

    elif (
        not isinstance(
            question_bank,
            list,
        )
        or len(question_bank) != 180
    ):

        fail(
            "T08 question_bank no contiene 180 preguntas."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T08 Banco original intacto: 180 preguntas."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T09 - REINFORCEMENT VACÍO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        reinforcement.get(
            "items"
        )
        != []
    ):

        fail(
            "T09 reinforcement_bank debería "
            "seguir con 0 preguntas."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T09 reinforcement_bank sigue vacío."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T10 - IDENTIDAD P2-D2
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        drafts.get(
            "stage"
        )
        != "P2-D2"
        or
        drafts.get(
            "draft_version"
        )
        != EXPECTED_DRAFT_VERSION
        or
        drafts.get(
            "status"
        )
        != "drafts_authored_pending_validation"
    ):

        fail(
            "T10 Identidad P2-D2 incorrecta."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T10 Paquete identificado como P2-D2."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T11 - NO ESCRITURA A BANCOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        drafts.get(
            "writes_to_reinforcement_bank"
        )
        is not False
        or
        drafts.get(
            "writes_to_original_bank"
        )
        is not False
        or
        drafts.get(
            "official_utn_questions"
        )
        is not False
    ):

        fail(
            "T11 Alcance de seguridad incorrecto."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T11 P2-D2 no escribe bancos "
            "ni declara preguntas oficiales."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T12 - VALIDATION STATE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    validation_state = drafts.get(
        "validation_state",
        {},
    )

    pending_fields = [
        "independent_validation_pending",
        "content_validation_pending",
        "answer_validation_pending",
        "coverage_validation_pending",
        "ambiguity_validation_pending",
        "distractor_validation_pending",
        "explanation_validation_pending",
    ]

    if (
        validation_state.get(
            "structural_self_check"
        )
        is not True
        or
        validation_state.get(
            "bank_insertion_allowed"
        )
        is not False
        or
        any(
            validation_state.get(field)
            is not True
            for field in pending_fields
        )
    ):

        fail(
            "T12 Estado previo de validación incorrecto."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T12 Borradores permanecen pendientes "
            "de validación independiente."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T13 - ITEMS = 8
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    items = drafts.get(
        "items",
        [],
    )

    if len(items) != 8:

        fail(
            f"T13 Hay {len(items)} borradores; "
            "se esperaban 8."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T13 Existen exactamente 8 borradores."
        )

    item_lookup = {
        item.get(
            "id"
        ):
            item
        for item in items
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T14 - IDS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    ids = {
        item.get(
            "id"
        )
        for item in items
    }

    if ids != EXPECTED_IDS:

        fail(
            "T14 IDs piloto incorrectos."
        )

    elif len(ids) != len(items):

        fail(
            "T14 Hay IDs duplicados."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T14 Los 8 IDs R-xxx son correctos y únicos."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T15 - SOURCE SPECS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    source_ids = {
        item.get(
            "source_spec_id"
        )
        for item in items
    }

    if source_ids != EXPECTED_SPEC_IDS:

        fail(
            "T15 source_spec_id incorrectos."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T15 Las 8 source specs coinciden con P2-D1."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T16 - MAPPING R -> SEED
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    mapping_errors = []

    for item_id, source_spec in EXPECTED_MAPPING.items():

        item = item_lookup.get(
            item_id,
            {},
        )

        if (
            item.get(
                "source_spec_id"
            )
            != source_spec
        ):

            mapping_errors.append(
                item_id
            )

    if mapping_errors:

        fail(
            "T16 Mapeo R-xxx -> SEED-xxx incorrecto."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T16 Mapeo R-xxx -> SEED-xxx correcto."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T17 - SCHEMA REQUIRED FIELDS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    required_fields = schema.get(
        "item_contract",
        {},
    ).get(
        "required_fields",
        [],
    )

    if len(required_fields) != 22:

        fail(
            "T17 Schema no contiene los "
            "22 campos requeridos."
        )

    else:

        missing_required = []

        for item in items:

            missing_for_item = [
                field
                for field in required_fields
                if field not in item
            ]

            if missing_for_item:

                missing_required.append(
                    (
                        item.get("id"),
                        missing_for_item,
                    )
                )

        if missing_required:

            fail(
                "T17 Algún borrador carece "
                "de campos obligatorios."
            )

        else:

            ok(
                "T17 Los 8 borradores contienen "
                "los 22 campos obligatorios."
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T18 - METADATA VS P2-D1
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    manifest_lookup = {
        item.get(
            "planned_item_id"
        ):
            item
        for item in p2d1.get(
            "selected_specs",
            [],
        )
    }

    metadata_fields = [
        "area",
        "unit",
        "cluster",
        "primary_topic_id",
        "secondary_topic_ids",
        "target_topic_ids",
        "difficulty",
        "cognitive_target",
        "learning_role",
    ]

    metadata_errors = []

    for item in items:

        source = manifest_lookup.get(
            item.get(
                "id"
            )
        )

        if source is None:

            metadata_errors.append(
                (
                    item.get("id"),
                    "missing manifest source",
                )
            )

            continue

        for field in metadata_fields:

            if (
                item.get(field)
                != source.get(field)
            ):

                metadata_errors.append(
                    (
                        item.get("id"),
                        field,
                    )
                )

    if metadata_errors:

        fail(
            "T18 Metadata P2-D2 difiere de P2-D1."
        )

        for error in metadata_errors[:20]:

            print(
                "      ",
                error,
            )

    else:

        ok(
            "T18 Metadata preservada exactamente desde P2-D1."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T19 - TARGETS EXACTOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    target_errors = []

    all_targets = []

    for item_id, expected in EXPECTED_TARGETS.items():

        actual = item_lookup.get(
            item_id,
            {},
        ).get(
            "target_topic_ids",
            [],
        )

        if actual != expected:

            target_errors.append(
                (
                    item_id,
                    expected,
                    actual,
                )
            )

        all_targets.extend(
            actual
        )

    if target_errors:

        fail(
            "T19 Targets de algún borrador incorrectos."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T19 Targets de las 8 preguntas "
            "coinciden con el piloto."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T20 - 20 TARGETS ÚNICOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        len(all_targets) != 20
        or
        len(set(all_targets)) != 20
    ):

        fail(
            "T20 Se esperaban 20 targets "
            "sin repetición."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T20 Existen 20 targets únicos."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T21 - PRIMARY / SECONDARY
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    target_structure_errors = []

    for item in items:

        targets = item.get(
            "target_topic_ids",
            [],
        )

        if not targets:

            target_structure_errors.append(
                item.get("id")
            )

            continue

        if (
            item.get(
                "primary_topic_id"
            )
            != targets[0]
            or
            item.get(
                "secondary_topic_ids"
            )
            != targets[1:]
        ):

            target_structure_errors.append(
                item.get("id")
            )

    if target_structure_errors:

        fail(
            "T21 Primary/secondary targets inconsistentes."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T21 Primary y secondary targets correctos."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T22 - DISTRIBUCIÓN POR ÁREA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    area_counts = Counter(
        item.get(
            "area"
        )
        for item in items
    )

    normalized_area = {
        area:
            area_counts.get(area, 0)
        for area in EXPECTED_AREA_COUNTS
    }

    if normalized_area != EXPECTED_AREA_COUNTS:

        fail(
            "T22 Distribución por área incorrecta."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T22 Distribución 2/2/2/2 correcta."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T23 - DIFICULTAD
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    difficulty_counts = Counter(
        item.get(
            "difficulty"
        )
        for item in items
    )

    normalized_difficulty = {
        key:
            difficulty_counts.get(key, 0)
        for key in EXPECTED_DIFFICULTY_COUNTS
    }

    if (
        normalized_difficulty
        != EXPECTED_DIFFICULTY_COUNTS
    ):

        fail(
            "T23 Distribución de dificultad incorrecta."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T23 Dificultad = "
            "5 foundation / 2 standard / 1 transfer."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T24 - COGNICIÓN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    cognitive_counts = Counter(
        item.get(
            "cognitive_target"
        )
        for item in items
    )

    normalized_cognitive = {
        key:
            cognitive_counts.get(key, 0)
        for key in EXPECTED_COGNITIVE_COUNTS
    }

    if (
        normalized_cognitive
        != EXPECTED_COGNITIVE_COUNTS
    ):

        fail(
            "T24 Distribución cognitiva incorrecta."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T24 Perfil cognitivo del piloto preservado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T25 - IDENTIDAD DE ÍTEMS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    identity_errors = []

    for item in items:

        if (
            item.get(
                "schema_version"
            )
            != EXPECTED_SCHEMA_VERSION
            or
            item.get(
                "origin"
            )
            != "generated_reinforcement"
            or
            item.get(
                "official_utn_question"
            )
            is not False
            or
            item.get(
                "learning_role"
            )
            != "coverage_seed"
        ):

            identity_errors.append(
                item.get("id")
            )

    if identity_errors:

        fail(
            "T25 Identidad contractual incorrecta."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T25 Todos los ítems son refuerzo "
            "sintético no oficial."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T26 - STEM
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    invalid_stems = []

    for item in items:

        stem = item.get(
            "stem"
        )

        if (
            not isinstance(stem, str)
            or len(stem.strip()) < 20
        ):

            invalid_stems.append(
                item.get("id")
            )

    if invalid_stems:

        fail(
            "T26 Algún enunciado es vacío "
            "o excesivamente corto."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T26 Los 8 enunciados son sustanciales."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T27 - NO DEPENDENCIA PDF
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    forbidden = [
        "ver figura",
        "observe la figura",
        "pagina del pdf",
        "página del pdf",
        "simulacro 1",
        "simulacro 3",
        "segun el pdf",
        "según el pdf",
    ]

    pdf_risks = []

    for item in items:

        text = normalize(
            item.get(
                "stem",
                "",
            )
        )

        if any(
            normalize(fragment) in text
            for fragment in forbidden
        ):

            pdf_risks.append(
                item.get("id")
            )

    if pdf_risks:

        fail(
            "T27 Algún borrador depende del PDF."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T27 Ninguna pregunta depende "
            "del PDF original."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T28 - CHOICES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    choice_errors = []

    for item in items:

        choices = item.get(
            "choices"
        )

        if not isinstance(
            choices,
            dict,
        ):

            choice_errors.append(
                item.get("id")
            )

            continue

        expected_keys = [
            "A",
            "B",
            "C",
            "D",
            "E",
        ][
            :len(choices)
        ]

        if (
            len(choices) not in {4, 5}
            or
            list(choices.keys())
            != expected_keys
            or
            any(
                not isinstance(value, str)
                or not value.strip()
                for value in choices.values()
            )
            or
            len(
                {
                    normalize(value)
                    for value in choices.values()
                }
            )
            != len(choices)
        ):

            choice_errors.append(
                item.get("id")
            )

    if choice_errors:

        fail(
            "T28 Algún ítem viola el contrato "
            "de 4/5 opciones distintas."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T28 Todas las preguntas tienen "
            "4 o 5 alternativas únicas."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T29 - ANSWER EXISTE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    missing_answers = []

    for item in items:

        if (
            item.get(
                "answer"
            )
            not in item.get(
                "choices",
                {},
            )
        ):

            missing_answers.append(
                item.get("id")
            )

    if missing_answers:

        fail(
            "T29 Alguna respuesta no existe "
            "en choices."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T29 Todas las respuestas apuntan "
            "a una alternativa existente."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T30 - ANSWER KEYS ESPERADAS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    wrong_keys = []

    for item_id, expected in EXPECTED_ANSWERS.items():

        if (
            item_lookup.get(
                item_id,
                {},
            ).get(
                "answer"
            )
            != expected
        ):

            wrong_keys.append(
                item_id
            )

    if wrong_keys:

        fail(
            "T30 Alguna clave no coincide "
            "con la solución independiente."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T30 Las ocho claves de respuesta "
            "coinciden con la revisión independiente."
        )

    # ========================================================
    # VALIDACIÓN INDEPENDIENTE DE RESPUESTAS
    # ========================================================

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T31 - R-001 LENGUAJE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    r001 = item_lookup["R-001"]

    r001_text = item_full_text(
        r001
    )

    if not all(
        fragment in r001_text
        for fragment in [
            "pececito",
            "vaya",
            "valla",
            "homofon",
            "arbol",
            "grave",
            "despues de m",
            "se escribe b",
        ]
    ):

        fail(
            "T31 R-001 no contiene las cuatro "
            "evidencias ortográficas necesarias."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T31 R-001: respuesta ortográfica "
            "A verificada conceptualmente."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T32 - R-004 LENGUAJE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    r004_text = item_full_text(
        item_lookup["R-004"]
    )

    if not all(
        fragment in r004_text
        for fragment in [
            "comunicacion humana",
            "digital",
            "impact",
            "gran",
            "apocop",
        ]
    ):

        fail(
            "T32 R-004 no integra comunicación, "
            "impacto y apócope."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T32 R-004: comunicación humana "
            "y apócope verificados."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T33 - R-007 MATEMÁTICA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    # f(x)=x^3:
    # - definida para todo R
    # - estrictamente creciente
    # - todo y tiene raíz cúbica real
    # - f(-x)=-f(x)

    test_x = [
        -4,
        -1,
        0,
        2,
        5,
    ]

    outputs = [
        x ** 3
        for x in test_x
    ]

    injective_sample = (
        len(outputs)
        == len(set(outputs))
    )

    odd_sample = all(
        ((-x) ** 3)
        == -(x ** 3)
        for x in test_x
    )

    surjective_examples = all(
        math.isclose(
            math.copysign(
                abs(y) ** (1 / 3),
                y,
            ) ** 3,
            y,
            rel_tol=1e-9,
            abs_tol=1e-9,
        )
        for y in [
            -27,
            -8,
            0,
            1,
            64,
        ]
    )

    if not (
        injective_sample
        and odd_sample
        and surjective_examples
    ):

        fail(
            "T33 Falló la verificación independiente "
            "de f(x)=x³."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T33 R-007: x³ es compatible con "
            "función biyectiva e impar."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T34 - R-016 QUÍMICA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    molar_mass_h2o2 = (
        2 * 1
        + 2 * 16
    )

    moles_h2o2 = (
        6.8
        / molar_mass_h2o2
    )

    moles_o2 = (
        moles_h2o2
        / 2
    )

    volume_o2 = (
        moles_o2
        * 22.4
    )

    if not math.isclose(
        volume_o2,
        2.24,
        rel_tol=1e-12,
        abs_tol=1e-12,
    ):

        fail(
            "T34 Cálculo independiente de "
            "R-016 no da 2,24 L."
        )

    elif normalize(
        item_lookup[
            "R-016"
        ][
            "choices"
        ][
            "A"
        ]
    ) != normalize(
        "2,24 L"
    ):

        fail(
            "T34 R-016 opción A no contiene 2,24 L."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T34 R-016: estequiometría independiente "
            "= 2,24 L de O₂."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T35 - R-019 MATEMÁTICA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    # (2x-3)(x+4) - (x²+5x-2)
    #
    # = 2x²+5x-12 - x²-5x+2
    # = x²-10

    def original_expression(x):

        return (
            (2 * x - 3)
            * (x + 4)
            - (
                x ** 2
                + 5 * x
                - 2
            )
        )

    def expected_expression(x):

        return (
            x ** 2
            - 10
        )

    algebra_ok = all(
        math.isclose(
            original_expression(x),
            expected_expression(x),
        )
        for x in [
            -5,
            -1,
            0,
            2,
            7,
        ]
    )

    if not algebra_ok:

        fail(
            "T35 R-019 no simplifica a x²-10."
        )

    elif normalize(
        item_lookup[
            "R-019"
        ][
            "choices"
        ][
            "A"
        ]
    ) != normalize(
        "x² - 10"
    ):

        fail(
            "T35 Opción A de R-019 no es x²-10."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T35 R-019: simplificación "
            "x²-10 verificada."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T36 - R-024 QUÍMICA ORGÁNICA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    r024_text = item_full_text(
        item_lookup["R-024"]
    )

    required_r024 = [
        "cooh",
        "acido carboxilico",
        "epoxido",
        "tres miembros",
        "diol",
    ]

    if not all(
        fragment in r024_text
        for fragment in required_r024
    ):

        fail(
            "T36 R-024 no contiene evidencia suficiente "
            "para epóxido + ácido carboxílico."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T36 R-024: identificación de epóxido "
            "y ácido carboxílico verificada."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T37 - R-033 FÍSICA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    angle_t1 = math.radians(
        90
    )

    angle_w = math.radians(
        150
    )

    t1 = (
        100
        * math.sin(angle_t1)
        / math.sin(angle_w)
    )

    if not math.isclose(
        t1,
        200.0,
        rel_tol=1e-12,
        abs_tol=1e-12,
    ):

        fail(
            "T37 Teorema de Lamy no produce 200 N."
        )

    elif normalize(
        item_lookup[
            "R-033"
        ][
            "choices"
        ][
            "A"
        ]
    ) != normalize(
        "200 N"
    ):

        fail(
            "T37 R-033 opción A no es 200 N."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T37 R-033: Teorema de Lamy "
            "= 200 N verificado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T38 - R-057 FÍSICA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    mass = 0.50
    vi = 8.0
    vf = -4.0

    impulse = (
        mass
        * (
            vf
            - vi
        )
    )

    if not math.isclose(
        impulse,
        -6.0,
        rel_tol=1e-12,
        abs_tol=1e-12,
    ):

        fail(
            "T38 Cálculo independiente del impulso "
            "no produce -6 N·s."
        )

    elif normalize(
        item_lookup[
            "R-057"
        ][
            "choices"
        ][
            "A"
        ]
    ) != normalize(
        "-6 N·s"
    ):

        fail(
            "T38 R-057 opción A no es -6 N·s."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T38 R-057: impulso = -6 N·s verificado."
        )

    # ========================================================
    # COBERTURA DE TARGETS
    # ========================================================

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T39 - TODOS LOS TARGETS TIENEN REGLA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        set(all_targets)
        != set(TARGET_EVIDENCE.keys())
    ):

        missing_rules = (
            set(all_targets)
            - set(TARGET_EVIDENCE.keys())
        )

        extra_rules = (
            set(TARGET_EVIDENCE.keys())
            - set(all_targets)
        )

        fail(
            "T39 Reglas de evidencia no coinciden "
            "con los 20 targets."
        )

        print(
            "      faltan:",
            sorted(missing_rules),
        )

        print(
            "      sobran:",
            sorted(extra_rules),
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T39 Existen reglas independientes "
            "para los 20 targets."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T40 - EVIDENCIA POR TARGET
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    coverage_errors = []

    for item in items:

        full_text = item_full_text(
            item
        )

        for topic_id in item.get(
            "target_topic_ids",
            [],
        ):

            anchors = TARGET_EVIDENCE.get(
                topic_id,
                [],
            )

            missing_anchors = [
                anchor
                for anchor in anchors
                if normalize(anchor)
                not in full_text
            ]

            if missing_anchors:

                coverage_errors.append(
                    (
                        item.get("id"),
                        topic_id,
                        missing_anchors,
                    )
                )

    if coverage_errors:

        fail(
            "T40 Algún target carece "
            "de evidencia conceptual suficiente."
        )

        for error in coverage_errors:

            print(
                "      ",
                error,
            )

    else:

        ok(
            "T40 Los 20 targets tienen "
            "evidencia explícita en sus preguntas."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T41 - NO TARGETS AJENOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    manifest_targets = {
        topic_id
        for entry in p2d1.get(
            "selected_specs",
            [],
        )
        for topic_id in entry.get(
            "target_topic_ids",
            [],
        )
    }

    if (
        set(all_targets)
        != manifest_targets
    ):

        fail(
            "T41 P2-D2 añadió o perdió "
            "targets respecto de P2-D1."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T41 No se añadieron targets ajenos "
            "a las specs seleccionadas."
        )

    # ========================================================
    # EXPLICACIONES
    # ========================================================

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T42 - EXPLANATION
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    explanation_errors = []

    for item in items:

        explanation = item.get(
            "explanation"
        )

        if (
            not isinstance(
                explanation,
                str,
            )
            or len(
                explanation.strip()
            )
            < 40
        ):

            explanation_errors.append(
                item.get("id")
            )

    if explanation_errors:

        fail(
            "T42 Alguna explicación resumida "
            "es insuficiente."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T42 Las 8 explicaciones resumidas "
            "son sustanciales."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T43 - CAPAS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    expected_layers = [
        "intuition",
        "step_by_step",
        "common_error",
        "why_correct",
    ]

    layer_errors = []

    for item in items:

        layers = item.get(
            "explanation_layers",
            {},
        )

        if (
            list(
                layers.keys()
            )
            != expected_layers
        ):

            layer_errors.append(
                item.get("id")
            )

            continue

        if any(
            not isinstance(
                layers[key],
                str,
            )
            or len(
                layers[key].strip()
            )
            < 20
            for key in expected_layers
        ):

            layer_errors.append(
                item.get("id")
            )

    if layer_errors:

        fail(
            "T43 Alguna pregunta carece "
            "de las cuatro capas pedagógicas."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T43 Las cuatro capas pedagógicas "
            "están presentes en los 8 ítems."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T44 - STEP BY STEP
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    weak_steps = []

    for item in items:

        steps = normalize(
            item.get(
                "explanation_layers",
                {},
            ).get(
                "step_by_step",
                "",
            )
        )

        # Aceptamos numeración explícita o varias
        # operaciones/relaciones suficientemente largas.
        has_numbered_steps = (
            "1)" in steps
            and
            "2)" in steps
        )

        has_math_sequence = (
            "=" in steps
            and len(steps) >= 60
        )

        if not (
            has_numbered_steps
            or
            has_math_sequence
        ):

            weak_steps.append(
                item.get("id")
            )

    if weak_steps:

        fail(
            "T44 Alguna explicación paso a paso "
            "no muestra una secuencia suficiente."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T44 Las soluciones muestran "
            "procedimiento secuencial."
        )

    # ========================================================
    # DISTRACTORES
    # ========================================================

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T45 - EXACTAMENTE LOS INCORRECTOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    distractor_errors = []

    for item in items:

        choices = item.get(
            "choices",
            {},
        )

        answer = item.get(
            "answer"
        )

        expected = {
            key
            for key in choices
            if key != answer
        }

        actual = set(
            item.get(
                "distractor_analysis",
                {},
            ).keys()
        )

        if actual != expected:

            distractor_errors.append(
                item.get("id")
            )

    if distractor_errors:

        fail(
            "T45 distractor_analysis no coincide "
            "con todas las opciones incorrectas."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T45 Todos los distractores incorrectos "
            "están documentados."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T46 - DIAGNÓSTICOS NO VACÍOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    weak_distractors = []

    for item in items:

        for key, explanation in item.get(
            "distractor_analysis",
            {},
        ).items():

            if (
                not isinstance(
                    explanation,
                    str,
                )
                or len(
                    explanation.strip()
                )
                < 25
            ):

                weak_distractors.append(
                    (
                        item.get("id"),
                        key,
                    )
                )

    if weak_distractors:

        fail(
            "T46 Algún distractor carece "
            "de diagnóstico suficiente."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T46 Los distractores poseen "
            "explicación diagnóstica."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T47 - NO ANALIZAR RESPUESTA COMO DISTRACTOR
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    incorrect_answer_analysis = []

    for item in items:

        if (
            item.get(
                "answer"
            )
            in item.get(
                "distractor_analysis",
                {},
            )
        ):

            incorrect_answer_analysis.append(
                item.get("id")
            )

    if incorrect_answer_analysis:

        fail(
            "T47 La respuesta correcta aparece "
            "como distractor."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T47 Ninguna respuesta correcta "
            "se etiqueta como distractor."
        )

    # ========================================================
    # AMBIGÜEDAD / CALIDAD DEL ENUNCIADO
    # ========================================================

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T48 - OPCIONES META
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    meta_phrases = [
        "todas las anteriores",
        "ninguna de las anteriores",
        "a y b son correctas",
        "todas son correctas",
    ]

    meta_risks = []

    for item in items:

        choice_text = normalize(
            " ".join(
                item.get(
                    "choices",
                    {},
                ).values()
            )
        )

        if any(
            normalize(phrase) in choice_text
            for phrase in meta_phrases
        ):

            meta_risks.append(
                item.get("id")
            )

    if meta_risks:

        fail(
            "T48 Se detectaron opciones meta "
            "que aumentan ambigüedad."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T48 No se usan «todas/ninguna "
            "de las anteriores»."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T49 - DATOS NUMÉRICOS COMPLETOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    numerical_requirements = {

        "R-016": [
            "6,8",
            "22,4",
            "h=1",
            "o=16",
            "2 h₂o₂",
        ],

        "R-033": [
            "90",
            "120",
            "150",
            "100",
        ],

        "R-057": [
            "0,50",
            "+8",
            "-4",
            "sentido positivo",
        ],
    }

    missing_numerical_data = []

    for item_id, required_fragments in (
        numerical_requirements.items()
    ):

        stem = normalize(
            item_lookup[
                item_id
            ].get(
                "stem",
                "",
            )
        )

        for fragment in required_fragments:

            if normalize(fragment) not in stem:

                missing_numerical_data.append(
                    (
                        item_id,
                        fragment,
                    )
                )

    if missing_numerical_data:

        fail(
            "T49 Algún problema numérico "
            "carece de un dato necesario."
        )

        for error in missing_numerical_data:

            print(
                "      ",
                error,
            )

    else:

        ok(
            "T49 Los problemas numéricos "
            "contienen todos sus datos necesarios."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T50 - RESPUESTAS NUMÉRICAS ÚNICAS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    expected_numeric = {
        "R-016": 2.24,
        "R-033": 200.0,
        "R-057": -6.0,
    }

    def extract_first_number(text):

        text = (
            str(text)
            .replace(",", ".")
            .replace("−", "-")
        )

        match = re.search(
            r"[-+]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?",
            text,
        )

        if not match:

            return None

        return float(
            match.group()
        )

    numeric_uniqueness_errors = []

    for item_id, expected_value in (
        expected_numeric.items()
    ):

        item = item_lookup[
            item_id
        ]

        matching_choices = []

        for key, value in item.get(
            "choices",
            {},
        ).items():

            number = extract_first_number(
                value
            )

            if (
                number is not None
                and math.isclose(
                    number,
                    expected_value,
                    rel_tol=1e-9,
                    abs_tol=1e-9,
                )
            ):

                matching_choices.append(
                    key
                )

        if (
            matching_choices
            != [
                item.get(
                    "answer"
                )
            ]
        ):

            numeric_uniqueness_errors.append(
                (
                    item_id,
                    matching_choices,
                )
            )

    if numeric_uniqueness_errors:

        fail(
            "T50 Algún ejercicio numérico "
            "no tiene una única opción correcta."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T50 Los tres ejercicios numéricos "
            "tienen una única alternativa correcta."
        )

    # ========================================================
    # QUALITY / GENERATION
    # ========================================================

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T51 - QUALITY SIGUE DRAFT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    expected_quality = {
        "status":
            "draft",

        "mastery_eligible":
            False,

        "coverage_verified":
            False,

        "answer_verified":
            False,

        "ambiguity_checked":
            False,

        "distractors_checked":
            False,

        "explanation_checked":
            False,

        "flags":
            [
                "pilot_pending_validation"
            ],
    }

    quality_errors = []

    for item in items:

        if (
            item.get(
                "quality"
            )
            != expected_quality
        ):

            quality_errors.append(
                item.get("id")
            )

    if quality_errors:

        fail(
            "T51 Algún borrador modificó "
            "prematuramente sus flags quality."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T51 Los 8 ítems permanecen "
            "en quality=draft."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T52 - MASTERY FALSE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if any(
        item.get(
            "quality",
            {},
        ).get(
            "mastery_eligible"
        )
        is not False
        for item in items
    ):

        fail(
            "T52 Un borrador se habilitó "
            "prematuramente para mastery."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T52 Ningún borrador es mastery_eligible."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T53 - GENERATION
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    expected_generation = {
        "generation_stage":
            "P2-D",

        "generator_type":
            "synthetic_reinforcement",

        "human_review_required":
            True,

        "source_material": [
            (
                "UTN FICA 2P2026 "
                "official syllabus"
            ),
            (
                "P2-C3 seed specification"
            ),
        ],
    }

    generation_errors = []

    for item in items:

        if (
            item.get(
                "generation"
            )
            != expected_generation
        ):

            generation_errors.append(
                item.get("id")
            )

    if generation_errors:

        fail(
            "T53 Trazabilidad de generación incorrecta."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T53 Trazabilidad de generación preservada."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T54 - NO OFICIAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if any(
        item.get(
            "official_utn_question"
        )
        is not False
        for item in items
    ):

        fail(
            "T54 Algún borrador se declara oficial UTN."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T54 Ninguna pregunta piloto "
            "se declara oficial UTN."
        )

    # ========================================================
    # SUMMARY
    # ========================================================

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T55 - SUMMARY
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    summary = drafts.get(
        "summary",
        {},
    )

    expected_summary_core = (
        summary.get(
            "draft_count"
        )
        == 8
        and
        summary.get(
            "target_assignments"
        )
        == 20
        and
        summary.get(
            "unique_target_topics"
        )
        == 20
        and
        summary.get(
            "by_area"
        )
        == EXPECTED_AREA_COUNTS
        and
        summary.get(
            "by_difficulty"
        )
        == EXPECTED_DIFFICULTY_COUNTS
        and
        summary.get(
            "reinforcement_bank_items"
        )
        == 0
        and
        summary.get(
            "original_bank_items"
        )
        == 180
        and
        summary.get(
            "all_items_draft"
        )
        is True
        and
        summary.get(
            "all_mastery_ineligible"
        )
        is True
    )

    if not expected_summary_core:

        fail(
            "T55 Summary P2-D2 inconsistente."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T55 Summary coincide con "
            "los 8 borradores reales."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T56 - TXT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:

        txt = P2D2_TXT.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        fail(
            f"T56 No puede leerse el TXT: {exc}"
        )

        txt = ""

    required_txt = [
        "P2-D2 - BORRADORES DEL LOTE PILOTO",
        "Preguntas borrador      : 8",
        "Targets conservados     : 20",
        "Banco reinforcement     : 0",
        "Banco original          : 180",
        "mastery_eligible permanece false",
        "reinforcement_bank.json permanece vacío",
        "Ninguna pregunta es una pregunta oficial UTN",
    ]

    missing_txt = [
        fragment
        for fragment in required_txt
        if fragment not in txt
    ]

    if missing_txt:

        fail(
            "T56 Informe TXT incompleto: "
            + " | ".join(
                missing_txt
            )
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T56 Informe TXT conserva "
            "las restricciones esenciales."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T57 - CHECKPOINTS DECLARADOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    checkpoint = drafts.get(
        "checkpoint_verification",
        {},
    )

    checkpoint_ok = (
        checkpoint.get(
            "p2c3_specs_sha256"
        )
        == P2C3_SHA256
        and
        checkpoint.get(
            "p2d0_schema_sha256"
        )
        == P2D0_SCHEMA_SHA256
        and
        checkpoint.get(
            "p2d0_empty_bank_sha256"
        )
        == P2D0_BANK_SHA256
        and
        checkpoint.get(
            "p2d0_contract_sha256"
        )
        == P2D0_CONTRACT_SHA256
        and
        checkpoint.get(
            "p2d1_manifest_sha256"
        )
        == P2D1_MANIFEST_SHA256
    )

    if not checkpoint_ok:

        fail(
            "T57 P2-D2 no referencia correctamente "
            "todos los checkpoints previos."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T57 P2-D2 referencia "
            "los cinco checkpoints correctos."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T58 - SEGURIDAD FINAL DE BANCOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )
        != P2D0_BANK_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "T58 reinforcement_bank fue modificado."
        )

    elif (
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )
        != sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK_P2B_BACKUP
        )
    ):

        fail(
            "T58 question_bank fue modificado."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T58 Ambos bancos permanecen intactos."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # FINAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    finish()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

checks = 0
errors = []
warnings = []


def ok(message):

    global checks

    checks += 1

    print(
        f"[OK] {message}"
    )


def fail(message):

    errors.append(
        message
    )

    print(
        f"[ERROR] {message}"
    )


def warn(message):

    warnings.append(
        message
    )

    print(
        f"[WARN] {message}"
    )


# ============================================================
# UTILIDADES
# ============================================================

def load_json(path: Path):

    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def sha256_file(path: Path):

    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open("rb") as handle:

        while True:

            chunk = handle.read(
                1024 * 1024
            )

            if not chunk:
                break

            digest.update(
                chunk
            )

    return digest.hexdigest().upper()


def canonical_sha256(data):

    payload = json.dumps(
        data,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode("utf-8")

    return hashlib.sha256(
        payload
    ).hexdigest().upper()

    print("=" * 72)

    print(

    )

    print(

    )

    if warnings:

        print()
        print(
            "WARNINGS"
        )
        print(
            "-" * 72
        )

        for item in warnings:

            print(
                f"- {item}"
            )

    if errors:

        print()
        print(
            "ERRORES"
        )
        print(
            "-" * 72
        )

        for item in errors:

            print(
                f"- {item}"
            )

        print()
        print(
            "RESULTADO: P2-D3 NO APROBADO"
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    print()
    print(
        "[OK] Checkpoints anteriores preservados."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] P2-D2 permanece byte por byte intacto."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] 8 registros de validación correctos."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] 8 hashes de contenido reconstruidos y coincidentes."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] 20 targets oficiales preservados."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Evidencia de los 58 controles registrada."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Inserción autorizada únicamente para estos 8 ítems."
    )
