def main():

    print()
    print("=" * 72)
    print(
        "VALIDACIÓN INDEPENDIENTE P2-D3"
    )
    print("=" * 72)
    print()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T01 - ARCHIVOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    required_files = [
        QUESTION_BANK,
        QUESTION_BANK_P2B_BACKUP,

        REINFORCEMENT_SCHEMA,
        REINFORCEMENT_SCHEMA_P2D0_BACKUP,

        REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK_P2D0_BACKUP,

        P2D0_CONTRACT,
        P2D0_CONTRACT_BACKUP,

        P2C3_SPECS,
        P2C3_BACKUP,

        P2D1_MANIFEST,
        P2D1_BACKUP,

        P2D2_DRAFTS,
        P2D2_BACKUP,

        P2D3_RECORD,
        P2D3_TXT,
    ]

    missing = [
        path
        for path in required_files
        if not path.exists()
    ]

    if missing:

        for path in missing:

            fail(
                f"T01 No existe: {path}"
            )

        finish()

    ok(
        "T01 Todos los archivos requeridos existen."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T02 - JSON
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:

        question_bank = load_json(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )

        reinforcement = load_json(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )

        schema = load_json(
            REINFORCEMENT_SCHEMA
        )

        drafts = load_json(
            P2D2_DRAFTS
        )

        record = load_json(
            P2D3_RECORD
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        fail(
            f"T02 Algún JSON no puede leerse: {exc}"
        )

        finish()

    ok(
        "T02 Todos los JSON principales se leen correctamente."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T03 - P2-C3 BACKUP
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2C3_BACKUP
        )
        != P2C3_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "T03 Backup P2-C3 alterado."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T03 SHA-256 del backup P2-C3 correcto."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T04 - P2-C3 ACTIVO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2C3_SPECS
        )
        != P2C3_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "T04 P2-C3 activo difiere "
            "del checkpoint aprobado."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T04 P2-C3 activo preservado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T05 - SCHEMA BACKUP
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_SCHEMA_P2D0_BACKUP
        )
        != P2D0_SCHEMA_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "T05 Backup del schema P2-D0 alterado."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T05 Backup del schema P2-D0 correcto."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T06 - SCHEMA ACTIVO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_SCHEMA
        )
        != P2D0_SCHEMA_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "T06 Schema P2-D0 activo alterado."
        )

    elif (
        schema.get(
            "schema_version"
        )
        != EXPECTED_SCHEMA_VERSION
    ):

        fail(
            "T06 schema_version inesperada."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T06 Schema P2-D0 activo preservado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T07 - REINFORCEMENT BACKUP
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK_P2D0_BACKUP
        )
        != P2D0_BANK_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "T07 Backup del reinforcement bank alterado."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T07 Backup del reinforcement bank correcto."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T08 - REINFORCEMENT ACTIVO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )
        != P2D0_BANK_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "T08 reinforcement_bank cambió "
            "antes de P2-D4."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T08 reinforcement_bank activo "
            "permanece en checkpoint P2-D0."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T09 - CONTRACT BACKUP
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2D0_CONTRACT_BACKUP
        )
        != P2D0_CONTRACT_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "T09 Backup contractual P2-D0 alterado."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T09 Backup contractual P2-D0 correcto."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T10 - CONTRACT ACTIVO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2D0_CONTRACT
        )
        != P2D0_CONTRACT_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "T10 Contrato P2-D0 activo alterado."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T10 Contrato P2-D0 activo preservado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T11 - P2-D1 BACKUP
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2D1_BACKUP
        )
        != P2D1_MANIFEST_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "T11 Backup P2-D1 alterado."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T11 Backup P2-D1 correcto."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T12 - P2-D1 ACTIVO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2D1_MANIFEST
        )
        != P2D1_MANIFEST_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "T12 Manifiesto P2-D1 activo alterado."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T12 P2-D1 activo preservado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T13 - P2-D2 BACKUP
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2D2_BACKUP
        )
        != P2D2_DRAFTS_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "T13 Backup P2-D2 alterado."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T13 SHA-256 del backup P2-D2 correcto."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T14 - P2-D2 ACTIVO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2D2_DRAFTS
        )
        != P2D2_DRAFTS_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "T14 Borradores P2-D2 cambiaron "
            "después de su aprobación."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T14 P2-D2 activo es idéntico "
            "al checkpoint aprobado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T15 - BANCO ORIGINAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        not isinstance(
            question_bank,
            list,
        )
        or len(
            question_bank
        )
        != 180
    ):

        fail(
            "T15 question_bank.json no contiene "
            "180 preguntas."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T15 Banco original conserva 180 preguntas."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T16 - BANCO ORIGINAL VS P2-B
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )
        != sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK_P2B_BACKUP
        )
    ):

        fail(
            "T16 Banco original difiere "
            "del checkpoint P2-B."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T16 Banco original idéntico "
            "al checkpoint P2-B."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T17 - REINFORCEMENT VACÍO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        reinforcement.get(
            "items"
        )
        != []
    ):

        fail(
            "T17 reinforcement_bank debería "
            "seguir con 0 preguntas."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T17 reinforcement_bank continúa vacío."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T18 - P2-D2 IDENTIDAD
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        drafts.get(
            "stage"
        )
        != "P2-D2"
        or
        drafts.get(
            "draft_version"
        )
        != EXPECTED_DRAFT_VERSION
        or
        drafts.get(
            "status"
        )
        != "drafts_authored_pending_validation"
    ):

        fail(
            "T18 Identidad de P2-D2 incorrecta."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T18 Fuente P2-D2 reconocida correctamente."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T19 - 8 BORRADORES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    draft_items = drafts.get(
        "items",
        [],
    )

    draft_ids = [
        item.get(
            "id"
        )
        for item in draft_items
    ]

    if (
        len(
            draft_items
        )
        != 8
        or
        draft_ids
        != EXPECTED_ITEMS
    ):

        fail(
            "T19 P2-D2 ya no contiene "
            "los 8 borradores esperados."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T19 P2-D2 conserva los 8 borradores "
            "en el orden aprobado."
        )

    draft_lookup = {
        item.get(
            "id"
        ):
            item
        for item in draft_items
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T20 - DRAFTS SIGUEN DRAFT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    expected_draft_quality = {
        "status":
            "draft",

        "mastery_eligible":
            False,

        "coverage_verified":
            False,

        "answer_verified":
            False,

        "ambiguity_checked":
            False,

        "distractors_checked":
            False,

        "explanation_checked":
            False,

        "flags":
            [
                "pilot_pending_validation"
            ],
    }

    if any(
        item.get(
            "quality"
        )
        != expected_draft_quality
        for item in draft_items
    ):

        fail(
            "T20 P2-D3 modificó prematuramente "
            "la quality de P2-D2."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T20 Los borradores originales "
            "siguen exactamente en quality=draft."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T21 - IDENTIDAD DEL REGISTRO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        record.get(
            "stage"
        )
        != "P2-D3"
        or
        record.get(
            "validation_record_version"
        )
        != EXPECTED_RECORD_VERSION
        or
        record.get(
            "status"
        )
        != "validated_for_insertion"
    ):

        fail(
            "T21 Identidad del registro P2-D3 incorrecta."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T21 Registro identificado correctamente "
            "como P2-D3."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T22 - FUENTE P2-D2
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        record.get(
            "source_drafts"
        )
        != "results/p2d2_pilot_drafts.json"
        or
        record.get(
            "source_drafts_sha256"
        )
        != P2D2_DRAFTS_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "T22 Fuente o SHA global P2-D2 incorrectos."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T22 P2-D3 referencia exactamente "
            "el checkpoint P2-D2 aprobado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T23 - SEGURIDAD DEL REGISTRO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        record.get(
            "target_bank"
        )
        != "data/reinforcement_bank.json"
        or
        record.get(
            "writes_to_reinforcement_bank"
        )
        is not False
        or
        record.get(
            "writes_to_original_bank"
        )
        is not False
        or
        record.get(
            "official_utn_questions"
        )
        is not False
    ):

        fail(
            "T23 Alcance de seguridad P2-D3 incorrecto."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T23 P2-D3 no modifica bancos "
            "y mantiene estado no oficial."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T24 - CHECKPOINTS DECLARADOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    checkpoint = record.get(
        "checkpoint_verification",
        {},
    )

    expected_checkpoint = {
        "p2c3_specs_sha256":
            P2C3_SHA256,

        "p2d0_schema_sha256":
            P2D0_SCHEMA_SHA256,

        "p2d0_empty_bank_sha256":
            P2D0_BANK_SHA256,

        "p2d0_contract_sha256":
            P2D0_CONTRACT_SHA256,

        "p2d1_manifest_sha256":
            P2D1_MANIFEST_SHA256,

        "p2d2_drafts_sha256":
            P2D2_DRAFTS_SHA256,
    }

    if checkpoint != expected_checkpoint:

        fail(
            "T24 Hashes de checkpoints "
            "declarados incorrectos."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T24 Registro conserva los seis "
            "checkpoints aprobados."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T25 - EVIDENCIA DEL VALIDADOR
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    evidence = record.get(
        "validator_evidence",
        {},
    )

    evidence_ok = (
        evidence.get(
            "validator"
        )
        == "tools/validate_p2d2.py"
        and
        evidence.get(
            "result"
        )
        == "P2-D2 APROBADO"
        and
        evidence.get(
            "checks_passed"
        )
        == 58
        and
        evidence.get(
            "errors"
        )
        == 0
        and
        evidence.get(
            "warnings"
        )
        == 0
    )

    if not evidence_ok:

        fail(
            "T25 Evidencia de validación "
            "P2-D2 incorrecta."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T25 Registro documenta 58 checks, "
            "0 errores y 0 warnings."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T26 - DIMENSIONES VALIDADAS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        evidence.get(
            "verified_dimensions"
        )
        != EXPECTED_VERIFIED_DIMENSIONS
    ):

        fail(
            "T26 Dimensiones verificadas "
            "no coinciden con el contrato."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T26 Se documentan las 11 dimensiones "
            "de validación."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T27 - POLÍTICA: INSERCIÓN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    policy = record.get(
        "insertion_policy",
        {},
    )

    if (
        policy.get(
            "insertion_allowed"
        )
        is not True
        or
        policy.get(
            "exactly_this_item_count"
        )
        != 8
        or
        policy.get(
            "exact_content_hash_required"
        )
        is not True
        or
        policy.get(
            "all_items_must_match_validation_record"
        )
        is not True
    ):

        fail(
            "T27 Autorización de inserción incompleta."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T27 Inserción permitida solo con "
            "coincidencia exacta de contenido."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T28 - POLÍTICA: SIN INSERCIÓN PARCIAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        policy.get(
            "partial_insertion_allowed"
        )
        is not False
    ):

        fail(
            "T28 La inserción parcial debería "
            "estar prohibida."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T28 Inserción parcial explícitamente prohibida."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T29 - POLÍTICA: IDS AUTORIZADOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        policy.get(
            "items_allowed"
        )
        != EXPECTED_ITEMS
    ):

        fail(
            "T29 Lista de ítems autorizados incorrecta."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T29 Solo los 8 IDs piloto están autorizados."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T30 - POLÍTICA: DUPLICADOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        policy.get(
            "duplicate_item_ids_allowed"
        )
        is not False
        or
        policy.get(
            "duplicate_source_spec_ids_allowed"
        )
        is not False
    ):

        fail(
            "T30 La política permite duplicados."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T30 Duplicados de item_id "
            "y source_spec_id prohibidos."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T31 - POLÍTICA: BANCO ORIGINAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        policy.get(
            "original_bank_modification_allowed"
        )
        is not False
    ):

        fail(
            "T31 La política permitiría modificar "
            "question_bank.json."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T31 Modificación del banco original prohibida."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T32 - POLÍTICA: NO OFICIAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        policy.get(
            "generated_items_are_official_utn_questions"
        )
        is not False
    ):

        fail(
            "T32 La política podría presentar "
            "material generado como oficial."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T32 Ítems generados se mantienen "
            "explícitamente no oficiales."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T33 - QUALITY A APLICAR
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    expected_validated_quality = {
        "status":
            "validated",

        "mastery_eligible":
            True,

        "coverage_verified":
            True,

        "answer_verified":
            True,

        "ambiguity_checked":
            True,

        "distractors_checked":
            True,

        "explanation_checked":
            True,

        "flags":
            [],
    }

    if (
        policy.get(
            "quality_to_apply_on_insertion"
        )
        != expected_validated_quality
    ):

        fail(
            "T33 quality_to_apply_on_insertion incorrecta."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T33 Quality de futura inserción "
            "coincide con validación completa."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T34 - 8 REGISTROS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    item_records = record.get(
        "items",
        [],
    )

    if len(
        item_records
    ) != 8:

        fail(
            "T34 El acta no contiene "
            "exactamente 8 registros."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T34 Existen exactamente 8 actas individuales."
        )

    record_ids = [
        item.get(
            "item_id"
        )
        for item in item_records
    ]

    record_lookup = {
        item.get(
            "item_id"
        ):
            item
        for item in item_records
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T35 - IDS / ORDEN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        record_ids
        != EXPECTED_ITEMS
        or
        len(
            record_ids
        )
        != len(
            set(
                record_ids
            )
        )
    ):

        fail(
            "T35 IDs u orden de actas incorrectos."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T35 Los 8 registros conservan "
            "IDs únicos y orden aprobado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T36 - MAPPING R -> SEED
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    mapping_errors = []

    for item_id in EXPECTED_ITEMS:

        if (
            record_lookup.get(
                item_id,
                {},
            ).get(
                "source_spec_id"
            )
            != EXPECTED_MAPPING[
                item_id
            ]
        ):

            mapping_errors.append(
                item_id
            )

    if mapping_errors:

        fail(
            "T36 Algún R-xxx perdió "
            "su source_spec_id."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T36 Mapeo R-xxx -> SEED-xxx preservado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T37 - RESPUESTAS REGISTRADAS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    answer_errors = []

    for item_id in EXPECTED_ITEMS:

        if (
            record_lookup.get(
                item_id,
                {},
            ).get(
                "answer"
            )
            != EXPECTED_ANSWERS[
                item_id
            ]
        ):

            answer_errors.append(
                item_id
            )

    if answer_errors:

        fail(
            "T37 Alguna respuesta registrada "
            "difiere de P2-D2."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T37 Las 8 respuestas validadas "
            "permanecen registradas correctamente."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T38 - HASH FORMAT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    hash_pattern = re.compile(
        r"^[0-9A-F]{64}$"
    )

    malformed_hashes = [
        item.get(
            "item_id"
        )
        for item in item_records
        if not hash_pattern.fullmatch(
            str(
                item.get(
                    "content_sha256",
                    "",
                )
            )
        )
    ]

    if malformed_hashes:

        fail(
            "T38 Algún content_sha256 "
            "no es un SHA-256 válido."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T38 Los 8 hashes individuales "
            "tienen formato SHA-256 válido."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T39 - HASHES ÚNICOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    recorded_hashes = [
        item.get(
            "content_sha256"
        )
        for item in item_records
    ]

    if (
        len(
            recorded_hashes
        )
        != len(
            set(
                recorded_hashes
            )
        )
    ):

        fail(
            "T39 Existen hashes individuales duplicados."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T39 Los 8 hashes individuales son únicos."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T40 - RECONSTRUCCIÓN INDEPENDIENTE DE HASHES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    hash_mismatches = []

    for item_id in EXPECTED_ITEMS:

        draft = draft_lookup.get(
            item_id
        )

        item_record = record_lookup.get(
            item_id
        )

        if (
            draft is None
            or item_record is None
        ):

            hash_mismatches.append(
                (
                    item_id,
                    "missing",
                )
            )

            continue

        reconstructed = canonical_sha256(
            draft
        )

        recorded = item_record.get(
            "content_sha256"
        )

        if reconstructed != recorded:

            hash_mismatches.append(
                (
                    item_id,
                    reconstructed,
                    recorded,
                )
            )

    if hash_mismatches:

        fail(
            "T40 Algún hash registrado no coincide "
            "con el contenido real de P2-D2."
        )

        for mismatch in hash_mismatches:

            print(
                "      ",
                mismatch,
            )

    else:

        ok(
            "T40 Los 8 hashes fueron reconstruidos "
            "independientemente y coinciden."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T41 - ÁREA VS BORRADOR
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    area_errors = []

    for item_id in EXPECTED_ITEMS:

        if (
            record_lookup[
                item_id
            ].get(
                "area"
            )
            != draft_lookup[
                item_id
            ].get(
                "area"
            )
        ):

            area_errors.append(
                item_id
            )

    if area_errors:

        fail(
            "T41 Algún área registrada "
            "difiere del borrador aprobado."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T41 Área de cada acta coincide con P2-D2."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T42 - TARGETS VS BORRADOR
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    target_errors = []

    all_targets = []

    for item_id in EXPECTED_ITEMS:

        record_targets = record_lookup[
            item_id
        ].get(
            "target_topic_ids",
            [],
        )

        draft_targets = draft_lookup[
            item_id
        ].get(
            "target_topic_ids",
            [],
        )

        if record_targets != draft_targets:

            target_errors.append(
                item_id
            )

        all_targets.extend(
            record_targets
        )

    if target_errors:

        fail(
            "T42 Algún target_topic_ids "
            "difiere de P2-D2."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T42 Targets de las 8 actas "
            "coinciden exactamente con P2-D2."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T43 - 20 TARGETS ÚNICOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        len(
            all_targets
        )
        != EXPECTED_TARGET_COUNT
        or
        len(
            set(
                all_targets
            )
        )
        != EXPECTED_TARGET_COUNT
    ):

        fail(
            "T43 El acta ya no conserva "
            "20 targets únicos."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T43 Se conservan 20 targets "
            "sin repetición."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T44 - DISTRIBUCIÓN POR ÁREA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    area_counts = Counter(
        item.get(
            "area"
        )
        for item in item_records
    )

    normalized_area_counts = {
        area:
            area_counts.get(
                area,
                0,
            )
        for area in EXPECTED_AREA_COUNTS
    }

    if (
        normalized_area_counts
        != EXPECTED_AREA_COUNTS
    ):

        fail(
            "T44 Distribución por área incorrecta."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T44 Distribución por área = 2/2/2/2."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T45 - VERIFICATION FLAGS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    expected_verification = {
        "content_verified":
            True,

        "answer_verified":
            True,

        "coverage_verified":
            True,

        "ambiguity_checked":
            True,

        "distractors_checked":
            True,

        "explanation_checked":
            True,

        "pdf_independence_verified":
            True,

        "official_status_checked":
            True,
    }

    verification_errors = [
        item.get(
            "item_id"
        )
        for item in item_records
        if item.get(
            "verification"
        )
        != expected_verification
    ]

    if verification_errors:

        fail(
            "T45 Alguna acta carece "
            "de verificaciones completas."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T45 Las 8 actas registran "
            "las 8 verificaciones requeridas."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T46 - VALIDATION BASIS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    basis_errors = []

    for item in item_records:

        basis = item.get(
            "validation_basis",
            {},
        )

        basis_ok = (
            basis.get(
                "independent_validator"
            )
            == "tools/validate_p2d2.py"
            and
            basis.get(
                "validator_result"
            )
            == "58 checks passed"
            and
            basis.get(
                "validator_errors"
            )
            == 0
            and
            basis.get(
                "validator_warnings"
            )
            == 0
            and
            basis.get(
                "answer_validation"
            )
            == "independently verified"
            and
            basis.get(
                "coverage_validation"
            )
            == "20 official targets verified"
            and
            basis.get(
                "distractor_validation"
            )
            == "all incorrect alternatives documented"
            and
            basis.get(
                "explanation_validation"
            )
            == (
                "summary and four pedagogical "
                "layers verified"
            )
        )

        if not basis_ok:

            basis_errors.append(
                item.get(
                    "item_id"
                )
            )

    if basis_errors:

        fail(
            "T46 Algún validation_basis "
            "es inconsistente."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T46 Las 8 actas documentan "
            "la misma evidencia independiente."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T47 - QUALITY APROBADA POR ÍTEM
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    quality_errors = []

    for item in item_records:

        if (
            item.get(
                "approved_quality_for_insertion"
            )
            != expected_validated_quality
        ):

            quality_errors.append(
                item.get(
                    "item_id"
                )
            )

    if quality_errors:

        fail(
            "T47 Alguna acta propone "
            "quality distinta a la aprobada."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T47 Quality aprobada es idéntica "
            "para los 8 ítems."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T48 - INSERTION APPROVAL INDIVIDUAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    insertion_errors = []

    for item in item_records:

        approval = item.get(
            "insertion_approval",
            {},
        )

        approval_ok = (
            approval.get(
                "approved"
            )
            is True
            and
            approval.get(
                "target_bank"
            )
            == "data/reinforcement_bank.json"
            and
            approval.get(
                "requires_exact_content_hash_match"
            )
            is True
            and
            approval.get(
                "requires_empty_or_compatible_bank"
            )
            is True
            and
            approval.get(
                "may_modify_original_bank"
            )
            is False
            and
            approval.get(
                "official_utn_question"
            )
            is False
        )

        if not approval_ok:

            insertion_errors.append(
                item.get(
                    "item_id"
                )
            )

    if insertion_errors:

        fail(
            "T48 Alguna autorización "
            "individual de inserción es inválida."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T48 Los 8 ítems exigen hash exacto "
            "y banco compatible."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T49 - SUMMARY: CONTEOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    summary = record.get(
        "summary",
        {},
    )

    summary_counts_ok = (
        summary.get(
            "validated_items"
        )
        == 8
        and
        summary.get(
            "target_assignments"
        )
        == 20
        and
        summary.get(
            "unique_target_topics"
        )
        == 20
        and
        summary.get(
            "by_area"
        )
        == EXPECTED_AREA_COUNTS
    )

    if not summary_counts_ok:

        fail(
            "T49 Conteos del summary P2-D3 incorrectos."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T49 Summary conserva 8 ítems "
            "y 20 targets."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T50 - SUMMARY: VALIDADOR
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        summary.get(
            "validator_checks_passed"
        )
        != 58
        or
        summary.get(
            "validator_errors"
        )
        != 0
        or
        summary.get(
            "validator_warnings"
        )
        != 0
    ):

        fail(
            "T50 Summary no conserva "
            "58/0/0 del validador."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T50 Summary registra 58 checks, "
            "0 errores y 0 warnings."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T51 - SUMMARY: BANCOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        summary.get(
            "reinforcement_bank_items"
        )
        != 0
        or
        summary.get(
            "original_bank_items"
        )
        != 180
    ):

        fail(
            "T51 Summary declara estado "
            "incorrecto de los bancos."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T51 Summary conserva "
            "reinforcement=0 y original=180."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T52 - SUMMARY: APROBACIÓN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        summary.get(
            "all_items_approved_for_insertion"
        )
        is not True
        or
        summary.get(
            "all_items_mastery_eligible_after_insertion"
        )
        is not True
    ):

        fail(
            "T52 Summary de aprobación incompleto."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T52 Los 8 ítems quedan aprobados "
            "para futura inserción."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T53 - TXT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:

        txt = P2D3_TXT.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        fail(
            f"T53 No se pudo leer el TXT: {exc}"
        )

        txt = ""

    required_txt_fragments = [
        "P2-D3 - REGISTRO FORMAL DE VALIDACIÓN",
        "Estado                 : validated_for_insertion",
        "Ítems validados        : 8",
        "Targets verificados    : 20",
        "Errores de validación  : 0",
        "Warnings               : 0",
        "Banco reinforcement    : 0",
        "Banco original         : 180",
        "SHA-256 contenido:",
        "mastery_eligible después de inserción: true",
        "reinforcement_bank.json permanece vacío",
        "Cada borrador tiene un SHA-256 individual",
        "58 controles independientes",
        "Ningún ítem es una pregunta oficial UTN",
        "P2-D4",
    ]

    missing_txt = [
        fragment
        for fragment in required_txt_fragments
        if fragment not in txt
    ]

    if missing_txt:

        fail(
            "T53 Informe TXT incompleto: "
            + " | ".join(
                missing_txt
            )
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T53 Informe TXT documenta "
            "las garantías P2-D3."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T54 - LOS 8 HASHES APARECEN EN TXT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    absent_hashes = [
        item.get(
            "item_id"
        )
        for item in item_records
        if item.get(
            "content_sha256"
        )
        not in txt
    ]

    if absent_hashes:

        fail(
            "T54 Algún hash individual "
            "no aparece en el informe TXT."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T54 Los 8 hashes individuales "
            "también están documentados en TXT."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T55 - P2-D3 NO ALTERÓ P2-D2
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            P2D2_DRAFTS
        )
        != P2D2_DRAFTS_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "T55 P2-D2 fue alterado "
            "durante la creación del acta."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T55 P2-D2 permanece byte por byte intacto."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T56 - P2-D3 NO ALTERÓ REINFORCEMENT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )
        != P2D0_BANK_SHA256
        or
        reinforcement.get(
            "items"
        )
        != []
    ):

        fail(
            "T56 P2-D3 modificó reinforcement_bank."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T56 reinforcement_bank permanece "
            "exactamente vacío."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T57 - P2-D3 NO ALTERÓ ORIGINAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )
        != sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK_P2B_BACKUP
        )
    ):

        fail(
            "T57 P2-D3 modificó question_bank."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T57 question_bank permanece "
            "idéntico al checkpoint P2-B."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T58 - SEPARACIÓN FÍSICA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        QUESTION_BANK.resolve()
        == REINFORCEMENT_BANK.resolve()
    ):

        fail(
            "T58 Los dos bancos apuntan "
            "al mismo archivo."
        )

    elif (
        schema.get(
            "must_remain_separate_from"
        )
        != "data/question_bank.json"
    ):

        fail(
            "T58 El schema perdió "
            "la regla de separación."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T58 Banco original y de refuerzo "
            "permanecen físicamente separados."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T59 - NADA OFICIAL UTN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    official_risk = (
        record.get(
            "official_utn_questions"
        )
        is not False
        or
        policy.get(
            "generated_items_are_official_utn_questions"
        )
        is not False
        or
        any(
            item.get(
                "insertion_approval",
                {},
            ).get(
                "official_utn_question"
            )
            is not False
            for item in item_records
        )
    )

    if official_risk:

        fail(
            "T59 Existe riesgo de marcar "
            "material generado como oficial UTN."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T59 Registro y actas mantienen "
            "el material como no oficial UTN."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T60 - BARRERA PARA P2-D4
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    p2d4_barrier_ok = (
        policy.get(
            "insertion_allowed"
        )
        is True
        and
        policy.get(
            "exact_content_hash_required"
        )
        is True
        and
        policy.get(
            "all_items_must_match_validation_record"
        )
        is True
        and
        policy.get(
            "partial_insertion_allowed"
        )
        is False
        and
        policy.get(
            "original_bank_modification_allowed"
        )
        is False
    )

    if not p2d4_barrier_ok:

        fail(
            "T60 P2-D4 no queda suficientemente "
            "restringido por el acta."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T60 P2-D4 queda bloqueado "
            "a inserción atómica de contenido exacto."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # FINAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    finish()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
