# ============================================================
# ESTADO
# ============================================================

checks = 0
errors: list[str] = []
warnings: list[str] = []


def ok(message: str) -> None:
    global checks
    checks += 1
    print(f"[OK] {message}")


def fail(message: str) -> None:
    errors.append(message)
    print(f"[ERROR] {message}")


def warn(message: str) -> None:
    warnings.append(message)
    print(f"[WARN] {message}")


# ============================================================
# UTILIDADES
# ============================================================

def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        while True:
            chunk = handle.read(
                1024 * 1024
            )

            if not chunk:
                break

            digest.update(chunk)

    return digest.hexdigest().upper()


def load_json(path: Path):
    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def canonical_sha256(data) -> str:
    encoded = json.dumps(
        data,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode("utf-8")

    return hashlib.sha256(
        encoded
    ).hexdigest().upper()


def finish() -> None:
    print()
    print("=" * 76)
    print("RESUMEN DE VALIDACIÓN P2-D5.2 - CONTRATO")
    print("=" * 76)

    print(
        f"Checks aprobados : {checks}"
    )

    print(
        f"Errores          : {len(errors)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Warnings         : {len(warnings)}"
    )

    if warnings:
        print()
        print("WARNINGS")
        print("-" * 76)

        for message in warnings:
            print(
                f"- {message}"
            )

    if errors:
        print()
        print("ERRORES")
        print("-" * 76)

        for message in errors:
            print(
                f"- {message}"
            )

        print()
        print(
            "RESULTADO: CONTRATO P2-D5.2 NO APROBADO"
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    print()
    print(
        "[OK] Los bancos existentes permanecen intactos."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] app.py permanece en el checkpoint P2-D5.1."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] El banco complementario inicia vacío."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Las explicaciones pedagógicas quedan separadas "
        "de question_bank.json."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] El contrato exige resolución pedagógica "
        "paso a paso."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] La validación es obligatoria antes de uso."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] No existe generación automática de soluciones "
        "durante runtime."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "RESULTADO: CONTRATO P2-D5.2 APROBADO"
    )

    sys.exit(0)


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main() -> None:
    print()
    print("=" * 76)
    print(
        "VALIDACIÓN INDEPENDIENTE "
        "P2-D5.2 - CONTRATO"
    )
    print("=" * 76)
    print()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T01 - ARCHIVOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    required_files = [
        APP,
        QUESTION_BANK,
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
        SCHEMA_FILE,
        BANK_FILE,
        REPORT_JSON,
        REPORT_TXT,
    ]

    missing = [
        path
        for path in required_files
        if not path.exists()
    ]

    if missing:
        for path in missing:
            fail(
                f"T01 Falta archivo: {path}"
            )

        finish()

    ok(
        "T01 Todos los archivos requeridos existen."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T02 - APP PRESERVADA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(APP)
        != APP_P2D5_1_SHA256
    ):
        fail(
            "T02 app.py cambió después de P2-D5.1."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T02 app.py permanece exactamente en P2-D5.1."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T03 - BANCO ORIGINAL HASH
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )
        != QUESTION_BANK_SHA256
    ):
        fail(
            "T03 question_bank.json fue alterado."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T03 SHA-256 del banco original correcto."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T04 - REFUERZO HASH
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )
        != REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256
    ):
        fail(
            "T04 reinforcement_bank.json fue alterado."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T04 SHA-256 del banco de refuerzo correcto."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T05 - SCHEMA HASH
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            SCHEMA_FILE
        )
        != SCHEMA_SHA256
    ):
        fail(
            "T05 original_explanations_schema.json "
            "no coincide con el contrato generado."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T05 SHA-256 del schema correcto."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T06 - BANCO COMPLEMENTARIO HASH
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        sha256_file(
            BANK_FILE
        )
        != BANK_SHA256
    ):
        fail(
            "T06 original_explanations_bank.json "
            "no coincide con el estado inicial."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T06 SHA-256 del banco complementario correcto."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T07 - LEER JSON
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:
        question_bank = load_json(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )

        reinforcement = load_json(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )

        schema = load_json(
            SCHEMA_FILE
        )

        explanation_bank = load_json(
            BANK_FILE
        )

        report = load_json(
            REPORT_JSON
        )

    except Exception as exc:
        fail(
            f"T07 Error leyendo JSON: {exc}"
        )

        finish()

    ok(
        "T07 Todos los JSON se leen correctamente."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T08 - 180 ORIGINALES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        not isinstance(
            question_bank,
            list,
        )
        or len(question_bank) != 180
    ):
        fail(
            "T08 Banco original no contiene 180 preguntas."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T08 Banco original conserva 180 preguntas."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T09 - IDS ORIGINALES ÚNICOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    source_ids = [
        item.get("id")
        for item in question_bank
    ]

    if (
        len(source_ids)
        != len(set(source_ids))
    ):
        fail(
            "T09 Los IDs originales no son únicos."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T09 Los 180 IDs originales son únicos."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T10 - FORMATO IDs
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    invalid_source_ids = [
        value
        for value in source_ids
        if not (
            isinstance(
                value,
                str,
            )
            and (
                value.startswith("S1-")
                or value.startswith("S3-")
            )
        )
    ]

    if invalid_source_ids:
        fail(
            "T10 Existen IDs originales inválidos."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T10 Todos los IDs originales son S1/S3."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T11 - 8 REFUERZOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    reinforcement_items = reinforcement.get(
        "items",
        [],
    )

    if len(
        reinforcement_items
    ) != 8:
        fail(
            "T11 Banco de refuerzo no conserva 8 ítems."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T11 Banco de refuerzo conserva 8 ítems."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T12 - SCHEMA VERSION
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    properties = schema.get(
        "properties",
        {},
    )

    schema_version_rule = properties.get(
        "schema_version",
        {},
    )

    if (
        schema_version_rule.get(
            "const"
        )
        != SCHEMA_VERSION
    ):
        fail(
            "T12 schema_version incorrecto."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T12 schema_version correcto."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T13 - BANK VERSION
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    bank_version_rule = properties.get(
        "bank_version",
        {},
    )

    if (
        bank_version_rule.get(
            "const"
        )
        != BANK_VERSION
    ):
        fail(
            "T13 bank_version incorrecto."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T13 bank_version correcto."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T14 - ORIGIN DEL BANCO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    origin_rule = properties.get(
        "origin",
        {},
    )

    if (
        origin_rule.get(
            "const"
        )
        != "pedagogical_companion_for_original_bank"
    ):
        fail(
            "T14 Origen del banco complementario incorrecto."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T14 Banco identificado como complemento pedagógico."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T15 - NO OFICIAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    official_rule = properties.get(
        "official_utn_question",
        {},
    )

    if (
        official_rule.get(
            "const"
        )
        is not False
    ):
        fail(
            "T15 El contrato podría declarar las explicaciones "
            "como preguntas oficiales UTN."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T15 Contrato mantiene official_utn_question=False."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T16 - CAMPOS ROOT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    expected_root_required = {
        "schema_version",
        "bank_version",
        "origin",
        "official_utn_question",
        "items",
    }

    actual_root_required = set(
        schema.get(
            "required",
            [],
        )
    )

    if (
        actual_root_required
        != expected_root_required
    ):
        fail(
            "T16 Campos obligatorios raíz incorrectos."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T16 Campos obligatorios raíz correctos."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T17 - ROOT CERRADO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        schema.get(
            "additionalProperties"
        )
        is not False
    ):
        fail(
            "T17 El schema raíz permite propiedades inesperadas."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T17 Schema raíz bloquea propiedades no definidas."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T18 - DEFINICIÓN ITEM
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    definitions = schema.get(
        "$defs",
        {},
    )

    item_schema = definitions.get(
        "explanation_item"
    )

    if not isinstance(
        item_schema,
        dict,
    ):
        fail(
            "T18 Falta definición explanation_item."
        )
        finish()

    ok(
        "T18 Existe definición explanation_item."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T19 - CAMPOS PEDAGÓGICOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    expected_item_fields = {
        "id",
        "schema_version",
        "source_question_id",
        "source_question_sha256",
        "origin",
        "official_utn_question",
        "idea_key",
        "what_is_asked",
        "relevant_data",
        "concept_or_rule",
        "formula_or_framework",
        "steps",
        "why_correct",
        "distractor_analysis",
        "common_error",
        "transfer_tip",
        "quick_check",
        "quality",
        "generation",
    }

    actual_item_fields = set(
        item_schema.get(
            "required",
            [],
        )
    )

    if (
        actual_item_fields
        != expected_item_fields
    ):
        missing_fields = sorted(
            expected_item_fields
            - actual_item_fields
        )

        extra_fields = sorted(
            actual_item_fields
            - expected_item_fields
        )

        fail(
            "T19 Campos obligatorios del item incorrectos. "
            f"Faltan={missing_fields}; "
            f"sobran={extra_fields}"
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T19 El item exige todas las capas pedagógicas."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T20 - ITEM CERRADO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        item_schema.get(
            "additionalProperties"
        )
        is not False
    ):
        fail(
            "T20 explanation_item permite propiedades inesperadas."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T20 explanation_item está cerrado."
        )

    item_properties = item_schema.get(
        "properties",
        {},
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T21 - ID EX-
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        item_properties.get(
            "id",
            {},
        ).get(
            "pattern"
        )
        != "^EX-(S1|S3)-[0-9]{2}$"
    ):
        fail(
            "T21 Patrón de ID de explicación incorrecto."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T21 IDs de explicación usan EX-S1/EX-S3."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T22 - SOURCE QUESTION ID
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        item_properties.get(
            "source_question_id",
            {},
        ).get(
            "pattern"
        )
        != "^(S1|S3)-[0-9]{2}$"
    ):
        fail(
            "T22 source_question_id no está limitado a S1/S3."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T22 source_question_id está limitado al banco original."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T23 - SOURCE HASH
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        item_properties.get(
            "source_question_sha256",
            {},
        ).get(
            "pattern"
        )
        != "^[A-F0-9]{64}$"
    ):
        fail(
            "T23 No se exige SHA-256 de la pregunta fuente."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T23 Cada explicación queda ligada al hash "
            "de su pregunta fuente."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T24 - ORIGEN ITEM
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        item_properties.get(
            "origin",
            {},
        ).get(
            "const"
        )
        != "generated_pedagogical_explanation"
    ):
        fail(
            "T24 origin del item incorrecto."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T24 Contenido nuevo queda identificado como generado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T25 - ITEM NO OFICIAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        item_properties.get(
            "official_utn_question",
            {},
        ).get(
            "const"
        )
        is not False
    ):
        fail(
            "T25 Una explicación podría declararse oficial UTN."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T25 Cada explicación queda marcada como no oficial."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T26 - IDEA CLAVE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        item_properties.get(
            "idea_key",
            {},
        ).get(
            "minLength"
        )
        != 1
    ):
        fail(
            "T26 idea_key podría estar vacío."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T26 idea_key es obligatoria y no vacía."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T27 - QUÉ PIDE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        item_properties.get(
            "what_is_asked",
            {},
        ).get(
            "minLength"
        )
        != 1
    ):
        fail(
            "T27 what_is_asked podría estar vacío."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T27 El contrato exige explicar qué pide el ejercicio."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T28 - DATOS RELEVANTES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        item_properties.get(
            "relevant_data",
            {},
        ).get(
            "type"
        )
        != "array"
    ):
        fail(
            "T28 relevant_data no es una lista."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T28 Datos relevantes se almacenan estructuradamente."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T29 - CONCEPTO/REGLA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        item_properties.get(
            "concept_or_rule",
            {},
        ).get(
            "minLength"
        )
        != 1
    ):
        fail(
            "T29 concept_or_rule podría estar vacío."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T29 Concepto o regla es obligatorio."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T30 - FÓRMULA/FRAMEWORK
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        item_properties.get(
            "formula_or_framework",
            {},
        ).get(
            "minLength"
        )
        != 1
    ):
        fail(
            "T30 formula_or_framework podría estar vacío."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T30 Fórmula o marco de razonamiento es obligatorio."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T31 - PASOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    steps_rule = item_properties.get(
        "steps",
        {},
    )

    if (
        steps_rule.get(
            "type"
        )
        != "array"
        or
        steps_rule.get(
            "minItems"
        )
        != 1
    ):
        fail(
            "T31 steps no exige al menos un paso."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T31 Toda explicación exige resolución paso a paso."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T32 - DEFINICIÓN STEP
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    step_schema = definitions.get(
        "step",
        {},
    )

    expected_step_fields = {
        "order",
        "title",
        "detail",
    }

    if (
        set(
            step_schema.get(
                "required",
                [],
            )
        )
        != expected_step_fields
    ):
        fail(
            "T32 Estructura de step incorrecta."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T32 Cada paso exige orden, título y detalle."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T33 - MATH OPCIONAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    math_type = (
        step_schema
        .get(
            "properties",
            {},
        )
        .get(
            "math",
            {},
        )
        .get(
            "type"
        )
    )

    if (
        math_type
        != [
            "string",
            "null",
        ]
    ):
        fail(
            "T33 Campo math opcional incorrecto."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T33 Los pasos soportan expresión matemática opcional."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T34 - WHY CORRECT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        item_properties.get(
            "why_correct",
            {},
        ).get(
            "minLength"
        )
        != 1
    ):
        fail(
            "T34 why_correct podría estar vacío."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T34 Debe explicarse por qué la respuesta es correcta."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T35 - DISTRACTOR ANALYSIS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    distractors_rule = item_properties.get(
        "distractor_analysis",
        {},
    )

    if (
        distractors_rule.get(
            "type"
        )
        != "array"
    ):
        fail(
            "T35 distractor_analysis no es una lista."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T35 El contrato soporta análisis de distractores."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T36 - DEFINICIÓN DISTRACTOR
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    distractor_schema = definitions.get(
        "distractor",
        {},
    )

    expected_distractor_fields = {
        "choice",
        "why_wrong",
        "error_pattern",
    }

    if (
        set(
            distractor_schema.get(
                "required",
                [],
            )
        )
        != expected_distractor_fields
    ):
        fail(
            "T36 Estructura de distractor incorrecta."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T36 Cada distractor puede explicar error y patrón."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T37 - ERROR COMÚN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        item_properties.get(
            "common_error",
            {},
        ).get(
            "minLength"
        )
        != 1
    ):
        fail(
            "T37 common_error podría estar vacío."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T37 Toda explicación exige un error típico."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T38 - TRANSFERENCIA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        item_properties.get(
            "transfer_tip",
            {},
        ).get(
            "minLength"
        )
        != 1
    ):
        fail(
            "T38 transfer_tip podría estar vacío."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T38 El contrato exige transferencia a ejercicios similares."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T39 - QUICK CHECK
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        item_properties.get(
            "quick_check",
            {},
        ).get(
            "minLength"
        )
        != 1
    ):
        fail(
            "T39 quick_check podría estar vacío."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T39 Se exige una comprobación rápida del aprendizaje."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T40 - QUALITY
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    quality_schema = definitions.get(
        "quality",
        {},
    )

    expected_quality_fields = {
        "status",
        "content_verified",
        "answer_verified",
        "steps_verified",
        "distractors_verified",
        "pedagogical_reviewed",
        "mastery_eligible",
        "flags",
    }

    if (
        set(
            quality_schema.get(
                "required",
                [],
            )
        )
        != expected_quality_fields
    ):
        fail(
            "T40 Estructura quality incompleta."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T40 Quality exige todas las verificaciones necesarias."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T41 - ESTADOS QUALITY
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    status_values = (
        quality_schema
        .get(
            "properties",
            {},
        )
        .get(
            "status",
            {},
        )
        .get(
            "enum",
            [],
        )
    )

    if (
        status_values
        != [
            "draft",
            "validated",
            "rejected",
        ]
    ):
        fail(
            "T41 Estados quality inesperados."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T41 Quality distingue draft/validated/rejected."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T42 - VERIFICACIÓN RESPUESTA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        "answer_verified"
        not in expected_quality_fields
    ):
        fail(
            "T42 No se exige verificar la respuesta correcta."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T42 La respuesta correcta debe verificarse."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T43 - VERIFICACIÓN PASOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        "steps_verified"
        not in expected_quality_fields
    ):
        fail(
            "T43 No se exige verificar los pasos."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T43 Los pasos de resolución deben verificarse."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T44 - REVISIÓN PEDAGÓGICA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        "pedagogical_reviewed"
        not in expected_quality_fields
    ):
        fail(
            "T44 No se exige revisión pedagógica."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T44 Se exige revisión pedagógica."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T45 - GENERATION
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    generation_schema = definitions.get(
        "generation",
        {},
    )

    expected_generation_fields = {
        "method",
        "source_question_locked",
        "generated_from_original_question",
        "human_validation_required",
    }

    if (
        set(
            generation_schema.get(
                "required",
                [],
            )
        )
        != expected_generation_fields
    ):
        fail(
            "T45 Estructura generation incorrecta."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T45 Generation conserva trazabilidad."
        )

    generation_properties = generation_schema.get(
        "properties",
        {},
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T46 - SOURCE LOCKED
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        generation_properties.get(
            "source_question_locked",
            {},
        ).get(
            "const"
        )
        is not True
    ):
        fail(
            "T46 La pregunta fuente no queda bloqueada."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T46 source_question_locked=True."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T47 - GENERATED FROM ORIGINAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        generation_properties.get(
            "generated_from_original_question",
            {},
        ).get(
            "const"
        )
        is not True
    ):
        fail(
            "T47 No se exige origen en la pregunta original."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T47 La explicación queda ligada a la pregunta original."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T48 - VALIDACIÓN HUMANA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        generation_properties.get(
            "human_validation_required",
            {},
        ).get(
            "const"
        )
        is not True
    ):
        fail(
            "T48 No se exige validación humana."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T48 human_validation_required=True."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T49 - BANCO VACÍO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        explanation_bank.get(
            "items"
        )
        != []
    ):
        fail(
            "T49 Banco complementario no inicia vacío."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T49 Banco complementario inicia con 0 explicaciones."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T50 - IDENTIDAD BANCO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    expected_bank_root = {
        "schema_version":
            SCHEMA_VERSION,

        "bank_version":
            BANK_VERSION,

        "origin":
            "pedagogical_companion_for_original_bank",

        "official_utn_question":
            False,

        "items":
            [],
    }

    if (
        explanation_bank
        != expected_bank_root
    ):
        fail(
            "T50 Estructura inicial del banco complementario incorrecta."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T50 Banco complementario tiene estructura inicial exacta."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T51 - REPORTE ETAPA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        report.get(
            "stage"
        )
        != "P2-D5.2"
        or
        report.get(
            "substage"
        )
        != "contract"
    ):
        fail(
            "T51 Reporte no corresponde al contrato P2-D5.2."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T51 Reporte identificado como P2-D5.2 contract."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T52 - STATUS REPORTE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        report.get(
            "status"
        )
        != "original_explanation_contract_created"
    ):
        fail(
            "T52 Estado del reporte incorrecto."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T52 Estado del contrato correctamente registrado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T53 - PRINCIPIOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    principles = report.get(
        "principles",
        {},
    )

    expected_true_principles = [
        "question_bank_remains_immutable",
        "reinforcement_bank_remains_immutable",
        "explanations_are_stored_separately",
        "expanded_explanation_means_solution_teaching",
        "curricular_metadata_is_secondary",
        "validation_required_before_use",
    ]

    invalid_principles = [
        key
        for key in expected_true_principles
        if principles.get(key) is not True
    ]

    if invalid_principles:
        fail(
            "T53 Principios contractuales inválidos: "
            + ", ".join(
                invalid_principles
            )
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T53 Principios esenciales del contrato están activos."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T54 - NO RUNTIME GENERATION
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        principles.get(
            "automatic_runtime_solution_generation"
        )
        is not False
    ):
        fail(
            "T54 El contrato permitiría generar soluciones "
            "automáticamente durante runtime."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T54 No se permite generación automática en runtime."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T55 - CAPAS DEL REPORTE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    expected_layers = [
        "idea_key",
        "what_is_asked",
        "relevant_data",
        "concept_or_rule",
        "formula_or_framework",
        "steps",
        "why_correct",
        "distractor_analysis",
        "common_error",
        "transfer_tip",
        "quick_check",
    ]

    if (
        report.get(
            "pedagogical_layers"
        )
        != expected_layers
    ):
        fail(
            "T55 Capas pedagógicas del reporte incorrectas."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T55 Reporte registra las 11 capas pedagógicas."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T56 - HASHES EN REPORTE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    source_report = report.get(
        "source",
        {},
    )

    if (
        source_report.get(
            "question_bank_sha256"
        )
        != QUESTION_BANK_SHA256
        or
        source_report.get(
            "reinforcement_bank_sha256"
        )
        != REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256
    ):
        fail(
            "T56 Hashes de bancos incorrectos en el reporte."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T56 Reporte registra hashes correctos de los bancos."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T57 - 180 HASHES INDIVIDUALES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    source_hashes = source_report.get(
        "source_question_hashes",
        {},
    )

    if len(
        source_hashes
    ) != 180:
        fail(
            "T57 Reporte no contiene 180 hashes de preguntas."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T57 Reporte contiene hash individual para las 180 preguntas."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T58 - HASHES INDIVIDUALES CORRECTOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    bad_question_hashes = []

    for question in question_bank:
        question_id = question.get(
            "id"
        )

        expected_hash = canonical_sha256(
            question
        )

        recorded_hash = source_hashes.get(
            question_id
        )

        if (
            recorded_hash
            != expected_hash
        ):
            bad_question_hashes.append(
                question_id
            )

    if bad_question_hashes:
        fail(
            "T58 Hash individual incorrecto en: "
            + ", ".join(
                bad_question_hashes[:10]
            )
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T58 Los 180 hashes individuales corresponden "
            "exactamente a sus preguntas."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T59 - ITEMS INICIALES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    initial_bank_report = report.get(
        "initial_bank",
        {},
    )

    if (
        initial_bank_report.get(
            "items"
        )
        != 0
        or
        initial_bank_report.get(
            "expected_initial_items"
        )
        != 0
    ):
        fail(
            "T59 Reporte no registra banco inicial vacío."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T59 Reporte confirma 0 explicaciones iniciales."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T60 - NEXT STAGE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    next_stage = report.get(
        "next_stage",
        {},
    )

    if (
        next_stage.get(
            "name"
        )
        != "P2-D5.2 pilot"
    ):
        fail(
            "T60 Siguiente etapa no es el piloto."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T60 Siguiente etapa definida como piloto P2-D5.2."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T61 - TXT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:
        txt = REPORT_TXT.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )

    except Exception as exc:
        fail(
            f"T61 No se pudo leer el TXT: {exc}"
        )
        txt = ""

    required_txt_fragments = [
        "P2-D5.2 - CONTRATO DE EXPLICACIONES PEDAGÓGICAS ORIGINALES",
        "Idea clave.",
        "Qué pide exactamente el ejercicio.",
        "Resolución paso a paso.",
        "Por qué la respuesta correcta es correcta.",
        "Análisis de distractores",
        "Error típico.",
        "Transferencia a ejercicios similares.",
        "question_bank.json permanece intacto.",
        "reinforcement_bank.json permanece intacto.",
        "No se generan soluciones automáticamente durante el examen.",
        "Todo contenido nuevo requiere validación antes de mostrarse.",
        "Crear un piloto pequeño de explicaciones pedagógicas.",
        QUESTION_BANK_SHA256,
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256,
        "RESULTADO: CONTRATO P2-D5.2 CREADO",
    ]

    missing_txt = [
        fragment
        for fragment in required_txt_fragments
        if fragment not in txt
    ]

    if missing_txt:
        fail(
            "T61 Informe TXT incompleto: "
            + " | ".join(
                missing_txt
            )
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T61 Informe TXT documenta correctamente el contrato."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T62 - SIN EXPLICACIONES PREMATURAS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if any(
        key.startswith("EX-")
        for key in source_hashes
    ):
        fail(
            "T62 source_question_hashes contiene IDs EX- inesperados."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T62 Trazabilidad fuente contiene solo IDs originales."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T63 - BANCO COMPLEMENTARIO NO DUPLICA PREGUNTAS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    bank_text = BANK_FILE.read_text(
        encoding="utf-8"
    )

    if (
        '"stem"'
        in bank_text
        or
        '"choices"'
        in bank_text
        or
        '"answer"'
        in bank_text
    ):
        fail(
            "T63 Banco complementario contiene campos "
            "de preguntas que no le corresponden."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T63 Banco complementario no duplica stem/choices/answer."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T64 - SCHEMA NO REQUIERE PDF
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        "pdf"
        in item_schema.get(
            "required",
            [],
        )
        or
        "page"
        in item_schema.get(
            "required",
            [],
        )
    ):
        fail(
            "T64 Explicaciones dependen innecesariamente del PDF."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T64 Banco pedagógico no depende de campos PDF."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T65 - NO CAMBIÓ NINGÚN BANCO ESTABLE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    stable_hashes_ok = (
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )
        == QUESTION_BANK_SHA256
        and
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )
        == REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256
    )

    if not stable_hashes_ok:
        fail(
            "T65 Algún banco estable cambió."
        )
    else:
        ok(
            "T65 Ambos bancos estables continúan byte por byte intactos."
        )

    finish()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
