# ============================================================
# ESTADO DE VALIDACIÓN
# ============================================================

checks = 0
structural_errors: list[str] = []
warnings: list[str] = []


def ok(message: str) -> None:
    global checks
    checks += 1
    print(
        f"[OK] {message}"
    )


def fail(message: str) -> None:
    structural_errors.append(
        message
    )
    print(
        f"[ERROR] {message}"
    )


def warn(message: str) -> None:
    warnings.append(
        message
    )
    print(
        f"[WARN] {message}"
    )


def check(
    condition: bool,
    code: str,
    message: str,
) -> None:

    if condition:
        ok(
            f"{code} {message}"
        )
    else:
        fail(
            f"{code} {message}"
        )


# ============================================================
# UTILIDADES
# ============================================================

def sha256_file(
    path: Path,
) -> str:

    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open(
        "rb"
    ) as handle:

        while True:

            chunk = handle.read(
                1024 * 1024
            )

            if not chunk:
                break

            digest.update(
                chunk
            )

    return digest.hexdigest().upper()


def canonical_sha256(
    data,
) -> str:

    payload = json.dumps(
        data,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode(
        "utf-8"
    )

    return hashlib.sha256(
        payload
    ).hexdigest().upper()


def load_json(
    path: Path,
):

    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def write_json(
    path: Path,
    data,
) -> None:

    path.parent.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            data,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        ) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def normalize(
    value,
) -> str:

    text = str(
        value or ""
    )

    text = unicodedata.normalize(
        "NFKD",
        text,
    )

    text = "".join(
        character
        for character in text
        if not unicodedata.combining(
            character
        )
    )

    text = (
        text.lower()
        .replace("×", "x")
        .replace("−", "-")
    )

    text = re.sub(
        r"\s+",
        " ",
        text,
    )

    return text.strip()


def clean_spaces(
    value,
) -> str:

    return re.sub(
        r"\s+",
        " ",
        str(
            value or ""
        ),
    ).strip()


def source_review_required(
    question: dict,
) -> bool:

    if (
        question.get(
            "status"
        )
        == "revisar_fuente"
    ):
        return True

    quality = question.get(
        "quality",
        {},
    )

    if isinstance(
        quality,
        dict,
    ):
        return bool(
            quality.get(
                "source_review_required"
            )
        )

    return False


# ============================================================
# EXTRACCIÓN INDEPENDIENTE DE PDF
# ============================================================

BOILERPLATE_PREFIXES = (
    "YachayPre Preuniversitario",
    "Simulacro UTN FICA-FICAYA",
    "Instrucciones:",
    "Resolver las 90 preguntas",
    "No está permitido el uso",
    "La evaluación deberá realizarse",
    "Marcar la opción correcta",
    "Si finaliza antes del tiempo",
)


def pdf_text(
    path: Path,
) -> str:

    pieces = []

    with fitz.open(
        path
    ) as document:

        for page in document:
            pieces.append(
                page.get_text(
                    "text"
                )
            )

    return "\n".join(
        pieces
    )


def remove_boilerplate(
    text: str,
) -> str:

    output = []

    for raw_line in text.splitlines():

        line = raw_line.strip()

        if not line:
            output.append("")
            continue

        if line.startswith(
            ""
        ):
            continue

        if any(
            line.startswith(
                prefix
            )
            for prefix
            in BOILERPLATE_PREFIXES
        ):
            continue

        output.append(
            raw_line
        )

    return "\n".join(
        output
    )


def parse_question_blocks(
    text: str,
) -> dict[int, str]:

    blocks = {}
    cursor = 0

    for number in range(
        1,
        91,
    ):

        pattern = re.compile(
            rf"(?m)^\s*{number}\.(?:-)?\s*"
        )

        match = pattern.search(
            text,
            cursor,
        )

        if not match:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"No se encontró pregunta "
                f"{number}."
            )

        if number < 90:

            next_pattern = re.compile(
                rf"(?m)^\s*{number + 1}"
                rf"\.(?:-)?\s*"
            )

            next_match = (
                next_pattern.search(
                    text,
                    match.end(),
                )
            )

            if not next_match:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"No se pudo delimitar "
                    f"pregunta {number}."
                )

            end = (
                next_match.start()
            )

        else:
            end = len(
                text
            )

        blocks[number] = (
            remove_boilerplate(
                text[
                    match.start():
                    end
                ].strip()
            )
        )

        cursor = match.end()

    return blocks


def split_stem_and_options(
    block: str,
) -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]]:

    body = re.sub(
        r"^\s*\d{1,2}\.(?:-)?\s*",
        "",
        block,
        count=1,
    ).strip()

    option_pattern = re.compile(
        r"(?ms)^\s*([A-Ea-e])"
        r"\s*[.)]\s*(.*?)"
        r"(?=^\s*[A-Ea-e]"
        r"\s*[.)]\s*|\Z)"
    )

    matches = list(
        option_pattern.finditer(
            body
        )
    )

    if not matches:
        return (
            clean_spaces(
                body
            ),
            {},
        )

    stem = clean_spaces(
        body[
            :matches[0].start()
        ]
    )

    options = {
        match.group(1).upper():
            clean_spaces(
                match.group(2)
            )
        for match in matches
    }

    return (
        stem,
        options,
    )


def extract_pdf_sources(
    questions: list[dict],
) -> dict[str, dict]:

    result = {}

    pdf_names = sorted(
        {
            question["pdf"]
            for question
            in questions
        }
    )

    parsed_pdfs = {}

    for pdf_name in pdf_names:

        path = (
            SOURCES_DIR
            / pdf_name
        )

        if not path.exists():
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Falta PDF: {path}"
            )

        blocks = (
            parse_question_blocks(
                pdf_text(
                    path
                )
            )
        )

        if len(
            blocks
        ) != 90:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"{pdf_name}: "
                "no produjo 90 bloques."
            )

        parsed_pdfs[
            pdf_name
        ] = blocks

    for question in questions:

        block = (
            parsed_pdfs[
                question["pdf"]
            ][
                int(
                    question[
                        "number"
                    ]
                )
            ]
        )

        stem, options = (
            split_stem_and_options(
                block
            )
        )

        result[
            question["id"]
        ] = {
            "stem":
                stem,

            "options":
                options,
        }

    return result


# ============================================================
# DETECCIÓN DE CONTENIDO
# ============================================================

def has_numeric_signal(
    question: dict,
    source: dict,
) -> bool:

    text = (
        source.get(
            "stem",
            ""
        )
        + " "
        + question.get(
            "explanation",
            ""
        )
    )

    normalized = normalize(
        text
    )

    return bool(
        re.search(
            r"\d",
            text,
        )
        and any(
            token in normalized
            for token in [
                "=",
                "calcula",
                "determine",
                "obtener",
                "halle",
                "valor",
                "m/s",
                "kg",
                "hz",
                "mol",
                "%",
                "cm",
                "km",
                "n ",
                "j ",
            ]
        )
    )


def math_step_count(
    item: dict,
) -> int:

    return sum(
        bool(
            clean_spaces(
                step.get(
                    "math"
                )
            )
        )
        for step in item.get(
            "steps",
            []
        )
    )


def resolution_step_count(
    item: dict,
) -> int:

    return sum(
        step.get(
            "title"
        )
        == GENERIC_RESOLUTION_TITLE
        for step in item.get(
            "steps",
            []
        )
    )


def has_generic_distractors(
    item: dict,
) -> bool:

    distractors = item.get(
        "distractor_analysis",
        []
    )

    if not distractors:
        return False

    return all(
        GENERIC_DISTRACTOR_TEXT
        in distractor.get(
            "why_wrong",
            ""
        )
        for distractor
        in distractors
    )


def has_specific_relevant_data(
    item: dict,
) -> bool:

    data = item.get(
        "relevant_data",
        []
    )

    if not data:
        return False

    for value in data:

        normalized = normalize(
            value
        )

        if not (
            normalized.startswith(
                "tema:"
            )
            or
            normalized.startswith(
                "habilidad:"
            )
        ):
            return True

    return False


# ============================================================
# AUDITORÍA PEDAGÓGICA POR ÍTEM
# ============================================================

def audit_item(
    question: dict,
    item: dict,
    source: dict,
) -> dict:

    blocking = []
    enrichment = []
    positive = []

    steps = item.get(
        "steps",
        []
    )

    source_review = (
        source_review_required(
            question
        )
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. TRAZABILIDAD
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    expected_source_hash = (
        canonical_sha256(
            question
        )
    )

    if (
        item.get(
            "source_question_sha256"
        )
        == expected_source_hash
    ):
        positive.append(
            "source_hash_ok"
        )
    else:
        blocking.append(
            "source_hash_mismatch"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. RESPUESTA BASE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    base_explanation = clean_spaces(
        question.get(
            "explanation"
        )
    )

    why_correct = clean_spaces(
        item.get(
            "why_correct"
        )
    )

    if (
        base_explanation
        and
        normalize(
            base_explanation
        )
        in normalize(
            why_correct
        )
    ):
        positive.append(
            "original_explanation_preserved"
        )
    else:
        blocking.append(
            "original_explanation_not_preserved"
        )

    answer = str(
        question.get(
            "answer",
            ""
        )
    ).upper()

    if (
        answer
        and
        answer
        in why_correct
    ):
        positive.append(
            "answer_reference_present"
        )
    else:
        blocking.append(
            "answer_reference_missing"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. CONCEPTO ESPECÍFICO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    concept = item.get(
        "concept_or_rule",
        ""
    )

    if concept.startswith(
        GENERIC_CONCEPT_PREFIX
    ):
        enrichment.append(
            "generic_concept"
        )
    else:
        positive.append(
            "specific_concept"
        )

    formula = item.get(
        "formula_or_framework",
        ""
    )

    if formula.startswith(
        GENERIC_FORMULA_PREFIX
    ):
        enrichment.append(
            "generic_formula_or_framework"
        )
    else:
        positive.append(
            "specific_formula_or_framework"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. QUÉ PIDE EL EJERCICIO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    what_is_asked = item.get(
        "what_is_asked",
        ""
    )

    if what_is_asked.startswith(
        GENERIC_WHAT_PREFIX
    ):
        enrichment.append(
            "what_is_asked_is_stem_wrapper"
        )
    else:
        positive.append(
            "what_is_asked_rephrased"
        )

    # Debe guardar relación real con el stem extraído.
    source_stem = source.get(
        "stem",
        ""
    )

    if (
        source_stem
        and
        normalize(
            source_stem
        )
        in normalize(
            what_is_asked
        )
    ):
        positive.append(
            "stem_trace_present"
        )
    else:
        enrichment.append(
            "weak_stem_trace"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. DATOS RELEVANTES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if has_specific_relevant_data(
        item
    ):
        positive.append(
            "specific_relevant_data"
        )
    else:
        enrichment.append(
            "relevant_data_too_generic"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. PROFUNDIDAD DE PASOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if len(
        steps
    ) >= 4:
        positive.append(
            "enough_steps"
        )
    else:
        blocking.append(
            "too_few_steps"
        )

    generic_scaffold = any(
        step.get(
            "title"
        )
        == GENERIC_STEP_TITLE
        for step in steps
    )

    resolution_count = (
        resolution_step_count(
            item
        )
    )

    math_count = (
        math_step_count(
            item
        )
    )

    if not generic_scaffold:
        positive.append(
            "question_specific_step_sequence"
        )

    elif (
        resolution_count >= 2
        or math_count >= 2
    ):
        positive.append(
            "generic_scaffold_with_substantive_work"
        )

    else:
        enrichment.append(
            "resolution_steps_too_template_based"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 7. CÁLCULOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if has_numeric_signal(
        question,
        source,
    ):

        if math_count >= 1:
            positive.append(
                "numeric_work_has_math"
            )
        else:
            blocking.append(
                "numeric_question_without_math_step"
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 8. DISTRACTORES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    source_options = source.get(
        "options",
        {}
    )

    distractors = item.get(
        "distractor_analysis",
        []
    )

    if source_options:

        expected_wrong = (
            len(source_options)
            - (
                1
                if answer
                in source_options
                else 0
            )
        )

        if distractors:
            positive.append(
                "distractor_analysis_present"
            )

        else:
            enrichment.append(
                "distractor_analysis_missing"
            )

        if (
            expected_wrong > 0
            and len(
                distractors
            )
            < min(
                expected_wrong,
                4,
            )
        ):
            enrichment.append(
                "incomplete_distractor_coverage"
            )

        if has_generic_distractors(
            item
        ):
            enrichment.append(
                "distractor_explanations_generic"
            )
        elif distractors:
            positive.append(
                "specific_distractor_explanations"
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 9. ERROR TÍPICO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    common_error = clean_spaces(
        item.get(
            "common_error"
        )
    )

    if len(
        common_error
    ) >= 30:
        positive.append(
            "common_error_present"
        )
    else:
        enrichment.append(
            "common_error_too_short"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 10. TRANSFERENCIA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    transfer = item.get(
        "transfer_tip",
        ""
    )

    if transfer.startswith(
        GENERIC_TRANSFER_PREFIX
    ):
        enrichment.append(
            "transfer_tip_generic"
        )
    else:
        positive.append(
            "transfer_tip_specific"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 11. QUICK CHECK
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    quick = item.get(
        "quick_check",
        ""
    )

    if quick.startswith(
        GENERIC_QUICK_PREFIX
    ):
        enrichment.append(
            "quick_check_generic"
        )
    else:
        positive.append(
            "quick_check_specific"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 12. SOURCE REVIEW
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if source_review:
        blocking.append(
            "source_review_required"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # SCORE PEDAGÓGICO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    score = 0

    score += int(
        "specific_concept"
        in positive
    )

    score += int(
        "specific_formula_or_framework"
        in positive
    )

    score += int(
        "specific_relevant_data"
        in positive
    )

    score += int(
        (
            "question_specific_step_sequence"
            in positive
        )
        or
        (
            "generic_scaffold_with_substantive_work"
            in positive
        )
    )

    score += int(
        (
            not has_numeric_signal(
                question,
                source,
            )
        )
        or
        (
            "numeric_work_has_math"
            in positive
        )
    )

    score += int(
        "original_explanation_preserved"
        in positive
    )

    score += int(
        "common_error_present"
        in positive
    )

    score += int(
        "transfer_tip_specific"
        in positive
    )

    score += int(
        "quick_check_specific"
        in positive
    )

    score += int(
        (
            not source_options
        )
        or
        (
            "distractor_analysis_present"
            in positive
        )
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # CLASIFICACIÓN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if source_review:

        classification = (
            "source_review"
        )

    elif blocking:

        classification = (
            "needs_correction"
        )

    elif (
        score >= 8
        and len(
            enrichment
        ) <= 3
    ):

        classification = (
            "validation_candidate"
        )

    else:

        classification = (
            "needs_enrichment"
        )

    return {
        "id":
            item["id"],

        "source_question_id":
            question["id"],

        "area":
            (
                question.get(
                    "area"
                )
                or question.get(
                    "subject"
                )
                or "Sin área"
            ),

        "topic":
            question.get(
                "topic",
                "",
            ),

        "answer":
            question.get(
                "answer"
            ),

        "source_review_required":
            source_review,

        "pedagogical_score":
            score,

        "score_max":
            10,

        "classification":
            classification,

        "blocking_reasons":
            sorted(
                set(
                    blocking
                )
            ),

        "enrichment_reasons":
            sorted(
                set(
                    enrichment
                )
            ),

        "positive_signals":
            sorted(
                set(
                    positive
                )
            ),

        "metrics": {
            "step_count":
                len(
                    steps
                ),

            "math_step_count":
                math_count,

            "resolution_step_count":
                resolution_count,

            "distractor_count":
                len(
                    distractors
                ),

            "pdf_option_count":
                len(
                    source_options
                ),

            "base_explanation_chars":
                len(
                    base_explanation
                ),
        },
    }


# ============================================================
# CASO DE CONTROL S1-70
# ============================================================

def validate_variance_control(
    items_by_source: dict,
) -> None:

    item = items_by_source.get(
        "S1-70"
    )

    if not item:

        fail(
            "T31 Falta explicación EX-S1-70."
        )
        return

    titles = [
        step.get(
            "title"
        )
        for step in item.get(
            "steps",
            []
        )
    ]

    expected_titles = [
        "Calcula la media",
        "Calcula las desviaciones",
        "Eleva las desviaciones al cuadrado",
        "Calcula la varianza",
        "Comprueba la alternativa",
    ]

    if titles != expected_titles:

        fail(
            "T31 EX-S1-70 no conserva "
            "la secuencia pedagógica específica "
            "de varianza."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T31 EX-S1-70 conserva los "
            "5 pasos específicos de varianza."
        )

    math_text = " ".join(
        str(
            step.get(
                "math"
            )
            or ""
        )
        for step in item.get(
            "steps",
            []
        )
    )

    normalized_math = (
        normalize(
            math_text
        )
        .replace(
            " ",
            ""
        )
    )

    if (
        "=53"
        not in normalized_math
        or
        "=5"
        not in normalized_math
    ):

        fail(
            "T32 EX-S1-70 no muestra "
            "media=53 y varianza=5."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T32 EX-S1-70 muestra "
            "media=53 y varianza=5."
        )

    common_error = normalize(
        item.get(
            "common_error"
        )
    )

    if (
        "n-1"
        not in common_error
        or
        "muestral"
        not in common_error
    ):

        fail(
            "T33 EX-S1-70 no explica "
            "el error N vs N-1."
        )

    else:

        ok(
            "T33 EX-S1-70 explica "
            "varianza poblacional vs muestral."
        )


# ============================================================
# REPORTE TXT
# ============================================================

def build_txt(
    report: dict,
) -> str:

    summary = report[
        "summary"
    ]

    classifications = (
        summary[
            "classifications"
        ]
    )

    lines = [
        "=" * 80,
        "P2-D5.2 FULL - AUDITORÍA DE 180 EXPLICACIONES DRAFT",
        "=" * 80,
        "",
        "RESUMEN",
        "-" * 80,
        (
            "Explicaciones auditadas       : "
            f"{summary['items_audited']}"
        ),
        (
            "Candidatas a validación       : "
            f"{classifications.get('validation_candidate', 0)}"
        ),
        (
            "Necesitan enriquecimiento     : "
            f"{classifications.get('needs_enrichment', 0)}"
        ),
        (
            "Necesitan corrección          : "
            f"{classifications.get('needs_correction', 0)}"
        ),
        (
            "Revisión de fuente            : "
            f"{classifications.get('source_review', 0)}"
        ),
        (
            "Errores estructurales         : "
            f"{summary['structural_errors']}"
        ),
        (
            "Warnings globales             : "
            f"{summary['warnings']}"
        ),
        "",
        "IMPORTANTE",
        "-" * 80,
        (
            "La clasificación 'validation_candidate' "
            "NO cambia quality.status."
        ),
        (
            "Las 180 explicaciones continúan siendo DRAFT "
            "hasta la fase de corrección/validación."
        ),
        (
            "La auditoría detecta contenido genérico "
            "para evitar aprobar explicaciones que "
            "solo repitan plantillas."
        ),
        "",
        "MOTIVOS DE ENRIQUECIMIENTO MÁS FRECUENTES",
        "-" * 80,
    ]

    for reason, count in (
        report[
            "top_enrichment_reasons"
        ]
    ):
        lines.append(
            f"- {reason}: {count}"
        )

    lines.extend(
        [
            "",
            "MOTIVOS BLOQUEANTES MÁS FRECUENTES",
            "-" * 80,
        ]
    )

    if (
        report[
            "top_blocking_reasons"
        ]
    ):

        for reason, count in (
            report[
                "top_blocking_reasons"
            ]
        ):
            lines.append(
                f"- {reason}: {count}"
            )

    else:
        lines.append(
            "- Ninguno."
        )

    for classification in [
        "validation_candidate",
        "needs_enrichment",
        "needs_correction",
        "source_review",
    ]:

        lines.extend(
            [
                "",
                classification.upper(),
                "-" * 80,
            ]
        )

        ids = report[
            "ids_by_classification"
        ].get(
            classification,
            [],
        )

        if not ids:
            lines.append(
                "- Ninguno."
            )

        else:

            for start in range(
                0,
                len(ids),
                12,
            ):

                lines.append(
                    ", ".join(
                        ids[
                            start:
                            start + 12
                        ]
                    )
                )

    lines.extend(
        [
            "",
            "HASHES",
            "-" * 80,
            (
                "app.py                 : "
                + report[
                    "hashes"
                ][
                    "app"
                ]
            ),
            (
                "question_bank          : "
                + report[
                    "hashes"
                ][
                    "question_bank"
                ]
            ),
            (
                "reinforcement_bank     : "
                + report[
                    "hashes"
                ][
                    "reinforcement_bank"
                ]
            ),
            (
                "schema                 : "
                + report[
                    "hashes"
                ][
                    "schema"
                ]
            ),
            (
                "explanation_bank       : "
                + report[
                    "hashes"
                ][
                    "explanation_bank"
                ]
            ),
            "",
            (
                "RESULTADO: AUDITORÍA "
                "P2-D5.2 FULL COMPLETADA"
            ),
        ]
    )

    return "\n".join(
        lines
    )


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main() -> None:

    print()
    print("=" * 80)
    print(
        "VALIDACIÓN / AUDITORÍA "
        "P2-D5.2 FULL - 180 DRAFTS"
    )
    print("=" * 80)
    print()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T01 - ARCHIVOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    required_files = [
        APP,
        QUESTION_BANK,
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
        SCHEMA_FILE,
        EXPLANATION_BANK,
        EMPTY_BANK_BACKUP,
        CONTRACT_REPORT,
        FULL_DRAFT_REPORT,
    ]

    missing = [
        path
        for path in required_files
        if not path.exists()
    ]

    check(
        not missing,
        "T01",
        "Todos los archivos requeridos existen.",
    )

    if missing:

        for path in missing:
            print(
                f"     Falta: {path}"
            )

        sys.exit(1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T02-T07 - HASHES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        sha256_file(
            APP
        )
        == APP_SHA256,
        "T02",
        "app.py permanece en P2-D5.1.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )
        == QUESTION_BANK_SHA256,
        "T03",
        "question_bank.json permanece intacto.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )
        == REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256,
        "T04",
        "reinforcement_bank.json permanece intacto.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            SCHEMA_FILE
        )
        == SCHEMA_SHA256,
        "T05",
        "Schema P2-D5.2 permanece intacto.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            EMPTY_BANK_BACKUP
        )
        == EMPTY_BANK_SHA256,
        "T06",
        "Backup contractual vacío permanece intacto.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )
        == FULL_DRAFT_BANK_SHA256,
        "T07",
        "Banco FULL DRAFT coincide con el SHA esperado.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T08 - JSON
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:

        questions = load_json(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )

        reinforcement = load_json(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )

        schema = load_json(
            SCHEMA_FILE
        )

        explanation_bank = load_json(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )

        contract_report = load_json(
            CONTRACT_REPORT
        )

        full_report = load_json(
            FULL_DRAFT_REPORT
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        fail(
            f"T08 Error leyendo JSON: {exc}"
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    ok(
        "T08 Todos los JSON se leen correctamente."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T09-T12 - CANTIDADES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        isinstance(
            questions,
            list,
        )
        and len(
            questions
        )
        == 180,
        "T09",
        "Banco original contiene exactamente 180 preguntas.",
    )

    reinforcement_items = (
        reinforcement.get(
            "items",
            []
        )
    )

    check(
        len(
            reinforcement_items
        )
        == 8,
        "T10",
        "Banco de refuerzo conserva 8 preguntas.",
    )

    items = explanation_bank.get(
        "items",
        []
    )

    check(
        len(
            items
        )
        == 180,
        "T11",
        "Banco complementario contiene 180 explicaciones.",
    )

    check(
        explanation_bank.get(
            "schema_version"
        )
        == SCHEMA_VERSION
        and
        explanation_bank.get(
            "bank_version"
        )
        == BANK_VERSION,
        "T12",
        "Versiones del banco complementario son correctas.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T13 - IDS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    expected_source_ids = [
        question.get(
            "id"
        )
        for question
        in questions
    ]

    actual_source_ids = [
        item.get(
            "source_question_id"
        )
        for item
        in items
    ]

    check(
        actual_source_ids
        == expected_source_ids,
        "T13",
        "Las 180 explicaciones siguen el orden exacto del banco original.",
    )

    explanation_ids = [
        item.get(
            "id"
        )
        for item in items
    ]

    check(
        len(
            set(
                explanation_ids
            )
        )
        == 180,
        "T14",
        "Los 180 IDs EX- son únicos.",
    )

    expected_explanation_ids = [
        f"EX-{question_id}"
        for question_id
        in expected_source_ids
    ]

    check(
        explanation_ids
        == expected_explanation_ids,
        "T15",
        "Cada EX- corresponde exactamente a su S1/S3.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T16 - ESTRUCTURA DE LOS 180
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    item_structure_errors = []

    for item in items:

        item_id = item.get(
            "id",
            "SIN-ID",
        )

        if set(
            item.keys()
        ) != EXPECTED_ITEM_FIELDS:

            item_structure_errors.append(
                f"{item_id}: campos item"
            )

        quality = item.get(
            "quality",
            {},
        )

        if set(
            quality.keys()
        ) != EXPECTED_QUALITY_FIELDS:

            item_structure_errors.append(
                f"{item_id}: campos quality"
            )

        generation = item.get(
            "generation",
            {},
        )

        if set(
            generation.keys()
        ) != EXPECTED_GENERATION_FIELDS:

            item_structure_errors.append(
                f"{item_id}: campos generation"
            )

        for step in item.get(
            "steps",
            []
        ):

            if not (
                EXPECTED_STEP_FIELDS_REQUIRED
                <= set(
                    step.keys()
                )
            ):

                item_structure_errors.append(
                    f"{item_id}: step incompleto"
                )

    check(
        not item_structure_errors,
        "T16",
        "Los 180 registros cumplen la estructura contractual.",
    )

    if item_structure_errors:

        for issue in (
            item_structure_errors[
                :20
            ]
        ):

            print(
                f"     {issue}"
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T17 - TODOS DRAFT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        all(
            item.get(
                "quality",
                {},
            ).get(
                "status"
            )
            == "draft"
            for item
            in items
        ),
        "T17",
        "Las 180 explicaciones permanecen en estado DRAFT.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T18 - NO MASTERY
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        all(
            item.get(
                "quality",
                {},
            ).get(
                "mastery_eligible"
            )
            is False
            for item
            in items
        ),
        "T18",
        "Ningún DRAFT cuenta como dominio.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T19 - VERIFICACIONES EN FALSE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    verification_fields = [
        "content_verified",
        "answer_verified",
        "steps_verified",
        "distractors_verified",
        "pedagogical_reviewed",
    ]

    check(
        all(
            all(
                item[
                    "quality"
                ].get(
                    field
                )
                is False
                for field
                in verification_fields
            )
            for item
            in items
        ),
        "T19",
        "Los DRAFT no están falsamente marcados como verificados.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T20 - ORIGIN / OFICIAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        all(
            item.get(
                "origin"
            )
            == "generated_pedagogical_explanation"
            and
            item.get(
                "official_utn_question"
            )
            is False
            for item
            in items
        ),
        "T20",
        "Las explicaciones están identificadas como generadas y no oficiales.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T21 - GENERATION
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        all(
            item[
                "generation"
            ].get(
                "method"
            )
            == "controlled_pedagogical_generation"
            and
            item[
                "generation"
            ].get(
                "source_question_locked"
            )
            is True
            and
            item[
                "generation"
            ].get(
                "generated_from_original_question"
            )
            is True
            and
            item[
                "generation"
            ].get(
                "human_validation_required"
            )
            is True
            for item
            in items
        ),
        "T21",
        "Las 180 explicaciones mantienen trazabilidad y validación humana requerida.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T22 - HASH POR PREGUNTA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    bad_hashes = []

    for question, item in zip(
        questions,
        items,
    ):

        expected_hash = (
            canonical_sha256(
                question
            )
        )

        if (
            item.get(
                "source_question_sha256"
            )
            != expected_hash
        ):

            bad_hashes.append(
                question[
                    "id"
                ]
            )

    check(
        not bad_hashes,
        "T22",
        "Los 180 hashes individuales corresponden a sus preguntas fuente.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T23 - FLAG FULL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        all(
            "full_pending_validation"
            in item[
                "quality"
            ].get(
                "flags",
                [],
            )
            for item
            in items
        ),
        "T23",
        "Los 180 DRAFT conservan full_pending_validation.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T24 - SOURCE REVIEW
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    review_ids = [
        question[
            "id"
        ]
        for question
        in questions
        if source_review_required(
            question
        )
    ]

    review_set = set(
        review_ids
    )

    flagged_review_set = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in items
        if (
            "source_review_required"
            in item[
                "quality"
            ].get(
                "flags",
                [],
            )
        )
    }

    check(
        flagged_review_set
        == review_set,
        "T24",
        "Las marcas source_review_required coinciden con el banco original.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T25 - CONTENIDO NO VACÍO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    required_text_fields = [
        "idea_key",
        "what_is_asked",
        "concept_or_rule",
        "formula_or_framework",
        "why_correct",
        "common_error",
        "transfer_tip",
        "quick_check",
    ]

    empty_content = []

    for item in items:

        for field in (
            required_text_fields
        ):

            if not clean_spaces(
                item.get(
                    field
                )
            ):

                empty_content.append(
                    (
                        item["id"],
                        field,
                    )
                )

    check(
        not empty_content,
        "T25",
        "Las capas pedagógicas obligatorias no están vacías.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T26 - PASOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    invalid_steps = []

    for item in items:

        steps = item.get(
            "steps",
            []
        )

        orders = [
            step.get(
                "order"
            )
            for step
            in steps
        ]

        expected_orders = list(
            range(
                1,
                len(
                    steps
                ) + 1,
            )
        )

        if (
            not steps
            or
            orders
            != expected_orders
        ):

            invalid_steps.append(
                item[
                    "id"
                ]
            )

    check(
        not invalid_steps,
        "T26",
        "Los pasos de las 180 explicaciones tienen orden secuencial.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T27 - REPORTE FULL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        full_report.get(
            "stage"
        )
        == "P2-D5.2"
        and
        full_report.get(
            "substage"
        )
        == "full_draft_generation"
        and
        full_report.get(
            "counts",
            {},
        ).get(
            "generated_explanations"
        )
        == 180,
        "T27",
        "Reporte FULL registra las 180 explicaciones.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T28 - HASH DEL FULL EN REPORTE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        full_report.get(
            "hashes",
            {},
        ).get(
            "explanation_bank_after"
        )
        == FULL_DRAFT_BANK_SHA256,
        "T28",
        "Reporte FULL contiene el SHA correcto del banco DRAFT.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T29 - CONTRATO PREVIO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        contract_report.get(
            "stage"
        )
        == "P2-D5.2"
        and
        contract_report.get(
            "substage"
        )
        == "contract",
        "T29",
        "El contrato P2-D5.2 previo permanece disponible.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T30 - EXTRACCIÓN PDF INDEPENDIENTE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:

        pdf_sources = (
            extract_pdf_sources(
                questions
            )
        )

        check(
            len(
                pdf_sources
            )
            == 180
            and all(
                clean_spaces(
                    source.get(
                        "stem"
                    )
                )
                for source
                in pdf_sources.values()
            ),
            "T30",
            "Los dos PDF vuelven a producir 180 enunciados no vacíos.",
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        fail(
            "T30 Falló extracción independiente "
            f"de PDF: {exc}"
        )

        pdf_sources = {}

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T31-T33 - CONTROL S1-70
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    items_by_source = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]:
            item
        for item
        in items
    }

    validate_variance_control(
        items_by_source
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Si hay errores estructurales, NO hacer clasificación
    # pedagógica sobre una base corrupta.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if structural_errors:

        print()
        print("=" * 80)
        print(
            "RESUMEN DE VALIDACIÓN "
            "P2-D5.2 FULL"
        )
        print("=" * 80)

        print(
            f"Checks aprobados       : {checks}"
        )

        print(
            f"Errores estructurales  : "
            f"{len(structural_errors)}"
        )

        print(
            f"Warnings               : "
            f"{len(warnings)}"
        )

        print()
        print("ERRORES")
        print("-" * 80)

        for error in structural_errors:
            print(
                f"- {error}"
            )

        print()
        print(
            "RESULTADO: AUDITORÍA "
            "P2-D5.2 FULL ABORTADA"
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    # ========================================================
    # AUDITORÍA PEDAGÓGICA 180/180
    # ========================================================

    print()
    print(
        "[INFO] Iniciando auditoría "
        "pedagógica 180/180..."
    )

    audits = []

    for question, item in zip(
        questions,
        items,
    ):

        source = pdf_sources.get(
            question[
                "id"
            ],
            {
                "stem": "",
                "options": {},
            },
        )

        audits.append(
            audit_item(
                question,
                item,
                source,
            )
        )

    classification_counter = Counter(
        audit[
            "classification"
        ]
        for audit
        in audits
    )

    enrichment_counter = Counter()

    blocking_counter = Counter()

    score_counter = Counter(
        audit[
            "pedagogical_score"
        ]
        for audit
        in audits
    )

    by_area = defaultdict(
        Counter
    )

    ids_by_classification = defaultdict(
        list
    )

    for audit in audits:

        ids_by_classification[
            audit[
                "classification"
            ]
        ].append(
            audit[
                "source_question_id"
            ]
        )

        by_area[
            audit[
                "area"
            ]
        ][
            audit[
                "classification"
            ]
        ] += 1

        for reason in audit[
            "enrichment_reasons"
        ]:

            enrichment_counter[
                reason
            ] += 1

        for reason in audit[
            "blocking_reasons"
        ]:

            blocking_counter[
                reason
            ] += 1

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # AUDIT REPORT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    report = {
        "stage":
            "P2-D5.2",

        "substage":
            "full_draft_audit",

        "status":
            "audit_completed_no_bank_mutation",

        "method": {
            "items_audited":
                180,

            "pdf_reextracted":
                True,

            "source_hash_recalculated":
                True,

                True,

            "bank_mutated":
                False,

            "quality_status_mutated":
                False,
        },

        "summary": {

                    audits

                    sorted(

                        counter.items()

    write_json(

    AUDIT_TXT.write_text(

    # --------------------------------------------------------

    post_hashes_ok = (

        == APP_SHA256
        and
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )
        == QUESTION_BANK_SHA256
        and
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )
        == REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256
        and
        sha256_file(
            SCHEMA_FILE
        )
        == SCHEMA_SHA256
        and
        sha256_file(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )
        == FULL_DRAFT_BANK_SHA256
    )

    if not post_hashes_ok:

        fail(
            "POST-AUDIT Algún archivo estable cambió."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # RESUMEN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    print()
    print("=" * 80)
    print(
        "RESUMEN DE AUDITORÍA "
        "P2-D5.2 FULL"
    )
    print("=" * 80)

    print(

        len(

        ),
    )

checks = 0
errors: list[str] = []
warnings: list[str] = []


def ok(message: str) -> None:
    global checks
    checks += 1
    print(f"[OK] {message}")


def fail(message: str) -> None:
    errors.append(message)
    print(f"[ERROR] {message}")


def warn(message: str) -> None:
    warnings.append(message)
    print(f"[WARN] {message}")


def check(
    condition: bool,
    code: str,
    message: str,
) -> None:

    if condition:
        ok(
            f"{code} {message}"
        )
    else:
        fail(
            f"{code} {message}"
        )


# ============================================================
# UTILIDADES
# ============================================================

def sha256_file(
    path: Path,
) -> str:

    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open("rb") as handle:

        while True:

            chunk = handle.read(
                1024 * 1024
            )

            if not chunk:
                break

            digest.update(chunk)

    return digest.hexdigest().upper()


def canonical_sha256(
    data,
) -> str:

    encoded = json.dumps(
        data,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode("utf-8")

    return hashlib.sha256(
        encoded
    ).hexdigest().upper()


def load_json(
    path: Path,
):

    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def write_json(
    path: Path,
    data,
) -> None:

    path.parent.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            data,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        ) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def normalize(
    value,
) -> str:

    text = str(
        value or ""
    )

    text = unicodedata.normalize(
        "NFKD",
        text,
    )

    text = "".join(
        character
        for character in text
        if not unicodedata.combining(
            character
        )
    )

    text = (
        text.lower()
        .replace("×", "x")
        .replace("−", "-")
    )

    text = re.sub(
        r"\s+",
        " ",
        text,
    )

    return text.strip()


def clean_spaces(
    value,
) -> str:

    return re.sub(
        r"\s+",
        " ",
        str(value or ""),
    ).strip()


def source_review_required(
    question: dict,
) -> bool:

    if (
        question.get("status")
        == "revisar_fuente"
    ):
        return True

    quality = question.get(
        "quality",
        {},
    )

    if isinstance(
        quality,
        dict,
    ):
        return bool(
            quality.get(
                "source_review_required"
            )
        )

    return False
