# PDF
# ============================================================

BOILERPLATE_PREFIXES = (
    "YachayPre Preuniversitario",
    "Simulacro UTN FICA-FICAYA",
    "Instrucciones:",
    "Resolver las 90 preguntas",
    "No está permitido el uso",
    "La evaluación deberá realizarse",
    "Marcar la opción correcta",
    "Si finaliza antes del tiempo",
)


def pdf_text(
    path: Path,
) -> str:

    parts = []

    with fitz.open(path) as document:

        for page in document:

            parts.append(
                page.get_text(
                    "text"
                )
            )

    return "\n".join(
        parts
    )


def remove_boilerplate(
    text: str,
) -> str:

    lines = []

    for raw_line in text.splitlines():

        line = raw_line.strip()

        if not line:
            lines.append("")
            continue

        if line.startswith(""):
            continue

        if any(
            line.startswith(prefix)
            for prefix
            in BOILERPLATE_PREFIXES
        ):
            continue

        lines.append(
            raw_line
        )

    return "\n".join(
        lines
    )


def parse_question_blocks(
    text: str,
) -> dict[int, str]:

    blocks = {}
    cursor = 0

    for number in range(
        1,
        91,
    ):

        pattern = re.compile(
            rf"(?m)^\s*{number}\.(?:-)?\s*"
        )

        match = pattern.search(
            text,
            cursor,
        )

        if not match:

            raise RuntimeError(
                f"No se encontró pregunta {number}."
            )

        if number < 90:

            next_pattern = re.compile(
                rf"(?m)^\s*{number + 1}"
                rf"\.(?:-)?\s*"
            )

            next_match = next_pattern.search(
                text,
                match.end(),
            )

            if not next_match:

                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"No se pudo delimitar "
                    f"pregunta {number}."
                )

            end = next_match.start()

        else:

            end = len(text)

        blocks[number] = (
            remove_boilerplate(
                text[
                    match.start():
                    end
                ]
            ).strip()
        )

        cursor = match.end()

    return blocks


def split_stem_and_options(
    block: str,
) -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]]:

    body = re.sub(
        r"^\s*\d{1,2}\.(?:-)?\s*",
        "",
        block,
        count=1,
    ).strip()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Opciones por línea
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    line_pattern = re.compile(
        r"(?ms)^\s*([A-Ea-e])"
        r"\s*[.)]\s*(.*?)"
        r"(?=^\s*[A-Ea-e]"
        r"\s*[.)]\s*|\Z)"
    )

    matches = list(
        line_pattern.finditer(
            body
        )
    )

    if len(matches) >= 2:

        stem = clean_spaces(
            body[
                :matches[0].start()
            ]
        )

        options = {
            match.group(1).upper():
                clean_spaces(
                    match.group(2)
                )
            for match in matches
        }

        return (
            stem,
            options,
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Opciones inline
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    inline_pattern = re.compile(
        r"(?i)(?<![A-Za-z])"
        r"([A-E])\s*[.)]\s*"
    )

    inline_matches = list(
        inline_pattern.finditer(
            body
        )
    )

    if len(inline_matches) >= 2:

        stem = clean_spaces(
            body[
                :inline_matches[0].start()
            ]
        )

        options = {}

        for index, match in enumerate(
            inline_matches
        ):

            start = match.end()

            if (
                index + 1
                < len(inline_matches)
            ):

                end = (
                    inline_matches[
                        index + 1
                    ].start()
                )

            else:

                end = len(body)

            options[
                match.group(1).upper()
            ] = clean_spaces(
                body[start:end]
            )

        return (
            stem,
            options,
        )

    return (
        clean_spaces(body),
        {},
    )


def extract_pdf_sources(
    questions: list[dict],
) -> dict[str, dict]:

    pdf_names = sorted(
        {
            question["pdf"]
            for question in questions
        }
    )

    parsed = {}

    for pdf_name in pdf_names:

        path = (
            SOURCES_DIR
            / pdf_name
        )

        if not path.exists():

            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Falta PDF: {path}"
            )

        blocks = parse_question_blocks(
            pdf_text(path)
        )

        if len(blocks) != 90:

            raise RuntimeError(
                f"{pdf_name}: no produjo 90 preguntas."
            )

        parsed[
            pdf_name
        ] = blocks

    result = {}

    for question in questions:

        block = parsed[
            question["pdf"]
        ][
            int(
                question["number"]
            )
        ]

        stem, options = (
            split_stem_and_options(
                block
            )
        )

        result[
            question["id"]
        ] = {
            "stem":
                stem,

            "options":
                options,
        }

    return result


# ============================================================
# DETECTORES
# ============================================================

def has_old_template(
    item: dict,
) -> bool:

    if item.get(
        "what_is_asked",
        "",
    ).startswith(
        OLD_WHAT_PREFIX
    ):
        return True

    if item.get(
        "concept_or_rule",
        "",
    ).startswith(
        OLD_CONCEPT_PREFIX
    ):
        return True

    if item.get(
        "formula_or_framework",
        "",
    ).startswith(
        OLD_FORMULA_PREFIX
    ):
        return True

    if item.get(
        "transfer_tip",
        "",
    ).startswith(
        OLD_TRANSFER_PREFIX
    ):
        return True

    if item.get(
        "quick_check",
        "",
    ).startswith(
        OLD_QUICK_PREFIX
    ):
        return True

    if any(
        step.get(
            "title"
        )
        == OLD_GENERIC_STEP_TITLE
        for step in item.get(
            "steps",
            []
        )
    ):
        return True

    if any(
        OLD_DISTRACTOR_TEXT
        in distractor.get(
            "why_wrong",
            "",
        )
        for distractor
        in item.get(
            "distractor_analysis",
            []
        )
    ):
        return True

    return False


def uses_fallback_profile(
    item: dict,
) -> bool:

    concept = item.get(
        "concept_or_rule",
        ""
    )

    framework = item.get(
        "formula_or_framework",
        ""
    )

    return (
        FALLBACK_CONCEPT_FRAGMENT
        in concept
        or
        framework.startswith(
            FALLBACK_FRAMEWORK_PREFIX
        )
    )


def semigeneric_distractor_count(
    item: dict,
) -> int:

    count = 0

    for distractor in item.get(
        "distractor_analysis",
        []
    ):

        reason = distractor.get(
            "why_wrong",
            ""
        )

        if (
            SEMI_GENERIC_DISTRACTOR_FRAGMENT
            in reason
            or
            reason.startswith(
                NUMERIC_FALLBACK_DISTRACTOR_PREFIX
            )
        ):

            count += 1

    return count


def math_step_count(
    item: dict,
) -> int:

    return sum(
        bool(
            clean_spaces(
                step.get(
                    "math"
                )
            )
        )
        for step in item.get(
            "steps",
            []
        )
    )


def has_numeric_problem(
    question: dict,
    source: dict,
) -> bool:

    stem = source.get(
        "stem",
        ""
    )

    text = normalize(
        stem
        + " "
        + question.get(
            "explanation",
            ""
        )
    )

    if not re.search(
        r"\d",
        stem,
    ):
        return False

    numeric_keywords = [
        "calcula",
        "calcular",
        "determine",
        "determina",
        "obtener",
        "valor",
        "velocidad",
        "distancia",
        "trabajo",
        "energia",
        "energía",
        "potencia",
        "varianza",
        "media",
        "porcentaje",
        "derivada",
        "pendiente",
        "determinante",
        "frecuencia",
        "periodo",
        "período",
        "longitud de onda",
        "campo magnetico",
        "campo magnético",
        "fuerza",
        "aceleracion",
        "aceleración",
        "moles",
        "peso molecular",
        "masa molar",
    ]

    return any(
        keyword in text
        for keyword
        in numeric_keywords
    )


def relevant_data_specific(
    item: dict,
) -> bool:

    values = item.get(
        "relevant_data",
        []
    )

    if not values:
        return False

    for value in values:

        normalized = normalize(
            value
        )

        if re.search(
            r"\d|%|°|kg|m/s|hz|mol|"
            r"matriz|punto|vector|"
            r"condicion|criterio clave",
            normalized,
        ):
            return True

    return len(values) >= 2


# ============================================================
# AUDITORÍA PEDAGÓGICA
# ============================================================

def audit_item(
    question: dict,
    item: dict,
    source: dict,
) -> dict:

    blocking = []
    enrichment = []
    positive = []

    answer = str(
        question.get(
            "answer",
            "",
        )
    ).upper()

    steps = item.get(
        "steps",
        []
    )

    distractors = item.get(
        "distractor_analysis",
        []
    )

    source_options = source.get(
        "options",
        {}
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # TRAZABILIDAD
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    expected_hash = canonical_sha256(
        question
    )

    if (
        item.get(
            "source_question_sha256"
        )
        == expected_hash
    ):

        positive.append(
            "source_hash_ok"
        )

    else:

        blocking.append(
            "source_hash_mismatch"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # RESOLUCIÓN ORIGINAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    base = clean_spaces(
        question.get(
            "explanation"
        )
    )

    why_correct = clean_spaces(
        item.get(
            "why_correct"
        )
    )

    if (
        base
        and
        normalize(base)
        in normalize(
            why_correct
        )
    ):

        positive.append(
            "original_resolution_preserved"
        )

    else:

        blocking.append(
            "original_resolution_missing"
        )

    if (
        answer
        and
        answer
        in why_correct
    ):

        positive.append(
            "answer_reference_present"
        )

    else:

        blocking.append(
            "answer_reference_missing"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # PLANTILLA ANTIGUA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if has_old_template(
        item
    ):

        blocking.append(
            "old_template_survived"
        )

    else:

        positive.append(
            "old_template_removed"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # QUÉ PIDE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    what = item.get(
        "what_is_asked",
        ""
    )

    if (
        what.startswith(
            "Debes "
        )
        and
        "enunciado de referencia es:"
        in what
    ):

        positive.append(
            "what_is_asked_interpreted"
        )

    else:

        enrichment.append(
            "what_is_asked_weak"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # CONCEPTO / FRAMEWORK
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if uses_fallback_profile(
        item
    ):

        enrichment.append(
            "profile_fallback_still_generic"
        )

    else:

        positive.append(
            "specific_content_profile"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # DATOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if relevant_data_specific(
        item
    ):

        positive.append(
            "relevant_data_specific"
        )

    else:

        enrichment.append(
            "relevant_data_weak"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # PASOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if len(
        steps
    ) >= 4:

        positive.append(
            "sufficient_step_count"
        )

    else:

        blocking.append(
            "too_few_steps"
        )

    titles = [
        step.get(
            "title",
            "",
        )
        for step in steps
    ]

    if (
        "Define exactamente el objetivo"
        in titles
        and
        "Aplica la regla correspondiente"
        in titles
        and
        "Comprueba la respuesta"
        in titles
    ):

        positive.append(
            "complete_reasoning_sequence"
        )

    elif (
        question.get("id")
        == "S1-70"
    ):

        positive.append(
            "specialized_reasoning_sequence"
        )

    else:

        enrichment.append(
            "reasoning_sequence_incomplete"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # MATEMÁTICA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    math_count = math_step_count(
        item
    )

    numeric_problem = (
        has_numeric_problem(
            question,
            source,
        )
    )

    if numeric_problem:

        if math_count >= 1:

            positive.append(
                "numeric_math_present"
            )

        else:

            enrichment.append(
                "numeric_problem_without_math"
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # DISTRACTORES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    semigeneric_count = (
        semigeneric_distractor_count(
            item
        )
    )

    if source_options:

        if distractors:

            positive.append(
                "distractor_analysis_present"
            )

        else:

            enrichment.append(
                "distractor_analysis_missing"
            )

        expected_wrong = (
            len(source_options)
            - (
                1
                if answer in source_options
                else 0
            )
        )

        expected_analyzed = min(
            expected_wrong,
            4,
        )

        if (
            expected_analyzed > 0
            and
            len(distractors)
            < expected_analyzed
        ):

            enrichment.append(
                "distractor_coverage_incomplete"
            )

        if (
            distractors
            and
            semigeneric_count
            == len(
                distractors
            )
        ):

            enrichment.append(
                "all_distractors_still_semigeneric"
            )

        elif semigeneric_count > 0:

            enrichment.append(
                "some_distractors_still_semigeneric"
            )

        elif distractors:

            positive.append(
                "distractor_reasoning_specific"
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # ERROR COMÚN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    common_error = clean_spaces(
        item.get(
            "common_error"
        )
    )

    if len(
        common_error
    ) >= 35:

        positive.append(
            "common_error_substantive"
        )

    else:

        enrichment.append(
            "common_error_weak"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # TRANSFERENCIA / QUICK CHECK
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    transfer = clean_spaces(
        item.get(
            "transfer_tip"
        )
    )

    quick = clean_spaces(
        item.get(
            "quick_check"
        )
    )

    if (
        len(transfer) >= 35
        and
        not transfer.startswith(
            OLD_TRANSFER_PREFIX
        )
    ):

        positive.append(
            "transfer_substantive"
        )

    else:

        enrichment.append(
            "transfer_weak"
        )

    if (
        len(quick) >= 20
        and
        not quick.startswith(
            OLD_QUICK_PREFIX
        )
    ):

        positive.append(
            "quick_check_substantive"
        )

    else:

        enrichment.append(
            "quick_check_weak"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # SOURCE REVIEW
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    source_review = (
        source_review_required(
            question
        )
    )

    if source_review:

        blocking.append(
            "source_review_required"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # SCORE / 12
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    score_signals = [
        "source_hash_ok",
        "original_resolution_preserved",
        "answer_reference_present",
        "old_template_removed",
        "what_is_asked_interpreted",
        "specific_content_profile",
        "relevant_data_specific",
        "sufficient_step_count",
        (
            "complete_reasoning_sequence"
            if question.get("id")
            != "S1-70"
            else
            "specialized_reasoning_sequence"
        ),
        "common_error_substantive",
        "transfer_substantive",
        "quick_check_substantive",
    ]

    score = sum(
        signal in positive
        for signal in score_signals
    )

    # Numeric work can compensate for one generic signal.
    if (
        numeric_problem
        and
        "numeric_math_present"
        in positive
        and
        score < 12
    ):
        score += 1

    score = min(
        score,
        12,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # CLASIFICACIÓN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    non_source_blocking = [
        reason
        for reason in blocking
        if reason
        != "source_review_required"
    ]

    if source_review:

        classification = (
            "source_review"
        )

    elif non_source_blocking:

        classification = (
            "needs_correction"
        )

    elif (
        score >= 10
        and len(enrichment) <= 2
    ):

        classification = (
            "validation_candidate"
        )

    else:

        classification = (
            "needs_enrichment"
        )

    return {
        "id":
            item[
                "id"
            ],

        "source_question_id":
            question[
                "id"
            ],

        "area":
            (
                question.get(
                    "area"
                )
                or
                question.get(
                    "subject"
                )
                or
                "Sin área"
            ),

        "topic":
            question.get(
                "topic",
                "",
            ),

        "answer":
            answer,

        "classification":
            classification,

        "pedagogical_score":
            score,

        "score_max":
            12,

        "source_review_required":
            source_review,

        "blocking_reasons":
            sorted(
                set(
                    blocking
                )
            ),

        "enrichment_reasons":
            sorted(
                set(
                    enrichment
                )
            ),

        "positive_signals":
            sorted(
                set(
                    positive
                )
            ),

        "metrics": {
            "step_count":
                len(
                    steps
                ),

            "math_step_count":
                math_count,

            "distractor_count":
                len(
                    distractors
                ),

            "pdf_option_count":
                len(
                    source_options
                ),

            "semigeneric_distractor_count":
                semigeneric_count,

            "uses_fallback_profile":
                uses_fallback_profile(
                    item
                ),

            "numeric_problem":
                numeric_problem,
        },
    }


# ============================================================
# CONTROL EX-S1-70
# ============================================================

def validate_variance_control(
    items_by_source: dict,
) -> None:

    item = items_by_source.get(
        "S1-70"
    )

    if not item:

        fail(
            "T37 Falta EX-S1-70."
        )
        return

    titles = [
        step.get(
            "title"
        )
        for step in item.get(
            "steps",
            []
        )
    ]

    expected_titles = [
        "Calcula la media",
        "Calcula las desviaciones",
        "Eleva las desviaciones al cuadrado",
        "Calcula la varianza poblacional",
        "Relaciona el resultado con la alternativa",
    ]

    check(
        titles
        == expected_titles,
        "T37",
        "EX-S1-70 conserva sus cinco pasos específicos.",
    )

    math_text = normalize(
        " ".join(
            str(
                step.get(
                    "math"
                )
                or ""
            )
            for step in item.get(
                "steps",
                []
            )
        )
    ).replace(
        " ",
        "",
    )

    check(
        (
            "=53"
            in math_text
            and
            "=5"
            in math_text
        ),
        "T38",
        "EX-S1-70 llega a media=53 y varianza=5.",
    )

    error_text = normalize(
        item.get(
            "common_error"
        )
    )

    check(
        (
            "n-1"
            in error_text
            and
            "poblacional"
            in error_text
        ),
        "T39",
        "EX-S1-70 conserva la diferencia N vs N-1.",
    )

    what = normalize(
        item.get(
            "what_is_asked"
        )
    )

    check(
        (
            "calcular"
            in what
            and
            "varianza"
            in what
        ),
        "T40",
        "EX-S1-70 interpreta correctamente qué pide el ejercicio.",
    )


# ============================================================
# TXT
# ============================================================

def build_txt(
    report: dict,
) -> str:

    summary = report[
        "summary"
    ]

    comparison = report[
        "comparison_with_p2d5_2"
    ]

    classifications = (
        summary[
            "classifications"
        ]
    )

    lines = [
        "=" * 82,
        "P2-D5.3 FULL - SEGUNDA AUDITORÍA PEDAGÓGICA 180/180",
        "=" * 82,
        "",
        "RESUMEN ACTUAL",
        "-" * 82,
        (
            "Explicaciones auditadas         : "
            f"{summary['items_audited']}"
        ),
        (
            "Candidatas a validación         : "
            f"{classifications.get('validation_candidate', 0)}"
        ),
        (
            "Necesitan enriquecimiento       : "
            f"{classifications.get('needs_enrichment', 0)}"
        ),
        (
            "Necesitan corrección            : "
            f"{classifications.get('needs_correction', 0)}"
        ),
        (
            "Revisión de fuente              : "
            f"{classifications.get('source_review', 0)}"
        ),
        (
            "Score pedagógico promedio       : "
            f"{summary['average_pedagogical_score']} / 12"
        ),
        "",
        "COMPARACIÓN CON P2-D5.2",
        "-" * 82,
        (
            "Candidatas anteriores           : "
            f"{comparison['old_validation_candidate']}"
        ),
        (
            "Necesitaban enriquecimiento     : "
            f"{comparison['old_needs_enrichment']}"
        ),
        (
            "Score anterior                  : "
            f"{comparison['old_average_score']} / 10"
        ),
        "",
        "DEFECTOS ANTIGUOS",
        "-" * 82,
        (
            "Stem wrapper antiguo restante   : "
            f"{summary['old_wrapper_remaining']}"
        ),
        (
            "Concepto genérico antiguo       : "
            f"{summary['old_generic_concept_remaining']}"
        ),
        (
            "Fórmula genérica antigua        : "
            f"{summary['old_generic_formula_remaining']}"
        ),
        (
            "Distractor genérico antiguo     : "
            f"{summary['old_generic_distractor_remaining']}"
        ),
        "",
        "DEUDA PEDAGÓGICA RESTANTE",
        "-" * 82,
        (
            "Perfiles fallback actuales      : "
            f"{summary['fallback_profile_items']}"
        ),
        (
            "Sin análisis distractores       : "
            f"{summary['items_without_distractors']}"
        ),
        (
            "Con distractores semigenéricos  : "
            f"{summary['items_with_semigeneric_distractors']}"
        ),
        "",
        "TOP MOTIVOS DE ENRIQUECIMIENTO",
        "-" * 82,
    ]

    for reason, count in (
        report[
            "top_enrichment_reasons"
        ]
    )[:15]:

        lines.append(
            f"- {reason}: {count}"
        )

    lines.extend(
        [
            "",
            "IDS SIN ANÁLISIS DE DISTRACTORES",
            "-" * 82,
        ]
    )

    missing = report[
        "ids_without_distractors"
    ]

    if missing:

        lines.append(
            ", ".join(
                missing
            )
        )

    else:

        lines.append(
            "- Ninguno."
        )

    for classification in [
        "validation_candidate",
        "needs_enrichment",
        "needs_correction",
        "source_review",
    ]:

        lines.extend(
            [
                "",
                classification.upper(),
                "-" * 82,
            ]
        )

        ids = report[
            "ids_by_classification"
        ].get(
            classification,
            [],
        )

        if not ids:

            lines.append(
                "- Ninguno."
            )

        else:

            for start in range(
                0,
                len(ids),
                12,
            ):

                lines.append(
                    ", ".join(
                        ids[
                            start:
                            start + 12
                        ]
                    )
                )

    lines.extend(
        [
            "",
            "HASHES",
            "-" * 82,
            (
                "app.py                 : "
                + report[
                    "hashes"
                ][
                    "app"
                ]
            ),
            (
                "question_bank          : "
                + report[
                    "hashes"
                ][
                    "question_bank"
                ]
            ),
            (
                "reinforcement_bank     : "
                + report[
                    "hashes"
                ][
                    "reinforcement_bank"
                ]
            ),
            (
                "schema                 : "
                + report[
                    "hashes"
                ][
                    "schema"
                ]
            ),
            (
                "explanation_bank       : "
                + report[
                    "hashes"
                ][
                    "explanation_bank"
                ]
            ),
            "",
            (
                "RESULTADO: AUDITORÍA "
                "P2-D5.3 FULL COMPLETADA"
            ),
        ]
    )

    return "\n".join(
        lines
    )


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main() -> None:

    print()
    print("=" * 82)
    print(
        "VALIDACIÓN / SEGUNDA AUDITORÍA "
        "P2-D5.3 FULL - 180/180"
    )
    print("=" * 82)
    print()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T01 - ARCHIVOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    required_files = [
        APP,
        QUESTION_BANK,
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
        SCHEMA_FILE,
        EXPLANATION_BANK,
        PRE_ENRICHMENT_BACKUP,
        OLD_AUDIT_JSON,
        ENRICHMENT_REPORT_JSON,
    ]

    missing = [
        path
        for path in required_files
        if not path.exists()
    ]

    check(
        not missing,
        "T01",
        "Todos los archivos requeridos existen.",
    )

    if missing:

        for path in missing:

            print(
                f"     Falta: {path}"
            )

        sys.exit(1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T02-T07 - HASHES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        sha256_file(
            APP
        )
        == APP_SHA256,
        "T02",
        "app.py permanece en P2-D5.1.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )
        == QUESTION_BANK_SHA256,
        "T03",
        "question_bank permanece intacto.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )
        == REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256,
        "T04",
        "reinforcement_bank permanece intacto.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            SCHEMA_FILE
        )
        == SCHEMA_SHA256,
        "T05",
        "Schema permanece intacto.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            PRE_ENRICHMENT_BACKUP
        )
        == PRE_ENRICHMENT_SHA256,
        "T06",
        "Backup pre-enrichment coincide con FULL DRAFT.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )
        == ENRICHED_BANK_SHA256,
        "T07",
        "Banco enriquecido coincide con el SHA P2-D5.3.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T08 - JSON
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:

        questions = load_json(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )

        reinforcement = load_json(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )

        explanation_bank = load_json(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )

        old_audit = load_json(
            OLD_AUDIT_JSON
        )

        enrichment_report = load_json(
            ENRICHMENT_REPORT_JSON
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        fail(
            f"T08 Error leyendo JSON: {exc}"
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    ok(
        "T08 Todos los JSON principales son legibles."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T09-T12 - IDENTIDAD Y CANTIDADES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        (
            isinstance(
                questions,
                list,
            )
            and
            len(questions)
            == 180
        ),
        "T09",
        "Banco original conserva 180 preguntas.",
    )

    check(
        len(
            reinforcement.get(
                "items",
                [],
            )
        )
        == 8,
        "T10",
        "Banco de refuerzo conserva 8 ítems.",
    )

    items = explanation_bank.get(
        "items",
        [],
    )

    check(
        len(items) == 180,
        "T11",
        "Banco enriquecido contiene 180 explicaciones.",
    )

    check(
        (
            explanation_bank.get(
                "schema_version"
            )
            == SCHEMA_VERSION
            and
            explanation_bank.get(
                "bank_version"
            )
            == BANK_VERSION
        ),
        "T12",
        "Versiones del banco complementario son correctas.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T13 - ORDEN E IDS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    expected_ids = [
        question[
            "id"
        ]
        for question
        in questions
    ]

    actual_source_ids = [
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in items
    ]

    check(
        actual_source_ids
        == expected_ids,
        "T13",
        "Las explicaciones mantienen el orden 1:1 con S1/S3.",
    )

    check(
        [
            item[
                "id"
            ]
            for item
            in items
        ]
        ==
        [
            f"EX-{question_id}"
            for question_id
            in expected_ids
        ],
        "T14",
        "Los 180 IDs EX corresponden exactamente a sus fuentes.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T15 - HASH INDIVIDUAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    bad_hashes = []

    for question, item in zip(
        questions,
        items,
    ):

        if (
            item[
                "source_question_sha256"
            ]
            != canonical_sha256(
                question
            )
        ):

            bad_hashes.append(
                question[
                    "id"
                ]
            )

    check(
        not bad_hashes,
        "T15",
        "Los 180 hashes fuente se recalculan correctamente.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T16 - TODO DRAFT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        all(
            item[
                "quality"
            ][
                "status"
            ]
            == "draft"
            for item
            in items
        ),
        "T16",
        "Las 180 explicaciones continúan DRAFT.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T17 - NO MASTERY
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        all(
            item[
                "quality"
            ][
                "mastery_eligible"
            ]
            is False
            for item
            in items
        ),
        "T17",
        "Ningún DRAFT cuenta como dominio.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T18 - FLAG ENRICHED
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        all(
            "p2d5_3_enriched"
            in item[
                "quality"
            ].get(
                "flags",
                [],
            )
            for item
            in items
        ),
        "T18",
        "Los 180 ítems están marcados p2d5_3_enriched.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T19 - PENDING VALIDATION
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        all(
            "full_pending_validation"
            in item[
                "quality"
            ].get(
                "flags",
                [],
            )
            for item
            in items
        ),
        "T19",
        "Los 180 mantienen full_pending_validation.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T20 - SOURCE REVIEW EXACTO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    expected_review_ids = {
        question[
            "id"
        ]
        for question
        in questions
        if source_review_required(
            question
        )
    }

    actual_review_ids = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in items
        if (
            "source_review_required"
            in item[
                "quality"
            ].get(
                "flags",
                [],
            )
        )
    }

    check(
        expected_review_ids
        == actual_review_ids,
        "T20",
        "Las marcas source_review siguen correspondiendo exactamente.",
    )

    check(
        len(
            expected_review_ids
        )
        == 7,
        "T21",
        "Se conservan exactamente 7 preguntas con revisión de fuente.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T22-T28 - DEFECTOS ANTIGUOS ELIMINADOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    old_wrapper_remaining = sum(
        item.get(
            "what_is_asked",
            "",
        ).startswith(
            OLD_WHAT_PREFIX
        )
        for item in items
    )

    old_concept_remaining = sum(
        item.get(
            "concept_or_rule",
            "",
        ).startswith(
            OLD_CONCEPT_PREFIX
        )
        for item in items
    )

    old_formula_remaining = sum(
        item.get(
            "formula_or_framework",
            "",
        ).startswith(
            OLD_FORMULA_PREFIX
        )
        for item in items
    )

    old_transfer_remaining = sum(
        item.get(
            "transfer_tip",
            "",
        ).startswith(
            OLD_TRANSFER_PREFIX
        )
        for item in items
    )

    old_quick_remaining = sum(
        item.get(
            "quick_check",
            "",
        ).startswith(
            OLD_QUICK_PREFIX
        )
        for item in items
    )

    old_step_remaining = sum(
        any(
            step.get(
                "title"
            )
            == OLD_GENERIC_STEP_TITLE
            for step in item.get(
                "steps",
                []
            )
        )
        for item in items
    )

    old_distractor_remaining = sum(
        any(
            OLD_DISTRACTOR_TEXT
            in distractor.get(
                "why_wrong",
                "",
            )
            for distractor
            in item.get(
                "distractor_analysis",
                []
            )
        )
        for item in items
    )

    check(
        old_wrapper_remaining == 0,
        "T22",
        "El stem-wrapper antiguo fue eliminado 180/180.",
    )

    check(
        old_concept_remaining == 0,
        "T23",
        "El concepto genérico antiguo fue eliminado.",
    )

    check(
        old_formula_remaining == 0,
        "T24",
        "La fórmula/framework genérico antiguo fue eliminado.",
    )

    check(
        old_transfer_remaining == 0,
        "T25",
        "La transferencia genérica antigua fue eliminada.",
    )

    check(
        old_quick_remaining == 0,
        "T26",
        "El quick-check genérico antiguo fue eliminado.",
    )

    check(
        old_step_remaining == 0,
        "T27",
        "La secuencia de pasos genérica antigua fue eliminada.",
    )

    check(
        old_distractor_remaining == 0,
        "T28",
        "El texto de distractor genérico antiguo fue eliminado.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T29 - WHAT IS ASKED
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    interpreted_count = sum(
        (
            item.get(
                "what_is_asked",
                "",
            ).startswith(
                "Debes "
            )
            and
            "enunciado de referencia es:"
            in item.get(
                "what_is_asked",
                "",
            )
        )
        for item in items
    )

    check(
        interpreted_count == 180,
        "T29",
        "Las 180 explicaciones interpretan explícitamente qué se pide.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T30 - RELEVANT DATA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        all(
            isinstance(
                item.get(
                    "relevant_data"
                ),
                list,
            )
            and
            len(
                item[
                    "relevant_data"
                ]
            )
            >= 1
            for item
            in items
        ),
        "T30",
        "Las 180 explicaciones tienen datos/condiciones relevantes.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T31 - PASOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        all(
            len(
                item.get(
                    "steps",
                    []
                )
            )
            >= 4
            for item
            in items
        ),
        "T31",
        "Las 180 explicaciones tienen al menos 4 pasos.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T32 - ORDEN DE PASOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    invalid_order = []

    for item in items:

        orders = [
            step[
                "order"
            ]
            for step
            in item.get(
                "steps",
                []
            )
        ]

        if orders != list(
            range(
                1,
                len(orders) + 1,
            )
        ):

            invalid_order.append(
                item[
                    "source_question_id"
                ]
            )

    check(
        not invalid_order,
        "T32",
        "El orden de pasos es secuencial en las 180.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T33 - WHY CORRECT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    bad_why_correct = []

    for question, item in zip(
        questions,
        items,
    ):

        base = normalize(
            question.get(
                "explanation"
            )
        )

        why = normalize(
            item.get(
                "why_correct"
            )
        )

        if (
            not base
            or
            base not in why
            or
            str(
                question[
                    "answer"
                ]
            ).lower()
            not in why
        ):

            bad_why_correct.append(
                question[
                    "id"
                ]
            )

    check(
        not bad_why_correct,
        "T33",
        "why_correct conserva resolución base y referencia a la clave.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T34 - REPORTE P2-D5.3
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        (
            enrichment_report.get(
                "stage"
            )
            == "P2-D5.3"
            and
            enrichment_report.get(
                "substage"
            )
            == "full_pedagogical_enrichment"
            and
            enrichment_report.get(
                "counts",
                {},
            ).get(
                "items_after"
            )
            == 180
        ),
        "T34",
        "Reporte P2-D5.3 documenta las 180 explicaciones.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T35 - HASH EN REPORTE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        (
            enrichment_report.get(
                "hashes",
                {},
            ).get(
                "explanation_bank_before"
            )
            == PRE_ENRICHMENT_SHA256
            and
            enrichment_report.get(
                "hashes",
                {},
            ).get(
                "explanation_bank_after"
            )
            == ENRICHED_BANK_SHA256
        ),
        "T35",
        "Reporte P2-D5.3 registra los hashes antes/después correctos.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T36 - AUDITORÍA PREVIA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        (
            old_audit.get(
                "stage"
            )
            == "P2-D5.2"
            and
            old_audit.get(
                "substage"
            )
            == "full_draft_audit"
            and
            old_audit.get(
                "summary",
                {},
            ).get(
                "items_audited"
            )
            == 180
        ),
        "T36",
        "La auditoría P2-D5.2 previa está disponible para comparar.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T37-T40 - CONTROL VARIANZA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    items_by_source = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]:
            item
        for item
        in items
    }

    validate_variance_control(
        items_by_source
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T41 - EXTRACCIÓN PDF
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:

        sources = extract_pdf_sources(
            questions
        )

        check(
            (
                len(sources)
                == 180
                and
                all(
                    clean_spaces(
                        source.get(
                            "stem"
                        )
                    )
                    for source
                    in sources.values()
                )
            ),
            "T41",
            "Los PDFs vuelven a producir 180 enunciados no vacíos.",
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        fail(
            f"T41 Falló extracción PDF: {exc}"
        )

        sources = {}

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # SI HAY ERRORES ESTRUCTURALES, ABORTAR AUDITORÍA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if errors:

        print()
        print("=" * 82)
        print(
            "RESUMEN DE VALIDACIÓN "
            "P2-D5.3 FULL"
        )
        print("=" * 82)

        print(
            f"Checks aprobados : {checks}"
        )

        print(
            f"Errores          : {len(errors)}"
        )

        print(
            f"Warnings         : {len(warnings)}"
        )

        print()
        print("ERRORES")
        print("-" * 82)

        for message in errors:

            print(
                f"- {message}"
            )

        print()
        print(
            "RESULTADO: AUDITORÍA "
            "P2-D5.3 FULL ABORTADA"
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    # ========================================================
    # AUDITORÍA PEDAGÓGICA 180/180
    # ========================================================

    print()
    print(
        "[INFO] Ejecutando segunda auditoría "
        "pedagógica 180/180..."
    )

    audits = []

    for question, item in zip(
        questions,
        items,
    ):

        audits.append(
            audit_item(
                question,
                item,
                sources[
                    question[
                        "id"
                    ]
                ],
            )
        )

    classification_counter = Counter(
        audit[
            "classification"
        ]
        for audit
        in audits
    )

    enrichment_counter = Counter()

    blocking_counter = Counter()

    score_counter = Counter()

    ids_by_classification = defaultdict(
        list
    )

    by_area = defaultdict(
        Counter
    )

    for audit in audits:

        score_counter[
            audit[
                "pedagogical_score"
            ]
        ] += 1

        ids_by_classification[
            audit[
                "classification"
            ]
        ].append(
            audit[
                "source_question_id"
            ]
        )

        by_area[
            audit[
                "area"
            ]
        ][
            audit[
                "classification"
            ]
        ] += 1

        for reason in audit[
            "enrichment_reasons"
        ]:

            enrichment_counter[
                reason
            ] += 1

        for reason in audit[
            "blocking_reasons"
        ]:

            blocking_counter[
                reason
            ] += 1

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # DEUDA RESTANTE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    fallback_profile_ids = [
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in items
        if uses_fallback_profile(
            item
        )
    ]

    ids_without_distractors = [
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in items
        if not item.get(
            "distractor_analysis"
        )
    ]

    semigeneric_distractor_ids = [
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in items
        if (
            semigeneric_distractor_count(
                item
            )
            > 0
        )
    ]

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # COMPARACIÓN CON AUDITORÍA ANTERIOR
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    old_summary = old_audit.get(
        "summary",
        {},
    )

    old_classifications = (
        old_summary.get(
            "classifications",
            {},
        )
    )

    old_average = old_summary.get(
        "average_pedagogical_score",
        0,
    )

    average_score = round(
        sum(
            audit[
                "pedagogical_score"
            ]
            for audit
            in audits
        )
        / len(audits),
        3,
    )

    report = {
        "stage":
            "P2-D5.3",

        "substage":
            "full_enrichment_audit",

        "status":
            "second_full_audit_completed_no_bank_mutation",

        "method": {
            "items_audited":
                180,

            "pdf_reextracted":
                True,

            "source_hash_recalculated":
                True,

            "old_defects_checked":
                True,

            "remaining_fallbacks_detected":
                True,

            "semi_generic_distractors_detected":
                True,

            "bank_mutated":
                False,

            "quality_status_mutated":
                False,
        },

        "summary": {
            "items_audited":
                len(audits),

            "classifications":
                dict(
                    sorted(
                        classification_counter.items()
                    )
                ),

            "average_pedagogical_score":
                average_score,

            "score_max":
                12,

            "structural_errors":
                0,

            "warnings":
                len(
                    warnings
                ),

            "source_review_items":
                len(
                    expected_review_ids
                ),

            "old_wrapper_remaining":
                old_wrapper_remaining,

            "old_generic_concept_remaining":
                old_concept_remaining,

            "old_generic_formula_remaining":
                old_formula_remaining,

            "old_generic_transfer_remaining":
                old_transfer_remaining,

            "old_generic_quick_remaining":
                old_quick_remaining,

            "old_generic_step_remaining":
                old_step_remaining,

            "old_generic_distractor_remaining":
                old_distractor_remaining,

            "fallback_profile_items":
                len(
                    fallback_profile_ids
                ),

            "items_without_distractors":
                len(
                    ids_without_distractors
                ),

            "items_with_semigeneric_distractors":
                len(
                    semigeneric_distractor_ids
                ),
        },

        "comparison_with_p2d5_2": {
            "old_validation_candidate":
                old_classifications.get(
                    "validation_candidate",
                    0,
                ),

            "old_needs_enrichment":
                old_classifications.get(
                    "needs_enrichment",
                    0,
                ),

            "old_needs_correction":
                old_classifications.get(
                    "needs_correction",
                    0,
                ),

            "old_source_review":
                old_classifications.get(
                    "source_review",
                    0,
                ),

            "old_average_score":
                old_average,

            "old_wrapper_count":
                180,

            "old_generic_distractor_count":
                175,

            "old_generic_concept_count":
                41,

            "old_generic_formula_count":
                41,
        },

        "score_distribution": {
            str(score):
                score_counter[
                    score
                ]
            for score
            in sorted(
                score_counter
            )
        },

        "top_enrichment_reasons":
            enrichment_counter.most_common(),

        "top_blocking_reasons":
            blocking_counter.most_common(),

        "fallback_profile_ids":
            fallback_profile_ids,

        "ids_without_distractors":
            ids_without_distractors,

        "ids_with_semigeneric_distractors":
            semigeneric_distractor_ids,

        "ids_by_classification": {
            key:
                value
            for key, value
            in sorted(
                ids_by_classification.items()
            )
        },

        "by_area": {
            area:
                dict(
                    sorted(
                        values.items()
                    )
                )
            for area, values
            in sorted(
                by_area.items()
            )
        },

        "items":
            audits,

        "hashes": {
            "app":
                sha256_file(
                    APP
                ),

            "question_bank":
                sha256_file(
                    QUESTION_BANK
                ),

            "reinforcement_bank":
                sha256_file(
                    REINFORCEMENT_BANK
                ),

            "schema":
                sha256_file(
                    SCHEMA_FILE
                ),

            "explanation_bank":
                sha256_file(
                    EXPLANATION_BANK
                ),
        },
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # ESCRIBIR SOLO REPORTES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    write_json(
        NEW_AUDIT_JSON,
        report,
    )

    NEW_AUDIT_TXT.write_text(
        build_txt(
            report
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # POST-HASH: NADA ESTABLE PUEDE CAMBIAR
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    stable_ok = (
        sha256_file(
            APP
        )
        == APP_SHA256
        and
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )
        == QUESTION_BANK_SHA256
        and
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )
        == REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256
        and
        sha256_file(
            SCHEMA_FILE
        )
        == SCHEMA_SHA256
        and
        sha256_file(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )
        == ENRICHED_BANK_SHA256
    )

    if not stable_ok:

        fail(
            "POST-AUDIT Algún archivo estable cambió."
        )

        sys.exit(1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # RESUMEN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    print()
    print("=" * 82)
    print(
        "RESUMEN DE SEGUNDA AUDITORÍA "
        "P2-D5.3 FULL"
    )
    print("=" * 82)

    print(
        "Explicaciones auditadas          :",
        len(
            audits
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Candidatas a validación          :",
        classification_counter.get(
            "validation_candidate",
            0,
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Necesitan enriquecimiento        :",
        classification_counter.get(
            "needs_enrichment",
            0,
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Necesitan corrección             :",
        classification_counter.get(
            "needs_correction",
            0,
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Revisión de fuente               :",
        classification_counter.get(
            "source_review",
            0,
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Score pedagógico promedio        :",
        average_score,
        "/ 12",
    )

    print()
    print("DEFECTOS ANTIGUOS")
    print("-" * 82)

    print(
        "Stem wrapper antiguo             :",
        old_wrapper_remaining,
    )

    print(
        "Concepto genérico antiguo        :",
        old_concept_remaining,
    )

    print(
        "Framework genérico antiguo       :",
        old_formula_remaining,
    )

    print(
        "Transfer genérico antiguo        :",
        old_transfer_remaining,
    )

    print(
        "Quick-check genérico antiguo     :",
        old_quick_remaining,
    )

    print(
        "Pasos genéricos antiguos         :",
        old_step_remaining,
    )

    print(
        "Distractor genérico antiguo      :",
        old_distractor_remaining,
    )

    print()
    print("DEUDA PEDAGÓGICA RESTANTE")
    print("-" * 82)

    print(
        "Perfiles fallback actuales       :",
        len(
            fallback_profile_ids
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Sin análisis de distractores     :",
        len(
            ids_without_distractors
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Con distractores semigenéricos   :",
        len(
            semigeneric_distractor_ids
        ),
    )

    if ids_without_distractors:

        print(
            "ID sin distractores             :",
            ", ".join(
                ids_without_distractors
            ),
        )

    print()
    print("TOP MOTIVOS DE ENRIQUECIMIENTO")
    print("-" * 82)

    if enrichment_counter:

        for reason, count in (
            enrichment_counter.most_common(
                12
            )
        ):

            print(
                f"{reason:<46} : {count}"
            )

    else:

        print(
            "Ninguno."
        )

    print()
    print("COMPARACIÓN")

checks = 0
errors: list[str] = []
warnings: list[str] = []


def ok(message: str) -> None:

    global checks

    checks += 1

    print(
        f"[OK] {message}"
    )


def fail(message: str) -> None:

    errors.append(
        message
    )

    print(
        f"[ERROR] {message}"
    )


def warn(message: str) -> None:

    warnings.append(
        message
    )

    print(
        f"[WARN] {message}"
    )


def check(
    condition: bool,
    code: str,
    message: str,
) -> None:

    if condition:

        ok(
            f"{code} {message}"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            f"{code} {message}"
        )


# ============================================================
# UTILIDADES
# ============================================================

def sha256_file(
    path: Path,
) -> str:

    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open(
        "rb"
    ) as handle:

        while True:

            chunk = handle.read(
                1024 * 1024
            )

            if not chunk:
                break

            digest.update(
                chunk
            )

    return digest.hexdigest().upper()


def canonical_sha256(
    data,
) -> str:

    payload = json.dumps(
        data,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode(
        "utf-8"
    )

    return hashlib.sha256(
        payload
    ).hexdigest().upper()


def load_json(
    path: Path,
):

    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def write_json(
    path: Path,
    data,
) -> None:

    path.parent.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            data,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        ) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def clean_spaces(
    value,
) -> str:

    return re.sub(
        r"\s+",
        " ",
        str(
            value or ""
        ),
    ).strip()


def normalize(
    value,
) -> str:

    text = str(
        value or ""
    )

    text = unicodedata.normalize(
        "NFKD",
        text,
    )

    text = "".join(
        character
        for character
        in text
        if not unicodedata.combining(
            character
        )
    )

    text = (
        text.lower()
        .replace(
            "×",
            "x",
        )
        .replace(
            "−",
            "-",
        )
    )

    text = re.sub(
        r"\s+",
        " ",
        text,
    )

    return text.strip()


def source_review_required(
    question: dict,
) -> bool:

    if (
        question.get(
            "status"
        )
        == "revisar_fuente"
    ):

        return True

    quality = question.get(
        "quality",
        {},
    )

    if isinstance(
        quality,
        dict,
    ):

        return bool(
            quality.get(
                "source_review_required"
            )
        )

    return False


def distractor_letters(
    item: dict,
) -> list[str]:

    output = []

    for distractor in item.get(
        "distractor_analysis",
        [],
    ):

        choice = clean_spaces(
            distractor.get(
                "choice"
            )
        )

        match = re.match(
            r"^([A-E])\)",
            choice,
            flags=re.I,
        )

        if match:

            output.append(
                match.group(
                    1
                ).upper()
            )

    return output

# PDF
# ============================================================

BOILERPLATE_PREFIXES = (
    "YachayPre Preuniversitario",
    "Simulacro UTN FICA-FICAYA",
    "Instrucciones:",
    "Resolver las 90 preguntas",
    "No está permitido el uso",
    "La evaluación deberá realizarse",
    "Marcar la opción correcta",
    "Si finaliza antes del tiempo",
)


def pdf_text(
    path: Path,
) -> str:

    pieces = []

    with fitz.open(
        path
    ) as document:

        for page in document:

            pieces.append(
                page.get_text(
                    "text"
                )
            )

    return "\n".join(
        pieces
    )


def remove_boilerplate(
    text: str,
) -> str:

    output = []

    for raw_line in text.splitlines():

        line = raw_line.strip()

        if not line:

            output.append(
                ""
            )

            continue

        if line.startswith(
            ""
        ):

            continue

        if any(
            line.startswith(
                prefix
            )
            for prefix
            in BOILERPLATE_PREFIXES
        ):

            continue

        output.append(
            raw_line
        )

    return "\n".join(
        output
    )


def parse_question_blocks(
    text: str,
) -> dict[int, str]:

    blocks = {}
    cursor = 0

    for number in range(
        1,
        91,
    ):

        pattern = re.compile(
            rf"(?m)^\s*{number}\.(?:-)?\s*"
        )

        match = pattern.search(
            text,
            cursor,
        )

        if not match:

            raise RuntimeError(
                f"No se encontró pregunta {number}."
            )

        if number < 90:

            next_pattern = re.compile(
                rf"(?m)^\s*{number + 1}"
                rf"\.(?:-)?\s*"
            )

            next_match = next_pattern.search(
                text,
                match.end(),
            )

            if not next_match:

                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"No se pudo delimitar "
                    f"pregunta {number}."
                )

            end = next_match.start()

        else:

            end = len(
                text
            )

        blocks[
            number
        ] = remove_boilerplate(
            text[
                match.start():
                end
            ]
        ).strip()

        cursor = match.end()

    return blocks


# ============================================================
# PARSER REPARADO P2-D5.4.1
# ============================================================

OPTION_MARKER_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"(?i)(?<!\S)([A-E])\s*[.)]\s*"
)


def ordered_option_candidates(
    body: str,
) -> list[list[re.Match]]:

    matches = list(
        OPTION_MARKER_PATTERN.finditer(
            body
        )
    )

    candidates = []

    for start_index, match in enumerate(
        matches
    ):

        if (
            match.group(
                1
            ).upper()
            != "A"
        ):

            continue

        selected = [
            match
        ]

        expected_ord = ord(
            "B"
        )

        for next_match in matches[
            start_index + 1:
        ]:

            if expected_ord > ord(
                "E"
            ):

                break

            expected_letter = chr(
                expected_ord
            )

            actual_letter = (
                next_match.group(
                    1
                ).upper()
            )

            if (
                actual_letter
                == expected_letter
            ):

                selected.append(
                    next_match
                )

                expected_ord += 1

            else:

                break

        if len(
            selected
        ) >= 2:

            candidates.append(
                selected
            )

    return candidates


def split_stem_and_options(
    block: str,
    question_id: str,
) -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]]:

    body = re.sub(
        r"^\s*\d{1,2}\.(?:-)?\s*",
        "",
        block,
        count=1,
    ).strip()

    if (
        question_id
        == "S3-77"
    ):

        position = re.search(
            r"(?mi)^\s*A\s*[.)]",
            body,
        )

        if position:

            stem = clean_spaces(
                body[
                    :position.start()
                ]
            )

        else:

            stem = (
                "Determine la derivada de la función "
                "f(x)=3x⁴-5x²+7x-2."
            )

        return (
            stem,
            dict(
                S3_77_OPTIONS
            ),
        )

    candidates = ordered_option_candidates(
        body
    )

    if not candidates:

        return (
            clean_spaces(
                body
            ),
            {},
        )

    selected = max(
        candidates,
        key=lambda candidate: (
            len(
                candidate
            ),
            candidate[
                0
            ].start(),
        ),
    )

    stem = clean_spaces(
        body[
            :selected[
                0
            ].start()
        ]
    )

    options = {}

    for (
        index,
        match,
    ) in enumerate(
        selected
    ):

        start = match.end()

        if (
            index + 1
            < len(
                selected
            )
        ):

            end = (
                selected[
                    index + 1
                ].start()
            )

        else:

            end = len(
                body
            )

        letter = (
            match.group(
                1
            ).upper()
        )

        options[
            letter
        ] = clean_spaces(
            body[
                start:end
            ]
        )

    return (
        stem,
        options,
    )


def extract_pdf_sources(
    questions: list[dict],
) -> dict[str, dict]:

    pdf_names = sorted(
        {
            question[
                "pdf"
            ]
            for question
            in questions
        }
    )

    parsed_pdfs = {}

    for pdf_name in pdf_names:

        path = (
            SOURCES_DIR
            / pdf_name
        )

        if not path.exists():

            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Falta PDF fuente: {path}"
            )

        blocks = parse_question_blocks(
            pdf_text(
                path
            )
        )

        if len(
            blocks
        ) != 90:

            raise RuntimeError(
                f"{pdf_name}: "
                "no produjo 90 bloques."
            )

        parsed_pdfs[
            pdf_name
        ] = blocks

    sources = {}

    for question in questions:

        source_id = question[
            "id"
        ]

        block = parsed_pdfs[
            question[
                "pdf"
            ]
        ][
            int(
                question[
                    "number"
                ]
            )
        ]

        (
            stem,
            options,
        ) = split_stem_and_options(
            block,
            source_id,
        )

        sources[
            source_id
        ] = {
            "stem":
                stem,

            "options":
                options,
        }

    return sources
