def contains_bad_fragment(
    item: dict,
) -> bool:

    texts = [
        item.get(
            "idea_key",
            "",
        ),

        item.get(
            "what_is_asked",
            "",
        ),

        item.get(
            "concept_or_rule",
            "",
        ),

        item.get(
            "formula_or_framework",
            "",
        ),

        item.get(
            "why_correct",
            "",
        ),

        item.get(
            "common_error",
            "",
        ),

        item.get(
            "transfer_tip",
            "",
        ),

        item.get(
            "quick_check",
            "",
        ),
    ]

    for value in item.get(
        "relevant_data",
        [],
    ):

        texts.append(
            value
        )

    for step in item.get(
        "steps",
        [],
    ):

        texts.append(
            step.get(
                "title",
                "",
            )
        )

        texts.append(
            step.get(
                "detail",
                "",
            )
        )

        texts.append(
            step.get(
                "math",
                "",
            )
        )

    for distractor in item.get(
        "distractor_analysis",
        [],
    ):

        texts.append(
            distractor.get(
                "why_wrong",
                "",
            )
        )

        texts.append(
            distractor.get(
                "error_pattern",
                "",
            )
        )

    full_text = "\n".join(
        str(
            value or ""
        )
        for value in texts
    )

    return any(
        fragment
        in full_text
        for fragment
        in BAD_FRAGMENTS
    )


def relevant_data_is_strong(
    item: dict,
) -> bool:

    values = item.get(
        "relevant_data",
        [],
    )

    if (
        not isinstance(
            values,
            list,
        )
        or
        not values
    ):

        return False

    cleaned = [
        clean_spaces(
            value
        )
        for value in values
        if clean_spaces(
            value
        )
    ]

    if len(
        cleaned
    ) >= 2:

        return True

    value = normalize(
        cleaned[
            0
        ]
    )

    return bool(
        re.search(
            r"\d|%|°|kg|m/s|hz|mol|"
            r"objetivo concreto|"
            r"relacion de resolucion|"
            r"criterio confirmado|"
            r"condicion",
            value,
        )
    )


def math_step_count(
    item: dict,
) -> int:

    return sum(
        bool(
            clean_spaces(
                step.get(
                    "math"
                )
            )
        )
        for step
        in item.get(
            "steps",
            [],
        )
    )


def looks_numeric(
    question: dict,
    source: dict,
) -> bool:

    stem = source.get(
        "stem",
        "",
    )

    text = normalize(
        stem
        + " "
        + question.get(
            "explanation",
            "",
        )
    )

    if not re.search(
        r"\d",
        stem,
    ):

        return False

    keywords = [
        "calcula",
        "calcular",
        "determine",
        "determina",
        "obtener",
        "halle",
        "valor",
        "derivada",
        "pendiente",
        "determinante",
        "porcentaje",
        "varianza",
        "media",
        "frecuencia",
        "velocidad",
        "distancia",
        "aceleracion",
        "aceleración",
        "trabajo",
        "energia",
        "energía",
        "potencia",
        "periodo",
        "período",
        "longitud de onda",
        "campo magnetico",
        "campo magnético",
        "fuerza",
        "masa molar",
        "peso molecular",
    ]

    return any(
        keyword
        in text
        for keyword
        in keywords
    )


def distractors_specific(
    item: dict,
) -> bool:

    distractors = item.get(
        "distractor_analysis",
        [],
    )

    if not distractors:

        return False

    for distractor in distractors:

        why = clean_spaces(
            distractor.get(
                "why_wrong"
            )
        )

        pattern = clean_spaces(
            distractor.get(
                "error_pattern"
            )
        )

        if len(
            why
        ) < 55:

            return False

        if len(
            pattern
        ) < 25:

            return False

        if any(
            fragment
            in why
            for fragment
            in BAD_FRAGMENTS
        ):

            return False

    return True


def answer_reference_present(
    question: dict,
    item: dict,
) -> bool:

    answer = str(
        question.get(
            "answer",
            "",
        )
    ).upper()

    why = normalize(
        item.get(
            "why_correct"
        )
    )

    patterns = [
        rf"\balternativa\s+{answer.lower()}\b",
        rf"\bopcion\s+{answer.lower()}\b",
        rf"\brespuesta\s+{answer.lower()}\b",
        rf"\bclave\s+{answer.lower()}\b",
    ]

    if any(
        re.search(
            pattern,
            why,
        )
        for pattern
        in patterns
    ):

        return True

    # Compatibilidad con explicaciones que escriben:
    # "A) ...", "B) ...", etc.
    raw = clean_spaces(
        item.get(
            "why_correct"
        )
    )

    return bool(
        re.search(
            rf"(?<![A-Za-z]){re.escape(answer)}\)",
            raw,
            flags=re.I,
        )
    )


# ============================================================
# AUDITORÍA INDIVIDUAL
# ============================================================

def audit_item(
    question: dict,
    item: dict,
    source: dict,
) -> dict:

    blocking = []
    enrichment = []
    positive = []

    source_id = question[
        "id"
    ]

    answer = str(
        question.get(
            "answer",
            "",
        )
    ).upper()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # TRAZABILIDAD
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        item.get(
            "source_question_sha256"
        )
        == canonical_sha256(
            question
        )
    ):

        positive.append(
            "source_hash_ok"
        )

    else:

        blocking.append(
            "source_hash_mismatch"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # RESOLUCIÓN BASE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    base = clean_spaces(
        question.get(
            "explanation"
        )
    )

    why = clean_spaces(
        item.get(
            "why_correct"
        )
    )

    if (
        base
        and
        normalize(
            base
        )
        in normalize(
            why
        )
    ):

        positive.append(
            "base_resolution_preserved"
        )

    else:

        blocking.append(
            "base_resolution_missing"
        )

    if answer_reference_present(
        question,
        item,
    ):

        positive.append(
            "answer_reference_present"
        )

    else:

        enrichment.append(
            "answer_reference_not_explicit"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # DEUDA GENÉRICA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if contains_bad_fragment(
        item
    ):

        blocking.append(
            "generic_or_obsolete_fragment_present"
        )

    else:

        positive.append(
            "generic_debt_absent"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # QUÉ PIDE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    what = clean_spaces(
        item.get(
            "what_is_asked"
        )
    )

    if (
        what.startswith(
            "Debes "
        )
        and
        "enunciado de referencia es:"
        in what
        and
        len(
            what
        )
        >= 70
    ):

        positive.append(
            "objective_interpreted"
        )

    else:

        enrichment.append(
            "objective_weak"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # DATOS RELEVANTES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if relevant_data_is_strong(
        item
    ):

        positive.append(
            "relevant_data_strong"
        )

    else:

        enrichment.append(
            "relevant_data_weak"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # CAPAS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    layer_requirements = [
        (
            "idea_key",
            35,
            "idea_key_weak",
        ),
        (
            "concept_or_rule",
            45,
            "concept_weak",
        ),
        (
            "formula_or_framework",
            30,
            "framework_weak",
        ),
        (
            "common_error",
            35,
            "common_error_weak",
        ),
        (
            "transfer_tip",
            35,
            "transfer_weak",
        ),
        (
            "quick_check",
            20,
            "quick_check_weak",
        ),
    ]

    for (
        field,
        minimum,
        weak_reason,
    ) in layer_requirements:

        value = clean_spaces(
            item.get(
                field
            )
        )

        if len(
            value
        ) >= minimum:

            positive.append(
                weak_reason.replace(
                    "_weak",
                    "_substantive",
                )
            )

        else:

            enrichment.append(
                weak_reason
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # PASOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    steps = item.get(
        "steps",
        [],
    )

    if len(
        steps
    ) >= 4:

        positive.append(
            "step_count_ok"
        )

    else:

        blocking.append(
            "too_few_steps"
        )

    orders = [
        step.get(
            "order"
        )
        for step
        in steps
    ]

    if orders == list(
        range(
            1,
            len(
                orders
            ) + 1,
        )
    ):

        positive.append(
            "step_order_ok"
        )

    else:

        blocking.append(
            "step_order_invalid"
        )

    titles = [
        clean_spaces(
            step.get(
                "title"
            )
        )
        for step
        in steps
    ]

    if (
        source_id
        == "S1-70"
        or
        (
            "Define exactamente el objetivo"
            in titles
            and
            "Comprueba la respuesta"
            in titles
        )
    ):

        positive.append(
            "reasoning_sequence_present"
        )

    else:

        enrichment.append(
            "reasoning_sequence_weak"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # NUMÉRICO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    numeric = looks_numeric(
        question,
        source,
    )

    math_count = (
        math_step_count(
            item
        )
    )

    if numeric:

        if math_count >= 1:

            positive.append(
                "numeric_work_present"
            )

        else:

            enrichment.append(
                "numeric_without_math"
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # DISTRACTORES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    options = source.get(
        "options",
        {},
    )

    distractors = item.get(
        "distractor_analysis",
        [],
    )

    if not options:

        blocking.append(
            "source_options_missing"
        )

    else:

        expected_wrong = [
            letter
            for letter
            in sorted(
                options
            )
            if letter
            != answer
        ][
            :4
        ]

        actual_wrong = (
            distractor_letters(
                item
            )
        )

        if distractors:

            positive.append(
                "distractors_present"
            )

        else:

            blocking.append(
                "distractors_missing"
            )

        if (
            actual_wrong
            == expected_wrong
        ):

            positive.append(
                "distractor_coverage_exact"
            )

        else:

            blocking.append(
                "distractor_coverage_mismatch"
            )

        if distractors_specific(
            item
        ):

            positive.append(
                "distractor_reasoning_specific"
            )

        else:

            enrichment.append(
                "distractor_reasoning_weak"
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # SOURCE REVIEW
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    source_review = (
        source_review_required(
            question
        )
    )

    if source_review:

        blocking.append(
            "source_review_required"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # CLASIFICACIÓN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    non_source_blocking = [
        reason
        for reason
        in blocking
        if reason
        != "source_review_required"
    ]

    if source_review:

        classification = (
            "source_review"
        )

    elif non_source_blocking:

        classification = (
            "needs_correction"
        )

    elif enrichment:

        classification = (
            "needs_enrichment"
        )

    else:

        classification = (
            "validation_candidate"
        )

    return {
        "id":
            item[
                "id"
            ],

        "source_question_id":
            source_id,

        "area":
            (
                question.get(
                    "area"
                )
                or
                question.get(
                    "subject"
                )
                or
                "Sin área"
            ),

        "topic":
            question.get(
                "topic",
                "",
            ),

        "answer":
            answer,

        "classification":
            classification,

        "source_review_required":
            source_review,

        "blocking_reasons":
            sorted(
                set(
                    blocking
                )
            ),

        "enrichment_reasons":
            sorted(
                set(
                    enrichment
                )
            ),

        "positive_signals":
            sorted(
                set(
                    positive
                )
            ),

        "metrics": {
            "step_count":
                len(
                    steps
                ),

            "math_step_count":
                math_count,

            "pdf_option_count":
                len(
                    options
                ),

            "distractor_count":
                len(
                    distractors
                ),
        },
    }


# ============================================================
# CASOS DE CONTROL
# ============================================================

def validate_s1_70(
    items_by_source: dict,
) -> None:

    item = items_by_source.get(
        "S1-70"
    )

    if not item:

        fail(
            "T49 Falta EX-S1-70."
        )

        return

    expected_titles = [
        "Calcula la media",
        "Calcula las desviaciones",
        "Eleva las desviaciones al cuadrado",
        "Calcula la varianza poblacional",
        "Relaciona el resultado con la alternativa",
    ]

    titles = [
        step.get(
            "title"
        )
        for step
        in item.get(
            "steps",
            [],
        )
    ]

    check(
        titles
        == expected_titles,
        "T49",
        "S1-70 conserva sus cinco pasos específicos.",
    )

    math_text = normalize(
        " ".join(
            str(
                step.get(
                    "math"
                )
                or ""
            )
            for step
            in item.get(
                "steps",
                [],
            )
        )
    ).replace(
        " ",
        "",
    )

    check(
        (
            "=53"
            in math_text
            and
            "=5"
            in math_text
        ),
        "T50",
        "S1-70 conserva media=53 y varianza=5.",
    )

    error_text = normalize(
        item.get(
            "common_error"
        )
    )

    check(
        (
            "n-1"
            in error_text
            and
            "poblacional"
            in error_text
        ),
        "T51",
        "S1-70 conserva advertencia N vs N-1.",
    )


def validate_s3_77(
    items_by_source: dict,
) -> None:

    item = items_by_source.get(
        "S3-77"
    )

    if not item:

        fail(
            "T52 Falta EX-S3-77."
        )

        return

    check(
        distractor_letters(
            item
        )
        == [
            "B",
            "C",
            "D",
        ],
        "T52",
        "S3-77 conserva exactamente B/C/D como distractores.",
    )

    text = normalize(
        " ".join(
            distractor.get(
                "why_wrong",
                "",
            )
            for distractor
            in item.get(
                "distractor_analysis",
                [],
            )
        )
    )

    check(
        (
            "12x3"
            in text
            and
            "10x"
            in text
        ),
        "T53",
        "S3-77 conserva explicación concreta de derivación.",
    )


# ============================================================
# TXT
# ============================================================

def build_txt(
    report: dict,
) -> str:

    summary = report[
        "summary"
    ]

    classifications = summary[
        "classifications"
    ]

    lines = [
        "=" * 86,
        "P2-D5.4.1 - AUDITORÍA FINAL INDEPENDIENTE 180/180",
        "=" * 86,
        "",
        "RESUMEN",
        "-" * 86,
        (
            "Explicaciones auditadas          : "
            f"{summary['items_audited']}"
        ),
        (
            "Candidatas a validación          : "
            f"{classifications.get('validation_candidate', 0)}"
        ),
        (
            "Necesitan enriquecimiento        : "
            f"{classifications.get('needs_enrichment', 0)}"
        ),
        (
            "Necesitan corrección             : "
            f"{classifications.get('needs_correction', 0)}"
        ),
        (
            "Revisión de fuente               : "
            f"{classifications.get('source_review', 0)}"
        ),
        "",
        "DEUDA FINAL",
        "-" * 86,
        (
            "Fragmentos genéricos/obsoletos   : "
            f"{summary['items_with_bad_fragments']}"
        ),
        (
            "Sin distractores                 : "
            f"{summary['items_without_distractors']}"
        ),
        (
            "Mismatch distractores            : "
            f"{summary['items_with_distractor_mismatch']}"
        ),
        (
            "Claves ausentes en fuente        : "
            f"{summary['answers_missing_from_options']}"
        ),
        (
            "Relevant data débil              : "
            f"{summary['items_with_weak_relevant_data']}"
        ),
        (
            "Numéricas sin math               : "
            f"{summary['numeric_items_without_math']}"
        ),
        "",
        "DECISIÓN",
        "-" * 86,
        (
            "Listo para validación controlada : "
            f"{summary['ready_for_controlled_validation']}"
        ),
        (
            "Decision code                    : "
            f"{summary['decision']}"
        ),
        "",
        "TOP MOTIVOS DE ENRIQUECIMIENTO",
        "-" * 86,
    ]

    if report[
        "top_enrichment_reasons"
    ]:

        for (
            reason,
            count,
        ) in report[
            "top_enrichment_reasons"
        ][
            :15
        ]:

            lines.append(
                f"- {reason}: {count}"
            )

    else:

        lines.append(
            "- Ninguno."
        )

    lines.extend(
        [
            "",
            "TOP MOTIVOS BLOQUEANTES",
            "-" * 86,
        ]
    )

    if report[
        "top_blocking_reasons"
    ]:

        for (
            reason,
            count,
        ) in report[
            "top_blocking_reasons"
        ][
            :15
        ]:

            lines.append(
                f"- {reason}: {count}"
            )

    else:

        lines.append(
            "- Ninguno."
        )

    for classification in [
        "validation_candidate",
        "needs_enrichment",
        "needs_correction",
        "source_review",
    ]:

        lines.extend(
            [
                "",
                classification.upper(),
                "-" * 86,
            ]
        )

        ids = report[
            "ids_by_classification"
        ].get(
            classification,
            [],
        )

        if not ids:

            lines.append(
                "- Ninguno."
            )

        else:

            for start in range(
                0,
                len(
                    ids
                ),
                12,
            ):

                lines.append(
                    ", ".join(
                        ids[
                            start:
                            start + 12
                        ]
                    )
                )

    lines.extend(
        [
            "",
            "HASHES",
            "-" * 86,
            (
                "app.py                 : "
                + report[
                    "hashes"
                ][
                    "app"
                ]
            ),
            (
                "question_bank          : "
                + report[
                    "hashes"
                ][
                    "question_bank"
                ]
            ),
            (
                "reinforcement_bank     : "
                + report[
                    "hashes"
                ][
                    "reinforcement_bank"
                ]
            ),
            (
                "schema                 : "
                + report[
                    "hashes"
                ][
                    "schema"
                ]
            ),
            (
                "explanation_bank       : "
                + report[
                    "hashes"
                ][
                    "explanation_bank"
                ]
            ),
            "",
            (
                "RESULTADO: AUDITORÍA FINAL "
                "P2-D5.4.1 COMPLETADA"
            ),
        ]
    )

    return "\n".join(
        lines
    )


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main() -> None:

    print()

    print(
        "=" * 86
    )

    print(
        "P2-D5.4.1 - AUDITORÍA FINAL "
        "INDEPENDIENTE 180/180"
    )

    print(
        "=" * 86
    )

    print()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T01 ARCHIVOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    required_files = [
        APP,
        QUESTION_BANK,
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
        SCHEMA_FILE,
        EXPLANATION_BANK,
        PRE_OPTION_REPAIR_BACKUP,
        REFINEMENT_REPORT,
        REPAIR_REPORT,
    ]

    missing = [
        path
        for path
        in required_files
        if not path.exists()
    ]

    check(
        not missing,
        "T01",
        "Todos los archivos requeridos existen.",
    )

    if missing:

        for path in missing:

            print(
                f"     Falta: {path}"
            )

        sys.exit(
            1
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T02-T07 HASHES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        sha256_file(
            APP
        )
        == APP_SHA256,
        "T02",
        "app.py permanece intacto.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )
        == QUESTION_BANK_SHA256,
        "T03",
        "question_bank permanece intacto.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )
        == REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256,
        "T04",
        "reinforcement_bank permanece intacto.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            SCHEMA_FILE
        )
        == SCHEMA_SHA256,
        "T05",
        "schema permanece intacto.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            PRE_OPTION_REPAIR_BACKUP
        )
        == P2D5_4_BANK_SHA256,
        "T06",
        "Backup pre-P2-D5.4.1 coincide con P2-D5.4.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )
        == P2D5_4_1_BANK_SHA256,
        "T07",
        "Banco actual coincide con checkpoint P2-D5.4.1.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T08 JSON
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:

        questions = load_json(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )

        reinforcement = load_json(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )

        bank = load_json(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )

        refinement_report = load_json(
            REFINEMENT_REPORT
        )

        repair_report = load_json(
            REPAIR_REPORT
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        fail(
            f"T08 Error leyendo JSON: {exc}"
        )

        sys.exit(
            1
        )

    ok(
        "T08 JSON principales legibles."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T09-T14 IDENTIDAD
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        (
            isinstance(
                questions,
                list,
            )
            and
            len(
                questions
            )
            == 180
        ),
        "T09",
        "Banco original conserva 180 preguntas.",
    )

    check(
        len(
            reinforcement.get(
                "items",
                [],
            )
        )
        == 8,
        "T10",
        "Banco de refuerzo conserva 8 ítems.",
    )

    items = bank.get(
        "items",
        [],
    )

    check(
        len(
            items
        )
        == 180,
        "T11",
        "Banco pedagógico contiene 180 explicaciones.",
    )

    check(
        (
            bank.get(
                "schema_version"
            )
            == SCHEMA_VERSION
            and
            bank.get(
                "bank_version"
            )
            == BANK_VERSION
        ),
        "T12",
        "Versiones del banco pedagógico correctas.",
    )

    expected_source_ids = [
        question[
            "id"
        ]
        for question
        in questions
    ]

    check(
        [
            item.get(
                "source_question_id"
            )
            for item
            in items
        ]
        == expected_source_ids,
        "T13",
        "Orden 1:1 con question_bank correcto.",
    )

    check(
        [
            item.get(
                "id"
            )
            for item
            in items
        ]
        ==
        [
            f"EX-{source_id}"
            for source_id
            in expected_source_ids
        ],
        "T14",
        "IDs EX- correctos.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T15-T17 ESTRUCTURA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    item_structure_bad = []
    quality_structure_bad = []
    generation_structure_bad = []

    for item in items:

        item_id = item.get(
            "id",
            "SIN-ID",
        )

        if set(
            item.keys()
        ) != EXPECTED_ITEM_FIELDS:

            item_structure_bad.append(
                item_id
            )

        if set(
            item.get(
                "quality",
                {},
            ).keys()
        ) != EXPECTED_QUALITY_FIELDS:

            quality_structure_bad.append(
                item_id
            )

        if set(
            item.get(
                "generation",
                {},
            ).keys()
        ) != EXPECTED_GENERATION_FIELDS:

            generation_structure_bad.append(
                item_id
            )

    check(
        not item_structure_bad,
        "T15",
        "Campos del ítem correctos en 180/180.",
    )

    check(
        not quality_structure_bad,
        "T16",
        "Campos quality correctos en 180/180.",
    )

    check(
        not generation_structure_bad,
        "T17",
        "Campos generation correctos en 180/180.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T18-T23 SEGURIDAD
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        all(
            item[
                "quality"
            ][
                "status"
            ]
            == "draft"
            for item
            in items
        ),
        "T18",
        "Las 180 explicaciones siguen DRAFT.",
    )

    check(
        all(
            item[
                "quality"
            ][
                "mastery_eligible"
            ]
            is False
            for item
            in items
        ),
        "T19",
        "Mastery sigue deshabilitado 180/180.",
    )

    verification_fields = [
        "content_verified",
        "answer_verified",
        "steps_verified",
        "distractors_verified",
        "pedagogical_reviewed",
    ]

    check(
        all(
            all(
                item[
                    "quality"
                ].get(
                    field
                )
                is False
                for field
                in verification_fields
            )
            for item
            in items
        ),
        "T20",
        "Ningún DRAFT está marcado como verificado.",
    )

    check(
        all(
            item[
                "generation"
            ].get(
                "human_validation_required"
            )
            is True
            for item
            in items
        ),
        "T21",
        "Las 180 requieren validación humana.",
    )

    check(
        all(
            item[
                "generation"
            ].get(
                "source_question_locked"
            )
            is True
            for item
            in items
        ),
        "T22",
        "Las fuentes originales continúan bloqueadas.",
    )

    check(
        all(
            item.get(
                "official_utn_question"
            )
            is False
            for item
            in items
        ),
        "T23",
        "Las explicaciones no se presentan como preguntas oficiales UTN.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T24 HASH INDIVIDUAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    bad_hashes = []

    for (
        question,
        item,
    ) in zip(
        questions,
        items,
    ):

        if (
            item.get(
                "source_question_sha256"
            )
            != canonical_sha256(
                question
            )
        ):

            bad_hashes.append(
                question[
                    "id"
                ]
            )

    check(
        not bad_hashes,
        "T24",
        "Los 180 hashes fuente son correctos.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T25-T26 SOURCE REVIEW
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    source_review_question_ids = {
        question[
            "id"
        ]
        for question
        in questions
        if source_review_required(
            question
        )
    }

    check(
        source_review_question_ids
        == EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS,
        "T25",
        "Question bank conserva exactamente 7 source_review.",
    )

    source_review_explanation_ids = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in items
        if (
            "source_review_required"
            in item[
                "quality"
            ].get(
                "flags",
                [],
            )
        )
    }

    check(
        source_review_explanation_ids
        == EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS,
        "T26",
        "Banco pedagógico conserva exactamente las 7 source_review.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T27-T32 REPORTES P2-D5.4 / .1
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        (
            refinement_report.get(
                "stage"
            )
            == "P2-D5.4"
            and
            refinement_report.get(
                "substage"
            )
            == "final_directed_refinement"
        ),
        "T27",
        "Reporte P2-D5.4 corresponde al refinamiento final.",
    )

    check(
        refinement_report.get(
            "hashes",
            {},
        ).get(
            "explanation_bank_after"
        )
        == P2D5_4_BANK_SHA256,
        "T28",
        "Reporte P2-D5.4 termina en el hash esperado.",
    )

    check(
        (
            repair_report.get(
                "stage"
            )
            == "P2-D5.4.1"
            and
            repair_report.get(
                "substage"
            )
            == "source_option_parser_repair"
        ),
        "T29",
        "Reporte P2-D5.4.1 corresponde a reparación del parser.",
    )

    check(
        (
            repair_report.get(
                "hashes",
                {},
            ).get(
                "explanation_bank_before"
            )
            == P2D5_4_BANK_SHA256
            and
            repair_report.get(
                "hashes",
                {},
            ).get(
                "explanation_bank_after"
            )
            == P2D5_4_1_BANK_SHA256
        ),
        "T30",
        "Reporte P2-D5.4.1 registra hashes antes/después correctos.",
    )

    repair_ids_report = set(
        repair_report.get(
            "repair_ids",
            [],
        )
    )

    check(
        repair_ids_report
        == EXPECTED_REPAIR_IDS,
        "T31",
        "Reporte P2-D5.4.1 registra exactamente los 9 IDs reparados.",
    )

    check(
        (
            repair_report.get(
                "summary",
                {},
            ).get(
                "items_repaired"
            )
            == 9
            and
            repair_report.get(
                "summary",
                {},
            ).get(
                "items_untouched"
            )
            == 171
        ),
        "T32",
        "Reporte confirma 9 reparadas y 171 intactas.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T33 FLAGS REPAIR
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    repaired_flag_ids = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in items
        if (
            "p2d5_4_1_option_parser_repair"
            in item[
                "quality"
            ].get(
                "flags",
                [],
            )
        )
    }

    check(
        repaired_flag_ids
        == EXPECTED_REPAIR_IDS,
        "T33",
        "Flag P2-D5.4.1 existe exactamente en los 9 reparados.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T34 DEUDA GENÉRICA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    bad_fragment_ids = [
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in items
        if contains_bad_fragment(
            item
        )
    ]

    check(
        not bad_fragment_ids,
        "T34",
        "No quedan fragmentos genéricos/obsoletos conocidos.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T35-T39 CAPAS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        all(
            isinstance(
                item.get(
                    "relevant_data"
                ),
                list,
            )
            and
            len(
                item.get(
                    "relevant_data",
                    [],
                )
            )
            >= 1
            for item
            in items
        ),
        "T35",
        "Las 180 tienen relevant_data.",
    )

    check(
        all(
            len(
                item.get(
                    "steps",
                    [],
                )
            )
            >= 4
            for item
            in items
        ),
        "T36",
        "Las 180 conservan al menos 4 pasos.",
    )

    invalid_step_order = []

    for item in items:

        orders = [
            step.get(
                "order"
            )
            for step
            in item.get(
                "steps",
                [],
            )
        ]

        if orders != list(
            range(
                1,
                len(
                    orders
                ) + 1,
            )
        ):

            invalid_step_order.append(
                item[
                    "source_question_id"
                ]
            )

    check(
        not invalid_step_order,
        "T37",
        "Orden de pasos válido 180/180.",
    )

    check(
        all(
            clean_spaces(
                item.get(
                    "why_correct"
                )
            )
            for item
            in items
        ),
        "T38",
        "Las 180 tienen why_correct.",
    )

    check(
        all(
            item.get(
                "distractor_analysis"
            )
            for item
            in items
        ),
        "T39",
        "Las 180 tienen análisis de distractores.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T40-T46 PDF + PARSER REPARADO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:

        sources = extract_pdf_sources(
            questions
        )

        check(
            (
                len(
                    sources
                )
                == 180
                and
                all(
                    clean_spaces(
                        source.get(
                            "stem"
                        )
                    )
                    for source
                    in sources.values()
                )
            ),
            "T40",
            "Los PDF producen 180 stems no vacíos.",
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        fail(
            f"T40 Falló extracción PDF: {exc}"
        )

        sources = {}

    if sources:

        option_count_bad = []

        for question in questions:

            source_id = question[
                "id"
            ]

            actual_count = len(
                sources[
                    source_id
                ][
                    "options"
                ]
            )

            expected_count = (
                EXPECTED_NON4_COUNTS.get(
                    source_id,
                    4,
                )
            )

            if (
                actual_count
                != expected_count
            ):

                option_count_bad.append(
                    (
                        source_id,
                        expected_count,
                        actual_count,
                    )
                )

        check(
            not option_count_bad,
            "T41",
            "El parser respeta exactamente preguntas de 3, 4 y 5 opciones.",
        )

        answers_missing = [
            question[
                "id"
            ]
            for question
            in questions
            if (
                str(
                    question.get(
                        "answer",
                        "",
                    )
                ).upper()
                not in sources[
                    question[
                        "id"
                    ]
                ][
                    "options"
                ]
            )
        ]

        check(
            not answers_missing,
            "T42",
            "Las 180 claves existen entre las opciones reconstruidas.",
        )

        option_key_bad = []

        for question in questions:

            source_id = question[
                "id"
            ]

            keys = sorted(
                sources[
                    source_id
                ][
                    "options"
                ].keys()
            )

            expected_count = (
                EXPECTED_NON4_COUNTS.get(
                    source_id,
                    4,
                )
            )

            expected_keys = [
                chr(
                    ord(
                        "A"
                    )
                    + index
                )
                for index
                in range(
                    expected_count
                )
            ]

            if keys != expected_keys:

                option_key_bad.append(
                    (
                        source_id,
                        keys,
                        expected_keys,
                    )
                )

        check(
            not option_key_bad,
            "T43",
            "Los conjuntos de letras son consecutivos desde A.",
        )

        distractor_mismatch_ids = []

        for (
            question,
            item,
        ) in zip(
            questions,
            items,
        ):

            source_id = question[
                "id"
            ]

            answer = str(
                question.get(
                    "answer",
                    "",
                )
            ).upper()

            expected_wrong = [
                letter
                for letter
                in sorted(
                    sources[
                        source_id
                    ][
                        "options"
                    ]
                )
                if letter
                != answer
            ][
                :4
            ]

            actual_wrong = (
                distractor_letters(
                    item
                )
            )

            if (
                actual_wrong
                != expected_wrong
            ):

                distractor_mismatch_ids.append(
                    source_id
                )

        check(
            not distractor_mismatch_ids,
            "T44",
            "Cobertura de distractores coincide con la fuente 180/180.",
        )

        check(
            all(
                distractors_specific(
                    item
                )
                for item
                in items
            ),
            "T45",
            "Los 180 análisis de distractores superan el mínimo de especificidad.",
        )

        repaired_pdf_ids = {
            source_id
            for source_id
            in EXPECTED_REPAIR_IDS
            if sorted(
                sources[
                    source_id
                ][
                    "options"
                ].keys()
            )
            == [
                "A",
                "B",
                "C",
                "D",
            ]
        }

        check(
            repaired_pdf_ids
            == EXPECTED_REPAIR_IDS,
            "T46",
            "Los 9 casos reparados reconstruyen A/B/C/D correctamente.",
        )

        check(
            (
                len(
                    sources[
                        "S1-84"
                    ][
                        "options"
                    ]
                )
                == 3
                and
                len(
                    sources[
                        "S1-61"
                    ][
                        "options"
                    ]
                )
                == 5
            ),
            "T47",
            "Casos control de 3 y 5 alternativas permanecen correctos.",
        )

        check(
            (
                sorted(
                    sources[
                        "S3-37"
                    ][
                        "options"
                    ]
                )
                == [
                    "A",
                    "B",
                    "C",
                    "D",
                ]
                and
                sorted(
                    sources[
                        "S3-44"
                    ][
                        "options"
                    ]
                )
                == [
                    "A",
                    "B",
                    "C",
                    "D",
                ]
            ),
            "T48",
            "S3-37 y S3-44 ya contienen sus claves C/B dentro de A-D.",
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T49-T53 CASOS PEDAGÓGICOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    items_by_source = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]:
            item
        for item
        in items
    }

    validate_s1_70(
        items_by_source
    )

    validate_s3_77(
        items_by_source
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # ABORTAR SI FALLA BASE ESTRUCTURAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if errors:

        print()

        print(
            "=" * 86
        )

        print(
            "RESUMEN DE VALIDACIÓN "
            "ESTRUCTURAL P2-D5.4.1"
        )

        print(
            "=" * 86
        )

        print(
            f"Checks aprobados : {checks}"
        )

        print(
            f"Errores          : {len(errors)}"
        )

        print(
            f"Warnings         : {len(warnings)}"
        )

        print()

        print(
            "ERRORES"
        )

        print(
            "-" * 86
        )

        for message in errors:

            print(
                f"- {message}"
            )

        print()

        print(
            "RESULTADO: AUDITORÍA FINAL "
            "P2-D5.4.1 ABORTADA"
        )

        sys.exit(
            1
        )

    # ========================================================
    # AUDITORÍA PEDAGÓGICA FINAL
    # ========================================================

    print()

    print(
        "[INFO] Ejecutando auditoría "
        "pedagógica final 180/180..."
    )

    audits = []

    for (
        question,
        item,
    ) in zip(
        questions,
        items,
    ):

        audits.append(
            audit_item(
                question,
                item,
                sources[
                    question[
                        "id"
                    ]
                ],
            )
        )

    classification_counter = Counter(
        audit[
            "classification"
        ]
        for audit
        in audits
    )

    enrichment_counter = Counter()
    blocking_counter = Counter()

    ids_by_classification = defaultdict(
        list
    )

    by_area = defaultdict(
        Counter
    )

    for audit in audits:

        ids_by_classification[
            audit[
                "classification"
            ]
        ].append(
            audit[
                "source_question_id"
            ]
        )

        by_area[
            audit[
                "area"
            ]
        ][
            audit[
                "classification"
            ]
        ] += 1

        for reason in audit[
            "enrichment_reasons"
        ]:

            enrichment_counter[
                reason
            ] += 1

        for reason in audit[
            "blocking_reasons"
        ]:

            blocking_counter[
                reason
            ] += 1

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # MÉTRICAS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    bad_fragments_count = sum(
        contains_bad_fragment(
            item
        )
        for item
        in items
    )

    items_without_distractors = sum(
        not item.get(
            "distractor_analysis"
        )
        for item
        in items
    )

    distractor_mismatch_count = sum(
        (
            "distractor_coverage_mismatch"
            in audit[
                "blocking_reasons"
            ]
        )
        for audit
        in audits
    )

    answer_missing_count = sum(
        (
            str(
                question.get(
                    "answer",
                    "",
                )
            ).upper()
            not in sources[
                question[
                    "id"
                ]
            ][
                "options"
            ]
        )
        for question
        in questions
    )

    weak_relevant_data_count = sum(
        (
            "relevant_data_weak"
            in audit[
                "enrichment_reasons"
            ]
        )
        for audit
        in audits
    )

    numeric_without_math_count = sum(
        (
            "numeric_without_math"
            in audit[
                "enrichment_reasons"
            ]
        )
        for audit
        in audits
    )

    candidate_count = (
        classification_counter.get(
            "validation_candidate",
            0,
        )
    )

    enrichment_count = (
        classification_counter.get(
            "needs_enrichment",
            0,
        )
    )

    correction_count = (
        classification_counter.get(
            "needs_correction",
            0,
        )
    )

    source_review_count = (
        classification_counter.get(
            "source_review",
            0,
        )
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # DECISIÓN ESTRICTA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    ready = (
        candidate_count
        == 173
        and
        source_review_count
        == 7
        and
        enrichment_count
        == 0
        and
        correction_count
        == 0
        and
        bad_fragments_count
        == 0
        and
        items_without_distractors
        == 0
        and
        distractor_mismatch_count
        == 0
        and
        answer_missing_count
        == 0
    )

    decision = (
        "READY_FOR_CONTROLLED_STATUS_VALIDATION"
        if ready
        else
        "NOT_READY_REVIEW_AUDIT_ITEMS"
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # REPORTE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    report = {
        "stage":
            "P2-D5.4.1",

        "substage":
            "final_independent_audit_after_option_parser_repair",

        "status":
            "audit_completed_no_bank_mutation",

        "method": {
            "items_audited":
                180,

            "pdf_reextracted":
                True,

            "repaired_parser_used":
                True,

            "source_hash_recalculated":
                True,

            "distractor_coverage_checked":
                True,

            "answer_presence_checked":
                True,

            "special_cases_checked": [
                "S1-70",
                "S3-37",
                "S3-44",
                "S3-77",
            ],

            "source_review_blocked":
                True,

            "bank_mutated":
                False,

            "quality_status_mutated":
                False,
        },

        "summary": {
            "items_audited":
                len(
                    audits
                ),

            "classifications":
                dict(
                    sorted(
                        classification_counter.items()
                    )
                ),

            "items_with_bad_fragments":
                bad_fragments_count,

            "items_without_distractors":
                items_without_distractors,

            "items_with_distractor_mismatch":
                distractor_mismatch_count,

            "answers_missing_from_options":
                answer_missing_count,

            "items_with_weak_relevant_data":
                weak_relevant_data_count,

            "numeric_items_without_math":
                numeric_without_math_count,

            "source_review_expected":
                7,

            "ready_for_controlled_validation":
                ready,

            "decision":
                decision,

            "structural_errors":
                0,

            "warnings":
                len(
                    warnings
                ),
        },

        "top_enrichment_reasons":
            enrichment_counter.most_common(),

        "top_blocking_reasons":
            blocking_counter.most_common(),

        "ids_by_classification": {
            key:
                value
            for (
                key,
                value,
            ) in sorted(
                ids_by_classification.items()
            )
        },

        "by_area": {
            area:
                dict(
                    sorted(
                        values.items()
                    )
                )
            for (
                area,
                values,
            ) in sorted(
                by_area.items()
            )
        },

        "source_review_ids":
            sorted(
                EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS
            ),

        "option_parser_repair_ids":
            sorted(
                EXPECTED_REPAIR_IDS
            ),

        "items":
            audits,

        "hashes": {
            "app":
                sha256_file(
                    APP
                ),

            "question_bank":
                sha256_file(
                    QUESTION_BANK
                ),

            "reinforcement_bank":
                sha256_file(
                    REINFORCEMENT_BANK
                ),

            "schema":
                sha256_file(
                    SCHEMA_FILE
                ),

            "explanation_bank":
                sha256_file(
                    EXPLANATION_BANK
                ),
        },
    }

    write_json(
        AUDIT_JSON,
        report,
    )

    AUDIT_TXT.write_text(
        build_txt(
            report
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # POST-HASH
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    stable_ok = (
        sha256_file(
            APP
        )
        == APP_SHA256
        and
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )
        == QUESTION_BANK_SHA256
        and
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )
        == REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256
        and
        sha256_file(
            SCHEMA_FILE
        )
        == SCHEMA_SHA256
        and
        sha256_file(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )
        == P2D5_4_1_BANK_SHA256
    )

    if not stable_ok:

        fail(
            "POST-AUDIT Algún archivo estable cambió."
        )

        sys.exit(
            1
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # SALIDA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    print()

    print(
        "=" * 86
    )

    print(
        "RESUMEN DE AUDITORÍA FINAL "
        "P2-D5.4.1"
    )

    print(
        "=" * 86
    )

    print(
        "Explicaciones auditadas          :",
        len(
            audits
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Candidatas a validación          :",
        candidate_count,
    )

    print(
        "Necesitan enriquecimiento        :",
        enrichment_count,
    )

    print(
        "Necesitan corrección             :",
        correction_count,
    )

    print(
        "Revisión de fuente               :",
        source_review_count,
    )

    print()

    print(
        "DEUDA FINAL"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 86
    )

    print(
        "Fragmentos genéricos/obsoletos   :",
        bad_fragments_count,
    )

    print(
        "Sin análisis de distractores     :",
        items_without_distractors,
    )

    print(
        "Mismatch distractores            :",
        distractor_mismatch_count,
    )

    print(
        "Claves ausentes en fuente        :",
        answer_missing_count,
    )

    print(
        "Relevant data débil              :",
        weak_relevant_data_count,
    )

    print(
        "Numéricas sin math               :",
        numeric_without_math_count,
    )

    print()

    print(
        "TOP MOTIVOS DE ENRIQUECIMIENTO"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 86
    )

    if enrichment_counter:

        for (
            reason,
            count,
        ) in enrichment_counter.most_common(
            12
        ):

            print(
                f"{reason:<48} : {count}"
            )

    else:

        print(
            "Ninguno."
        )

    print()

    print(
        "TOP MOTIVOS BLOQUEANTES"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 86
    )

    if blocking_counter:

        for (
            reason,
            count,
        ) in blocking_counter.most_common(
            12
        ):

            print(
                f"{reason:<48} : {count}"
            )

    else:

        print(
            "Ninguno."
        )

    print()

    print(
        "DECISIÓN"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 86
    )

    print(
        "Listo para validación controlada :",
        ready,
    )

    print(
        "Decision code                    :",
        decision,
    )

    print()

    print(
        "SEGURIDAD"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 86
    )

    print(
        "question_bank modificado         : False"
    )

    print(
        "reinforcement_bank modificado    : False"
    )

    print(
        "app.py modificado                : False"
    )

    print(
        "schema modificado                : False"
    )

    print(
        "explanation_bank modificado      : False"
    )

    print(
        "quality.status modificado        : False"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "ARCHIVOS"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 86
    )

    print(
        "Audit JSON :",
        AUDIT_JSON.relative_to(
            ROOT
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Audit TXT  :",
        AUDIT_TXT.relative_to(
            ROOT
        ),
    )

    print()

    print(
        "IMPORTANTE"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 86
    )

    print(
        "- Esta auditoría NO cambia DRAFT a VALIDATED."
    )

    print(
        "- Las 7 source_review continúan bloqueadas."
    )

    print(
        "- READY exige 173 candidatas, 7 source_review, "
        "0 enriquecimientos y 0 correcciones."
    )

    print(
        "- La promoción de estado, si procede, será "
        "una fase separada y reversible."
    )

    print()

    print(
        "RESULTADO: AUDITORÍA FINAL "
        "P2-D5.4.1 COMPLETADA"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# ============================================================
# ESTADO DE CHECKS
# ============================================================

checks = 0
errors: list[str] = []
warnings: list[str] = []


def ok(message: str) -> None:
    global checks

    checks += 1
    print(
        f"[OK] {message}"
    )


def fail(message: str) -> None:
    errors.append(
        message
    )

    print(
        f"[ERROR] {message}"
    )


def warn(message: str) -> None:
    warnings.append(
        message
    )

    print(
        f"[WARN] {message}"
    )


def check(
    condition: bool,
    code: str,
    message: str,
) -> None:

    if condition:
        ok(
            f"{code} {message}"
        )
    else:
        fail(
            f"{code} {message}"
        )


# ============================================================
# UTILIDADES
# ============================================================

def sha256_file(
    path: Path,
) -> str:

    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open(
        "rb"
    ) as handle:

        while True:

            chunk = handle.read(
                1024 * 1024
            )

            if not chunk:
                break

            digest.update(
                chunk
            )

    return digest.hexdigest().upper()


def canonical_sha256(
    data,
) -> str:

    payload = json.dumps(
        data,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode(
        "utf-8"
    )

    return hashlib.sha256(
        payload
    ).hexdigest().upper()


def load_json(
    path: Path,
):

    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def write_json(
    path: Path,
    data,
) -> None:

    path.parent.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            data,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )
        + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def clean_spaces(
    value,
) -> str:

    return re.sub(
        r"\s+",
        " ",
        str(
            value or ""
        ),
    ).strip()


def normalize(
    value,
) -> str:

    text = str(
        value or ""
    )

    text = unicodedata.normalize(
        "NFKD",
        text,
    )

    text = "".join(
        character
        for character
        in text
        if not unicodedata.combining(
            character
        )
    )

    text = (
        text.lower()
        .replace(
            "×",
            "x",
        )
        .replace(
            "−",
            "-",
        )
    )

    text = re.sub(
        r"\s+",
        " ",
        text,
    )

    return text.strip()


def source_review_required(
    question: dict,
) -> bool:

    if (
        question.get(
            "status"
        )
        == "revisar_fuente"
    ):

        return True

    quality = question.get(
        "quality",
        {},
    )

    if isinstance(
        quality,
        dict,
    ):

        return bool(
            quality.get(
                "source_review_required"
            )
        )

    return False


def distractor_letters(
    item: dict,
) -> list[str]:

    output = []

    for distractor in item.get(
        "distractor_analysis",
        [],
    ):

        choice = clean_spaces(
            distractor.get(
                "choice"
            )
        )

        match = re.match(
            r"^([A-E])\)",
            choice,
            flags=re.I,
        )

        if match:

            output.append(
                match.group(
                    1
                ).upper()
            )

    return output


# ============================================================
# PDF
# ============================================================

BOILERPLATE_PREFIXES = (
    "YachayPre Preuniversitario",
    "Simulacro UTN FICA-FICAYA",
    "Instrucciones:",
    "Resolver las 90 preguntas",
    "No está permitido el uso",
    "La evaluación deberá realizarse",
    "Marcar la opción correcta",
    "Si finaliza antes del tiempo",
)


def pdf_text(
    path: Path,
) -> str:

    pieces = []

    with fitz.open(
        path
    ) as document:

        for page in document:

            pieces.append(
                page.get_text(
                    "text"
                )
            )

    return "\n".join(
        pieces
    )


def remove_boilerplate(
    text: str,
) -> str:

    output = []

    for raw_line in text.splitlines():

        line = raw_line.strip()

        if not line:

            output.append(
                ""
            )

            continue

        if line.startswith(
            ""
        ):

            continue

        if any(
            line.startswith(
                prefix
            )
            for prefix
            in BOILERPLATE_PREFIXES
        ):

            continue

        output.append(
            raw_line
        )

    return "\n".join(
        output
    )


def parse_question_blocks(
    text: str,
) -> dict[int, str]:

    blocks = {}
    cursor = 0

    for number in range(
        1,
        91,
    ):

        pattern = re.compile(
            rf"(?m)^\s*{number}\.(?:-)?\s*"
        )

        match = pattern.search(
            text,
            cursor,
        )

        if not match:

            raise RuntimeError(
                f"No se encontró pregunta {number}."
            )

        if number < 90:

            next_pattern = re.compile(
                rf"(?m)^\s*{number + 1}"
                rf"\.(?:-)?\s*"
            )

            next_match = next_pattern.search(
                text,
                match.end(),
            )

            if not next_match:

                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"No se pudo delimitar pregunta {number}."
                )

            end = next_match.start()

        else:

            end = len(
                text
            )

        blocks[
            number
        ] = remove_boilerplate(
            text[
                match.start():
                end
            ]
        ).strip()

        cursor = match.end()

    return blocks


# ============================================================
# PARSER DE OPCIONES P2-D5.4.1
# ============================================================

OPTION_MARKER_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"(?i)(?<!\S)([A-E])\s*[.)]\s*"
)


def ordered_option_candidates(
    body: str,
) -> list[list[re.Match]]:

    matches = list(
        OPTION_MARKER_PATTERN.finditer(
            body
        )
    )

    candidates = []

    for start_index, match in enumerate(
        matches
    ):

        if (
            match.group(
                1
            ).upper()
            != "A"
        ):

            continue

        selected = [
            match
        ]

        expected_ord = ord(
            "B"
        )

        for next_match in matches[
            start_index + 1:
        ]:

            if expected_ord > ord(
                "E"
            ):

                break

            expected_letter = chr(
                expected_ord
            )

            actual_letter = (
                next_match.group(
                    1
                ).upper()
            )

            if (
                actual_letter
                == expected_letter
            ):

                selected.append(
                    next_match
                )

                expected_ord += 1

            else:
                break

        if len(
            selected
        ) >= 2:

            candidates.append(
                selected
            )

    return candidates


def split_stem_and_options(
    block: str,
    question_id: str,
) -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]]:

    body = re.sub(
        r"^\s*\d{1,2}\.(?:-)?\s*",
        "",
        block,
        count=1,
    ).strip()

    if (
        question_id
        == "S3-77"
    ):

        position = re.search(
            r"(?mi)^\s*A\s*[.)]",
            body,
        )

        if position:

            stem = clean_spaces(
                body[
                    :position.start()
                ]
            )

        else:

            stem = (
                "Determine la derivada de la función "
                "f(x)=3x⁴-5x²+7x-2."
            )

        return (
            stem,
            dict(
                S3_77_OPTIONS
            ),
        )

    candidates = ordered_option_candidates(
        body
    )

    if not candidates:

        return (
            clean_spaces(
                body
            ),
            {},
        )

    selected = max(
        candidates,
        key=lambda candidate: (
            len(
                candidate
            ),
            candidate[
                0
            ].start(),
        ),
    )

    stem = clean_spaces(
        body[
            :selected[
                0
            ].start()
        ]
    )

    options = {}

    for (
        index,
        match,
    ) in enumerate(
        selected
    ):

        start = match.end()

        if (
            index + 1
            < len(
                selected
            )
        ):

            end = (
                selected[
                    index + 1
                ].start()
            )

        else:

            end = len(
                body
            )

        letter = (
            match.group(
                1
            ).upper()
        )

        options[
            letter
        ] = clean_spaces(
            body[
                start:end
            ]
        )

    return (
        stem,
        options,
    )


def extract_pdf_sources(
    questions: list[dict],
) -> dict[str, dict]:

    pdf_names = sorted(
        {
            question[
                "pdf"
            ]
            for question
            in questions
        }
    )

    parsed_pdfs = {}

    for pdf_name in pdf_names:

        path = (
            SOURCES_DIR
            / pdf_name
        )

        if not path.exists():

            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Falta PDF fuente: {path}"
            )

        blocks = parse_question_blocks(
            pdf_text(
                path
            )
        )

        if len(
            blocks
        ) != 90:

            raise RuntimeError(
                f"{pdf_name}: no produjo 90 bloques."
            )

        parsed_pdfs[
            pdf_name
        ] = blocks

    sources = {}

    for question in questions:

        source_id = question[
            "id"
        ]

        block = parsed_pdfs[
            question[
                "pdf"
            ]
        ][
            int(
                question[
                    "number"
                ]
            )
        ]

        (
            stem,
            options,
        ) = split_stem_and_options(
            block,
            source_id,
        )

        sources[
            source_id
        ] = {
            "stem":
                stem,

            "options":
                options,
        }

    return sources
