    "distractors_verified",
    "pedagogical_reviewed",
]


# ============================================================
# CHECKS
# ============================================================

checks = 0
errors: list[str] = []
warnings: list[str] = []


def ok(
    message: str,
) -> None:

    global checks

    checks += 1

    print(
        f"[OK] {message}"
    )


def fail(
    message: str,
) -> None:

    errors.append(
        message
    )

    print(
        f"[ERROR] {message}"
    )


def warn(
    message: str,
) -> None:

    warnings.append(
        message
    )

    print(
        f"[WARN] {message}"
    )


def check(
    condition: bool,
    code: str,
    message: str,
) -> None:

    if condition:

        ok(
            f"{code} {message}"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            f"{code} {message}"
        )


# ============================================================
# UTILIDADES
# ============================================================

def sha256_file(
    path: Path,
) -> str:

    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open(
        "rb"
    ) as handle:

        while True:

            chunk = handle.read(
                1024 * 1024
            )

            if not chunk:
                break

            digest.update(
                chunk
            )

    return digest.hexdigest().upper()


def canonical_sha256(
    data,
) -> str:

    payload = json.dumps(
        data,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode(
        "utf-8"
    )

    return hashlib.sha256(
        payload
    ).hexdigest().upper()


def load_json(
    path: Path,
):

    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def write_json(
    path: Path,
    data,
) -> None:

    path.parent.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            data,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )
        + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def source_review_ids_from_bank(
    bank: dict,
) -> set[str]:

    return {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in bank.get(
            "items",
            [],
        )
        if (
            "source_review_required"
            in item.get(
                "quality",
                {},
            ).get(
                "flags",
                [],
            )
        )
    }


# ============================================================
# REPORTE TXT
# ============================================================

def build_txt(
    report: dict,
) -> str:

    summary = report[
        "summary"
    ]

    hashes = report[
        "hashes"
    ]

    lines = [
        "=" * 88,
        "P2-D5.5 - AUDITORÍA POST-VALIDACIÓN INDEPENDIENTE",
        "=" * 88,
        "",
        "RESUMEN",
        "-" * 88,
        (
            "Explicaciones totales            : "
            f"{summary['items_total']}"
        ),
        (
            "VALIDATED                        : "
            f"{summary['validated']}"
        ),
        (
            "DRAFT                            : "
            f"{summary['draft']}"
        ),
        (
            "source_review DRAFT              : "
            f"{summary['source_review_draft']}"
        ),
        (
            "Mastery habilitado               : "
            f"{summary['mastery_true']}"
        ),
        (
            "Verificaciones completas         : "
            f"{summary['fully_verified']}"
        ),
        (
            "Contenido pedagógico modificado  : "
            f"{summary['pedagogical_content_modified']}"
        ),
        (
            "Diff fuera de quality            : "
            f"{summary['items_changed_outside_quality']}"
        ),
        (
            "Source review modificadas        : "
            f"{summary['source_review_modified']}"
        ),
        "",
        "TRANSICIÓN",
        "-" * 88,
        (
            "Ítems cambiados                  : "
            f"{summary['changed_items']}"
        ),
        (
            "Cambios autorizados              : "
            f"{summary['authorized_transitions']}"
        ),
        (
            "Cambios no autorizados           : "
            f"{summary['unauthorized_transitions']}"
        ),
        "",
        "DECISIÓN",
        "-" * 88,
        (
            "Listo para integración app       : "
            f"{summary['ready_for_app_integration']}"
        ),
        (
            "Decision code                    : "
            f"{summary['decision']}"
        ),
        "",
        "SOURCE REVIEW BLOQUEADAS",
        "-" * 88,
        ", ".join(
            report[
                "source_review_ids"
            ]
        ),
        "",
        "HASHES",
        "-" * 88,
        (
            "app.py                   : "
            + hashes[
                "app"
            ]
        ),
        (
            "question_bank            : "
            + hashes[
                "question_bank"
            ]
        ),
        (
            "reinforcement_bank       : "
            + hashes[
                "reinforcement_bank"
            ]
        ),
        (
            "schema                   : "
            + hashes[
                "schema"
            ]
        ),
        (
            "explanation_bank pre     : "
            + hashes[
                "pre_validation_bank"
            ]
        ),
        (
            "explanation_bank actual  : "
            + hashes[
                "current_bank"
            ]
        ),
        "",
        "SEGURIDAD",
        "-" * 88,
        "question_bank modificado         : False",
        "reinforcement_bank modificado    : False",
        "app.py modificado                : False",
        "schema modificado                : False",
        "auditoría modifica banco         : False",
        "integración app realizada        : False",
        "",
        (
            "RESULTADO: AUDITORÍA POST-VALIDACIÓN "
            "P2-D5.5 COMPLETADA"
        ),
    ]

    return "\n".join(
        lines
    )


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main() -> None:

    print()

    print(
        "=" * 88
    )

    print(
        "P2-D5.5 - AUDITORÍA POST-VALIDACIÓN INDEPENDIENTE"
    )

    print(
        "=" * 88
    )

    print()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T01 ARCHIVOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    required = [
        APP,
        QUESTION_BANK,
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
        SCHEMA_FILE,
        EXPLANATION_BANK,
        PRE_VALIDATION_BACKUP,
        FINAL_PRE_VALIDATION_AUDIT,
        P2D5_5_REPORT,
    ]

    missing = [
        path
        for path
        in required
        if not path.exists()
    ]

    check(
        not missing,
        "T01",
        "Todos los archivos requeridos existen.",
    )

    if missing:

        for path in missing:

            print(
                f"     Falta: {path}"
            )

        sys.exit(
            1
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T02-T07 HASHES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        sha256_file(
            APP
        )
        == APP_SHA256,
        "T02",
        "app.py permanece intacto.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )
        == QUESTION_BANK_SHA256,
        "T03",
        "question_bank permanece intacto.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )
        == REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256,
        "T04",
        "reinforcement_bank permanece intacto.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            SCHEMA_FILE
        )
        == SCHEMA_SHA256,
        "T05",
        "schema permanece intacto.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            PRE_VALIDATION_BACKUP
        )
        == P2D5_4_2_BANK_SHA256,
        "T06",
        "Backup pre-validación coincide con P2-D5.4.2.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )
        == P2D5_5_BANK_SHA256,
        "T07",
        "Banco actual coincide con checkpoint P2-D5.5.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T08 JSON
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:

        questions = load_json(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )

        reinforcement = load_json(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )

        before_bank = load_json(
            PRE_VALIDATION_BACKUP
        )

        current_bank = load_json(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )

        final_audit = load_json(
            FINAL_PRE_VALIDATION_AUDIT
        )

        validation_report = load_json(
            P2D5_5_REPORT
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        fail(
            f"T08 No se pudieron leer los JSON: {exc}"
        )

        sys.exit(
            1
        )

    ok(
        "T08 JSON principales legibles."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T09-T13 IDENTIDAD
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        (
            isinstance(
                questions,
                list,
            )
            and
            len(
                questions
            )
            == 180
        ),
        "T09",
        "question_bank conserva exactamente 180 preguntas.",
    )

    check(
        len(
            reinforcement.get(
                "items",
                [],
            )
        )
        == 8,
        "T10",
        "reinforcement_bank conserva exactamente 8 ítems.",
    )

    before_items = before_bank.get(
        "items",
        [],
    )

    current_items = current_bank.get(
        "items",
        [],
    )

    check(
        (
            len(
                before_items
            )
            == 180
            and
            len(
                current_items
            )
            == 180
        ),
        "T11",
        "Banco pre y post contienen 180 explicaciones.",
    )

    check(
        (
            before_bank.get(
                "schema_version"
            )
            == SCHEMA_VERSION
            and
            current_bank.get(
                "schema_version"
            )
            == SCHEMA_VERSION
            and
            before_bank.get(
                "bank_version"
            )
            == BANK_VERSION
            and
            current_bank.get(
                "bank_version"
            )
            == BANK_VERSION
        ),
        "T12",
        "Identidad schema/bank permanece estable.",
    )

    expected_ids = [
        question[
            "id"
        ]
        for question
        in questions
    ]

    check(
        (
            [
                item.get(
                    "source_question_id"
                )
                for item
                in before_items
            ]
            == expected_ids
            and
            [
                item.get(
                    "source_question_id"
                )
                for item
                in current_items
            ]
            == expected_ids
        ),
        "T13",
        "Orden 1:1 permanece idéntico antes y después.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T14-T15 HASHES FUENTE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    bad_before_hashes = []
    bad_current_hashes = []

    for (
        question,
        before,
        current,
    ) in zip(
        questions,
        before_items,
        current_items,
    ):

        expected_hash = canonical_sha256(
            question
        )

        if (
            before.get(
                "source_question_sha256"
            )
            != expected_hash
        ):

            bad_before_hashes.append(
                question[
                    "id"
                ]
            )

        if (
            current.get(
                "source_question_sha256"
            )
            != expected_hash
        ):

            bad_current_hashes.append(
                question[
                    "id"
                ]
            )

    check(
        not bad_before_hashes,
        "T14",
        "Backup conserva los 180 hashes fuente correctos.",
    )

    check(
        not bad_current_hashes,
        "T15",
        "Banco actual conserva los 180 hashes fuente correctos.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T16-T18 AUDITORÍA PREVIA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    audit_summary = final_audit.get(
        "summary",
        {},
    )

    audit_classes = audit_summary.get(
        "classifications",
        {},
    )

    check(
        (
            final_audit.get(
                "stage"
            )
            == "P2-D5.4.2"
            and
            final_audit.get(
                "hashes",
                {},
            ).get(
                "explanation_bank"
            )
            == P2D5_4_2_BANK_SHA256
        ),
        "T16",
        "Auditoría previa corresponde al checkpoint pre-validación.",
    )

    check(
        (
            audit_summary.get(
                "ready_for_controlled_validation"
            )
            is True
            and
            audit_summary.get(
                "decision"
            )
            == READY_PREVALIDATION_DECISION
        ),
        "T17",
        "Auditoría previa autorizó validación controlada.",
    )

    check(
        (
            audit_classes.get(
                "validation_candidate",
                0,
            )
            == 173
            and
            audit_classes.get(
                "needs_enrichment",
                0,
            )
            == 0
            and
            audit_classes.get(
                "needs_correction",
                0,
            )
            == 0
            and
            audit_classes.get(
                "source_review",
                0,
            )
            == 7
        ),
        "T18",
        "Baseline previo es exactamente 173/0/0/7.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T19-T21 IDS AUTORIZADOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    audit_items = final_audit.get(
        "items",
        [],
    )

    validation_ids = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in audit_items
        if (
            item.get(
                "classification"
            )
            == "validation_candidate"
        )
    }

    audit_source_review_ids = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in audit_items
        if (
            item.get(
                "classification"
            )
            == "source_review"
        )
    }

    check(
        len(
            validation_ids
        )
        == 173,
        "T19",
        "Auditoría previa contiene exactamente 173 IDs autorizados.",
    )

    check(
        audit_source_review_ids
        == EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS,
        "T20",
        "Auditoría previa conserva las 7 source_review congeladas.",
    )

    check(
        (
            validation_ids
            & EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS
        )
        == set(),
        "T21",
        "Ninguna source_review pertenece a los 173 autorizados.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T22-T26 REPORTE P2-D5.5
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        (
            validation_report.get(
                "stage"
            )
            == "P2-D5.5"
            and
            validation_report.get(
                "substage"
            )
            == "controlled_status_validation"
        ),
        "T22",
        "Reporte corresponde a P2-D5.5.",
    )

    report_hashes = validation_report.get(
        "hashes",
        {},
    )

    check(
        (
            report_hashes.get(
                "explanation_bank_before"
            )
            == P2D5_4_2_BANK_SHA256
            and
            report_hashes.get(
                "explanation_bank_after"
            )
            == P2D5_5_BANK_SHA256
        ),
        "T23",
        "Reporte P2-D5.5 registra hashes antes/después correctos.",
    )

    report_summary = validation_report.get(
        "summary",
        {},
    )

    check(
        (
            report_summary.get(
                "validated"
            )
            == 173
            and
            report_summary.get(
                "draft"
            )
            == 7
            and
            report_summary.get(
                "source_review_preserved"
            )
            == 7
        ),
        "T24",
        "Reporte P2-D5.5 registra 173 VALIDATED + 7 DRAFT.",
    )

    report_validated_ids = set(
        validation_report.get(
            "validated_ids",
            [],
        )
    )

    check(
        report_validated_ids
        == validation_ids,
        "T25",
        "IDs validados del reporte coinciden con validation_candidate.",
    )

    check(
        set(
            validation_report.get(
                "draft_source_review_ids",
                [],
            )
        )
        == EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS,
        "T26",
        "Reporte preserva exactamente las 7 source_review.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # MAPAS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    before_by_id = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]:
            item
        for item
        in before_items
    }

    current_by_id = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]:
            item
        for item
        in current_items
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T27 DIFF GLOBAL
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    changed_ids = {
        source_id
        for source_id
        in expected_ids
        if (
            before_by_id[
                source_id
            ]
            != current_by_id[
                source_id
            ]
        )
    }

    check(
        changed_ids
        == validation_ids,
        "T27",
        "Solo cambiaron exactamente los 173 IDs autorizados.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T28 SOURCE REVIEW BYTE-EQUIVALENTE A NIVEL JSON
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    modified_source_review = {
        source_id
        for source_id
        in EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS
        if (
            before_by_id[
                source_id
            ]
            != current_by_id[
                source_id
            ]
        )
    }

    check(
        not modified_source_review,
        "T28",
        "Las 7 source_review permanecen idénticas.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T29-T34 DIFERENCIA SOLO QUALITY
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    outside_quality_changes = []

    quality_structure_bad = []

    unauthorized_quality_transitions = []

    missing_validation_flag = []

    content_changed_ids = []

    for source_id in sorted(
        validation_ids
    ):

        before = dict(
            before_by_id[
                source_id
            ]
        )

        current = dict(
            current_by_id[
                source_id
            ]
        )

        before_quality = dict(
            before.pop(
                "quality"
            )
        )

        current_quality = dict(
            current.pop(
                "quality"
            )
        )

        if (
            before
            != current
        ):

            outside_quality_changes.append(
                source_id
            )

            content_changed_ids.append(
                source_id
            )

        if (
            set(
                before_quality.keys()
            )
            != EXPECTED_QUALITY_FIELDS
            or
            set(
                current_quality.keys()
            )
            != EXPECTED_QUALITY_FIELDS
        ):

            quality_structure_bad.append(
                source_id
            )

            continue

        expected_current_quality = dict(
            before_quality
        )

        expected_current_quality[
            "status"
        ] = VALIDATED_STATUS

        for field in VERIFICATION_FIELDS:

            expected_current_quality[
                field
            ] = True

        expected_current_quality[
            "mastery_eligible"
        ] = True

        expected_flags = list(
            before_quality.get(
                "flags",
                [],
            )
        )

        if (
            VALIDATION_FLAG
            not in expected_flags
        ):

            expected_flags.append(
                VALIDATION_FLAG
            )

        expected_current_quality[
            "flags"
        ] = expected_flags

        if (
            current_quality
            != expected_current_quality
        ):

            unauthorized_quality_transitions.append(
                source_id
            )

        if (
            VALIDATION_FLAG
            not in current_quality.get(
                "flags",
                [],
            )
        ):

            missing_validation_flag.append(
                source_id
            )

    check(
        not outside_quality_changes,
        "T29",
        "En las 173 solo cambió quality.",
    )

    check(
        not quality_structure_bad,
        "T30",
        "La estructura de quality permanece exacta.",
    )

    check(
        not unauthorized_quality_transitions,
        "T31",
        "Las 173 transiciones quality son exactamente las autorizadas.",
    )

    check(
        not missing_validation_flag,
        "T32",
        "Las 173 contienen el flag P2-D5.5.",
    )

    check(
        not content_changed_ids,
        "T33",
        "No cambió ningún contenido pedagógico.",
    )

    validation_flag_ids = {
        item[

# ============================================================
# ESTADO DE AUDITORÍA
# ============================================================

checks = 0
errors: list[str] = []
warnings: list[str] = []


def ok(
    message: str,
) -> None:

    global checks

    checks += 1

    print(
        f"[OK] {message}"
    )


def fail(
    message: str,
) -> None:

    errors.append(
        message
    )

    print(
        f"[ERROR] {message}"
    )


def warn(
    message: str,
) -> None:

    warnings.append(
        message
    )

    print(
        f"[WARN] {message}"
    )


def check(
    condition: bool,
    code: str,
    message: str,
) -> None:

    if condition:

        ok(
            f"{code} {message}"
        )

    else:

        fail(
            f"{code} {message}"
        )


# ============================================================
# UTILIDADES
# ============================================================

def sha256_file(
    path: Path,
) -> str:

    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open(
        "rb"
    ) as handle:

        while True:

            chunk = handle.read(
                1024 * 1024
            )

            if not chunk:
                break

            digest.update(
                chunk
            )

    return digest.hexdigest().upper()


def load_json(
    path: Path,
):

    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def write_json(
    path: Path,
    data,
) -> None:

    path.parent.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            data,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )
        + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def normalize_ast_text(
    value: str,
) -> str:

    return (
        value.replace(
            " ",
            "",
        )
        .replace(
            "\n",
            "",
        )
        .replace(
            "(",
            "",
        )
        .replace(
            ")",
            "",
        )
    )


# ============================================================
# AST
# ============================================================

def function_defs(
    tree: ast.AST,
) -> dict[str, list[ast.FunctionDef]]:

    output: dict[
        str,
        list[ast.FunctionDef],
    ] = {}

    for node in ast.walk(
        tree
    ):

        if isinstance(
            node,
            ast.FunctionDef,
        ):

            output.setdefault(
                node.name,
                [],
            ).append(
                node
            )

    return output


def calls_in_function(
    function: ast.FunctionDef,
    function_name: str,
) -> list[ast.Call]:

    result = []

    for node in ast.walk(
        function
    ):

        if not isinstance(
            node,
            ast.Call,
        ):

            continue

        if (
            isinstance(
                node.func,
                ast.Name,
            )
            and
            node.func.id
            == function_name
        ):

            result.append(
                node
            )

    return result


def if_ancestors_for_calls(
    function: ast.FunctionDef,
    target_call: str,
) -> list[list[str]]:

    paths: list[
        list[str]
    ] = []

    def walk_node(
        node: ast.AST,
        if_stack: list[str],
    ) -> None:

        new_stack = list(
            if_stack
        )

        if isinstance(
            node,
            ast.If,
        ):

            try:

                test_text = ast.unparse(
                    node.test
                )

            except Exception:

                test_text = ""

            new_stack.append(
                test_text
            )

        if isinstance(
            node,
            ast.Call,
        ):

            if (
                isinstance(
                    node.func,
                    ast.Name,
                )
                and
                node.func.id
                == target_call
            ):

                paths.append(
                    list(
                        new_stack
                    )
                )

        for child in ast.iter_child_nodes(
            node
        ):

            walk_node(
                child,
                new_stack,
            )

    walk_node(
        function,
        [],
    )

    return paths


# ============================================================
# REVERSIÓN TEXTUAL DEL PARCHE
# ============================================================

def reconstruct_preintegration_app(
    current: str,
) -> str:

    if (
        current.count(
            INTEGRATION_BLOCK_START
        )
        != 1
    ):

        raise RuntimeError(
            "No existe exactamente un inicio de bloque P2-D5.6."
        )

    if (
        current.count(
            REINFORCEMENT_RENDER_DEF
        )
        != 1
    ):

        raise RuntimeError(
            "No existe exactamente un renderer de refuerzo."
        )

    start = current.index(
        INTEGRATION_BLOCK_START
    )

    reinforcement_start = current.index(
        REINFORCEMENT_RENDER_DEF,
        start,
    )

    prefix = current[
        :start
    ]

    suffix = current[
        reinforcement_start:
    ]

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # CORRECCIÓN T32
    #
    # La inserción P2-D5.6 dejó un salto de línea adicional
    # inmediatamente antes del marcador. Al retirar el bloque,
    # eliminamos exactamente ese salto para reconstruir
    # byte-a-byte el app.py pre-integración.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if prefix.endswith(
        "\n"
    ):

        prefix = prefix[
            :-1
        ]

    reconstructed = (
        prefix
        + suffix
    )

    if (
        reconstructed.count(
            BASE_RENDER_DEF
        )
        != 1
    ):

        raise RuntimeError(
            "No existe exactamente un renderer base para revertir."
        )

    reconstructed = reconstructed.replace(
        BASE_RENDER_DEF,
        OLD_RENDER_DEF,
        1,
    )

    return reconstructed

    summary = report[
        "summary"
    ]

    hashes = report[
        "hashes"

        "=" * 88,

        "=" * 88,
        "",
        "RESUMEN",
        "-" * 88,
        (
            "Originales pedagógicos totales   : "
            f"{summary['pedagogical_items_total']}"
        ),
        (
            "Companion integrables VALIDATED  : "
            f"{summary['validated_integrable']}"
        ),
        (
            "source_review excluidas           : "
            f"{summary['source_review_excluded']}"
        ),
        (
            "Patch reversible contra backup   : "
            f"{summary['patch_reversible']}"
        ),
        (
            "app.py compila                    : "
            f"{summary['app_compiles']}"
        ),
        (
            "Wrapper original correcto         : "
            f"{summary['wrapper_correct']}"
        ),
        (
            "Práctica original preservada      : "
            f"{summary['practice_original_flow_ok']}"
        ),
        (
            "Práctica refuerzo preservada      : "
            f"{summary['practice_reinforcement_flow_ok']}"
        ),
        (
            "Evaluación fuera del patch         : "
            f"{summary['evaluation_outside_patch']}"
        ),
        "",
        "DECISIÓN",
        "-" * 88,
        (
            "Listo para regresión manual        : "
            f"{summary['ready_for_manual_regression']}"
        ),
        (
            "Decision code                     : "
            f"{summary['decision']}"
        ),
        "",
        "SOURCE REVIEW EXCLUIDAS",
        "-" * 88,
        ", ".join(
            report[
                "source_review_ids"
            ]
        ),
        "",
        "SHA-256",
        "-" * 88,
        (
            "app.py pre               : "
            + hashes[
                "app_before"
            ]
        ),
        (
            "app.py actual            : "
            + hashes[
                "app_after"
            ]
        ),
        (
            "question_bank            : "
            + hashes[
                "question_bank"
            ]
        ),
        (
            "reinforcement_bank       : "
            + hashes[
                "reinforcement_bank"
            ]
        ),
        (
            "schema                   : "
            + hashes[
                "schema"
            ]
        ),
        (
            "explanation_bank         : "
            + hashes[
                "explanation_bank"
            ]
        ),
        "",
        "SEGURIDAD",
        "-" * 88,
        "question_bank modificado         : False",
        "reinforcement_bank modificado    : False",
        "schema modificado                : False",
        "explanation_bank modificado      : False",
        "source_review promovidas         : False",
        "auditoría modifica app.py        : False",
        "auditoría ejecuta Streamlit      : False",
        "",
        (
            "RESULTADO: AUDITORÍA POST-INTEGRACIÓN "
            "P2-D5.6 COMPLETADA"
        ),
    ]

    return "\n".join(
        lines
    )


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main() -> None:

    print()

    print(
        "=" * 88
    )

    print(
        "P2-D5.6 - AUDITORÍA POST-INTEGRACIÓN"
    )

    print(
        "=" * 88
    )

    print()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T01 ARCHIVOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    required = [
        APP,
        APP_BACKUP,
        QUESTION_BANK,
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
        SCHEMA_FILE,
        EXPLANATION_BANK,
        POST_VALIDATION_AUDIT,
        INTEGRATION_REPORT,
    ]

    missing = [
        path
        for path
        in required
        if not path.exists()
    ]

    check(
        not missing,
        "T01",
        "Todos los archivos requeridos existen.",
    )

    if missing:

        for path in missing:

            print(
                f"     Falta: {path}"
            )

        sys.exit(
            1
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T02-T07 HASHES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        sha256_file(
            APP_BACKUP
        )
        == APP_BEFORE_SHA256,
        "T02",
        "Backup de app.py coincide con checkpoint pre-P2-D5.6.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            APP
        )
        == APP_AFTER_SHA256,
        "T03",
        "app.py coincide con checkpoint post-P2-D5.6.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )
        == QUESTION_BANK_SHA256,
        "T04",
        "question_bank permanece intacto.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )
        == REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256,
        "T05",
        "reinforcement_bank permanece intacto.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            SCHEMA_FILE
        )
        == SCHEMA_SHA256,
        "T06",
        "schema permanece intacto.",
    )

    check(
        sha256_file(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )
        == EXPLANATION_BANK_SHA256,
        "T07",
        "explanation_bank permanece en checkpoint P2-D5.5.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T08 JSON
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:

        questions = load_json(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )

        reinforcement = load_json(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )

        explanation_bank = load_json(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )

        post_validation_audit = load_json(
            POST_VALIDATION_AUDIT
        )

        integration_report = load_json(
            INTEGRATION_REPORT
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        fail(
            f"T08 Error leyendo JSON: {exc}"
        )

        sys.exit(
            1
        )

    ok(
        "T08 JSON requeridos legibles."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T09-T11 BANCOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        (
            isinstance(
                questions,
                list,
            )
            and
            len(
                questions
            )
            == 180
        ),
        "T09",
        "question_bank conserva exactamente 180 preguntas.",
    )

    check(
        len(
            reinforcement.get(
                "items",
                [],
            )
        )
        == 8,
        "T10",
        "reinforcement_bank conserva exactamente 8 ítems.",
    )

    items = explanation_bank.get(
        "items",
        [],
    )

    check(
        (
            explanation_bank.get(
                "schema_version"
            )
            == SCHEMA_VERSION
            and
            explanation_bank.get(
                "bank_version"
            )
            == BANK_VERSION
            and
            len(
                items
            )
            == 180
        ),
        "T11",
        "Banco pedagógico conserva identidad y 180 explicaciones.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T12-T17 ESTADO 173/7
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    validated_ids = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in items
        if (
            item.get(
                "quality",
                {},
            ).get(
                "status"
            )
            == "validated"
        )
    }

    draft_ids = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in items
        if (
            item.get(
                "quality",
                {},
            ).get(
                "status"
            )
            == "draft"
        )
    }

    mastery_ids = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in items
        if (
            item.get(
                "quality",
                {},
            ).get(
                "mastery_eligible"
            )
            is True
        )
    }

    fully_verified_ids = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in items
        if all(
            item.get(
                "quality",
                {},
            ).get(
                field
            )
            is True
            for field
            in VERIFICATION_FIELDS
        )
    }

    source_review_ids = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in items
        if (
            "source_review_required"
            in item.get(
                "quality",
                {},
            ).get(
                "flags",
                [],
            )
        )
    }

    check(
        len(
            validated_ids
        )
        == 173,
        "T12",
        "Existen exactamente 173 VALIDATED.",
    )

    check(
        draft_ids
        == EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS,
        "T13",
        "Los 7 DRAFT son exactamente las source_review.",
    )

    check(
        source_review_ids
        == EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS,
        "T14",
        "source_review_required aparece exactamente en las 7 bloqueadas.",
    )

    check(
        mastery_ids
        == validated_ids,
        "T15",
        "Mastery=True coincide exactamente con los 173 VALIDATED.",
    )

    check(
        fully_verified_ids
        == validated_ids,
        "T16",
        "Verificación completa coincide exactamente con los 173 VALIDATED.",
    )

    check(
        not (
            validated_ids
            & EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS
        ),
        "T17",
        "Ninguna source_review está VALIDATED.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T18-T20 AUDITORÍA P2-D5.5
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    post_summary = post_validation_audit.get(
        "summary",
        {},
    )

    check(
        (
            post_validation_audit.get(
                "stage"
            )
            == "P2-D5.5"
            and
            post_validation_audit.get(
                "substage"
            )
            == "independent_post_validation_audit"
        ),
        "T18",
        "Auditoría previa corresponde a P2-D5.5.",
    )

    check(
        (
            post_summary.get(
                "ready_for_app_integration"
            )
            is True
            and
            post_summary.get(
                "decision"
            )
            == READY_FROM_P2D5_5
        ),
        "T19",
        "P2-D5.5 autorizó integración en app.",

    check(

            post_validation_audit.get(
                "hashes",

            ).get(
                "current_bank"
            )
            == EXPLANATION_BANK_SHA256
        ),
        "T20",
        "Auditoría P2-D5.5 corresponde al banco actual.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T21-T25 REPORTE INTEGRACIÓN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        (
            integration_report.get(
                "stage"
            )
            == "P2-D5.6"
            and
            integration_report.get(
                "substage"
            )
            == "validated_original_explanations_app_integration"
        ),
        "T21",
        "Reporte corresponde a P2-D5.6.",
    )

    integration_hashes = integration_report.get(
        "hashes",
        {},
    )

    check(
        (
            integration_hashes.get(
                "app_before"
            )
            == APP_BEFORE_SHA256
            and
            integration_hashes.get(
                "app_after"
            )
            == APP_AFTER_SHA256
        ),
        "T22",
        "Reporte registra hashes app antes/después correctos.",
    )

    integration_data = integration_report.get(
        "integration",
        {},
    )

    check(
        (
            integration_data.get(
                "validated_originals_available"
            )
            == 173
            and
            integration_data.get(
                "source_review_excluded"
            )
            == 7
        ),
        "T23",
        "Reporte confirma 173 integrables y 7 excluidas.",
    )

    check(
        integration_data.get(
            "evaluation_flow_modified"
        )
        is False,
        "T24",
        "Reporte declara Evaluación sin modificaciones.",
    )

    check(
        integration_data.get(
            "reinforcement_flow_modified"
        )
        is False,
        "T25",
        "Reporte declara refuerzo sin modificaciones.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # LEER APP
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    current_text = APP.read_text(
        encoding="utf-8"
    )

    backup_text = APP_BACKUP.read_text(
        encoding="utf-8"
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T26 COMPILACIÓN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    app_compiles = True

    try:

            "exec",

    except SyntaxError as exc:

            f"T26 app.py no compila: {exc}"

    if app_compiles:

        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------

    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(

    # --------------------------------------------------------

        except Exception as exc:

    defs = (

    expected_defs = [

    unique_defs_ok = all(

    check(

    wrapper_correct = False

        )

    check(
        wrapper_correct,

        "Wrapper llama una vez al renderer base y una vez al companion.",

    loader_static_ok = all(
        fragment
        in current_text
        for fragment
        in [
            "'original_explanations_bank.json'",
            "'validated'",
            "'mastery_eligible'",
            "'content_verified'",

            "'steps_verified'",
            "'distractors_verified'",
            "'pedagogical_reviewed'",
            "'source_review_required'",
            "!= 173",
        ]
    )

    check(
        loader_static_ok,
        "T36",
        "Loader exige VALIDATED, mastery, verificaciones y exclusión source_review.",
    )

    pedagogical_layers_ok = all(
        text
        in current_text
        for text
        in [
            "Idea clave",
            "Qué te pide realmente",
            "Datos y pistas relevantes",
            "Concepto o regla",
            "Fórmula o marco de resolución",
            "Paso a paso",
            "Por qué la respuesta es correcta",
            "Cómo descartar las otras opciones",
            "Error común",
            "Cómo transferirlo a otro ejercicio",
            "Comprobación rápida",
        ]
    )

    check(
        pedagogical_layers_ok,
        "T37",
        "Renderer companion contiene las capas pedagógicas previstas.",
    )

    companion_expander_ok = (
        "Ver resolución pedagógica completa"
        in current_text
    )

    check(
        companion_expander_ok,
        "T38",
        "Companion se presenta mediante expander explícito.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # CORRECCIÓN T39
    #
    # En app.py el aviso está compuesto por dos literales
    # contiguos. Python los concatena en runtime, pero en el
    # código fuente no necesariamente forman una única cadena
    # textual continua.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    check(
        (
            "El enunciado y la pregunta original"
            in current_text
            and
            "permanecen sin modificaciones."
            in current_text
        ),
        "T39",
        "UI conserva aviso de separación del contenido original.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T40-T44 FLUJO PRÁCTICA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    practice_original_flow_ok = False
    practice_reinforcement_flow_ok = False

    if unique_defs_ok:

        exam_function = defs[
            "exam_screen"
        ][
            0
        ]

        original_paths = if_ancestors_for_calls(
            exam_function,
            "render_original_explanation",
        )

        reinforcement_paths = if_ancestors_for_calls(
            exam_function,
            "render_reinforcement_explanation",
        )

        original_call_count = len(
            calls_in_function(
                exam_function,
                "render_original_explanation",
            )
        )

        reinforcement_call_count = len(
            calls_in_function(
                exam_function,
                "render_reinforcement_explanation",
            )
        )

        practice_original_flow_ok = (
            original_call_count

                    (
                        "practice"

            reinforcement_call_count

                any(
                    "reinforcement"
                    in normalize_ast_text(
                        test
                    )

                    in path
                )
                for path
                in reinforcement_paths
            )
        )

        practice_original_flow_ok,
        "T40",
        "Originales siguen mostrando explicación dentro del feedback de Práctica.",

        practice_reinforcement_flow_ok,
        "T41",
        "Refuerzo sigue usando su renderer separado.",

                    node.func,
                    ast.Name,

                    node
                )

    check(
        len(
            public_calls_global
        )
        == 1,
        "T42",
        "Solo existe una llamada runtime al renderer original.",
    )

    check(
        "if practice and ans:"
        in backup_text,
        "T43",
        "El checkpoint previo ya restringía feedback a Práctica.",
    )

    check(
        "render_original_explanation("
        in backup_text,
        "T44",
        "La llamada runtime original existía antes de P2-D5.6.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T45-T47 EVALUACIÓN Y SCOPE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    # P2-D5.6 y revirtiendo el rename del renderer original,
    # recuperamos byte-a-byte el app.py anterior.
    evaluation_outside_patch = (
        patch_reversible
    )

    check(
        evaluation_outside_patch,
        "T45",
        "Código preexistente fuera del patch, incluida Evaluación, permanece intacto.",
    )

    check(
        (
            "def render_reinforcement_explanation(q):"
            in backup_text
            and
            "def render_reinforcement_explanation(q):"
            in current_text
        ),
        "T46",
        "Renderer de refuerzo continúa presente.",
    )

    check(
        (
            "def exam_screen(bank):"
            in backup_text
            and
            "def exam_screen(bank):"
            in current_text
        ),
        "T47",
        "exam_screen continúa presente sin sustitución.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T48-T50 SOURCE REVIEW RUNTIME ELIGIBILITY
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    eligible_runtime_ids = set()

    for item in items:

        source_id = item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]

        quality = item.get(
            "quality",
            {},
        )

        if (
            quality.get(
                "status"
            )
            != "validated"
        ):

            continue

        if (
            quality.get(
                "mastery_eligible"
            )
            is not True
        ):

            continue

        if not all(
            quality.get(
                field
            )
            is True
            for field
            in VERIFICATION_FIELDS
        ):

            continue

        if (
            "source_review_required"
            in quality.get(
                "flags",
                [],
            )
        ):

            continue

        if (
            item.get(
                "official_utn_question"
            )
            is not False
        ):

            continue

        eligible_runtime_ids.add(
            source_id
        )

    check(
        eligible_runtime_ids
        == validated_ids,
        "T48",
        "La lógica de elegibilidad produce exactamente los 173 VALIDATED.",
    )

    check(
        not (
            eligible_runtime_ids
            & EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS
        ),
        "T49",
        "Las 7 source_review quedan fuera de elegibilidad runtime.",
    )

    check(
        len(
            eligible_runtime_ids
        )
        == 173,
        "T50",
        "El loader debe poder exponer exactamente 173 companions.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # T51 ESTADOS ÚNICOS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    status_counter = Counter(
        item.get(
            "quality",
            {},
        ).get(
            "status"
        )
        for item
        in items
    )

    check(
        (
            status_counter
            == Counter(
                {
                    "validated": 173,
                    "draft": 7,
                }
            )
        ),
        "T51",
        "No existen estados pedagógicos inesperados.",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # ABORTAR SI FALLA ALGO
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if errors:

        print()

        print(
            "=" * 88
        )

        print(
            "RESUMEN DE AUDITORÍA POST-INTEGRACIÓN P2-D5.6"
        )

        print(
            "=" * 88

        print(

        )

        sys.exit(
            1
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # DECISIÓN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    ready = (
        app_compiles

        wrapper_correct
        and
        loader_static_ok

    )

    report = {

class Validation:
    def __init__(self):
        self.results = []

    def add(self, name, passed, detail="", critical=True):
        self.results.append(
            {
                "test": name,
                "passed": bool(passed),
                "critical": bool(critical),
                "detail": str(detail),
            }
        )

    def ok(self, name, detail=""):
        self.add(name, True, detail)

    def fail(self, name, detail="", critical=True):
        self.add(name, False, detail, critical)

    @property
    def critical_failures(self):
        return [
            r
            for r in self.results
            if not r["passed"] and r["critical"]
        ]

    @property
    def warnings(self):
        return [
            r
            for r in self.results
            if not r["passed"] and not r["critical"]
        ]


V = Validation()

def load_json(path: Path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def get_free_port():
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as sock:
        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


def section(title):
    print()
    print("=" * 72)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 72)


def print_test(name, passed, detail=""):
    icon = "[OK]" if passed else "[ERROR]"
    print(f"{icon:<8} {name}")

    if detail:
        print(f"         {detail}")

def test_structure():

    required = [
        APP_FILE,
        DATA_FILE,
        SOURCES_DIR,
        RESULTS_DIR,
        HISTORY_FILE,
    ]

    for path in required:
        passed = path.exists()

        if passed:
            V.ok(f"Existe {path.relative_to(ROOT)}")
        else:
            V.fail(
                f"Existe {path.relative_to(ROOT)}",
                "Ruta obligatoria no encontrada.",
            )

        print_test(
            str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),
            passed,
        )

def test_dependencies():
    section("T02 - DEPENDENCIAS")

    modules = {

    for module, label in modules.items():

        found = importlib.util.find_spec(module) is not None

            V.ok(f"Dependencia {label}")

# T05 - TOTAL DE PREGUNTAS
# ============================================================

def test_question_count(bank):

    section("T05 - TOTAL Y DISTRIBUCIÓN")

    passed = len(bank) == EXPECTED_QUESTIONS

    detail = (
        f"Esperadas: {EXPECTED_QUESTIONS} | "
        f"Encontradas: {len(bank)}"
    )

    if passed:
        V.ok("Total preguntas", detail)
    else:
        V.fail("Total preguntas", detail)

    print_test(
        "Total de preguntas",
        passed,
        detail,
    )

    counts = Counter(
        q.get("simulacro")
        for q in bank
    )

    for simulacro, expected in EXPECTED_SIMULACROS.items():

        actual = counts.get(simulacro, 0)

        passed = actual == expected

        detail = (
            f"Esperadas: {expected} | "
            f"Encontradas: {actual}"
        )

        if passed:
            V.ok(
                f"Cantidad {simulacro}",
                detail,
            )
        else:
            V.fail(
                f"Cantidad {simulacro}",
                detail,
            )

        print_test(
            simulacro,
            passed,
            detail,
        )

# T06 - ESTRUCTURA DE CADA PREGUNTA
# ============================================================

def test_question_schema(bank):

    section("T06 - ESTRUCTURA DE PREGUNTAS")

    errors = []

    for index, q in enumerate(bank, start=1):

        if not isinstance(q, dict):
            errors.append(
                f"Registro {index}: no es objeto JSON"
            )
            continue

        missing = REQUIRED_QUESTION_FIELDS - set(q)

        if missing:
            errors.append(
                f"{q.get('id', index)}: "
                f"faltan {sorted(missing)}"
            )

    passed = not errors

    if passed:
        V.ok(
            "Campos obligatorios",
            f"{len(bank)} preguntas verificadas",
        )
    else:
        V.fail(
            "Campos obligatorios",
            " | ".join(errors[:20]),
        )

    print_test(
        "Campos obligatorios",
        passed,
        (
            f"{len(bank)} preguntas verificadas"
            if passed
            else f"{len(errors)} problemas"
        ),
    )

    for error in errors[:10]:
        print("         -", error)


# ============================================================
# T07 - IDs Y NUMERACIÓN
# ============================================================

def test_ids(bank):

    section("T07 - IDS Y NUMERACIÓN")

    ids = [
        q.get("id")
        for q in bank
    ]

    duplicates = [
        value
        for value, count in Counter(ids).items()
        if value is not None and count > 1
    ]

    passed = (
        len(ids) == len(set(ids))
        and None not in ids
    )

    if passed:
        V.ok(
            "IDs únicos",
            f"{len(ids)} IDs",
        )
    else:
        V.fail(
            "IDs únicos",
            f"Duplicados: {duplicates}",
        )

    print_test(
        "IDs únicos",
        passed,
        f"Duplicados: {duplicates}" if duplicates else "",
    )

    pairs = [
        (
            q.get("simulacro"),
            q.get("number"),
        )
        for q in bank
    ]

    duplicate_pairs = [
        value
        for value, count in Counter(pairs).items()
        if count > 1
    ]

    passed = not duplicate_pairs

    if passed:
        V.ok("Numeración única por simulacro")
    else:
        V.fail(
            "Numeración única por simulacro",
            str(duplicate_pairs),
        )

    print_test(
        "Numeración por simulacro",
        passed,
    )


# ============================================================
# T08 - RESPUESTAS Y OPCIONES
# ============================================================

def test_answers(bank):

    section("T08 - RESPUESTAS Y OPCIONES")

    errors = []

    for q in bank:

        qid = q.get("id", "?")

        choices = q.get("choices")
        answer = q.get("answer")

        if not isinstance(choices, list):
            errors.append(
                f"{qid}: choices no es lista"
            )
            continue

        if set(choices) != EXPECTED_CHOICES:
            errors.append(
                f"{qid}: opciones={choices}"
            )

        if answer not in choices:
            errors.append(
                f"{qid}: respuesta {answer} "
                "no está en choices"
            )

    passed = not errors

    if passed:
        V.ok(
            "Respuestas y opciones",
            f"{len(bank)} verificadas",
        )
    else:
        V.fail(
            "Respuestas y opciones",
            " | ".join(errors[:20]),
        )

    print_test(
        "Respuestas válidas",
        passed,
        (
            f"{len(bank)} preguntas"
            if passed
            else f"{len(errors)} problemas"
        ),
    )

    for error in errors[:10]:
        print("         -", error)


# ============================================================
# T09 - ESTADOS Y EXPLICACIONES
# ============================================================

def test_status_and_explanations(bank):

    section("T09 - ESTADOS Y EXPLICACIONES")

    status_errors = []
    explanation_errors = []

    review_count = 0

    for q in bank:

        qid = q.get("id", "?")

        status = q.get("status")

        if status not in ALLOWED_STATUS:
            status_errors.append(
                f"{qid}: {status}"
            )

        if status == "revisar_fuente":
            review_count += 1

        explanation = q.get("explanation")

        if not isinstance(explanation, str) or not explanation.strip():
            explanation_errors.append(qid)

    status_ok = not status_errors
    exp_ok = not explanation_errors

    if status_ok:
        V.ok(
            "Estados del banco",
            f"REVISAR FUENTE: {review_count}",
        )
    else:
        V.fail(
            "Estados del banco",
            str(status_errors[:20]),
        )

    if exp_ok:
        V.ok(
            "Explicaciones presentes",
            f"{len(bank)} verificadas",
        )
    else:
        V.fail(
            "Explicaciones presentes",
            str(explanation_errors[:20]),
        )

    print_test(
        "Estados válidos",
        status_ok,
        f"REVISAR FUENTE: {review_count}",
    )

    print_test(
        "Explicaciones presentes",
        exp_ok,
    )

            f"PyMuPDF no disponible: {exc}",
        )

        print_test(
            "PDFs",
            False,
            str(exc),
        )

        return

    referenced_pdfs = sorted(
        {
            q.get("pdf")
            for q in bank
            if q.get("pdf")
        }
    )

    pdf_pages = {}

    errors = []

    for pdf_name in referenced_pdfs:

        path = SOURCES_DIR / pdf_name

        if not path.exists():
            errors.append(
                f"No existe {pdf_name}"
            )
            continue

        try:
            with fitz.open(path) as doc:
                pdf_pages[pdf_name] = doc.page_count

        except Exception as exc:
            errors.append(
                f"{pdf_name}: {exc}"
            )

    for q in bank:

        pdf_name = q.get("pdf")
        page = q.get("page")
        qid = q.get("id", "?")

        if pdf_name not in pdf_pages:
            continue

        if not isinstance(page, int):
            errors.append(
                f"{qid}: página no entera"
            )
            continue

        if page < 1 or page > pdf_pages[pdf_name]:
            errors.append(
                f"{qid}: página {page} fuera de "
                f"1..{pdf_pages[pdf_name]}"
            )

    passed = not errors

    if passed:
        V.ok(
            "PDFs y páginas",
            str(pdf_pages),
        )
    else:
        V.fail(
            "PDFs y páginas",
            " | ".join(errors[:20]),
        )

    print_test(
        "PDFs y páginas válidas",
        passed,
        str(pdf_pages),
    )

    for error in errors[:10]:
        print("         -", error)

def test_history():

    section("T11 - HISTORIAL")

    if not HISTORY_FILE.exists():

        V.fail(
            "history.json",
            "Archivo inexistente.",
        )

        print_test(
            "history.json",
            False,
        )

        return

    try:
        history = load_json(HISTORY_FILE)

        if not isinstance(history, list):
            raise TypeError(
                "El historial debe ser una lista."
            )

        V.ok(
            "history.json",
            f"{len(history)} intentos",
        )

        print_test(
            "JSON de historial válido",
            True,
            f"{len(history)} intentos",
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        V.fail(
            "history.json",
            repr(exc),
        )

        print_test(
            "JSON de historial válido",
            False,
            repr(exc),
        )


# ============================================================
# T12 - ARRANQUE REAL DE STREAMLIT
# ============================================================

def test_streamlit_startup(timeout=25):

    section("T12 - ARRANQUE HEADLESS DE STREAMLIT")

    if importlib.util.find_spec("streamlit") is None:

        V.fail(
            "Arranque Streamlit",
            "Streamlit no instalado.",
        )

        print_test(
            "Servidor Streamlit",
            False,
        )

        return

    port = get_free_port()

    command = [
        sys.executable,
        "-m",
        "streamlit",
        "run",
        str(APP_FILE),
        "--server.headless=true",
        "--browser.gatherUsageStats=false",
        "--server.address=127.0.0.1",
        f"--server.port={port}",
    ]

    process = None

    try:

        process = subprocess.Popen(
            command,
            cwd=str(ROOT),
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            text=True,
        )

        health_url = (
            f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/_stcore/health"
        )

        start = time.time()
        healthy = False

        while time.time() - start < timeout:

            if process.poll() is not None:
                break

            try:

                with urllib.request.urlopen(
                    health_url,
                    timeout=1,
                ) as response:

                    if response.status == 200:
                        healthy = True
                        break

            except Exception:
                pass

            time.sleep(0.5)

        if healthy:

            V.ok(
                "Arranque Streamlit",
                f"Servidor respondió correctamente "
                f"en puerto temporal {port}",
            )

            print_test(
                "Servidor Streamlit",
                True,
                "Health check HTTP 200",
            )

        else:

            output = ""

            if process.poll() is not None:
                try:
                    output = process.stdout.read()[-3000:]
                except Exception:
                    output = ""

            V.fail(
                "Arranque Streamlit",
                output or "No respondió antes del timeout.",
            )

            print_test(
                "Servidor Streamlit",
                False,
                "No respondió al health check.",
            )

    except Exception as exc:

        V.fail(
            "Arranque Streamlit",
            repr(exc),
        )

        print_test(
            "Servidor Streamlit",
            False,
            repr(exc),
        )

    finally:

        if process is not None:

            try:
                process.terminate()
                process.wait(timeout=5)

            except Exception:
                try:
                    process.kill()
                except Exception:
                    pass

def save_report():

    RESULTS_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

    passed = len(V.critical_failures) == 0

    report = {
        "version": PROJECT_VERSION,
        "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(
            timespec="seconds"
        ),
        "project_root": str(ROOT),
        "passed": passed,
        "tests_total": len(V.results),
        "tests_passed": sum(
            1 for r in V.results
            if r["passed"]
        ),
        "critical_failures": len(
            V.critical_failures
        ),
        "warnings": len(V.warnings),
        "results": V.results,
    }

    REPORT_FILE.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            report,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    return report

def main():

    print()
    print("=" * 72)
    print("SIMULADOR UTN - PRUEBA AUTOMÁTICA P0")
    print(f"Versión: {PROJECT_VERSION}")
    print(f"Proyecto: {ROOT}")
    print("=" * 72)

    test_structure()
    test_dependencies()
    test_app_syntax()

    bank = load_and_test_bank()

    if bank:
        test_question_count(bank)
        test_question_schema(bank)
        test_ids(bank)
        test_answers(bank)
        test_status_and_explanations(bank)
        test_pdf_sources(bank)

    test_history()

    # Esta es la prueba real:
    # levanta Streamlit automáticamente,
    # consulta su endpoint de salud
    # y lo cierra.
    test_streamlit_startup()

    report = save_report()

    section("RESULTADO FINAL")

    print(
        f"Pruebas: "
        f"{report['tests_passed']}/"
        f"{report['tests_total']}"
    )

    print(
        f"Fallos críticos: "
        f"{report['critical_failures']}"
    )

    print(
        f"Advertencias: "
        f"{report['warnings']}"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Informe JSON:",
        REPORT_FILE,
    )

    print()

    if report["passed"]:

        print(
            "RESULTADO: P0 APROBADO"
        )

        print(
            "El proyecto puede avanzar al siguiente parche."
        )

        sys.exit(0)

    else:

        print(
            "RESULTADO: P0 RECHAZADO"
        )

        print(
            "No avanzar al siguiente parche."
        )

        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
