def fail(
    message: str,
) -> None:

    print(
        f"[ERROR] {message}"
    )

    sys.exit(
        1
    )


def sha256_file(
    path: Path,
) -> str:

    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open(
        "rb"
    ) as handle:

        while True:

            chunk = handle.read(
                1024 * 1024
            )

            if not chunk:
                break

            digest.update(
                chunk
            )

    return digest.hexdigest().upper()


def canonical_sha256(
    data,
) -> str:

    payload = json.dumps(
        data,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode(
        "utf-8"
    )

    return hashlib.sha256(
        payload
    ).hexdigest().upper()


def load_json(
    path: Path,
):

    return json.loads(
        path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )


def atomic_write_text(
    path: Path,
    text: str,
) -> None:

    path.parent.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    fd, temp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(
        prefix=f".{path.name}.",
        suffix=".tmp",
        dir=str(
            path.parent
        ),
    )

    temp_path = Path(
        temp_name
    )

    try:

        with os.fdopen(
            fd,
            "w",
            encoding="utf-8",
            newline="\n",
        ) as handle:

            handle.write(
                text
            )

            handle.flush()

            os.fsync(
                handle.fileno()
            )

        os.replace(
            temp_path,
            path,
        )

    except Exception:

        try:

            temp_path.unlink(
                missing_ok=True
            )

        except Exception:
            pass

        raise


def atomic_write_json(
    path: Path,
    data,
) -> None:

    atomic_write_text(
        path,
        json.dumps(
            data,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )
        + "\n",
    )


def add_validation_flag(
    quality: dict,
) -> None:

    flags = list(
        quality.get(
            "flags",
            [],
        )
    )

    if (
        VALIDATION_FLAG
        not in flags
    ):

        flags.append(
            VALIDATION_FLAG
        )

    quality[
        "flags"
    ] = flags


def source_review_ids_from_bank(
    bank: dict,
) -> set[str]:

    return {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in bank.get(
            "items",
            [],
        )
        if (
            "source_review_required"
            in item.get(
                "quality",
                {},
            ).get(
                "flags",
                [],
            )
        )
    }


# ============================================================
# PRECONDICIONES DE ARCHIVOS
# ============================================================

def verify_file_preconditions() -> None:

    required = [
        APP,
        QUESTION_BANK,
        REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
        SCHEMA_FILE,
        EXPLANATION_BANK,
        FINAL_AUDIT,
    ]

    missing = [
        path
        for path
        in required
        if not path.exists()
    ]

    if missing:

        for path in missing:

            print(
                f"[ERROR] Falta archivo requerido: {path}"
            )

        sys.exit(
            1
        )

    checkpoints = [
        (
            APP,
            APP_SHA256,
            "app.py",
        ),
        (
            QUESTION_BANK,
            QUESTION_BANK_SHA256,
            "question_bank",
        ),
        (
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK,
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256,
            "reinforcement_bank",
        ),
        (
            SCHEMA_FILE,
            SCHEMA_SHA256,
            "schema",
        ),
        (
            EXPLANATION_BANK,
            P2D5_4_2_BANK_SHA256,
            "explanation_bank P2-D5.4.2",
        ),
    ]

    for (
        path,
        expected_hash,
        label,
    ) in checkpoints:

        actual_hash = sha256_file(
            path
        )

        if (
            actual_hash
            != expected_hash
        ):

            fail(
                f"{label} cambió. "
                f"Esperado={expected_hash}; "
                f"actual={actual_hash}"
            )

    print(
        "[OK] Checkpoints de archivos verificados."
    )


# ============================================================
# VALIDAR BANCO PREVIO
# ============================================================

def verify_bank_preconditions(
    questions: list[dict],
    bank: dict,
) -> None:

    if (
        not isinstance(
            questions,
            list,
        )
        or
        len(
            questions
        )
        != 180
    ):

        fail(
            "question_bank debe contener exactamente 180 preguntas."
        )

    if (
        bank.get(
            "schema_version"
        )
        != SCHEMA_VERSION
        or
        bank.get(
            "bank_version"
        )
        != BANK_VERSION
    ):

        fail(
            "La identidad del banco pedagógico no coincide con P2-D5.2."
        )

    items = bank.get(
        "items",
        [],
    )

    if (
        len(
            items
        )
        != 180
    ):

        fail(
            "El banco pedagógico debe contener exactamente 180 explicaciones."
        )

    source_review_ids = source_review_ids_from_bank(
        bank
    )

    if (
        source_review_ids
        != EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "El conjunto source_review no coincide con las 7 preguntas esperadas."
        )

    for (
        question,
        item,
    ) in zip(
        questions,
        items,
    ):

        source_id = question.get(
            "id"
        )

        if (
            item.get(
                "source_question_id"
            )
            != source_id
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: orden 1:1 roto."
            )

        if (
            item.get(
                "source_question_sha256"
            )
            != canonical_sha256(
                question
            )
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: hash fuente incorrecto."
            )

        quality = item.get(
            "quality",
            {},
        )

        if (
            quality.get(
                "status"
            )
            != DRAFT_STATUS
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: se esperaba status=draft antes de P2-D5.5."
            )

        if (
            quality.get(
                "mastery_eligible"
            )
            is not False
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: mastery_eligible debe estar False antes de P2-D5.5."
            )

        if any(
            quality.get(
                field
            )
            is not False
            for field
            in VERIFICATION_FIELDS
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: algún verification field ya estaba activado."
            )

    print(
        "[OK] Banco previo conserva 180 DRAFT sin verificaciones activadas."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Las 7 source_review están identificadas y bloqueadas."
    )


# ============================================================
# VALIDAR AUDITORÍA FINAL
# ============================================================

def validation_ids_from_audit(
    audit: dict,
) -> set[str]:

    if (
        audit.get(
            "stage"
        )
        != "P2-D5.4.2"
    ):

        fail(
            "La auditoría no corresponde a P2-D5.4.2."
        )

    if (
        audit.get(
            "substage"
        )
        != "final_independent_audit_after_pedagogical_debt_repair"
    ):

        fail(
            "Substage inesperado en la auditoría final."
        )

    audit_hash = (
        audit.get(
            "hashes",
            {},
        ).get(
            "explanation_bank"
        )
    )

    if (
        audit_hash
        != P2D5_4_2_BANK_SHA256
    ):

        fail(
            "La auditoría final no corresponde al checkpoint actual del banco."
        )

    summary = audit.get(
        "summary",
        {},
    )

    classifications = summary.get(
        "classifications",
        {},
    )

    expected_counts = {
        "validation_candidate": 173,
        "needs_enrichment": 0,
        "needs_correction": 0,
        "source_review": 7,
    }

    for (
        classification,
        expected,
    ) in expected_counts.items():

        actual = int(
            classifications.get(
                classification,
                0,
            )
        )

        if (
            actual
            != expected
        ):

            fail(
                f"Conteo {classification} inesperado: "
                f"esperado={expected}; actual={actual}."
            )

    if (
        summary.get(
            "ready_for_controlled_validation"
        )
        is not True
    ):

        fail(
            "La auditoría no declara ready_for_controlled_validation=True."
        )

    if (
        summary.get(
            "decision"
        )
        != READY_DECISION
    ):

        fail(
            "Decision code distinto de READY_FOR_CONTROLLED_STATUS_VALIDATION."
        )

    audit_items = audit.get(
        "items",
        [],
    )

    if (
        len(
            audit_items
        )
        != 180
    ):

        fail(
            "La auditoría final debe contener 180 registros."
        )

    candidates = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in audit_items
        if (
            item.get(
                "classification"
            )
            == "validation_candidate"
        )
    }

    source_review = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in audit_items
        if (
            item.get(
                "classification"
            )
            == "source_review"
        )
    }

    enrichment = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in audit_items
        if (
            item.get(
                "classification"
            )
            == "needs_enrichment"
        )
    }

    correction = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in audit_items
        if (
            item.get(
                "classification"
            )
            == "needs_correction"
        )
    }

    if (
        len(
            candidates
        )
        != 173
    ):

        fail(
            f"La auditoría produjo {len(candidates)} candidatos; se esperaban 173."
        )

    if (
        source_review
        != EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "Los 7 source_review de la auditoría no coinciden con el conjunto congelado."
        )

    if enrichment:

        fail(
            f"Aún hay needs_enrichment: {sorted(enrichment)}"
        )

    if correction:

        fail(
            f"Aún hay needs_correction: {sorted(correction)}"
        )

    if (
        candidates
        & EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "Una source_review apareció indebidamente como validation_candidate."
        )

    if (
        candidates
        | source_review
    ) != {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in audit_items
    }:

        fail(
            "La partición 173 candidatas + 7 source_review no cubre exactamente los 180 ítems."
        )

    # Ninguna candidata puede tener motivos bloqueantes.
    candidate_blocking = []

    candidate_enrichment = []

    for item in audit_items:

        source_id = item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]

        if (
            source_id
            not in candidates
        ):

            continue

        if item.get(
            "blocking_reasons",
            []
        ):

            candidate_blocking.append(
                (
                    source_id,
                    item.get(
                        "blocking_reasons",
                        [],
                    ),
                )
            )

        if item.get(
            "enrichment_reasons",
            []
        ):

            candidate_enrichment.append(
                (
                    source_id,
                    item.get(
                        "enrichment_reasons",
                        [],
                    ),
                )
            )

    if candidate_blocking:

        fail(
            "Hay candidatas con blocking_reasons: "
            f"{candidate_blocking[:10]}"
        )

    if candidate_enrichment:

        fail(
            "Hay candidatas con enrichment_reasons: "
            f"{candidate_enrichment[:10]}"
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Auditoría final confirma exactamente 173 candidatas."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Auditoría final confirma exactamente 7 source_review bloqueadas."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] No existen needs_enrichment ni needs_correction."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Decision code autoriza P2-D5.5."
    )

    return candidates


# ============================================================
# CONSTRUIR CANDIDATO VALIDADO
# ============================================================

def build_candidate(
    bank: dict,
    validation_ids: set[str],
) -> dict:

    candidate = copy.deepcopy(
        bank
    )

    for item in candidate[
        "items"
    ]:

        source_id = item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]

        if (
            source_id
            not in validation_ids
        ):

            continue

        quality = item[
            "quality"
        ]

        quality[
            "status"
        ] = VALIDATED_STATUS

        quality[
            "content_verified"
        ] = True

        quality[
            "answer_verified"
        ] = True

        quality[
            "steps_verified"
        ] = True

        quality[
            "distractors_verified"
        ] = True

        quality[
            "pedagogical_reviewed"
        ] = True

        quality[
            "mastery_eligible"
        ] = True

        add_validation_flag(
            quality
        )

    return candidate


# ============================================================
# VALIDACIÓN DEL DIFF
# ============================================================

def validate_candidate(
    questions: list[dict],
    before_bank: dict,
    after_bank: dict,
    validation_ids: set[str],
) -> None:

    before_items = before_bank[
        "items"
    ]

    after_items = after_bank[
        "items"
    ]

    if (
        len(
            before_items
        )
        != 180
        or
        len(
            after_items
        )
        != 180
    ):

        fail(
            "El banco antes/después debe contener 180 ítems."
        )

    before_by_id = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]:
            item
        for item
        in before_items
    }

    after_by_id = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]:
            item
        for item
        in after_items
    }

    changed_ids = {
        source_id
        for source_id
        in before_by_id
        if (
            before_by_id[
                source_id
            ]
            != after_by_id[
                source_id
            ]
        )
    }

    if (
        changed_ids
        != validation_ids
    ):

        fail(
            "El diff no coincide exactamente con las 173 candidatas. "
            f"Modificadas={len(changed_ids)}."
        )

    if (
        len(
            changed_ids
        )
        != 173
    ):

        fail(
            f"Se modificaron {len(changed_ids)} explicaciones; se esperaban 173."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Las 7 source_review deben ser byte-equivalentes a nivel JSON
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    for source_id in EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS:

        if (
            before_by_id[
                source_id
            ]
            != after_by_id[
                source_id
            ]
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: source_review fue modificada."
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # En las 173 solo puede cambiar quality
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    for source_id in sorted(
        validation_ids
    ):

        before = copy.deepcopy(
            before_by_id[
                source_id
            ]
        )

        after = copy.deepcopy(
            after_by_id[
                source_id
            ]
        )

        before_quality = before.pop(
            "quality"
        )

        after_quality = after.pop(
            "quality"
        )

        if (
            before
            != after
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: cambió contenido fuera de quality."
            )

        # Quality debe conservar exactamente las mismas claves.
        if (
            set(
                before_quality.keys()
            )
            != set(
                after_quality.keys()
            )
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: cambió la estructura de quality."
            )

        # Status.
        if (
            before_quality.get(
                "status"
            )
            != DRAFT_STATUS
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: status previo no era draft."
            )

        if (
            after_quality.get(
                "status"
            )
            != VALIDATED_STATUS
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: status final no es validated."
            )

        # Verificaciones.
        for field in VERIFICATION_FIELDS:

            if (
                before_quality.get(
                    field
                )
                is not False
            ):

                fail(
                    f"{source_id}: {field} previo no era False."
                )

            if (
                after_quality.get(
                    field
                )
                is not True
            ):

                fail(
                    f"{source_id}: {field} final no es True."
                )

        # Mastery.
        if (
            before_quality.get(
                "mastery_eligible"
            )
            is not False
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: mastery_eligible previo no era False."
            )

        if (
            after_quality.get(
                "mastery_eligible"
            )
            is not True
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: mastery_eligible final no es True."
            )

        # Flags: únicamente se añade el flag de esta fase.
        before_flags = list(
            before_quality.get(
                "flags",
                [],
            )
        )

        after_flags = list(
            after_quality.get(
                "flags",
                [],
            )
        )

        expected_flags = list(
            before_flags
        )

        if (
            VALIDATION_FLAG
            not in expected_flags
        ):

            expected_flags.append(
                VALIDATION_FLAG
            )

        if (
            after_flags
            != expected_flags
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: flags finales inesperados."
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Estado final exacto
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    validated_ids = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in after_items
        if (
            item.get(
                "quality",
                {},
            ).get(
                "status"
            )
            == VALIDATED_STATUS
        )
    }

    draft_ids = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in after_items
        if (
            item.get(
                "quality",
                {},
            ).get(
                "status"
            )
            == DRAFT_STATUS
        )
    }

    if (
        validated_ids
        != validation_ids
    ):

        fail(
            "El conjunto VALIDATED no coincide exactamente con las 173 candidatas."
        )

    if (
        draft_ids
        != EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS
    ):

        fail(
            "El conjunto DRAFT final no coincide exactamente con las 7 source_review."
        )

    if (
        len(
            validated_ids
        )
        != 173
        or
        len(
            draft_ids
        )
        != 7
    ):

        fail(
            "Conteo final de estados incorrecto."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Verificación final 173 / 7
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    for source_id in validation_ids:

        quality = after_by_id[
            source_id
        ][
            "quality"
        ]

        if not all(
            quality.get(
                field
            )
            is True
            for field
            in VERIFICATION_FIELDS
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: no tiene todas las verificaciones activas."
            )

        if (
            quality.get(
                "mastery_eligible"
            )
            is not True
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: mastery_eligible no quedó True."
            )

    for source_id in EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS:

        quality = after_by_id[
            source_id
        ][
            "quality"
        ]

        if (
            quality.get(
                "status"
            )
            != DRAFT_STATUS
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: source_review dejó de estar DRAFT."
            )

        if (
            quality.get(
                "mastery_eligible"
            )
            is not False
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: source_review activó mastery."
            )

        if any(
            quality.get(
                field
            )
            is not False
            for field
            in VERIFICATION_FIELDS
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: source_review activó verificaciones."
            )

        if (
            VALIDATION_FLAG
            in quality.get(
                "flags",
                [],
            )
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: source_review recibió flag P2-D5.5."
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Fuentes siguen intactas
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    for (
        question,
        item,
    ) in zip(
        questions,
        after_items,
    ):

        source_id = question[
            "id"
        ]

        if (
            item.get(
                "source_question_id"
            )
            != source_id
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: orden fuente roto después de validación."
            )

        if (
            item.get(
                "source_question_sha256"
            )
            != canonical_sha256(
                question
            )
        ):

            fail(
                f"{source_id}: hash fuente cambió."
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Flag exacto
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    validation_flag_ids = {
        item[
            "source_question_id"
        ]
        for item
        in after_items
        if (
            VALIDATION_FLAG
            in item.get(
                "quality",
                {},
            ).get(
                "flags",
                [],
            )
        )
    }

    if (
        validation_flag_ids
        != validation_ids
    ):

        fail(
            "El flag P2-D5.5 no aparece exactamente en las 173 candidatas."
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Diff limitado exactamente a las 173 validation_candidate."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] En las 173 solo cambió quality."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Las 7 source_review permanecen idénticas."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Estado final previsto: 173 VALIDATED + 7 DRAFT."
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Mastery previsto: 173 True + 7 False."
    )


# ============================================================
# REPORTE
# ============================================================

def build_report(
    validation_ids: set[str],
    before_hash: str,
    after_hash: str,
) -> dict:

    return {
        "stage":
            "P2-D5.5",

        "substage":
            "controlled_status_validation",

        "status":
            "completed",

        "basis": {
            "audit_file":
                str(
                    FINAL_AUDIT.relative_to(
                        ROOT
                    )
                ),

            "audit_stage":
                "P2-D5.4.2",

            "required_decision":
                READY_DECISION,

            "selection_method":
                (
                    "IDs derived directly from audit items "
                    "classified validation_candidate"
                ),
        },

        "summary": {
            "items_total":
                180,

            "validated":
                173,

            "draft":
                7,

            "source_review_preserved":
                7,

            "verification_fields_enabled":
                173,

            "mastery_eligible_true":
                173,

            "mastery_eligible_false":
                7,

            "content_items_modified":
                0,

            "quality_items_modified":
                173,
        },

        "validated_ids":
            sorted(
                validation_ids
            ),

        "draft_source_review_ids":
            sorted(
                EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS
            ),

        "quality_transition": {
            "validation_candidates": {
                "status":
                    {
                        "before":
                            DRAFT_STATUS,

                        "after":
                            VALIDATED_STATUS,
                    },

                "content_verified":
                    {
                        "before":
                            False,

                        "after":
                            True,
                    },

                "answer_verified":
                    {
                        "before":
                            False,

                        "after":
                            True,
                    },

                "steps_verified":
                    {
                        "before":
                            False,

                        "after":
                            True,
                    },

                "distractors_verified":
                    {
                        "before":
                            False,

                        "after":
                            True,
                    },

                "pedagogical_reviewed":
                    {
                        "before":
                            False,

                        "after":
                            True,
                    },

                "mastery_eligible":
                    {
                        "before":
                            False,

                        "after":
                            True,
                    },
            },

            "source_review":
                "unchanged",
        },

        "safety": {
            "question_bank_modified":
                False,

            "reinforcement_bank_modified":
                False,

            "app_modified":
                False,

            "schema_modified":
                False,

            "pedagogical_content_modified":
                False,

            "source_review_promoted":
                False,

            "automatic_all_180_validation":
                False,

            "app_integration_performed":
                False,
        },

        "hashes": {
            "app":
                sha256_file(
                    APP
                ),

            "question_bank":
                sha256_file(
                    QUESTION_BANK
                ),

            "reinforcement_bank":
                sha256_file(
                    REINFORCEMENT_BANK
                ),

            "schema":
                sha256_file(
                    SCHEMA_FILE
                ),

            "explanation_bank_before":
                before_hash,

            "explanation_bank_after":
                after_hash,
        },
    }

) -> str:

    hashes = report[
        "hashes"
    ]

    lines = [
        "=" * 88,
        "P2-D5.5 - VALIDACIÓN CONTROLADA DE ESTADO",

        "",

        "Verificaciones activadas         : 173",
        "Mastery habilitado               : 173",
        "Contenido pedagógico modificado  : 0",
        "",
        "SOURCE REVIEW BLOQUEADAS",
        "-" * 88,
        ", ".join(
            sorted(
                EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS
            )
        ),
        "",
        "SEGURIDAD",
        "-" * 88,
        "question_bank modificado         : False",
        "reinforcement_bank modificado    : False",
        "app.py modificado                : False",
        "schema modificado                : False",
        "contenido pedagógico modificado  : False",
        "source_review promovidas         : False",
        "validación automática 180/180    : False",
        "integración app realizada        : False",
        "",
        "SHA-256",
        "-" * 88,
        (
            "app.py                   : "
            + hashes[
                "app"
            ]
        ),
        (
            "question_bank            : "
            + hashes[
                "question_bank"
            ]
        ),
        (
            "reinforcement_bank       : "
            + hashes[
                "reinforcement_bank"
            ]
        ),
        (
            "schema                   : "
            + hashes[
                "schema"
            ]
        ),
        (
            "explanation_bank antes   : "
            + hashes[
                "explanation_bank_before"
            ]
        ),
        (
            "explanation_bank después : "
            + hashes[
                "explanation_bank_after"
            ]
        ),
        "",
        "IMPORTANTE",
        "-" * 88,
        (
            "- Los 173 IDs se obtuvieron directamente de "
            "validation_candidate en la auditoría P2-D5.4.2."
        ),
        (
            "- Las 7 source_review permanecen DRAFT, "
            "sin verificaciones y sin mastery."
        ),
        (
            "- Esta fase no integra todavía el banco "
            "de explicaciones en app.py."
        ),
        (
            "- El siguiente paso será una auditoría "
            "post-validación independiente."

        (

            "VALIDATION COMPLETADA"
        ),
    ]

    return "\n".join(
        lines
    )


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main() -> None:

    print()

    print(
        "=" * 88
    )

    print(
        "P2-D5.5 - VALIDACIÓN CONTROLADA DE ESTADO"
    )

    print(
        "=" * 88
    )

    print()

    verify_file_preconditions()

    try:

        questions = load_json(
            QUESTION_BANK
        )

        reinforcement = load_json(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        )

        bank = load_json(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )

        audit = load_json(
            FINAL_AUDIT
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        fail(
            f"No se pudieron leer los JSON requeridos: {exc}"
        )

    if (
        len(
            reinforcement.get(
                "items",
                [],
            )
        )
        != 8
    ):

        fail(
            "reinforcement_bank debe conservar exactamente 8 ítems."
        )

    verify_bank_preconditions(
        questions,
        bank,
    )

    validation_ids = validation_ids_from_audit(
        audit
    )

    if (
        len(
            validation_ids
        )
        != 173
    ):

        fail(
            "La selección controlada no contiene exactamente 173 IDs."
        )

    candidate = build_candidate(
        bank,
        validation_ids,
    )

    validate_candidate(
        questions,
        bank,
        candidate,
        validation_ids,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # BACKUP
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if PRE_VALIDATION_BACKUP.exists():

        backup_hash = sha256_file(
            PRE_VALIDATION_BACKUP
        )

        if (
            backup_hash
            != P2D5_4_2_BANK_SHA256
        ):

            fail(
                "El backup pre-P2-D5.5 existente no coincide "
                "con el checkpoint P2-D5.4.2."
            )

        print(
            "[OK] Backup pre-P2-D5.5 existente y correcto."
        )

    else:

        shutil.copy2(
            EXPLANATION_BANK,
            PRE_VALIDATION_BACKUP,
        )

        backup_hash = sha256_file(
            PRE_VALIDATION_BACKUP
        )

        if (
            backup_hash
            != P2D5_4_2_BANK_SHA256
        ):

            fail(
                "El backup pre-P2-D5.5 se creó con hash incorrecto."
            )

        print(
            "[OK] Backup pre-P2-D5.5 creado."
        )

    before_hash = sha256_file(
        EXPLANATION_BANK
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # ESCRITURA + ROLLBACK
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    try:

        atomic_write_json(
            EXPLANATION_BANK,
            candidate,
        )

        written = load_json(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )

        if (
            written
            != candidate
        ):

            raise RuntimeError(
                "El banco escrito no coincide con el candidato validado."
            )

        # Archivos estables.
        if (
            sha256_file(
                APP
            )
            != APP_SHA256
        ):

            raise RuntimeError(
                "app.py cambió."
            )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                QUESTION_BANK
            )
            != QUESTION_BANK_SHA256
        ):

            raise RuntimeError(
                "question_bank cambió."
            )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                REINFORCEMENT_BANK
            )
            != REINFORCEMENT_BANK_SHA256
        ):

            raise RuntimeError(
                "reinforcement_bank cambió."
            )

        if (
            sha256_file(
                SCHEMA_FILE
            )
            != SCHEMA_SHA256
        ):

            raise RuntimeError(
                "schema cambió."
            )

        final_bank = load_json(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )

        validate_candidate(
            questions,
            bank,
            final_bank,
            validation_ids,
        )

        after_hash = sha256_file(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )

        if (
            after_hash
            == before_hash
        ):

            raise RuntimeError(
                "El banco no cambió tras la promoción de estado."
            )

        report = build_report(
            validation_ids,
            before_hash,
            after_hash,
        )

        atomic_write_json(
            REPORT_JSON,
            report,
        )

        atomic_write_text(
            REPORT_TXT,
            build_txt(
                report
            ),
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        print(
            f"[ERROR] Falló P2-D5.5: {exc}"
        )

        print(
            "[INFO] Restaurando checkpoint P2-D5.4.2..."
        )

        shutil.copy2(
            PRE_VALIDATION_BACKUP,
            EXPLANATION_BANK,
        )

        restored_hash = sha256_file(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        )

        if (
            restored_hash
            != P2D5_4_2_BANK_SHA256
        ):

            fail(
                "Rollback falló: el banco no volvió al checkpoint P2-D5.4.2."
            )

        fail(
            "P2-D5.5 abortado; checkpoint P2-D5.4.2 restaurado."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # RESUMEN
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    final_bank = load_json(
        EXPLANATION_BANK
    )

    final_items = final_bank[
        "items"
    ]

    validated_count = sum(
        item[
            "quality"
        ][
            "status"
        ]
        == VALIDATED_STATUS
        for item
        in final_items
    )

    draft_count = sum(
        item[
            "quality"
        ][
            "status"
        ]
        == DRAFT_STATUS
        for item
        in final_items
    )

    mastery_count = sum(
        item[
            "quality"
        ][
            "mastery_eligible"
        ]
        is True
        for item
        in final_items
    )

    print()

    print(
        "RESUMEN"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 88
    )

    print(
        "Explicaciones totales            : 180"
    )

    print(
        "VALIDATED                        :",
        validated_count,
    )

    print(
        "DRAFT                            :",
        draft_count,
    )

    print(
        "source_review preservadas        : 7"
    )

    print(
        "Verificaciones activadas         : 173"
    )

    print(
        "Mastery habilitado               :",
        mastery_count,
    )

    print(
        "Contenido pedagógico modificado  : 0"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "SOURCE REVIEW BLOQUEADAS"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 88
    )

    print(
        ", ".join(
            sorted(
                EXPECTED_SOURCE_REVIEW_IDS
            )
        )
    )

    print()

    print(
        "SEGURIDAD"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 88
    )

    print(
        "question_bank modificado         : False"
    )

    print(
        "reinforcement_bank modificado    : False"
    )

    print(
        "app.py modificado                : False"
    )

    print(
        "schema modificado                : False"
    )

    print(
        "source_review promovidas         : False"
    )

    print(
        "validación automática 180/180    : False"
    )

    print(
        "integración app realizada        : False"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "SHA-256"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 88
    )

    print(
        "app.py                   :",
        sha256_file(
            APP
        ),
    )

    print(
        "question_bank            :",
        sha256_file(
            QUESTION_BANK
        ),
    )

    print(
        "reinforcement_bank       :",
        sha256_file(
            REINFORCEMENT_BANK
        ),
    )

    print(
        "schema                   :",
        sha256_file(
            SCHEMA_FILE
        ),
    )

    print(
        "explanation_bank antes   :",
        before_hash,
    )

    print(
        "explanation_bank después :",
        sha256_file(
            EXPLANATION_BANK
        ),
    )

    print()

    print(
        "ARCHIVOS"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 88
    )

    print(
        "Backup :",
        PRE_VALIDATION_BACKUP.relative_to(
            ROOT
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Report JSON :",
        REPORT_JSON.relative_to(
            ROOT
        ),
    )

    print(
        "Report TXT  :",
        REPORT_TXT.relative_to(
            ROOT
        ),
    )

    print()

    print(
        "IMPORTANTE"
    )

    print(
        "-" * 88
    )

    print(
        "- Los 173 VALIDATED proceden exclusivamente "
        "de validation_candidate en P2-D5.4.2."
    )

    print(
        "- Las 7 source_review siguen DRAFT, "
        "sin verificaciones y sin mastery."
    )

    print(
        "- No se modificó ningún contenido pedagógico."
    )

    print(
        "- Todavía NO se integra el banco en app.py."
    )

    print(
        "- El siguiente paso será una auditoría "
        "post-validación independiente."
    )

    print()

    print(
        "RESULTADO: P2-D5.5 CONTROLLED STATUS "
        "VALIDATION COMPLETADA"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
